# Akṣayamatinirdeśa

## 10th akṣaya: Prajñā

śes rab mi zad pa la gnas pa’i byaṅ chub sems dpa’ ni chos la mi ñams pa’i byaṅ chub sems dpa’
źes bya ste, de bstan pa’i phyir btsun pa śa ra dva ti’i bu byaṅ chub sems dpa’ rnams kyi
śes rab kyaṅ mi zad pa yin te źes bya ba la sogs pa gsuṅs so – "The bodhisattva established
in the imperishability of insight is the bodhisattva not forgetting religion (prajñākṣayatāpratiṣṭhito
bodhisattvo dharmāpramuṣito bodhisattvaḥ)...".ṭ. fol. 88a6-7: de mi zad
pa yaṅ ’og nas sems can thams cad kyi sems kyi spyod pa ji sñed pa śes rab daṅ ye śes kyi
las kyaṅ de sñed do źes bya ba la sogs pa gsuṅs pas bstan te, sems can thams cad kyi sems
daṅ spyod pa nam mkha’ bźin mtha’ thug pa med pa la dmigs pas zad mi śes pa’i phyir ro; yaṅ
na sñiṅ rje chen po’i rgyu las byuṅ ba daṅ, sems can thams cad kyi phyir bsgrub pa daṅ,
śes bya mtha’ med pa’i yul la dmigs pa daṅ, rnam par mi rtog pa’i ye śes kyis zin pa’i phyir
śes rab mi zad pa źes bya’o. The imperishability of insight is explained by the fact that
its object (ālambana), the thoughts and practices (cittacarita) of all beings, is endless
like space, and thus it must itself also be imperishable, quoting Akṣ p. 8324-25 to support
this argument. Also, it is imperishable because it has great compassion as its cause
(mahākaruṇāhetuka), because it is attained for the sake of all beings, because its range is
endless, and because it is "embraced by knowledge beyond thought-constructions (nirvikalpajñānaparigṛhīta)".ṭ.
fol. 88a7-b3: śes rab mi zad pa de yaṅ rnam pa bdun lta ste: śes rab
kyi a) rnam pa daṅ, b) ’jug pa daṅ, c) ṅes pa’i tshig daṅ, d) ’bras bu daṅ, e) raṅ bźin
daṅ, f) yul daṅ, g) las (94b) rnams so. de las a) rnam pa ni thos pa’i rnam pa brgyad cu rtsa
bźis bstan, b) ’jug pa ni tshul bźin yid la byed pa la ’jug pa sum cu rtsa gcig gis bstan,
c) ṅes pa’i tshig ni rigs pa’i tshig go źes bya ba la sogs pa’i tshig gi tshar gyis bstan,
d) ’bras bu ni tshul bźin źes bya ba ni chos thams cad do źes bya ba la sogs pas bstan,
e) raṅ bźin ni ’grogs pa bcu drug daṅ lhan cig mi gnas pas bstan, f) yul ni chos brgyad
la mkhas pas bstan, g) las ni gźan yaṅ dge ba daṅ mi dge ba’i chos rnams rab tu śes pa ni
śes rab bo źes bya ba ni de la byaṅ chub sems dpas bslab par bya’o źes bya ba yan chad kyis
bstan to.These are the divisions on which our edition is based. An alternative division
is, however, given at fol. 88b3-89a1: yaṅ na śes rab mi zad pa de yaṅ 1) śes rab kyi raṅ
bźin daṅ, 2) śes rab kyi ’jug pa daṅ, 3) śes rab kyi rgyu daṅ, 4) śes rab de śes rab kyi
mi mthun pa’i phyogs daṅ ma ’dres pa daṅ, 5) śes rab kyi yul daṅ, 6) śes rab kyi ṅes pa’i
tshig daṅ, 7) śes rab kyi ’bras bu daṅ, 8) bstan pa’i bdag ñid chen po brjod pas bstan to;
de la 1) thos pa’i rnam pa brgyad cu rtsa bźi ni śes rab kyi raṅ bźin no, 2) tshul bźin yid
la byed pa la ’jug pa sum cu rtsa gñis ni śes rab kyi ’jug pa’o, 3) gźan yaṅ btsun pa śa
ra dva ti’i bu tshul bźin źes bya ba ni chos thams cad do źes bya ba la sogs pa ni śes rab
kyi rgyu’o, 4) de la śes rab ni ’grogs pa bcu drug daṅ lhan cig mi gnas so źes bya ba la
sogs pa ni śes rab de śes rab kyi mi mthun pa’i phyogs daṅ ma ’dres pa’o, 5) phuṅ po la
sogs pa chos brgyad ni śes rab kyi yul lo, 6) gźan yaṅ dge ba daṅ mi dge ba’i chos rnams rab
tu śes pa źes bya ba la sogs pa ni śes rab kyi ṅes pa’i tshig go, 7) btsun pa śa ra dva
ti’i bu de ni byaṅ chub sems dpa’ rnams kyi śes rab mi zad pa ste, śes rab mi zad pa ’dis
ye śes mi zad pa thob par ’gyur ro źes bya ba ni śes rab kyi ’bras bu’o, 8) śes rab mi zad
pa bstan pa’i chos kyi le’u ’di źes bya ba la sogs pas ni bstan pa’i bdag ñid chen po brjod
pa bstan to – 1) Essence of insight (prajñāsvabhāva), 2) entrance into insight (prajñāpraveśa),
3) cause of insight (prajñāhetu), 4) that insight is not mixed up with its contrary
(tasyāḥ prajñāyā vipakṣāsaṃsṛṣṭatā), 5) range of insight (prajñāviṣaya), 6) etymology
of insight (prajñānirukti), 7) fruit of insight (prajñāphala), 8) praising the greatness of
the teaching (nirdeśamahātmyānuśaṃsānirdeśa); 1) corresponds to a), 2) corresponds to b),
3) corresponds to d), 4) corresponds to e), 5) corresponds to f), 6) corresponds to g) except
for the last few lines, 7) is p. 8332-34 and 8) p. 8335-37. Item c) is for some reason
left out in this scheme, possibly because this paragraph deals with nirukti according to
the first scheme, while g) deals with nirukti according to the second.

śes rab de’i rnam pa ji lta bu źes bya ba ni śes rab de’i raṅ bźin ji lta bu źes bya ba’i tshig
go. ’jug pa ni ci źes bya ba ni śes rab des chos rnams kyi mtshan ñid la ji ltar rtog
ces bya ba’i tha tshig ste, ’jug pa’i sgra ni rtog par byed pa la bya’o.

de skad dris pa daṅ lan du thos pa ni rnam pa’o, tshul bźin yid la byed pa ni ’jug pa’o źes
gsuṅs te, thos pa ni śes rab kyi raṅ bźin yin la, tshul bźin yid la byed pa’i sgo nas chos
rnams kyi mtshan ñid rtogs par ’gyur bas tshul bźin yid la byed pa ni ’jug pa źes bya’o.
yaṅ na, rnam pa ni śes rab kyi raṅ bźin ji lta bu bye brag tu ’byed pa’o, de yaṅ thos pa las
śes rab kyi bye brag phyed par ’gyur te, de bas na thos pa’i rnam pa brgyad cu rtsa bźi
po de dag las śes rab ’byuṅ ba’i phyir, brgyad cu rtsa bźi po dag ni śes rab kyi bye brag
gam rnam graṅs źes bya’o. yaṅ na, śes rab de’i rnam pa ji lta bu źes bya ba ni rgyu ’dri
ba’i tshig ste, śes rab de’i rgyu gaṅ yin źes bya ba’i don to. The form (ākāra), namely learning
(śruta), is explained as the essence (svabhāva) of prajñā, but alternatively as eighty-four
forms of prajñā originating from śruta; and again, alternatively, ākāra is glossed
with hetu, "What is the cause of insight?" being the meaning of the question "What is the
form of insight?". In the Sanskrit text -ākāraṃ is clearly a bahuvrīhi in apposition to
śruta, not withstanding the yaṅ in the Tibetan text p. 622 between thos pa’i and rnam pa.

’di lta ste ’dun pa’i rnam pa daṅ źes bya ba la sogs pas thos pa’i rnam pa brgyad cu rtsa bźi
po de dag gaṅ yin pa ston te, ’dun pa ni chos ñan par ’dod pa la bya ste, ñan par ’dod pa
las thos pa daṅ śes rab ’byuṅ gi ’dod pa med na mi ’byuṅ bas de’i phyir ’dun pa ni śes rab
’byuṅ ba’i rgyur rig par bya’o. yaṅ na thos pa las ’dun pa’i rnam pa ’byuṅ gi ma thos pa
las ma yin pas thos pa ni ’dun pa ’byuṅ ba’i rgyu yin te; ’dun pa daṅ thos pa gñis gcig
gi rgyu gcig yin par blta’o. yaṅ na śes rab kyi raṅ bźin ji lta bu źes dris pa na, ’dun pa’i
rnam pa źes bya ba ni śes rab de ’dun pa’i raṅ bźin źes bya ba’i don to. de bźin du rnam
pa’i sgra ni bsam pa’i rnam pa la sogs pa lhag pa rnams la yaṅ sbyar ro – "Eagerness (chanda)
is "the wish to listen to religious teachings (dharmaśravaṇakāma)". (1) From the wish
to listen (śravaṇakāma) learning (śruta) and insight (prajñā) arise, without the wish they
do not; thus eagerness is to be understood as the cause (hetu) by which insight arises.
Or (atha vā), (2) from learning (śruta) eagerness (chanda) arises, from no learning it does
not; thus learning is the cause (hetu) by which eagerness (chanda) arises; and thus eagerness
and learning (namely insight, prajñā) are the cause of each other (chandaśrutayor itaritarahetutvaṃ
draṣṭavyam). Or (atha vā), (3) if asking what the essence (svabhāva) of insight
(prajñā) is: "It has the form of eagerness" should be taken in the meaning "that insight
has the essence of eagerness" (chandākāram iti sā prajñā chandasvabhāvety arthaḥ). In
the following items, the form of intention etc., the word form should be understood accordingly."
The alternatives are: 1. chanda cause of śruta and prajñā; chanda cause of prajñā;
2. śruta cause of chanda; chanda and śruta (=prajñā) cause of each other; 3. chanda essence
of prajñā.bsam pa’i rnam pa ni goṅ du bsam pa mi zad pa’i skabs su rgya cher bśad pa
la bya’o. de yaṅ mdor bsdu na bsam pa rnam pa gñis te, phan par bya ba’i bsam pa daṅ, bde
bar bya ba’i bsam pa’o. de la phan par bya ba’i bsam pa ni mi dge ba’i gnas nas bton nas dge
ba’i gnas su ’god par ’dod pa gaṅ yin pa’o; bde bar bya ba’i bsam pa ni sems can phoṅs
pa daṅ, mgon med pa daṅ, rten med pa rnams la ñon moṅs pa can spaṅs te phan pa’i dṅos po bsgrub
par ’dod pa gaṅ yin pa’o. Besides referring to the section on āśaya, this short definition
is given by quoting from Bbh p. 1817-21: hitādhyāśayaś ca sukhādhyāśayaś ca. tatra
hitādhyāśayaḥ yā akuśalāt sthānād vyutthāpya kuśale sthāne pratiṣṭhāpanakāmatā. sukhādhyāśayo
yā vighātinām anāthānām apratisaraṇānāṃ sattvānāṃ kliṣṭavarjitānugrāhakavastūpasaṃharaṇakāmatā.
Note that the definition from Bbh is that of adhyāśaya, not that of āśaya as in
ṭ, showing the close connection between the two concepts.lhag pa’i bsam pa’i rnam pa ni goṅ
du lhag pa’i bsam pa mi zad pa’i skabs su rgya cher bśad pa la bya’o.89b2-90a2 refers to
the section on the topic, but gives besides a shorter definition: sbyor ba’i rnam pa ni sbyor
ba mi zad pa’i skabs su rgya cher bśad pa la bya’o. de yaṅ mdor bsdus na rnam pa drug
ste: 1) phoṅs pa sel ba’i sbyor ba daṅ, 2) mos pa la sbyor ba daṅ, 3) bsgrub pa la sbyor
ba daṅ, 4) śes bźin du srid par skye ba la sbyor ba daṅ, 5) tshogs yoṅs su rdzogs par sbyor
ba daṅ, 6) dka’ bar spyod pa bzod pa la sbyor ba’o. 1) sems can dṅos po gaṅ gis phoṅs pa
de la de gtoṅ ba ni phoṅs pa sel ba la sbyor ba źes bya ste, de yaṅ sbyin pa mi zad pa’i
skabs su zas ’dod pa la zas sbyin par byed pa daṅ btuṅ ba ’dod pa la btuṅ ba sbyin par byed
pa źes bya ba la sogs pa gsuṅs pa’o. 2) mos pa la sbyor bar byed pa ni gaṅ zag la bdag med
pa daṅ chos la bdag med pa’i mtshan ñid de bźin ñid la mos par byed pa’o. 3) sgrub pa la
sbyor bar byed pa ni rtag tu gźan gyi don sgrub par byed pa ste, gaṅ sbyor ba mi zad pa’i
skabs su dge ba’i rtsa ba la rab tu gzud pa’i phyir sems can byaṅ chub kyi sems ’dzin du
’jug pa’i bsam pa ni byaṅ chub sems dpa’i sbyor ba mi zad pa’o źes bya ba la sogs pa gsuṅs
pa’o. 4) śes bźin du srid par skye ba la sbyor ba ni las daṅ ñon moṅs pa’i dbaṅ gis khams
gsum du skye ba ni ma yin gyi, smon lam gyis śes bźin du ’khor bar skye ba’o. 5) tshogs
yoṅs su rdzogs par bya ba la sbyor ba ni bsod nams daṅ ye śes kyi tshogs rdzogs par bya ba’i
phyir pha rol tu phyin pa drug la sbyod pa ste, gaṅ goṅ du sbyin pa mi zad pa’i bsam pa
ni byaṅ chub sems dpa’i sbyor ba mi zad pa ste źes bya ba la sogs pa gsuṅs so. 6) dka’ bar
spyod pa bzod pa la sbyor ba ni sems can yoṅs su smin par bya ba daṅ saṅs rgyas kyi chos
yoṅs su smin par bya ba’i phyir naṅ gi sdug bsṅal mgo daṅ rkaṅ lag la sogs pa btaṅ ba daṅ,
phyi’i sdug bsṅal graṅ ba daṅ tsha ba la sogs pa bzod pa ste, de yaṅ goṅ du btsun pa śa
ra dva ti’i bu bźi po ’di dag ni byaṅ chub sems dpa’ rnams kyi sbyor ba mi zad pa ste, bźi
gaṅ źe na? byaṅ chub kyi sems kyi sbyor ba mi zad pa daṅ, chos sbyin pa ston pa’i sbyor ba
mi zad pa daṅ, sems can yoṅs su smin par byed pa’i sbyor ba mi zad pa la sogs pas bstan
to. The six items refer to important loci on the subject supra.dge ba’i bśes gñen gyi rnam
pa źes bya ba la 1) bskyod par byed pa daṅ, 2) ’jog par byed pa daṅ, 3) stobs par byed pa
daṅ, 4) skyabs dpag tu med par byed pa ni dge ba’i bśes gñen źes bya’o. de la 1) bskyod par
byed pa ni srog gcod pa la sogs pa mi dge ba bcu spyod pa las bskyod par byed pa ste, las
ṅan pa spoṅ du ’dzud ces bya ba’i don to. 2) ’jog par byed pa ni srog gcod pa las ldog
pa la sogs pa dge ba bcu la ’god par byed pa’o. 3) stobs par byed pa ni lha daṅ mi’i bde ba
sbyin par byed pa nas bla na med pa’i byaṅ chub kyi ’bras bu’i bar du sbyin pa daṅ ’thob
pa byed pa’o. 4) skyabs dpag tu med par byed pa ni mu stegs can la sogs pa’i lta ba ṅan par
mi ltuṅ bar skyob pa daṅ, ñan thos la sogs pa’i theg pa dman par mi ltuṅ bar skyob pa daṅ,
’khor ba’i lam ṅan par mi ltuṅ ba skyob pa daṅ, sdug bsṅal gyi gnas ṅan soṅ du mi ltuṅ
bar skyob pa’o. chos thos pa las sems can thams cad 1) mi dge ba las bskyod par byed pa daṅ,
2) dge ba la ’jog par byed pa daṅ, 3) ’bras bu stobs par byed pa daṅ, 4) sdug bsṅal dpag
tu med pa las skyob par byed pas na dge ba’i bśes gñen gyi rnam pa źes bya’o. No exact
counterpart has been found, but cf. Bbh p. 23713ff: tatra katibhir ākāraiḥ samanvāgataṃ bodhisattvasya
kalyāṇamitraṃ veditavyam ...ṅa rgyal med pa ni cho rigs daṅ śes ñen la sogs pas
mi sñems pa’o.bag yod pa ni bag med pa’i gñen po ste, bag med pa yaṅ gźan las ’byuṅ ba
daṅ, bdag las ’byuṅ ba rnam pa gñis yod de; gźan las ’byuṅ ba yaṅ rnam pa gñis te, byur las
byuṅ ba daṅ, sems can las byuṅ ba’o: de la byur las byuṅ ba ni tshe rabs sṅa ma’i mi dge
ba’i las kyi ’dod chags la sogs pa mi dge ba’i rtsa ba ’byuṅ ba daṅ, srog gcod pa la sogs
pa mi dge ba’i las byed pa’o. sems can las byuṅ ba ni ’dod chags daṅ źe sdaṅ skye bar ’gyur
ba’i yul ñe bar ’oṅs pas ’dod chags la sogs pa ñon moṅs pa ’byuṅ ba’o. bdag las ’byuṅ ba
yaṅ rnam pa gñis te, lus kyi ’du ’dzi las ’byuṅ ba daṅ, log pa’i rnam par rtog pa las ’byuṅ
ba’o: de la lus kyi ’du ’dzi las ’byuṅ ba ni bdag ñid khye’u daṅ, bu mo daṅ, ’gro ba bzaṅ
mo daṅ, rgyal rigs daṅ, bram ze’i rigs la sogs pa daṅ ’dra bar mos pas ñon moṅs pa ’byuṅ
ba’o. log pa’i rnam par rtog pa las ’byuṅ ba ni ’dod pa daṅ ’dun pa daṅ gnod sems la sogs
pa la rtog pa’i rgyus ñon moṅs pa ’byuṅ ba ste, thos pa las de dag sṅon ’byuṅ ba yaṅ, spoṅ
bar byed la, phyis kyaṅ mi ’byuṅ bar byed pas na bag yod pa’i rnam pa źes bya’o.gus par
byed pa ni chos daṅ chos smra ba la brñas pa med pa ste, mdo las: dge sloṅ dag, ri dags
kyi rgyal po seṅ ge ni ri boṅ la mchoṅ na yaṅ bsgrims te, mchoṅ gi ma bsgrims par ma yin no.
rta daṅ glaṅ po la mchoṅ na yaṅ bsgrims te, mchoṅ gi ma bsgrims par ma yin no źes rgyas
par gsuṅs pa bźin du chos daṅ chos smras pa la brñas pa med par byas nas gus par ñan pa’o.’thun
par ’dzin pa ni mkhan po daṅ slob dpon la sogs pas ji skad bstan pa bźin du sgrub par
byed pa’o.bka’ blo bde ba ni phyir mi ldog pa ñan pa daṅ spyod lam gus pa bstan pa’o.bsñen
bkur byed pa ni chos daṅ chos smra ba la ci rigs par phyag ’tshal ba la sogs pa lus daṅ
ṅag gis rim gro byed pa’o. yaṅ na bsñen bkur mi byed pa’i gñen po ni bsñen bkur byed pa
ste, bsñen bkur med pa ni ñan pa khri mtho la, ’chad pa khri dma’ ba la bźag ciṅ, rkaṅ lag
brkyaṅ ba daṅ kha glal ba la sogs pas ṅan ṅon ñan pa ste, thos pa daṅ ldan pa rnams ni chos
bla mar byed pa de lta bu med de, de bas na bsñen bkur byed pa’i rnam pa źes bya’o.rna
ba blags te ñan pa ni phyi rol du g-yeṅ ba daṅ naṅ du gñid daṅ rmugs pas sems bsdus pa chos
ñan pa’i dri ma gñis med par ñan pa ste, mdo las kyaṅ: dge sloṅ dag gñis po ’di dag ni chos
ñan pa’i dri ma ste, de khyed rnams kyis spaṅ bar bya’o. gñis gaṅ źe na? sems rgod pa
daṅ źum pa’o, źes gsuṅs pa’i phyir ro.yid la byed pa ni ji skad bstan pa bźin du chos ñid
phyin ci ma log pa daṅ, dgoṅs pa phyin ci ma log par ’dzin pa ste, de la chos ñid phyin ci
ma log par ’dzin pa ni ma rig pa’i rkyen gyis ’du byed la sogs pa ’byuṅ gi rgyu med pa daṅ
mi mthun pa’i rgyu las skye bar mi rtog pa’o; dgoṅs pa phyin ci ma log pa ’dzin pa ni tshor
ba thams cad sdug bsṅal ba źes gsuṅs pa la, bde ba’i tshor ba daṅ gñis ka ma yin pa’i
tshor ba raṅ bźin gyis sdug bsṅal ba ni ma yin gyi, ’gyur ba daṅ ’du byed kyi ’du byed la
dgoṅs pa la sogs pa rtogs pa’o.rnam par mi g-yeṅ ba ni g-yeṅ ba rnam pa gsum po raṅ bźin gyis
g-yeṅ ba daṅ, phyi rol du g-yeṅ ba daṅ, naṅ du g-yeṅ ba med pa ste, de la raṅ bźin gyis
g-yeṅ ba ni chos ñan pa’i tshe mig la sogs pa’i rnam par śes pa rnams rnam pa sna tshogs
su rtog pa ’jug pa’o; phyi rol du g-yeṅ ba ni chos ñan pa’i tshe ñan par mi ’dod ciṅ skyo
ba skye la gzugs la sogs pa la rtog pa ’byuṅ ba’o; naṅ du g-yeṅ ba ni chos ñan pa’i tshe
źum pa’am rgod pa’i dbaṅ du gyur pa’o.gnas ni lus kyi spyod lam mi rgod pa ste, gnas gcig
na ’dug ciṅ ñan pa’o.rin po cher ’du śes pa ni thos pa de ñid rin po che daṅ ’dra bar dkon
pas ’du śes nas ñan pa la bya’o; yaṅ na dam pa’i chos ñan pa ni phan pa daṅ bde ba’i rgyur
’gyur ba daṅ śin tu dkon pa daṅ, bsgrub dka’ bar ’du śes bskyed nas ñan pa ni rin po cher
’du śes pa’i rnam pa źes bya’o; de la phan pa’i rgyur ’gyur ba ni lha daṅ mi’i bde ba nas
mya ṅan las ’das pa’i bar gyi bde ba ’thob pa’i rgyu yin pa’i phyir ro, bde ba’i rgyur ’gyur
ba ni mu stegs can gyi dka’ thub bdag ñid ṅal bar byed pa’i mtha’ daṅ ’dod pa la loṅs
spyod pa rnams kyi ’dod pa’i bsod nams kyi mtha’ gñis spaṅs pa dbu ma’i lam bde ba la ’jug
pa’i rgyu yin pa’i phyir ro; śin tu dkon pa ni de bźin gśegs pa brgya lam na ’jig rten du
’byuṅ źiṅ dam pa’i chos bśad pa yaṅ brgya lam na ’byuṅ ba’i phyir ro; bsgrub par dka’ ba
ni de bźin gśegs pa’i gsuṅ rab kyi tshig bźi pa’i tshigs su bcad pa gcig tsam mñan pa yaṅ
bsod nams daṅ ye śes kyi tshogs dpag tu med pas bsgrub dgos pa’i phyir ro.sman du ’du śes
pa ni thos pas dug gsum gyi nad sel bar ’gyur ba’i phyir te, de bas na ñon moṅs pa’i nad
thams cad źi bar byed pa’i rnam pa źes tshig goṅ ma gsal bar bśad do.dran pa’i snod ces bya
ba la, dran pa ñid snod yin pas na dran pa’i snod de, dran pa’i sgras ni thos pa’i śes rab
la bya’o, snod kyi sgras ni mi brjed pa’i gźi la bya ste, thos pa las yid gźuṅs pa ’byuṅ
ste, mi brjed pa’i gźi byed pas na thos pa ni dran pa’i snod kyi rnam pa źes bya’o. rtogs
pa śes pa ni bsam pa’i śes rab la bya ste, bsam pa’i śes rab kyaṅ mñam par bźag pa daṅ ma
bźag pa’i bye brag gis rnam pa gñis te, de la rtogs pa des śes pas na rtogs pa śes pa źes
bya ste, rtogs pa śes pa’i sgras ni mñam par bźag pa’i śes rab la bya’o. blo gros ’dod pa
źes bya ba la blo gros kyi sgra ni mñam par bźag pa’i śes rab la bya ste, ’di ltar thos
pa daṅ ldan pa blo che ba la dga’ bar ’gyur ba’am, yaṅ na ’dod pa źes bya ba ’bar ba’am gsal
ba lta bu la bya ste, thos pa la blo gros gsal bar ’gyur bas na blo gros ’dod pa’i rnam
pa źes bya’o. blo bsgoms pa las byuṅ ba’i śes rab la bya la, ’jug pa ni goms par byed pa
la bya ste, ’di ltar thos pa las blo la ’dris śiṅ goms pa ’byuṅ ba na thos pa ni blo la ’jug
pa’i rnam pa źes bya’o. yaṅ na dran pa de’i snod yin pas na dran pa’i snod de, dran pa
źes bya ba ni sṅon ji ltar bzuṅ ba’i chos daṅ don mi brjed pa’o, dran pa de’i snod ni thos
pa’i śes rab ste, sṅon thos pa’i gźi las dran pa ’byuṅ gi ma thos pa las ni ma yin pa’i phyir
ro. blo de la ’jug pas na blo la ’jug pa ste, blo ni thogs pa daṅ chags pa med pa’i ye
śes la bya’o, ’jug pa ni mṅon sum du byed pa ste, thos pa las de bźin rtogs pa’i ye śes
mṅon sum du ’gyur pas na thos pa ni blo la ’jug pa’i rnam pa źes bya’o. yaṅ na blo ’dis ’jug
pas na blo la ’jug pa ste, blo ni bsgom pa’i śes rab la ’jug pa ni brjod du med pa’i bdag
ñid chos bdag med pa rtogs pa la bya ste, bsgom pa’i śes rab kyis de bźin rtogs par ’gyur
ba’i phyir ro, de’i rgyu yaṅ thos pa’i śes rab yin te, de bas na skabs ’dir yaṅ thos pa
ni blo la ’jug pa’i rnam pa yin par sbyar ro.saṅs rgyas kyi chos ni ñan thos daṅ raṅ saṅs
rgyas kyi theg pa daṅ theg pa bla na med pa ste, mi ṅoms par ñan pa ni de dag ñan pa la chog
mi śes pa’o.gtoṅ ba ni ji skad du thos pa’i chos rnams ’chad pa’o, spel ba ni gaṅ zag
’ga’ tsam la phyogs gcig tsam du bar ’ga’ ’chad pa ma yin źiṅ, sems can thams cad la phyogs
kun tu rtag tu ’chad pa’o. yaṅ na gtoṅ ba spel ba ni sems kyi rgyan daṅ, sems kyi yo byad
daṅ, rnal ’byor gyi tshogs daṅ, don gyi mchog thob par bya ba’i phyir kha na ma tho ba med
pa’i sbyin pa sbyin par byed pa’o. de la 1) sus sbyin par byed, 2) su la sbyin par byed,
3) ci źig sbyin par byed, 4) cis sbyin par byed, 5) ji ltar sbyin par byed, 6) ci’i phyir
sbyin par byed ce na? smras pa: 1) sus sbyin par byed pa ni thos pa daṅ ldan pa gtoṅ ba
po’i gaṅ zag gis so. 2) su la sbyin par byed pa ni bźi la ste, sdug bsṅal ba daṅ, phan ’dogs
pa daṅ, sdug pa daṅ, khyad par can la sbyin par byed do; de la sdug bsṅal ba ni bza’ ba
daṅ bgo ba la sogs pas phoṅs pa mgon daṅ skyabs med pa’i bram ze daṅ tshoṅ pa daṅ gdol ba
la sogs pa’o; phan ’dogs pa ni pha ma daṅ sdug bsṅal dpag tu med par źugs pa las ’byin pa’i
gaṅ zag rnams so; sdug pa ni smos ’drin gaṅ dag de la byams pa’am gtam ’dres pa daṅ, phebs
par smra ba daṅ, ’grogs bśes rnams so. khyad par can ni gaṅ ñon moṅs pa gdul ba la źugs
pa’am, ñon moṅs pa btul ba’i ’bras bu la gnas pa rnams so, yaṅ na byaṅ chub sems dpa’i sbyin
pa’i gnas ni sems can thams cad de su la sbyin pa ni sems can thams cad la’o. 3) ci źig
sbyin pa ni phyi daṅ naṅ gi dṅos po’o. 4) cis sbyin pa ni sems mṅon par ’du byed pa yid
kyi las chags med pa daṅ gtoṅ ba’i lus daṅ ṅag gi las kyis so. 5) ji ltar sbyin pa ni ma
’oṅs pa la blta ba daṅ ’bras bu mthoṅ ba’i dad pas sbyin par byed pa daṅ, brñas pa med par
raṅ gi lag nas sbyin par byed pa’o. 6) ci’i phyir sbyin pa ni sems can thams cad la sñiṅ
rje’i rgyus sbyin pa ste, sbyin pa de lta bu yaṅ sems can thams cad la sñiṅ brtse ba daṅ ldan
pa, loṅs spyod thams cad rmi lam daṅ ’dra bar sñiṅ po med par ’dzin pa, gźan gyi don la
gtso bor byed pa’i gaṅ zag thos pa daṅ ldan pa rnams la ’byuṅ gi gźan las ma yin pas na
thos pa ni gtoṅ ba spel ba’i rnam pa źes bya’o.’dis ni chos daṅ zaṅ ziṅ gi sbyin pa rgya cher
byed pa bstan te, dul ba ni gñen po bsgom pa ’phel ba daṅ ldan pas mig la sogs pa’i dbaṅ
po rnams yul la mi ’jug pas dul ba daṅ, ’dod chags la sogs pa ñon moṅs pa rnams dul ba
ste, de ni rgyu’o. de lta bu dul bas na caṅ śes pa źes bya ste, caṅ śes pa ni lam draṅ po
nas ji srid bgrod par bya bar phyin par ’gro ba’i phyir te, ’di ni ’bras bu’o. de la lam draṅ
po ni thabs daṅ śes rab zuṅ du ’brel ba daṅ, ’phags pa’i lam yan lag brgyad pa daṅ, ’phags
pa’i bden pa bźi la sogs pa’o. bgrod par bya ba ni mya ṅan las ’das pa la bya ste, de
lta bu ’phags pa’i lam rgyu daṅ ’bras bu’i mtshan ñid kyaṅ thos pa las byuṅ bas na thos pa
ni dul źiṅ caṅ śes pa’i rnam pa źes bya’o.maṅ du thos pa la bsten pa ni maṅ po las rnam
pa maṅ du chos gaṅ thog mar dge ba, bar du dge ba, tha mar dge ba, don bzaṅ po, tshig ’bru
bzaṅ po, ma ’dres pa, yoṅs su rdzogs pa, yoṅs su dag pa, yoṅs su byaṅ ba źes bya ba la sogs
pa’i mdo sde phal cher thos pa la bya’o. de la maṅ po la źes bya ba ni dge ba’i bśes gñen
maṅ po la thos pa’o, rnam pa maṅ du źes bya ba ni chos de ñid la lan graṅs maṅ du thos
pa ste, de yaṅ thos pa las ’byuṅ gi, ma thos pa las ma yin pas ni thos pa ni maṅ du thos pa
la bsten pa’i rnam pa źes bya’o.bsti staṅ du byas te dga’ ba myoṅ bar byed pa źes bya ba
la, bsti staṅ du byas pa ni chos daṅ chos smra ba’i gaṅ zag la lus daṅ ṅag daṅ yid kyi bsti
staṅ du byas nas ñan pa ste, de ltar bsti staṅ du byas te mñan na dga’ źiṅ yid du ’oṅ ba
bzaṅ po daṅ ldan par ’byuṅ bas na thos pa ni bsti staṅ du byas te dga’ ba myoṅ bar byed
pa’i rnam pa źes bya’o. de la lus kyi bsti staṅ du byas te, ñan pa ni dus thams cad du lus
kyi spyod lam mi mdzes pa mi ston ciṅ ’dud pa daṅ, thal mo sbyar ba la sogs pa byed pa’o.
sems kyi gus par byas te ñan pa ni chos daṅ chos smra ba la gnod pa’i bsam pa daṅ, ’phyas
gdags pa’i bsam pa daṅ, klan ka’i bsam pa med ciṅ, chos don du gñer ba’i bsam pas bla na
med pa’i lam stobs par byed pa’i sñam du bsams nas ñan pa’o. ṅag gis gus par byed de ñan pa
ni chos smra ba’i gaṅ zag la nams kyaṅ źer ’debs pa’i tshig mi smra źiṅ rtag tu de’i yon
tan brjod par byed pa’o. thos pa las sems ma ’khrugs śiṅ źi gnas kyi mtshan ñid tiṅ ṅe ’dzin
thob par ’gyur la, źi gnas daṅ ldan pas mig la sogs pa dbaṅ po’i yul la mi ’jug ciṅ sems
rnam par rtog pa maṅ pos g-yen spyo ba med pas sems bde bar ’gyur la sems bde na lus bde
bar ’gyur bas lus bde ba’i rnam pa źes bya’o. thos pa las śes rab kyi mtshan ñid lhag mthoṅ
thob par ’gyur la, lhag mthoṅ gis the tshom daṅ yid gñis sel bar byed pas sems rab tu
dga’ ba’i rnam pa źes bya’o.brtson ’grus kyi skyon gñis so, ha caṅ brtun drags pa daṅ, g-yel
ba las phyis chos ñan pa mi ’dod pa’am, ched ’ga’ ñan ched ’ga’ mi ñan pa ni skyo ba ste,
de lta bu med pas mi skyo bar ñan pa źes bya’o.don daṅ chos daṅ nan tan ñan pa’i rnam pa
gsum gyis thob par bya ba daṅ, bśad par bya ba daṅ, bsgrub par bya ba ñan par rim bźin du
bstan to.de la don ni mya ṅan las ’das pa la bya ste, ’phags pa’i lam gyis bsgrubs pa’i
’bras bu yin pa’i phyir ro.ṭ then explains the twelvefold structure of the canonical scriptures:
chos ni gsuṅ rab kyi yan lag bcu gñis te: 1) mdo’i sde daṅ, 2) dbyaṅs kyis bsñad pa’i
sde daṅ, 3) luṅ du bstan pa’i sde daṅ, 4) tshigs su bcad pa’i sde daṅ, 5) ched du brjod
pa’i sde daṅ, 6) gleṅ gźi’i sde daṅ, 7) rtogs pa brjod pa’i sde daṅ, 8) de lta bu byuṅ ba’i
sde daṅ, 9) skyes pa rabs kyi sde daṅ, 10) śin tu rgyas pa’i sde daṅ, 11) rmad du byuṅ
ba’i chos kyi sde daṅ, 12) gtan la phab par bstan pa’i sde dag go. [1) de la mdo sde gaṅ źe
na? bcom ldan ’das kyis de daṅ de dag tu gdula ba de daṅ de dag daṅ gdula ba’i spyod pa
rnams las brtsams te, phuṅ po daṅ ldan pa’i gtam daṅ, skye mched daṅ ldan pa daṅ, rten ciṅ
’brel bar ’byuṅ ba daṅ ldan pa daṅ, zas daṅ bden pa daṅ khams daṅ ldan pa daṅ, ñan thos daṅ
raṅ saṅs rgyas daṅ de bźin gśegs pa daṅ ldan pa daṅ, dran pa ñe bar gźag pa daṅ, yaṅ dag
par spoṅ ba daṅ rdzu ’phrul gyi rkaṅ pa daṅ dbaṅ po daṅ stobs daṅ byaṅ chub kyi yan lag
daṅ ldan pa daṅ, mi sdug pa daṅ dbugs rdub pa daṅ dbyuṅ ba daṅ bslab pa daṅ śes nas dad pa
daṅ ldan pa’i gtam gsuṅs pa gaṅ yin pa dag yaṅ dag par sdud par byed pa rnams kyis yoṅs su
bzuṅ nas bstan pa yun riṅ du gnas par bya ba’i don du miṅ daṅ tshig daṅ yi ge’i tshogs mthun
pa dag gis ci rigs par rim gyis bkod ciṅ sbyar ba gaṅ yin pa’o. 2) dbyaṅs kyis bsñad
pa’i sde ni gaṅ gi tha ma’i mjug tu tshigs su bcad pa mṅon par brjod pa daṅ, bkri ba’i don
gyi mdo sde gaṅ yin pa’o. 3) luṅ du bstan pa’i sde ni gaṅ las ñan thos śi ’phos pa daṅ, dus
byas pa daṅ, skye ba luṅ ston pa daṅ, ṅes pa’i don gyi mdo sde gaṅ yin pa’o. 4) tshigs
su bcad pa’i sde ni rkyaṅ pas bśad pa ma yin pa ste, ’di ltar rtsa ba gñis pa’am, gsum pa’am,
bźi pa’am, lṅa pa’am, rtsa ba drug par rtsa bsdebs te bśad pa gaṅ yin pa’o. 5) ched du
brjod pa’i sde ni gaṅ zag gi miṅ daṅ rigs yoṅs su ma brjod ma bstan par phyis dam pa’i chos
yun riṅ du gnas par bya ba’i phyir bśad pa’o. 6) gleṅ gźi’i sde ni gaṅ zag gi miṅ daṅ rigs
yoṅs su brjod ciṅ bstan te bśad pa daṅ, gaṅ daṅ ’dul ba daṅ ldan pa’i byuṅ ba daṅ bcas,
gleṅ gźi daṅ bcas pa so sor thar pa’i mdo sde gaṅ yin pa’o. 7) rtogs par brjod pa’i sde
ni dpe daṅ bcas par bstan pa ste, dpe des don gyi raṅ bźin de rnam par gsal bar ’gyur ba gaṅ
yin pa’o. 8) de lta bu byuṅ ba’i sde ni cuṅ zad sṅon gyi sbyor ba daṅ ldan pa gaṅ yin pa’o.
9) skyes pa rabs kyi sde ni ’das pa’i dus la brten te, bcom ldan ’das kyis ’chi ’pho
daṅ skye ba de daṅ de dag tu byaṅ chub sems dpa’i spyod pa daṅ dka’ bar spyod pa bstan pa
gaṅ yin pa’o. 10) śin tu rgyas pa’i sde ni gaṅ las bla na med pa yaṅ dag par rdzogs pa’i byaṅ
chub daṅ stobs bcu daṅ, sgrib pa med pa’i ye śes yaṅ dag par sgrub pa’i phyir byaṅ chub
sems dpa’ rnams kyi lam bstan pa gaṅ yin pa’o. 11) rmad du byuṅ ba’i chos kyi sde ni gaṅ
las saṅs rgyas rnams daṅ saṅs rgyas kyi ñan thos rnams kyi thun moṅ daṅ, thun moṅ ma yin
pa daṅ, de las gźan khyad par du ’phags pa’i yon tan khyad par can ṅo mtshar rmad du byuṅ
bar grags pa dag bstan pa gaṅ yin pa’o. 12) gtan la phab par bstan pa’i sde ni mdo sde ’dren
par byed ciṅ, mdo sde rnam par ’chad par byed pa, ma lta bu’i chos mṅon pa thams cad la
bya’o. gsuṅ rab yan lag bcu gñis po de dag la mdo sde yaṅ yod, ’dul ba yaṅ yod, chos mṅon
pa yaṅ yod de, de la re źig mdo sde daṅ, dbyaṅs kyis bsñad pa’i sde daṅ, luṅ du bstan pa’i
sde daṅ, tshigs su bcad pa’i sde daṅ, ched du brjod pa’i sde daṅ, rtogs pa brjod pa’i sde
daṅ, de lta bu byuṅ ba’i sde daṅ, skyes pa rabs kyi sde daṅ, śin tu rgyas pa’i sde daṅ,
rmad du byuṅ ba’i chos kyi sde gaṅ yin pa ni mdo sde’o. gleṅ gźi’i sde gaṅ yin pa ni ’dul
ba’o. gtan la phab par bstan pa’i sde gaṅ yin pa ni chos mṅon pa’o.] de la sde snod gsum pa
de dag las mdo sde’i mtshan ñid ni chos rnams mdor bsdus nas ston pa’o. ’dul ba’i mtshan
ñid ni chos daṅ don mṅon du byed pa ste, ñon moṅs pa btul na chos daṅ don mṅon du ’gyur ba’i
phyir ro. chos mṅon pa’i mtshan ñid ni ṅes pa’i gtam gtan la ’bebs pas chos kyi loṅs spyod
la rig par byed pa’o. de dag gi las ni mdo sde’i sde snod kyis the tshom ñe ba’i ñon
moṅs pa sel bar byed do, ’dul ba’i sde snod kyis mtha’ gñis la sbyor ba’i ñe ba’i ñon moṅs
pa sel bar byed do, chos mṅon pa’i sde snod kyis raṅ gi lta ba mchog tu ’dzin pa’i kun nas
ñon moṅs pa sel bar byed pa’o.The part in brackets is a quotation from Śbh fol. 7A23-7B25,
S p. 1361-13915, W p. 75-78, D fol. 55b6-57a1: tatra sūtraṃ katamat / yat tatra tatra bhagavatā
tāṃs tān vineyān vineyacaritāni cārabhya skandhapratisaṃyuktā vā kathā kṛtā dhātupratisaṃyuktā
(4) vā kathā kṛtā āyatanapratisaṃyuktā vā pratītyasamutpādapratisaṃyuktā vā
āhārasatyadhātupratisaṃyuktā vā śrāvakapratyekabuddhatathāgatapratisaṃyuktā vā smṛtyupasthānasamyakprahāṇarddhipādendriyabalabodhyaṃgamārgāṃgapratisaṃyuktā
vā aśubhānāpānasmṛtiśikṣāvetyaprasādapra(5)tisaṃyuktā
kathā kṛtā sā ca kathā saṃgītikāraiḥ parigṛhya śāsanacirasthitaye
yathāyogam anupūrvveṇa racitā anupūrvveṇa samāyuktā / pratirūpair nāmakāyapadakāyavyaṃjanakāyair
[yad uta teṣāṃ teṣām arthānāṃ sūcanāyai kuśalānām arthopasaṃhitānāṃ brahmacaryopasaṃhitānām
idam ucyate sūtram] / geyaṃ [katamat /] (6) yasyānte paryavasāne gāthā abhigītā
/ yac ca sūtraṃ neyārtham [idam ucyate geyaṃ] / vyākaraṇaṃ [katamat |] yasmiṃ chrāvako
’bhyatītakālagata upapattau vyākriyate / yac ca sūtraṃ nītārtham [idam ucyate vyākaraṇaṃ]
/ gāthā [katamā /] yā na gadyena bhāṣitā / api tu pādopanibandhena dvipadā vā tripadā vā
catuṣpadā vā paṃcapadā vā ṣaṭpadā vā [iyam ucyate gāthā] / udānā [katamā /] yat pudgalasya
nāmagotram aparikīrtayitvā uddiśya bhāṣitam āyatyāṃ vā saddharmasthitaye [śāsanasthitaye
ca / iyam ucyate udānā] / nidānaṃ [katamat /] yat pudgalasya nāmagotraṃ parikīrtayitvā uddiśya
bhāṣitam / (7B2) yac ca vinayapratisaṃyuktaṃ sotpattikaṃ sanidānaṃ prātimokṣasūtram
[idam ucyate nidānaṃ] / avadānaṃ [katamat /] yat sadṛṣṭāntakam udāhṛtaṃ / yena dṛṣṭāntena
yasya prakṛtasyārthasya vyavadānaṃ bhavat[īdam ucyate avadānaṃ] / vṛttakaṃ [katamat /] yat
kiṃcit pūrvvayogapratisaṃyuktam [idam ucyate vṛttakaṃ] / jātakaṃ (2) [katamat /] yad atītam
adhvānam upādāya tatra tatra bhagavataḥ cyutyupapādeṣu bodhisatvacaryā duṣkaracaryā ākhyātā
[idam ucyate jātakaṃ] / vaipulyaṃ [katamat /] yatra bodhisatvānāṃ mārgo deśyate anuttarāyai
samyaksaṃbodhaye daśabalānāvaraṇajñānasamudāgamāya [idam ucyate vaipulyaṃ] / adbhutā
dharmāḥ [katame /] yatra bu(3)ddhānāñ ca buddhaśrāvakāṇāñ ca [bhikṣūṇāñ ca bhikṣūṇīnāñ ca
śikṣamāṇānāṃ śrāmaṇerāṇāṃ śrāmaṇerīṇām upāsakānām upāsikānāṃ] sādhāraṇāsādhāraṇāś ca tadanyaprativiśiṣṭāś
cāścaryādbhutasammatā guṇaviśeṣā ākhyātā [ime ucyante adbhutā dharmāḥ] /
upadeśāḥ [katame /] sarvvamātṛkā abhidharmaḥ sūtrāntaniṣkarṣaḥ / sūtrāntavyākhyāna(4)m [upadeśa
ity ucyate] / tac caitad dvādaśāṃgavacogatam asti sūtram asti vinayaḥ asty abhidharmaḥ
/ tatra yat tāvad āha sūtraṃ geyaṃ vyākaraṇaṃ gāthodānāvadānavṛttakajātakavaipulyādbhutadharmā
