byed de źes bya ba ni mtshan ñid kyi bden pa khoṅ du chud pas don dam pa daṅ, kun rdzob
kyi bden pa daṅ, sdug bsṅal daṅ, kun ’byuṅ ba daṅ, ’gog pa daṅ, lam la sogs pa’i bden pa
rnams de bźin ñid kyi mtshan ñid du ro gcig par rtogs kyaṅ thabs rnam pa sna tshogs kyis theg
pa rnam pa gsum du gar rigs rigs su sems can rnams yoṅs su smin par byed de, de lta bur
thabs daṅ śes rab kyis yoṅs su zin pa’i bden pa rtogs pa ni byaṅ chub sems dpa’i bden pa
la mkhas pa źes bya’o.ṭ. fol. 126b5-127a6 then quotes in an abridged form Paripākapaṭala
in Bbh p. 78ff, on paripāka: de la yoṅs su smin pa gaṅ źe na? de yaṅ mdor rnam pa gsum ste:
1) yoṅs su smin pa’i raṅ bźin daṅ, 2) yoṅs su smin par bya ba’i gaṅ zag daṅ, 3) yoṅs su
smin pa’i rnam pa rab tu dbye ba’o. 1) yoṅs su smin pa’i raṅ bźin ni dper na ’bras bu smin
par gyur na rdol par ’os pa daṅ ’bras bu smin nas nam kun tu bza’ bar ’os pa’i dus na yoṅs
su smin pa źes bya ba, de bźin du dge ba’i chos rnams kyi sa bon yaṅ nas yaṅ du bsten pa
daṅ ldan pas ñon moṅs pa daṅ śes bya’i sgrib pa spoṅ bar nus pa daṅ rjes su mthun pa’i lus
daṅ sems las su ruṅ ba rñed nas ñon moṅs pa daṅ śes bya’i sgrib pa spoṅ ba’i mthu daṅ ldan
pa ni yoṅs su smin pa’i raṅ bźin źes bya’o. 2) yoṅs su smin par bya ba’i gaṅ zag ni rnam
pa bźi ste, ñan thos kyi rigs can daṅ, raṅ saṅs rgyas kyi rigs can daṅ, saṅs rgyas kyi rigs
can daṅ, rigs med pa’i gaṅ zag go. de la rigs can gsum ni theg pa gsum du yoṅs su smin
par bya’o, rigs med pa’i gaṅ zag kyaṅ lha daṅ mi’i bde ’gror yoṅs su smin par bya’o. 3) yoṅs
su smin pa’i rnam pa rab tu dbye ba yaṅ mdor na gsum ste, a) dbaṅ po yoṅs su smin pa daṅ,
b) dge ba’i rtsa ba yoṅs su smin pa daṅ, c) śes pa yoṅs su smin pa’o. de la a) dbaṅ po
yoṅs su smin pa ni tshe daṅ, mdog daṅ, rigs daṅ, dbaṅ phyug phun sum tshogs pa daṅ, tshig
btsun pa daṅ, dbaṅ che bar grags pa daṅ, mir gyur pa daṅ, rig pa’i gnas rnams la mkhas pa’o.
b) dge ba’i rtsa ba yoṅs su smin pa ni gaṅ raṅ bźin gyis ñon moṅs pa śas chuṅ ba las na
raṅ bźin gyis sdig pa mi dge ba’i chos la sems mi ’jug ciṅ sgrib pa chuṅ ba daṅ, rtog pa
ñuṅ ba daṅ, draṅ źiṅ mthun par ’dzin pa yin no. c) śes pa yoṅs su smin pa ni dran pa daṅ
ldan pa, yid gźuṅs pa daṅ ldan pa, legs par smras pa daṅ ñes par smras pa’i chos rnams kyi
don kun śes par nus śiṅ lhan cig skyes pa’i śes rab kyis raṅ gi sems la yod pa’i ñon moṅs
pa sel nus pa’i mthu daṅ ldan pa’o.Bbh. p. 781-7922: tatra paripākaḥ katamaḥ. paripākaḥ samāsataḥ
ṣaḍbhir ākārair veditavyaḥ. svabhāvato ’pi paripācyapudgalato ’pi paripākaprabhedato
’pi [paripākopāyato ’pi paripācakapudgalato ’pi paripakvapudgalalakṣaṇato ’pi] ca.1) tatrāyaṃ
paripākasvabhāvaḥ kuśaladharmabīje sati kuśalānāṃ dharmāṇām āsevanānvayād yā kleśajñeyāvaraṇaprahāṇaviśuddhyanukūlā
kāyacittakarmaṇyatā kalyatā samyakprayoganiṣṭhā [yatra sthitāḥ
śāstāraṃ vā āgamyānāgamya vā śāstāraṃ bhavyo bhavati pratibalo ’nantaraṃ kleśāvaraṇaprahāṇaṃ
vā sākṣātkartuṃ jñeyāvaraṇaprahāṇaṃ vā]. tad yathā vraṇo yadā paripāṭanāya niṣṭhāgato
bhavaty anaṃtaraṃ pāṭanārhaḥ. sa paripakva ity ucyate. [ghaṭaghaṭīśarāvādi ca mṛnmayaṃ
bhāṇḍaṃ yadā paribhogāya bhavaty anantaraṃ paribhogārhaṃ. tadā paripakva ity ucyate]. phalāni
vā āmrapanasādīni yadā paribhogāya niṣṭhāgatāni bhavaṃty anantaraṃ paribhogārhāṇi.
tadā paripakvānīty ucyaṃte. evam eva kuśalānāṃ dharmāṇām āsevanānvayād yāsau samyakprayoganiṣṭhā
anantaraṃ viśuddhaye saṃvartate. sa paripākasvabhāvaḥ.2) tatra paripācyāḥ pudgalāḥ
samāsataś catvāraḥ. śrāvakagotraḥ śrāvakayāne. pratyekabuddhagotraḥ pratyekabuddhayāne. buddhagotro
mahāyāne paripācayitavyaḥ. agotrastho ’pi pudgalaḥ sugatigamanāya paripācayitavyo
bhavati. [bodhisattvānāṃ buddhānāṃ ca bhagavatāṃ ity ete catvāraḥ pudgalāḥ eṣu caturṣu vastuṣu
paripācayitavyāḥ. evaṃ paripācyapudgalataḥ paripāko veditavyaḥ.]3) tatra paripākaprabhedaḥ
katamaḥ. samāsataḥ ṣaḍvidhaḥ. indriyaparipākaḥ. kuśalamūlaparipākaḥ. jñānaparipākaś
ca [mṛdumadhyādhimātraś ca paripākaḥ].a) tatrendriyaparipāko yā āyurvarṇakulaiśvaryasaṃpad
ādeyavacanatā maheśākhyatā manuṣyatvaṃ [mahotsāhatā yām āśrayaparipākaphalasaṃpadam āgamya
bhavyo bhavaty ātaptānuyogāyāparikhinnamānasaś ca] sarvavidyāsthānasamudāgamābhiyogeṣu.b)
kuśalamūlaparipākaḥ katamaḥ. yā prakṛtyā mandarajaskatāyām āgamya prakṛtyaivāsya pāpakeṣv
akuśaleṣu cittaṃ na krāmati. mandanivaraṇaś ca bhavati mandavitarkaḥ ṛjupradakṣiṇagrāhī.c)
jñānaparipākaḥ katamaḥ. smṛtimāṃ bhavati medhāvī [pratibalaś] ca bhavati subhāṣitadurbhāṣitānāṃ
dharmāṇām arthasya ājñānāya [udgrahaṇāya dhāraṇāya prativedhāya]. sahajayā prajñayā
samanvāgato bhavati yāṃ prajñām āgamya bhavyo bhavati pratibalaḥ sarvato ’tayaṃtaṃ sarvasaṃkleśāc
cittaṃ vimocayituṃ.yoṅs su smin par byed pa ni theg pa gsum gyi rigs can gyi
gaṅ zag rnams so so’i theg pa’i chos rnams daṅ po bstan pa daṅ, de nas bsam pa daṅ, bsgom
pa la sogs pa’i rim pas khad kyis ñon moṅs pa daṅ śes bya’i sgrib pa spoṅs su btsud de, raṅ
raṅ gi ’bras bu la ’god pa’o. The last paragraph of ṭ summarizes the rest of the Bbh-chapter.Notes
to the Sanskrit text: 1) ṭ tribhir 2) Bracketed parts, here and in the following,
are not found in ṭ 3) The vraṇa and phala examples are confounded in ṭ, and the text is
also further abridged. 4) ṭ trividhaḥ

bden pa’i rnam pa gźan yaṅ bstan par bźed na gźan yaṅ bden pa rnam pa gñis te źes bya ba la
sogs pa gsuṅs te, gźan yaṅ źes bya ba ni sṅar bśad pa’i don du blta’o. ’dir yaṅ bstan pa daṅ
bśad pa’i tshul khoṅ du chud par bya ba’i phyir rnam pa gñis po gaṅ źe na? gaṅ ’di tha
sñad kyi bden pa daṅ don dam pa’i bden pa źes bya ba bstan pa’i tshul bśad do. de la tha sñad
kyi bden pa ni gaṅ dus su źes bya ba la sogs pas bśad pa’i tshul bstan to. ’jig rten gyi
tha sñad rnams bden pas na tha sñad kyi bden pa ste, ji ltar snaṅ ba tsam du bden pa’i
phyir ro. de bas na mdo las kyaṅ: ’jig rten rnams las gaṅ yod par bden pa la yaṅ de bden no
źes gsuṅs so. don dam pa ñid bden pas na don dam pa’i bden pa ste, ji ltar gnas pa las gźan
du mi ’gyur ba’i phyir ro. de bas na mdo las kyaṅ: ’dus byas rnams ni bslu bas na brdzun
pa yin gyi, ’dus ma byas ni bden pa’o źes gsuṅs so. ci’i phyir bden pa gñis bśad ce na?
’phags pa’i lam daṅ lam gyi ’bras bu bstan par bya ba’i phyir bden pa gñis bśad de: ’phags
pa’i lam bstan pa’i phyir tha sñad kyi bden pa bśad do, lam de’i ’bras bu bstan par bya
ba’i phyir don dam pa’i bden pa bśad do. yaṅ na ’jig rten pa’i śes pa’i yul daṅ ’jig rten
las ’das pa’i śes pa’i yul la dgoṅs nas bden gñis bśad de: ’jig rten pa’i śes pa’i yul la
dgoṅs nas tha sñad kyi bden pa bśad do, ’jig rten las ’das pa’i śes pa’i yul la dgoṅs nas
don dam pa’i bden pa bśad do.

de la tha sñad kyi bden pa bstan pa’i phyir tha sñad kyi bden pa ni źes bya ba la sogs pa gsuṅs
te, tshig gis mṅon par brjod pa maṅ po ni tha sñad do, brjod pa des khoṅ du chud par ’gyur
ba’i bden pa ni tha sñad kyi bden pa’o. tha sñad kyi bden pa de’aṅ rnam pa gñis te, ma
’khrul pa’i ’jig rten pa’i śes pa’i yul daṅ, ’khrul pa’i ’jig rten pa’i śes pa’i yul lo.
de la ma ’khrul pa’i ’jig rten pa’i śes pa ni rjes las thob pa dag pa ’jig rten pa’i ye śes
te, de’i yul bstan pa’i phyir gaṅ dus su bden pa smra ba ste, gaṅ ’di sdug bsṅal gyi bden
pa daṅ źes bya ba la sogs pa gsuṅs pa’o. de la gaṅ dus su bden par smra ba źes bya ba ni
de bźin khoṅ du chud pa daṅ ldan pa’i gaṅ zag rnam par mi rtog pa’i tiṅ ṅe ’dzin las laṅs
nas bdag gis ji ltar myoṅ ba’i don ’dul ba rnams yoṅs su smin pa’i dus daṅ sbyar te, rjes
las thob pa dag pa ’jig rten pa’i ye śes kyis ’di ni sdug bsṅal gyi bden pa ’di ni kun ’byuṅ
ba’i bden pa’o źes phyin ci ma log par ’chad ciṅ ston pa ni dus su bden par smra ba źes
bya’o. ’khrul pa’i ’jig rten pa’i śes pa’i yul bstan pa’i phyir ’jig rten gyi tha sñad
daṅ źes bya ba la sogs pa smras te, ’jig rten gyi tha sñad yi ge daṅ ’brel pa’i sgras bstan
pa’i brda ni ’jig rten gyi tha sñad daṅ yi ge daṅ sgra daṅ brdas bstan pa źes bya ste, ’jig
rten gyi tha sñad thams cad ni brdzun pa yin pas na ’khrul pa’o. yaṅ na gdul ba’i dus
su bden par smra ba ni tha sñad kyi bden pa źes bya ste, de la bden pa gaṅ źe na? gaṅ sdug
bsṅal gyi bden pa daṅ źes bya ba la sogs pa gsuṅs pa’o. smra ba gaṅ źe na? ’jig rten gyi
tha sñad daṅ źes bya ba la sogs pa gsuṅs te, don du na ’jig rten gyi tha sñad daṅ mthun pa’i
yi ge daṅ sgra daṅ brdas sdug bsṅal la sogs pa bden pa bźi bstan pa ni tha sñad kyi bden
pa źes bya’o.don dam pa’i bden pa bstan par bya ba’i phyir don dam pa’i bden pa ni gaṅ ’di
brjed pa med pa’i chos can mya ṅan las ’das pa źes bya ba gsuṅs te, ’jig rten las ’das
pa’i ye śes dam pa’i yul lam ’bras bu yin pas na don dam pa’o. gaṅ brjed pa med pa’i chos
daṅ ldan pa ni brjed pa med pa’i chos can te, skye ba daṅ ’jig pa med pa’i raṅ bźin thog ma
nas ṅo bo ñid kyis ’od gsal ba de bźin ñid bslu ba med pa’i chos can de ni don dam pa’i
bden pa źes bya’o – "... The essentially unborn and undestroyed, originally brilliant, true
suchness is the highest truth (anudayavyayādiprakṛtiprabhāsvarāvitathatathatādharma tad
paramārthasatyam iti)."de ci’i phyir źe na źes bya ba ni de bźin ñid de ci’i phyir bslu ba
med pa’i chos can źes bya ba źe na źes bya ba’i tha tshig go; bslu ba med pa’i chos can gyi
rgyu bstan pa’i phyir rtag tu chos kyi de bźin ñid kyi phyir, de’i rigs ni rtag pa’i phyir
ro źes bya ba gsuṅs te, de’i rigs źes bya ba ni de bźin ñid de’i raṅ bźin no. de bźin
ñid de’i raṅ bźin ni skye ba daṅ ’jig pa med pa’i raṅ bźin las gźan du mi ’gyur bas rtag pa
ste, de bas na mi bslu ba źes bya ba, ji ltar rtag ce na? rtag tu chos kyi de bźin ñid kyi
phyir te, chos kyi de bźin ñid kyi ṅo bo la ni so so’i skye bo daṅ, ’phags pa’i dus na
yaṅ de la mtshan ñid tha dad du gyur pa med pa’i phyir ro. de la mi bslu ba’i don ci raṅ bźin
gźan du gnas la gźan du mi ston pa ni mi bslu ba ste, ji ltar ’dus byas ’dus byas kyi
ṅo bo ñid du med na, de ni de’i ṅo bo ñid du snaṅ bas na bslu ba źes bya ba’i don dam pa ni
raṅ bźin gźan du mi ’gyur te, de la de bźin du ston par byed pas na mi bslu ba źes bya’o.
de bas na mdo las kyaṅ: mi bslu ba’i chos can mya ṅan las ’das pa ni bden pa gcig pu’o,
’du byed thams cad daṅ snod kyi ’jig rten ni brdzun pa bslu ba’i chos can no źes gsuṅs so.

’dir yaṅ thabs daṅ śes rab kyis yoṅs su zin pa bstan pa’i phyir ro: de la byaṅ chub sems dpa’
tha sñad kyi bden pa bstan pas kyaṅ yoṅs su mi skyo źes bya ba la sogs pa gsuṅs te, tha
sñad kyi bden pa bstan pa ni sdug bsṅal daṅ kun ’byuṅ ba la sogs pa bdag gis gźan la bśad
pa’am, gźan gyis bdag la bstan pa ste, yoṅs su mi skyo ba ni śes rab kyi tha sñad kyi bden
pa thams cad don dam par dṅos po med par khoṅ du chud pas de dag las yid byuṅ źiṅ skrag pa
daṅ dṅos por ’dzin par mi ’gyur źes bya ba’i don to. don dam pa’i bden pa mṅon sum du byed
par yaṅ mi ltuṅ la źes bya ba ni chos thams cad sgyu ma daṅ rmi lam lta bur khoṅ du chud
de, de yaṅ ma brtags na gcig tu dga’ ba tsam med pa ma yin źes rig pa’i thabs kyis yoṅs
su zin pas na, de kho na ñid ’ba’ źig la yaṅ gnas par mi byed la, thabs daṅ śes rab kyis sems
can rnams yoṅs su smin par byed pa ni byaṅ chub sems dpa’i bden pa la mkhas pa źes bya
ba’i don to.

chos ’di pa daṅ phyi rol pa rnams lta ba rnam pa sna tshogs la mṅon par źen pa’i gñen por gźan
yaṅ bden pa ni gcig ste, gñis su med do źes bya ba gsuṅs so. gñis su med do źes bya bas
ni ’dir bden pa gcig bstan pa las ma gtogs pa rnams yaṅ dag pa ma yin par ston pa’o. Cf.
Bbh. p. 29217-18; quoted supra ad ṭ fol. 122a5-7.bden pa gcig po gaṅ źe na źes khoṅ nas dris
pa daṅ de la bden pa gcig ni gaṅ ’di chos thams cad la sgro ’dogs pa med ciṅ, sgro ’dogs
par ltuṅ ba’i sems can rnams kyaṅ bden pa la rab tu gzud pa’o źes bya ba gsuṅs te, chos
thams cad brjod pa med pa’i raṅ bźin yin pa la, gal te miṅ daṅ tshig daṅ yi ge dag gis gaṅ
zag daṅ chos kyi ṅo bo ñid dam bye brag tu ’dogs na de ni sgro ’dogs pa yin te, chos rnams
kyi raṅ bźin ji skad du btags pa de dag ma yin pa’i phyir ro. de ltar chos rnams la sgro
mi ’dogs śiṅ, de bźin ñid kyi raṅ bźin du yaṅ śes par byed la, sgro ’dogs par ltuṅ ba spros
pas tshogs la mṅon par źen pa’i sems can rnams kyaṅ brjod du med pa’i bden pa de la rab
tu ’dzud pa ni bden pa gcig ces bya’o.Cf. infra.

’dir yaṅ thabs daṅ śes rab kyis bstan pa’i phyir de la byaṅ chub sems dpa’ sgro ’dogs pa’i bden
pa bstan pas kyaṅ mi skyo la źes bya ba la sogs pa gsuṅs te, de ltar bden pa gcig po de
ni tshig gi spyod yul ma yin yaṅ, sems can de la gzud pa’i thabs gźan med pas ’dus byas
daṅ ’dus ma byas źes bya ba la sogs pa’i tshig gis sgro btags nas ston pa ni sgro ’dogs pa’i
bden pa ste, de dag bstan pas kyaṅ mi skyo źes bya ba’i don to. bśad pa gźan ni sṅa ma
bźin du blta’o.

goṅ du bden pa bźi bśad pa’i rnam graṅs bstan par bźed de, sdug bsṅal gaṅ yin pa bstan pa’i
phyir gźan yaṅ phuṅ po lṅa ni sdug bsṅal ba ste, gaṅ phuṅ po lṅa rnams kyi mtshan ñid, ’di
ni sdug bsṅal źes bya’o źes gsuṅs te, de la daṅ po daṅ bar ma daṅ tha ma’i sdug bsṅal rnams
bsdus pa’i don gyis ni gzugs la sogs pa’i phuṅ po lṅa ni sdug bsṅal ba źes bya ste, de
la daṅ po’i sdug bsṅal ni skye ba’o, bar gyi sdug bsṅal ni na ba daṅ rga ba daṅ ’dod pa mi
rñed pa la sogs pa’o, tha ma’i sdug bsṅal ni ’chi ba ste, sdug bsṅal de dag ñe bar len pa’i
phuṅ po lṅa’i gnas der ’dus pas na phuṅ po lṅa ni sdug bsṅal ba źes bya ste, de la phuṅ
po lṅa rnams kyi sdug bsṅal gyi mtshan ñid gaṅ yin pa sdug bsṅal yin par ston to.ji ltar
sdug bsṅal śes pa bstan pa’i phyir gaṅ gis sdug bsṅal gyi mtshan ñid de stoṅ par rtogs pa,
’di ni sdug bsṅal la sdug bsṅal du śes pa ’phags pa’i bden pa’o źes gsuṅs te, ’phags pa ñan
thos dag ltar sdug bsṅal gyi dṅos po yod par lta ba ma yin gyi, gaṅ zag gaṅ gis goṅ du
bśad pa’i sdug bsṅal ñid kyaṅ raṅ bźin med ciṅ mi dmigs par rtogs pa, de ni sdug bsṅal la
sdug bsṅal du śes pa ’phags pa’i bden pa źes bya’o.For this kind of expression where the relative
pronoun is related to an implied correlative in the genitive cf. Rkp p. 2713-303,
e. g. ... dhāraṇīmatir bodhisattva āha / yo bhagavan na traidhātukaṃ na trīṇi saṃyojanāni
na traividyatāṃ na tṛyānatāṃ na skandhadhātvāyatanāni na kalpayati na vikalpayati na hāniṃ
na vṛddhiṃ na sāmīcīkaroty eṣa evābhisaṃbodhaḥ // ... akṣayamatir bodhisattva āha / yas trimaṇḍalapariśuddhyā
pāramitāsv abhyāsaṃ karoty anupalaṃbhayogena na rajyate na virajyata
eṣa evābhisaṃbodhaḥ // ...T1 p. 197b23 reads ṛD qiu – spṛhayati (?)

kun ’byuṅ ba gaṅ yin pa bstan pa’i phyir gaṅ phuṅ po lṅa’i sred pa’i rgyu daṅ lta ba’i rgyu
bag la ñal ’di ni kun ’byuṅ ba źes gsuṅs te, phuṅ po lṅa po de dag skyed pa’i rgyu ni phuṅ
po lṅa’i rgyu ste, de yaṅ sred pa’i rgyu daṅ lta ba’i rgyu las phuṅ po lṅa la skye’o. de
la sred pa daṅ lta ba ni sṅar bśad par zad do, sred pa daṅ lta ba de dag ñid rgyu yin pas
sred pa’i rgyu daṅ lta ba’i rgyu źes bya ste, bag la ñal yaṅ de gñis la bya’o. ji ltar kun
’byuṅ ba śes pa bstan pa’i phyir gaṅ gis sred pa’i rgyu daṅ lta ba’i rgyu de dag mi len pa
daṅ źes bya ba la sogs pa gsuṅs te, mi len pa ni sred pa daṅ lta ba la mtshan mar mi ’dzin
pa’o, sgro mi ’dogs pa ni de dag la med pa daṅ yod par mi lta ba’o, reg par mi byed pa
ni de dag gi raṅ bźin la rtog par mi byed pa’am, sred pa daṅ lta ba la spyod par mi byed pa’o;
des ni ’di skad bstan te, phuṅ po lṅa’i rgyu sred pa daṅ lta ba rnams raṅ bźin gyis mi
dmigs śiṅ dṅos po med par rtogs na kun ’byuṅ ba la kun ’byuṅ bar śes pa ’phags pa’i bden
pa źes bya’o.

’gog pa’i bden pa’i raṅ bźin gaṅ yin pa bstan pa’i phyir gaṅ phuṅ po lṅa rnams śin tu zad de
’gags nas, sṅon gyi mthar mi ’byuṅ ba daṅ źes bya ba la sogs pa gsuṅs so, śin tu zad pa ni
phuṅ po lṅa bskyed pa’i rgyu sred pa’i bag la ñal daṅ lta ba’i bag la ñal spaṅs pas skyed
ba’i rgyun chad pa’o, ’gags pa ni skye ba gźan daṅ mtshams mi sbyor źiṅ ma ’oṅs pa’i phuṅ
po skyed pa’i rgyu mi byed pa’o; yaṅ na skad cig ma re re la skye ba med pas na śin tu zad
pa źes bya’o, tshe’i ñiṅ mtshams gcig nas gcig tu mtshams sbyor źiṅ skye ba med pas na
’gag pa’o; yaṅ na skye ba’i mtshan ñid daṅ bral ba’i phyir śin tu zad pa’o, ’jig pa’i chos
daṅ bral ba’i phyir śin tu ’gag pa’o; de ñid kyi don gsal bar bstan pa’i phyir sṅon gyi mthar
mi ’byuṅ ba daṅ phyi ma’i mthar mi ’pho ba daṅ, da ltar byuṅ bar phyin pa med pa źes
bya ba gsuṅs te, sṅon gyi mthar mi ’byuṅ ba ni ’das pa’i dus su yaṅ ma skyes pa’o, phyi ma’i
mthar mi ’pho ba ni da ltar gyi dus nas phuṅ po lṅa’i rgyu las daṅ ñon moṅs pa ma lus par
spaṅs śiṅ, phuṅ po lṅa yaṅ raṅ bźin med pas ma ’oṅs pa’i dus kyi tshe daṅ mtshams sbyor
ba med pa’o, da ltar byuṅ bar phyin pa med pa ni ’das pa’i las daṅ ñon moṅs pas da ltar gyi
dus su’aṅ skyes pa med pa ste, de ltar dus sum du yaṅ phuṅ po lṅa ma skyes pa de ni ’gog
pa’i bden pa’i raṅ bźin no. ji ltar na ’gog pa’i bden pa śes pa bstan pa’i phyir de la gaṅ
gis de ltar śes pa, ’di ni źes bya ba la sogs pa gsuṅs te, phuṅ po lṅa po skye ba med pa’i
mtshan ñid la gaṅ zag gaṅ gis goṅ du bśad pa lta bur ’gog pa’i bden pa ṅo bo ñid kyis
stoṅ ste, skye ba daṅ ’gag pa med par khoṅ du chud ciṅ mi dmigs par śes pa ni ’gog pa la ’gog
par śes pa ’phags pa’i bden pa źes bya’o.

lam gyi bden pa’i raṅ bźin bstan pa’i phyir lam gaṅ la brten te, sdug bsṅal śes pa daṅ, kun
’byuṅ ba śes pa daṅ, ’gog pa śes pa la reg ciṅ źes bya ba la sogs pa gsuṅs so, lam gaṅ la
brten te źes bya ba ni sdug bsṅal daṅ kun ’byuṅ ba daṅ, ’gog pa gsum raṅ bźin gyis stoṅ par
khoṅ du chud pa’i lam gaṅ la gnas te źes bya ba’i tha tshig go, reg ciṅ źes bya ba ni sdug
bsṅal daṅ kun ’byuṅ ba gñis la nag po’i phyogs su’aṅ mi lta, ’gog pa la dkar po’i phyogs
su’aṅ mi lta źes bya ba’i don to, gñis su med pa’i ye śes su ’jog ces bya ba ni de gñis
dbyer med par khoṅ du chud ces bya ba’i don to. de ltar ’jog pa’i ye śes de ni lam ’phags
pa’i bden pa źes bya ste, sdug bsṅal ’gog par ’gro ba źes bya ba ni sdug bsṅal ’gog pa ’thob
pa’am, chud par byed pa’i lam źes bya ba’i don to. ji ltar na lam gyi bden pa śes par gyur
pa bstan pa’i phyir ro. gaṅ ’di la stoṅ pa ñid du śes pa, ’di ni lam la lam du śes pa
’phags pa’i bden pa’o źes bya ba gsuṅs te, de lta bu’i lam gyi bden pa de yaṅ stoṅ pa ñid
du rtogs te, mi dmigs par khoṅ du chud pa de ni lam la lam du śes pa ’phags pa’i bden pa źes
bya’o.

bden pa rgya cher bśad pa rnams bsdus te bstan pa’i phyir gaṅ gis ’phags pa’i bden pa bźi po
’di dag la de ltar ye śes kyis rtog ciṅ, bden pa’i rtog pas mi rtog pa, ’di ni źes bya ba
la sogs pa gsuṅs te, gaṅ gis źes bya ba ni gaṅ zag gaṅ gis so, ’phags pa’i bden pa bźi po
’di dag la źes bya ba ni sdug bsṅal la sogs pa pa bden pa bźi goṅ du bśad pa rnams la’o,
de ltar ye śes rtog ciṅ źes bya ba ni goṅ du bśad pa’i tshul du bden pa bźi po de dag ṅo bo
ñid kyis stoṅ par khoṅ du chud pa’o, bden pa’i rtog pas mi rtog pa źes bya ba ni ’phags
pa’i bden pa de dag ñid ṅo bo ñid kyis med par khoṅ du chud pas bden pa de dag la bden par
yaṅ mi ’dzin ces bya ba’i don to, de lta bu ni ’phags pa’i bden pa la mkhas pa źes bya’o.

’phags pa’i bden pa bźi’i rnam pa gźan yaṅ bśad par bźed de, sdug bsṅal gyi bden pa’i raṅ bźin
bstan pa’i phyir gźan yaṅ tshor ba thams cad sdug bsṅal te źes bya ba gsuṅs so, de la tshor
ba thams cad ni sdug bsṅal gyi tshor ba daṅ, bde ba’i tshor ba daṅ, bde ba yaṅ ma yin
sdug bsṅal ba yaṅ ma yin pa’i tshor ba’o; de la sdug bsṅal gyi tshor ba ni raṅ bźin gyis
sdug bsṅal bas sdug bsṅal ba’o, bde ba’i tshor ba daṅ bde ba yaṅ ma yin sdug bsṅal ba yaṅ
ma yin pa’i tshor ba ni mthar sdug bsṅal du ’gyur ba daṅ, ’du byed kyi sdug bsṅal gyis khyab
pas sdug bsṅal ba ste, tshor ba thams cad sdug bsṅal ba ’di ni sdug bsṅal gyi bden pa’i
raṅ bźin no.ji ltar na sdug bsṅal gyi raṅ bźin śes par ’gyur ba bstan pa’i phyir tshor ba
de la rnam par ’byed ciṅ rig par śes pa źes bya ba la sogs pa gsuṅ so, tshor ba de la źes
bya ba ni goṅ du bśad pa’i tshor ba rnam pa gsum la’o, rnam par ’byed ces bya ba ni sdug
bsṅal gyi tshor ba ni raṅ bźin gyis sdug bsṅal bas khyab pa daṅ bde ba’i tshor ba ni ’gyur
ba’i sdug bsṅal bas khyab pa daṅ, bde ba yaṅ ma yin sdug bsṅal ba yaṅ ma yin pa’i tshor ba
ni ’du byed kyi sdug bsṅal gyis khyab par bye brag phyed ciṅ źes bya ba’i don to, rig par
śes pa źes bya ba ni tshor ba de dag kyaṅ mi dmigs par khoṅ du chud ces bya ba’i don te,
goṅ du bśad pa lta bur tshor ba thams cad sdug bsṅal yin par bye brag phyed ciṅ mi dmigs
pa śes pa de ni sdug bsṅal la sdug bsṅal du śes pa ’phags pa’i bden pa źes bya’o.kun ’byuṅ
ba’i raṅ bźin bstan pa’i phyir tshor ba de rgyu gaṅ gis kun ’byuṅ ba, de ni kun ’byuṅ ba
źes bya ste źes bya ba la sogs pa gsuṅs te, goṅ du bśad pa’i tshor ba de dag rgyu gaṅ gis
bskyed ciṅ phyuṅ ba’i rgyu de ni kun ’byuṅ ba źes bya ste, tshor ba kun ’byuṅ ba’i rgyu ni
reg pa ste, reg pa las tshor ba ’byuṅ bas na reg pa la kun ’byuṅ ba źes bya’o. de bas na
mdo las reg pa’i rkyen gyis tshor ba, tshor ba’i rkyen gyis sred pa la sogs pa gsuṅs so. ji
ltar na kun ’byuṅ ba śes par ’gyur ba bstan pa’i phyir gaṅ gis rgyu de yaṅ dag pa ji lta
ba bźin du rab tu śes pa źes bya ba la sogs pa gsuṅs te,gaṅ gis śes bya ba ni gaṅ zag gaṅ
gis sam śes rab gaṅ gis śes bya ba’i don to: alternatively "that [person (pudgala)] by which
this cause is known as it is, this is [his] holy truth of knowledge of origin as origin".rgyu
de źes bya ba ni tshor ba’i rgyu reg pa ste źes bya ba’i tha tshig go. yaṅ dag pa
ji lta ba bźin du rab tu śes źes bya ba’i tshor ba ’byuṅ ba’i rgyu de stoṅ pa ñid du phyin
ci ma log par khoṅ du chud ces bya ba’i don to.’gog pa’i bden pa’i raṅ bźin gaṅ yin pa daṅ,
ji ltar na ’gog pa’i bden pa śes par ’gyur ba bstan pa’i phyir gaṅ tshor ba thams cad rgyun
chad de, tshor ba med pa yaṅ tshor źiṅ źes bya ba la sogs pa gsuṅs te, goṅ du smos pa
lta bu’i tshor ba rnam pa thams cad du rgyun chad de med par gyur pa de ni ’gog pa’i bden
pa’i raṅ bźin no, de lta bu’i tshor ba med pa ’gog pa’i bden pa phyin ci ma log par śes te,
rnam par mi rtog pa’i ye śes la yaṅ gnas la sems can la lta ba’i phyir ’gog pa’i bden pa
yaṅ mṅon du mi byed pa, de ni ’gog pa la ’gog par śes pa ’phags pa’i bden pa źes bya’o.lam
gyi bden pa’i raṅ bźin bstan pa’i phyir tshor ba gaṅ gis bsgrubs pa’i lam, de ni gziṅs
lta bu źes bya ba la sogs pa gsuṅs te, ’phags pa’i lam la gnas na tshor ba’i raṅ bźin goṅ
du bśad pa lta bur tshor ba thams cad sdug bsṅal ba’am, tshor ba de ñid ṅo bo ñid kyis stoṅ
par rtogs par byed pa’i lam de la tshor bas bsgrubs pa’i lam źes bya ste, lam de yaṅ bsgrubs
par bya ba’i chos rnams grub nas dor dgos pa’i phyir gziṅs lta bu źes bya’o; yaṅ na ’phags
pa’i lam la brten nas sdug bsṅal gyi raṅ bźin du gyur pa’i tshor ba de las sgrol źiṅ
de dag spoṅ bar byed pas na lam ni rgya mtsho las sgrol ba’i gziṅs daṅ ’dra’o. ji ltar lam
gyi raṅ bźin śes par ’gyur ba bstan pa’i phyir gaṅ tshor bar ’dod pa, de ni lam ’dod pa
ma yin no źes bya ba ni gaṅ tshor ba rnam pa gsum la chags pa de ni phyin ci log la mṅon par
źen pa yin pas, ’phags pa’i lam la gnas pa ma yin źes bya ba’i tha tshig go.

bden pa rgya cher bstan pa’i don rnams bsdus te bstan pa’i phyir de ltar bden pa bźi po ’di
mthoṅ ba daṅ źes bya ba la sogs pa gsuṅs te, gaṅ źes bya ba ni gaṅ źag gaṅ ṅo, de ltar bden
pa bźi po ’di mthoṅ źes bya ba ni goṅ du bśad pa’i tshul ltar bden pa bźi mthoṅ ba la rnam
par dag pas mñam par rtogs pa źes bya ba ni ye śes rnam par dag pas źe’am, bden pa bźi
po ñid raṅ bźin gyis rnam par dag pas bden pa thams cad mtshan ñid gcig ciṅ raṅ bźin gcig
par rtogs pa źes bya ba’i don to.

bden pa’i rnam graṅs gźan bstan par bźed de, sdug bsṅal la sogs pa’i raṅ bźin mdor bsdus nas
bstan pa’i phyir gźan yaṅ, mdor na, skye ba ni sdug bsṅal ba ste źes bya ba la sogs pa gsuṅs
so.phuṅ po lṅa mṅon par smin te, skye ba sdug bsṅal sna tshogs daṅ ldan pas na skye ba
sdug bsṅal ba źes bya’o.yaṅ na, ñiṅ mtshams sbyor bar byed pa’i las kyi bag chags bsags pa’i
khyad par de daṅ de dag gis lha daṅ mi la sogs pa’i ’gro ba de daṅ de dag tu phuṅ po daṅ,
khams daṅ, skye mched blaṅs par gyur pa ni skye ba źes bya’o.yaṅ na, skye ba rnam pa lṅa
ste: 1) chos rtogs pa’i skye ba daṅ; 2) mṅal du gnas pa’i skye ba daṅ; 3) rigs kyi gnas
phun sum tshogs pa’i skye ba daṅ; 4) sems can gyi ris mthun pa’i ṅo bo mthun par gyur pa’i
skye ba daṅ; 5) so sor byuṅ ba’i skye ba’o. 1) de la chos rtogs pa’i skye ba ni de bźin
gśegs pas bśad pa’i gsuṅ rab kyi don rtogs nas sras su gyur pa ste, de bas na mdo las kyaṅ
źal nas skyes pa, ’phags pa’i chos ’dul ba las skyes źes bya ba la sogs pa gsuṅs so; 2) mṅal
du gnas pa’i skye ba ni sa bon las myu gu, myu gu las ’dab ma bźin du mer mer po daṅ nur
nur po la sogs pa’i rim pas skyes pa’o; 3) rigs kyi gnas phun sum tshogs pa’i skye ba ni
nor bu rin po che indranīla’i rigs daṅ indranīla chen po’i rigs śes bya ba bźin du rgyal
rigs su gyur pa daṅ, bram ze’i rigs su gyur pa’o; 4) sems can gyi ris mthun par ṅo bo mthun
par skye ba ni dper na śiṅ rnam pa sna tshogs la ta la ta lar ris mthun pa daṅ, seṅ ldeṅ
seṅ ldeṅ du ris mthun pa bźin du sems can rnams la mi daṅ mir ris mthun pa la sogs pa’o;
5) so sor byuṅ ba’i skye ba ni me tog daṅ ’bras bu ’byuṅ ba bźin du phuṅ po daṅ khams daṅ
skye mched rnams byuṅ bar gyur pa ste; de ltar skye ba rnam pa lṅa las kyaṅ ’dir 1) mṅal
du gnas pa’i skye ba daṅ 5) so sor ’byuṅ ba’i skye ba la bya bar dgoṅs so. skye ba de dag
rnam pa gñis kyi phyir sdug bsṅal ba ste, gnod pa’i raṅ bźin gyis sdug bsṅal ba daṅ, sdug
bsṅal gźan gyi rten du gyur pa’i phyir ro. de la gnod pa’i raṅ bźin gyis sdug bsṅal ba ni
mi’i mṅal na źu ba’i gnas daṅ ma źu ba’i gnas kyi bar na gnas pa daṅ, mṅal nas phyir byuṅ
ba’i tshe mi gtsaṅ ba’i rdzas rnam pa sna tshogs kyis btsir ba na ri’i thim par bcug pa bźin
du yan lag la dpag tu med pa’i sdug bsṅal ’byuṅ bas na skye ba sdug bsṅal ba’o. sdug bsṅal
gźan gyi rten du gyur pa ni skye bar gyur na rga ba la sogs pa’i sdug bsṅal rnams źar
la ’byuṅ bas na skye ba sdug bsṅal ba źes bya ste, ’di ni sdug bsṅal gyi bden pa’i raṅ bźin
no. ji ltar na sdug bsṅal gyi bden pa śes par ’gyur ba bstan pa’i phyir gaṅ mi skye ba la
rtog pa’i śes pa ’di ni źes bya ba la sogs pa gsuṅs te, skye ba de ni don dam par skye ba
med ciṅ mi dmigs par rtogs pa de ni sdug bsṅal la sdug bsṅal du śes pa bden pa źes bya’o
źes bya ba’i tha tshig go.kun ’byuṅ ba’i bden pa’i raṅ bźin bstan pa’i phyir srid pa’i rkyen
gyis skye ba ste, srid pa gaṅ yin pa kun ’byuṅ ba’o źes bya ba gsuṅs te, ñiṅ mtshams sbyor
ba’i rgyur gyur pa las rnam pa sna tshogs kyi bag chags bsags pa ni srid pa źes bya’o,
rten ciṅ ’brel bar ’byuṅ ba’i yan lag bcu gñis las srid pa’i rkyen gyis skye ba źes ’byuṅ
ste, srid pa de las skye ba kun tu ’byuṅ ba’i phyir srid pa la kun tu ’byuṅ ba źes bya’o;
ji ltar kun ’byuṅ ba śes pa bstan pa’i phyir gaṅ srid pa ’jig pa śes pa źes bya ba la sogs
pa gsuṅs te, srid pa ’jig pa śes pa źes bya ba ni srid pa’i raṅ bźin med par śes pa źes
bya ba’i don to.’gog pa’i bden pa’i raṅ bźin bstan pa’i phyir skye ba thams cad ni skye ba
med pa ste, mi skye ba ni ’gog pa’o źes gsuṅs te, skye ba rnam pa lṅa bśad pa la sogs pa
phyi daṅ naṅ gi dṅos po skye ba thams cad ni don dam par na skye ba med pa ste, gaṅ skye
ba med pa mi skye ba de ni ’gog pa’i bden pa’o. ji ltar na ’gog pa’i bden pa śes pa bstan
pa’i phyir gaṅ mi skye ba de la ’gog pa gaṅ yaṅ med de źes bya ba la sogs pa gsuṅs te, ’gog
pa ni skye ba la brten pa ste, skyes par gyur na ’jig par ’gyur ba’i phyir ro, ’di ltar
ma skyes na ’jig pa med pas na ma skyes pa de la ’gog pa gaṅ yaṅ med pa źes bya’o, gaṅ ’gog
pa med par śes pa, ’di ni zad pa’i ’gog pa śes pa źes bya la, skye ba thams cad skye ba
med ciṅ mi skye ba’i mtshan ñid kyi ’gog pa gaṅ yin pa de ñid kyaṅ raṅ bźin gyis med par śes
pa ni mi skye ba’i mtshan ñid mi ’gog pa źes bya’o.lam gyi bden pa’i raṅ bźin daṅ ji ltar
lam gyi bden pa śes pa bstan pa’i phyir gaṅ de ltar bgraṅ ba’am, ’jal ba źes bya ba la
sogs pa gsuṅs te, goṅ du bśad pa ltar sdug bsṅal ci ’dra ba daṅ, kun ’byuṅ ba daṅ ’gog pa
ci ’dra ba ṅes par rtog ciṅ gtan la ’bebs la lam gyi bden pa źes bya ste, de dag phyin ci
ma log par śes pa ni lam gyi bden pa śes pa’o. bgraṅ ba daṅ ’jal ba źes bya ba ni gtan la
’bebs śiṅ śes par byed ces bya ba’i tha tshig go. yaṅ na, gaṅ gis ’phags pa’i bden pa bźi
ston pa’i mdo sde la sogs pa’i miṅ daṅ tshig daṅ yi ge rnams kyi graṅs ji sñed ’byuṅ ba la
rtog pa ni bgraṅ ba śes pa źes bya’o; gaṅ gis gñis bzuṅ nas gñis kun tu rtog pa ste, miṅ
kun tu bzuṅ nas don kun rtogs pa daṅ, don kun tu bzuṅ nas miṅ kun rtogs pa ni ’jal ba śes
pa’o; gaṅ gis ’phags pa’i bden pa’i miṅ kun ’dzin pa sṅon du byas nas don rtogs pa ’jug pa
ni tshol ba śes pa źes bya’o;ṭ. fol.133a4-b7 enumerates eleven kinds of spiritual penetration
to paraphrase prativedha: rab tu rtogs pa’i sbyor ba bcu gcig ni rtogs pa śes pa ste,
bcu gcig po śes pa gaṅ źe na? 1) glo bur du byuṅ ba rab tu rtogs pa daṅ, 2) yaṅ dag par snaṅ
ba’i rgyu mtshan rab tu rtogs pa daṅ, 3) don mi dmigs pa rab tu rtogs pa daṅ, 4) dmigs
pa mi dmigs pa rab tu rtogs pa daṅ, 5) chos kyi dbyiṅs rab tu rtogs pa daṅ, 6) gaṅ zag la
bdag med pa rab tu rtogs pa daṅ, 7) chos la bdag med pa rab tu rtogs pa daṅ, 8) bsam pa chuṅ
ṅu rab tu rtogs pa daṅ, 9) rgya chen po’i bdag ñid chen po’i bsam pa rab tu rtogs pa daṅ,
10) ji ltar chos khoṅ du chud pa’i chos rnam par gźag pa rab tu rtogs pa daṅ, 11) rnam
par gźag pa’i chos rab tu rtogs pa’o.1) ’phags pa’i bden pa bźi miṅ daṅ don du btags pa de
dag thams cad ni yaṅ dag pa ma yin pa la glo bur du btags pa yin no źes khoṅ du chud pa
ni glo bur du byuṅ ba rab tu rtogs pa źes bya’o; de ni drod kyi dus na’o. 2) dṅos po thams
cad yod pa ma yin pa la gzuṅ ba daṅ ’dzin pa lta bur snaṅ ba ni yaṅ dag par snaṅ ba’o, snaṅ
ba de dag gi rgyu yaṅ sems daṅ sems las byuṅ ba yin pas na sems daṅ sems las byuṅ ba ni
snaṅ ba’i rgyu mtshan no, gzuṅ ba daṅ ’dzin pa de dag snaṅ ba ni sems daṅ sems las byuṅ ba
la snaṅ ste źes rtogs pa ni yaṅ dag par snaṅ ba’i rgyu mtshan rab tu rtogs pa ste; ’di ni
spyi bo’i tshe na’o. 3) don ni gzugs la sogs pa phyi’i yul rnams te, de dag med par rtogs
pa ni don med dmigs par rtogs pa ste; ’di ni bzod pa’i dus so. 4) de ltar gzuṅ ba med na
’dzin pa yaṅ mi ’jug pas phyi’i yul la ’dzin pa’i sems med par rtogs pa ni dmigs pa mi dmigs
pa rab tu rtogs pa źes bya ste; de ni ’jig rten pa’i chos kyi mchog gi dus na’o. 5) de
ltar gzuṅ ba daṅ ’dzin pa gñis mi dmigs par gyur nas thams cad du ’gro ba’i don gyi de bźin
ñid rtogs pa ni chos kyi dbyiṅs rab tu rtogs pa ste; ’di ni mthoṅ ba’i lam gyi tshe’o.
6) de ltar mthoṅ ba’i lam gyi tshe ’phags pa ñan thos rnams kyis ni mthoṅ bas spaṅ bar bya
ba’i ñon moṅs pa’i sgrib pa spaṅs nas gaṅ zag la bdag med par rab tu rtogs so. 7) byaṅ chub
sems dpa’ rnams kyis ni mthoṅ bas spaṅ bar bya ba’i ñon moṅs pa daṅ śes bya’i sgrib pa
che loṅ spaṅs nas gaṅ zag daṅ chos la bdag med pa gñis rtogs so. 8) de lta bas na ’phags pa
ñan thos rnams kyis ni gaṅ zag la bdag med tsam rtogs pa daṅ, bdag gi don gyi phyir źugs
pas na bsam pa chuṅ ṅu rab tu rtogs pa źes bya’o. 9) byaṅ chub sems dpa’ rnams kyis ni gaṅ
zag daṅ chos la bdag med pa rtogs la bdag daṅ gźan gyi don gyi phyir źugs pas na de dag
gi rtogs pa ni rgya chen po’i bdag ñid kyi bsam pa rab tu rtogs pa źes bya’o. 10) sa daṅ po’i
tshe chos rnams kyi de bźin ñid khoṅ du chud pa ni ji ltar chos khoṅ du chud pa’o. de
ltar khoṅ du chud nas khoṅ du chud pa’i chos kyi yon tan rnams rtogs pa ni ji ltar khoṅ du
chud pa’i chos rnam par gźag pa rab tu rtogs pa źes bya’o. 11) de nas bsgom pa’i chos rnams
sems la yaṅ dag par ’jog ciṅ, bsgom pa’i lam gyi dus na bsgom pa’i chos daṅ yon tan rnams
rtogs pa ni rnam par gźag pa’i chos rab tu rtogs pa źes bya’o.The same enumeration is found
in Msa. p. 588-13: prativedhaprāyogikaś ca / sa punar ekādaśavidho veditavya 1) āgantukatvaprativedhataḥ,
2) saṃkhyānanimittaprativedhato, 3) ’rthānupalambhaprativedhata, 4) upalambhānupalambhaprativedhato,
5) dharmadhātuprativedhataḥ, 6) pudgalanairātmyaprativedhato,
7) dharmanairātmyaprativedhato, 8) hīnāśayaprativedhata, 9) udāramahātmyāśayaprativedhato,
10) yathādhigamadharmavyavasthānaprativedhato, 11) vyavasthāpitadharmaprativedhataś ca
/The explanations are an abbreviated form of the commentary in Sūtrālaṃkāravṛttibhāṣya mi
fol. 172a5-173a5 on Msa.ṭ. 133b7-134a2: gaṅ gis rnam pa gñis la ñe bar ’jug ste, yi ge rnams
tshad yod pa la ’jug pa daṅ, miṅ daṅ tshig gi tshad med pa la ’jug ste, de ltar ’jug
pa ni ’jug pa śes pa’o. ’di ltar bgraṅ ba daṅ, ’jal ba daṅ, tshol ba daṅ, rtogs pa daṅ, ’jug
pa rnam pa lṅa ni ’phags pa lam ste, de ltar śes na lam la lam du śes pa ’phags pa’i bden
pa źes bya’o.

ji ltar bśad pa’i don rnams bsdus te bstan pa’i phyir gaṅ bden pa’i śes pa ’di la ’jug ciṅ źes
bya ba la sogs pa gsuṅs te, bden pa’i śes pa la ’jug pa ni bden pa bźi po goṅ du bśad pa
rnams stoṅ par rtogs pa’o; bden pa’i śes pa la yaṅ mi gnas źes bya ba ni sems can gyi don
du lta bas ji ltar stoṅ par rtogs pa de ’ba’ źig gi phyogs la yaṅ gnas par mi byed ces bya
ba’i don to.

bden pa la mkhas pa bśad pa’i ’og tu rten ciṅ ’brel bar ’byuṅ ba la mkhas pa bstan pas ji ltar
bstan pa bźin du bśad par bźed nas de la byaṅ chub sems dpa’i rten ciṅ ’brel bar ’byuṅ
ba la mkhas pa gaṅ źe na źes dris so. de la źes bya ba’i don ni goṅ du smos pa daṅ ’dra’o.rgyu
daṅ rkyen la brten nas dus mñam du ’bras bu ’byuṅ ba ni rten ciṅ ’brel bar ’byuṅ ba ste,
de la mkhas pa ni rten ciṅ ’brel bar ’byuṅ ba la mkhas pa’o – "Origination of the fruit
in the same moment depending on causes and conditions is dependent origination (hetupratyayān
āśritya samānakālaphalotpādaḥ pratītyasamutpādaḥ), skill with this is skill with dependent
origination (tatra kauśalyaṃ pratītyasamutpādakauśalyam)."On samānakāla cf. Kośa p.
9616 and 1451ff.de ni de skad du rten ciṅ ’brel bar ’byuṅ ba’i mtshan ñid phyin ci ma log
par rtogs pa ni rten ciṅ ’brel bar ’byuṅ ba la mkhas pa yin par ston to. de bas na rten źes
bya ba daṅ, ’brel źes bya ba daṅ, ’byuṅ źes bya ba’i tshig gsum gyis rnam pa gsum ’gog
par byed de; rnam pa gsum ni 1) rgyu med par smra ba daṅ, 2) rgyu mi ’dra bar smra ba daṅ,
3) med par smra ba’o. de la 1) rten ces bya ba ni rgyu daṅ rkyen la brten te ’byuṅ ba yin
pas na, ’dis ni rgyu med par smra ba ’gog par byed do. 2) ’brel ces bya ba’i sgra ni mthun
pa la bya ste, rgyu daṅ ’bras bu mthun pa las skye’i, mi mthun pa las ma yin te, dper na
ma rig pa las ’du byed ’byuṅ gi, dbaṅ phyug daṅ byed pa po las mi ’byuṅ ba; ’dis ni mi mthun
pa’i rgyur smra ba ’gog par byed do. 3) ’byuṅ ba’i sgra ni rgyu daṅ ’bras bu bar chad
med par skye ba la bya ste, ’dis ni med par smra ba ’gog par byed do.Cf. Abhidharmasamuccaya
p. 2615-16: ahetuviṣamahetukātmābhiniveśatyājanārtham, p. 1008-9: balaiḥ kiṃ karma karoti
/ ahetuviṣamahetuvādaṃ pratyākhyāyākṛtābhyāgamavādeca samyagabhyudayamārgaṃ deśayati ...,
and Pras p. 1011: ahetvekahetuviṣamahetusaṃbhūtatvaṃ.ci’i phyir rten ciṅ ’brel te ’byuṅ
ba bśad ce na? ’gro ba ’di dag ma rig pa’i rkyen las skye’o. mi mthun pa’i rgyu daṅ rgyu
med pa las mi skye’o, źes bstan pa’i phyir bśad do – "Why is origination in dependence taught?
It is taught because these states of existence (gati) originate from the condition of
ignorance (avidyāpratyaya), not from some inappropriate cause (viṣamahetu) or without cause
(ahetuka)".

yaṅ na, 1) ’khor bar ’jug pa la rmoṅs pa daṅ, 2) ’khor ba las ldog pa la rmoṅs pa bsal ba’i
phyir rten ciṅ ’brel bar ’byuṅ ba lugs daṅ mthun par ’byuṅ ba daṅ, lugs las bzlog pa’i mtshan
ñid rnam pa gñis bśad do. de la 1) ’khor bar ’jug pa la rmoṅs pa ni rgyu gaṅ gis ’khor
bar skye bar ’gyur ba’i rgyu mi śes pa ste, mi śes pa de bsal ba’i phyir tshul bźin ma yin
pa kun ’byuṅ ba las ma rig pa kun ’byuṅ ṅo źes bya ba gsuṅs so. 2) ’khor ba las ldog pa
ni mya ṅan las ’das pa ste, rgyu gaṅ gis ’khor ba las ’grol źiṅ mya ṅan las ’da’ bar ’gyur
ba mi śes pa de bsal ba’i phyir tshul bźin ma yin pa ’gags pas ma rig pa ’gag ces bya ba
la sogs pa gsuṅs so.In accordance with Abhidharmasamuccaya p. 283-5: katham anulomapratilomataḥ
/ saṃkleśānulomapratilomato ’pi vyavadānānulomapratilomato ’pi pratītyasamutpādasyānulomapratilomanirdeśo
draṣṭavyaḥ // Cf. next note.de la rten ciṅ ’brel bar ’byuṅ ba lugs daṅ
mthun par ’byuṅ ba yaṅ mtshan ñid rnam pa bźir rig par bya ste: 1) yan lag rnam par dbye
ba’i mtshan ñid daṅ, 2) yan lag bsdu ba’i mtshan ñid daṅ, 3) yan lag gi kun nas ñon moṅs
pa bsdu ba’i mtshan ñid daṅ, 4) bdag med pa rkyen las ’byuṅ ba’i mtshan ñid do.yan lag rnam
par dbye ba’i mtshan ñid (1) las brtsams te gsuṅs pa ’di lta ste, tshul bźin ma yin pa
kun ’byuṅ ba las ma rig pa kun ’byuṅ ṅo źes bya ba la sogs pa’o.The divisions 1, 2 and 3 are
based on divisions 2, 3 and 6 in the treatment of pratītyasamutpāda in Abhidharmasamuccaya,
p. 2612-16: 1) lakṣaṇato ’py 2) aṅgavibhāgato ’py 3) aṅgasamāsato ’py 4) aṅgapratyayatvavyavasthānato
’py 5) aṅgakarmavyavasthānato ’py 6) aṅgasaṃkleśasaṃgrahato ’pi 7) arthato
’pi 8) gambhīryato ’pi 9) prabhedato ’py 10) anulomapratilomato ’pi pratītyasamutpannaṃ
draṣṭavyam / No. 4 is not in Abhidharmasamuccaya.Abhidharmasamuccaya p. 2617-18: katham aṅgavibhāgataḥ
/ dvādaśāṅgāni / dvādaśāṅgaḥ pratītyasamutpādaḥ avidyā saṃskārā vijñānaṃ nāmarūpaṃ
ṣaḍāyatanaṃ sparśo vedanā tṛṣṇopādānaṃ bhavo jātir jarāmaraṇaṃ ca //The paragraphs corresponding
to the divisions 2 and 3 of ṭ do not apply to the mūla, but only to the commentary
in ṭ itself. Paragraph 4, however, is again concerned with the mūla. Cf. infra.’di lta
ste źes bya ba ni tshig gi mgo draṅ ba’am, tshig gi rkyen du bźag pa’o.de la mi rtag pa
la rtag par ’du śes pa daṅ, sdug bsṅal ba la bde bar ’du śes pa daṅ, mi gtsaṅ ba la gtsaṅ
bar ’du śes pa daṅ, bdag med pa la bdag tu ’du śes pa ni tshul bźin ma yin pa ste, kun ’byuṅ
ba las śes bya ba ni tshul bźin ma yin pa kun tu skyes par ’gyur ba las ma rig pa kun
’byuṅ bar ’gyur te, ma rig pa kun du skye bar ’gyur ro, źes bya ba’i don to. ’dir tshul bźin
ma yin pa smos pa ni ma rig pa’i rgyu bstan pa’i phyir smos pa yin te, ’byuṅ ba’i don ni
lhag ma rnams la yaṅ de bźin du sbyar bar bya’o. de la 1) gcig pur ’du śes pa daṅ, 2) ril
por ’du śes pa daṅ, 3) rtag par ’du śes pa daṅ, 4) brtan par ’du śes pa daṅ, 5) ther zug
tu ’du śes pa daṅ, 6) bde bar ’du śes pa ni ma rig pa źes bya’o. 1) sa daṅ chu daṅ me daṅ
rluṅ daṅ nam mkha’ la sogs pa tha dad pa mi ’dra ba du ma ’dus pas bskyed na ’di la gcig
pur sems pa ni gcig pur ’du śes pa’o. 2) sa la sogs pa de dag kyaṅ rdul phra rab tha dad pa
las ’byuṅ ba yin na, de la gcig pur sems pa ni ril por ’du śes pa’o. 3) skad cig ma re re
la yaṅ mi rtag par gyur nas gźan daṅ gźan du gyur na, gnas nas kyaṅ bdag ces ’dzin, phyis
kyaṅ bdag ñid ’dug go sñam du sems pa ni rtag par ’du śes pa’o. 4) med pa las ’byuṅ ba la
gaṅ yod pa las skye bar ’dzin pa ni brtan par ’du śes pa’o. yaṅ na ’di dag thams cad dṅos
po med pa sgyu ma lta bu yin na, bdag ñid can du dṅos por sems pa ni brtan par ’du śes pa’o.
5) byuṅ nas med par ’gyur ba la yaṅ rdza ma’i byi ru ltar bdag ma ’oṅs pa’i dus su ’pho
bar ’dzin pa ni ther zug tu ’du śes pa’o. 6) ’jig rten gsum daṅ ’dus byas thams cad ni
sdug bsṅal gsum gyi mes gduṅs pas sdug bsṅal daṅ ldan pa yin na, gaṅ gcig pu bzaṅ po’i ṅo
bor ’dzin pa de ni bde bar ’du śes pa’o.Cf. Śālistamba p. 912-15: tatrāvidyā katamā / yaiṣām
eva ṣaṇṇāṃ dhātūnām ekasaṃjñā piṇḍasaṃjñā nityasaṃjñā dhruvasaṃjñā śāśvatasaṃjñā sukhasaṃjñā
ātmasaṃjñā sattvajīvajantupoṣapuruṣapudgalasaṃjñā manujamānavasaṃjñā ahaṃkāramamakārasaṃjñā
/ evamādi vividham ajñānam iyam ucyate ’vidyeti /de ltar kun tu gti mug pa’i rgyus
lus daṅ ṅag daṅ yid kyi las rnam pa sna tshogs byed pa ni ’du byed do. yaṅ na, ’du byed rnam
pa gsum ste, 1) bsod nams ma yin par ñe bar ’gro ba’i ’du byed daṅ, 2) bsod nams su ñe
bar ’gro ba’i ’du byed daṅ, 3) mi g-yo bar ñe bar ’gro ba’i ’du byed do. 1) de la sdig pa’i
las byed pa la mṅon par chags pa tshe rabs gźan daṅ las kyi ’bras bu la kun tu gti mug
pas med par lta ba rnams ni bsod nams ma yin pa’i las mṅon par ’du byed do. 2) ma rig pas
rmoṅs par gyur pa srid pa daṅ srid pa’i loṅs spyod la yon tan du lta źiṅ bde bar ’du śes pa
rnams ni bsod nams kyi las mṅon par ’du byed do. 3) ma rig pa’i rkyen gyis sñoms par ’jug
pa’i ro la chags par lta bas sred pa daṅ lta ba daṅ ṅa rgyal gyi śas che ba’i bsam gtan
rnams ni mi g-yo ba’i las mṅon par ’du byed de, de bas na ma rig pa kun ’byuṅ ba las ’du byed
kun ’byuṅ ba źes bya’o.Cf. Abhidharmasamuccaya p. 2626-272: avidyā kiṃkarmakā / bhave
sattvān saṃmohayati pratyayaś ca bhavati saṃskārāṇām // saṃskārāḥ kiṃkarmakāḥ / gatiṣu ca
sattvān vibhajanti pratyayāś ca bhavanti vijñānavāsanāyāḥ // Bhāṣya p. 3211-17: avidyā bhave
sattvān saṃmohayati, tad āvṛtteḥ pūrvāntāparāntamadhyāntānāṃ yathābhūtāparijñānāt / yata
evaṃ vicikitsati – kiṃ nv aham abhūvam atīte ’dhvany āho svin nāham abhūvam ity evamādi
/ pratyayaś ca bhavati saṃskārāṇām, tadvaśena punarbhavikakarmopacayāt / saṃskārā gatiṣu ca
sattvān vibhajanti, karmavaśena sattvānāṃ gatyantaragamanavaicitryāt / pratyayāś ca bhavanti
vijñānasya vāsanāyāḥ, āyatyā nāmarūpābhinirvṛttaye bījapoṣaṇāt /Cf. Śālistamba p. 119ff:
evam avidyāyāṃ satyāṃ trividhāḥ saṃskārā abhinirvartante / puṇyopagā apuṇyopagā aneñjyopagāḥ
/ ...de la ma’i mṅal du daṅ po ñid du skad cig ma gcig la źugs pa’i sems, phuṅ po daṅ
khams daṅ skye mched kyi bag chags kyis yoṅs su bsgos pa sṅon gyi las kyis ’phaṅs pa’i
sa bon thams cad pa’i kun gźi rnam par śes pa ni ’dir ’du byed kyi rkyen las byuṅ ba’i rnam
par śes pa yin par dgoṅs so. (Translated in the introduction.)Abhidharmasamuccaya p. 121-2:
cittaṃ katamat / skandhadhātvāyatanavāsanāparibhāvitaṃ sarvabījakaṃ ālayavijñānaṃ; (cf.
Bhāṣya p. 119-14); cf. also p. 272-3 and Bhāṣya p. 3217-19: vijñānaṃ karmabandhaṃ dhārayati,
saṃskārāhitavāsanāsahotpatteḥ / pratyayaś ca bhavati nāmarūpasya, mātuḥ kukṣau vijñānāvakrāntyā
nāmarūpavivṛddhigamanāt /de nas skad cig ma gñis phan chad mer mer po daṅ nur nur
po la sogs pa daṅ bcas pa’i rnam par śes pa ni miṅ daṅ gzugs so. de la miṅ ni tshor ba
daṅ, ’du śes daṅ, ’du byed daṅ, rnam par śes pa’i phuṅ po’o. gzugs ni bstan du yod la thogs
pa daṅ bcas pa daṅ, bstan du med pa la thogs pa daṅ bcas pa daṅ, bstan du yaṅ med la thogs
pa yaṅ med pa ste, de gñis gcig tu bsdoms nas miṅ daṅ gzugs źes bya’o.mig gi skye mched
nas yid kyi bar du drug ni skye mched drug go. de la mig gi skye mched ni lta ba’i bdag ñid
can daṅ ba’i raṅ bźin gzugs la dmigs par byed pa ste; lhag ma la yaṅ de bźin du sbyar ro.yul
daṅ dbaṅ po daṅ rnam par śes pa rnams rgyu daṅ ’bras bu’i mtshan ñid du dus mñam pa
ñid du tshogs pa ni reg pa’o. de la dbaṅ po daṅ yul ni rgyu’i mtshan ñid do, de gñis la brten
nas de ma thag tu rnam par śes pa skye bas na rnam par śes pa ni ’bras bu’i mtshan ñid
do.bde ba daṅ, sdug bsṅal ba daṅ, bde ba yaṅ ma yin sdug bsṅal ba yaṅ ma yin pa’i myoṅ ba
ni tshor ba źes bya’o. de la lus daṅ dbaṅ po daṅ rnam par śes pa la phan par byed pa’i bdag
ñid ni bde ba’i tshor ba’o; lus daṅ dbaṅ po daṅ rnam par śes pa la gnod par byed pa’i bdag
ñid ni sdug bsṅal gyi tshor ba’o; lus daṅ dbaṅ po daṅ rnam par śes pa la phan gnod gñi
ga mi byed pa ni bde ba yaṅ ma yin sdug bsṅal ba yaṅ ma yin pa’i tshor ba’o.sred pa daṅ sred
pa’i loṅs spyod la rgyun du spyod kyaṅ tshva chu ’thuṅs pa daṅ ’dra bar ṅoms pa daṅ tshim
pa med pa ni sred pa źes bya’o. de’aṅ dus gsum tha dad pa’i dbye bas sred pa rnam pa gsum
du ’gyur te: 1) lta ba’i sred pa daṅ, 2) mṅon par dga’ ba’i sred pa daṅ, 3) mṅon par chags
pa’i sred pa’o. de la 1) ’das pa’i dus su mthoṅ ba’i sred pa daṅ, thos pa daṅ rig pa’i
dṅos po ’gags par gyur pa rnams daṅ yaṅ phrad par ’dod pa ni lta ba’i sred pa źes bya’o.
2) ma ’oṅs pa’i dus na raṅ gi lus rnam pa sna tshogs daṅ yo byad rnam pa maṅ po daṅ ldan
par smon pa ni mṅon par dga’ ba’i sred pa’o. 3) da ltar gyi dus kyi phuṅ po daṅ yo byad la
chags pas mi gtoṅ ba ni mṅon par chags pa’i sred pa źes bya’o. yaṅ na, 1) ’dod pa’i sred
pa daṅ, 2) srid pa’i sred pa daṅ, 3) mi srid pa’i sred pa daṅ, 4) lta ba’i sred pa ste, bźi’o.
de la 1) ’dod pa’i sred pa ni mthoṅ ba daṅ bsgom pas spaṅ bar bya ba ’dod pa’i khams
kyi ’dod chags so. 2) srid pa’i sred pa ni mthoṅ ba daṅ bsgom pas spaṅ bar bya ba’i gzugs
daṅ gzugs med pa’i khams kyi ’dod chags so. 3) mi srid pa’i sred pa ni thar pa la mṅon par
chags pa’o. 4) lta ba’i sred pa ni ’jig tshogs la sogs pa lta ba lṅa la chags pa’o.de la
len pa yaṅ rnam pa bźi ste, 1) ’dod pa len pa daṅ, 2) tshul khrims daṅ brtul źugs len pa daṅ,
3) lta ba len pa daṅ, 4) bdag tu smra ba len pa’o. de la 1) ’dod chags rnam pa gsum ni
’dod pa len pa źes bya ste, a) ’dod pa’i ’dod chags daṅ, b) chos kyi ’dod chags daṅ, c) yul
gyi ’dod chags so. a) ’dod pa’i ’dod chags ni skyes pa daṅ bud med gñis kyis gñis sprod
pa las chags pa’o. b) mu stegs can gyi chos la chags pa ni chos kyi ’dod chags so. c) ’dod
pa lṅa’i yon tan la chags pa ni yul gyi ’dod chags so. 2) khyi daṅ ba laṅ la sogs pa’i dka’
thub ’dzin pa ni tshul khrims daṅ brtul źugs len pa źes bya’o. 3) chad pa daṅ rtag pa
la sogs pa lta ba sna tshogs la źugs pa ni lta ba len pa’o) 4. bdag yod par lta źiṅ chags
pa ni bdag tu smra ba len pa źes bya’o.ñiṅ mtshams sbyor ba’i rgyur gyur pa’i las rnam pa
sna tshogs kyi bag chags bsags pa ni srid pa źes bya ste, de yaṅ ’dod pa’i srid pa daṅ, gzugs
kyi srid pa daṅ, gzugs med pa’i srid pa ste, rnam pa gsum mo.las kyi bag chags rnam pa
sna tshogs pa bsags pa’i khyad par la ñiṅ mtshams sbyor ba de daṅ de dag phuṅ po daṅ khams
daṅ skye mched la sogs pa mṅon par grub pa ni skye ba źes bya’o.mer mer po daṅ, nur nur
po daṅ, mkhraṅ gyur pa daṅ, rkaṅ lag ’gyus pa nas gźon nu daṅ, laṅ tsho dar la bab pa’i bar
gyi stobs daṅ, mthu daṅ, gzi brjid daṅ, mdaṅs la sogs pa gźan du ’gyur te, ñams ni rga ba’o.
yaṅ na, laṅ tsho bcom pa daṅ, na tshod ñams pa daṅ, ’byuṅ ba chen po rnams bri ba daṅ,
’du byed rnams rñiṅs par gyur pa daṅ, lus lhod par gyur pa daṅ, yan lag rnams śig śig por
gyur pa daṅ, kha dog daṅ dbyibs mi mdzes pa daṅ, dbaṅ po rnams ñam chuṅ ba daṅ, dran pa
daṅ rtogs pa daṅ blo gros rnams rab tu ñams pa daṅ, ’jig pa la mṅon du bltas pa ni rga ba’o.
de la laṅ tsho bcom pa ni dar la bab pa med par gyur pa’o. na tshod ñams pa ni byis pa
daṅ gźon nu’i spyod pa daṅ tshul rnams bral ba’o. ’byuṅ ba chen po rnams bri ba ni sa la sogs
pa ’byuṅ ba rnams źum par gyur pa ste, śa sla ba daṅ gñer ma can du gyur pa’o. ’du byed
rnams rñiṅs par gyur pa ni dar la babs la laṅ tsho’i byad gzugs sar pa daṅ bral bar gyur
pa’o. lus lhod par gyur pa ni ldaṅ ba daṅ ’dug pa la lus lci ba’o. yan lag śig śig por gyur
pa ni rkaṅ pa daṅ lag pa la sogs pa rnams tshigs tshigs su so sor gyes śiṅ ñams daṅ mthu
med par gyur pa’o. kha dog daṅ dbyibs mi sdug pa ni śa daṅ khrag skams la rus pa phyir snaṅ
ba daṅ, khabs nag pos khebs pa daṅ, gñer ma daṅ skra dkar gyis gaṅ ba’o. dbaṅ po rnams
ñam chuṅ ba ni mig la sogs pa’i dbaṅ po rnams mthoṅ ba daṅ thos pa mi gsal ba’o. dran pa
daṅ rtogs pa daṅ blo gros rab tu ñams pa ni sṅon smras pa daṅ thos pa rnams mi dran źiṅ brjed
pa’o. ’jig pa la mṅon du bltas pa ni ’chi ba’i dus daṅ khad ñe ba’o. yaṅ na rga ba rnam
pa gñis te: rten ñams pa daṅ, brten pa ñams pa’o. de la rten ñams pa ni ’di ltar ’byuṅ ba
chen po las gyur pa, khrag daṅ śa daṅ tshil daṅ rkaṅ daṅ rus pa la sogs pa bri bas de’i
rgyus na rgyug pa daṅ rgal ba daṅ mchoṅ ba daṅ bskum pa daṅ rmyoṅ ba daṅ ’oṅ ba daṅ ’gro ba
la sogs pa’i bya ba ni mi nus śiṅ, lus kyi brtson ’grus daṅ stobs mthu chuṅ ba’o. de la
brten pa ñams pa ni mig la sogs pa’i dbaṅ po rnams lta ba daṅ ñan pa la sogs pa la mi gsal
bar ’jug ciṅ, de’i rgyus na dran pa daṅ rtogs pa daṅ blo gros la sogs pa ñams śiṅ sems kyi
stobs daṅ brtson ’grus bri ba’o. dbaṅ po rnams ñams pa las de’i rgyu ba sems daṅ sems las
byuṅ ba rnams mi mthun pa ni ’chi ba ste, sems daṅ sems las byuṅ ba rgyus med par gyur pa
na gaṅ zag de śi ba źes bya’o. de la ’chi ba yaṅ rnam pa gñis te, raṅ gi ṅaṅ gis ’chi ba
daṅ, ñe bar bcom pas ’chi ba’o. raṅ gi ṅaṅ gis ’chi ba ni tshe zad pa daṅ bsod nams zad nas
’chi ba’o. ñe bar bcom pa ni mtshon cha daṅ dbyig pa la sogs pa’i rkyen gyis śi ba’o. yaṅ
na ’chi ba rnam pa gsum ste, rjes su skad cig mas ’chi ba daṅ, ñe bar bcom pas ’chi ba
daṅ, rgyu zad pas ’chi ba’o. de la rjes su skad cig mas ’chi ba ni skad cig ma re re la yaṅ
’chi ba źes bya’o. ñe bar bcom pas ’chi ba dug daṅ mtshon la sogs pa phog nas śi ba’o. rgyu
zad pas ’chi ba ni tshe riṅ por gyur pa’i las zad pas gaṅ ’chi bar gyur pa’o. mya ṅan
daṅ smre sṅags ’don pa la sogs pa ni rga śi’i yan lag tu gtogs te, de la mdza ba daṅ bral
ba daṅ, mi mdza’ ba daṅ phrad pa’i rnam par rtog pa las skyes pa’i sems kyi gduṅ ba ni mya
ṅan ces bya’o. sems kyi gduṅ ba’i rgyu las tshig tu smra ba rnam pa sna tshogs ’byin pa ni
smre sṅags ’don pa’o. khams rnams ’khrugs pas yul mṅon du gyur pa la yaṅ dbaṅ pos ’dzin
par mi nus śiṅ rmoṅs pa’i gnod pas reg par gyur pa ni sdug bsṅal ba źes bya’o. yul mṅon du
ma gyur pa rnams dbaṅ pos gzuṅ bar chags pa skye ba ni yid mi bde ba’o. źe sdaṅ las byuṅ
ba’i rgyu lus daṅ sems ñon moṅs par gyur pa ni ’khrug pa źes bya’o. yaṅ na bu smad la sogs
pa daṅ yo byad rnams la gtoṅ mi nus śiṅ chags pa ni mya ṅan ces bya’o. mya ṅan las laṅs pa’i
tshig tu smra ba ni smre sṅags ’don pa’o. rnam par śes pa’i tshogs lṅa daṅ ldan pa’i mi
bde ba myoṅ ba ni sdug bsṅal lo. yid la byed pa daṅ ldan pa yid kyi sdug bsṅal ni yid mi
bde ba’o. gźan yaṅ de la sogs pa sṅon rgyal po’i źam ’briṅ byed byed pa las dben pa daṅ,
tshoṅ byed byed pa las khe med pa la sogs pa ñes pa byas pa rnams dran nas mi dga’ ba ni ’khrug
pa źes bya’o.1) D thabs 2) N par 3) D rtog 4) N om. ni 5) N om. daṅ 6) N ñams 7) N sṅon
8) N khas 9) N rten 10) N brten 11) N brgal 12) N blta 13...13) D om. 14) N rtog 15) D
rgyus for rgyu ba 16) N pa 17) N phogs 18) N ’chi 19) DN nas 20) N po 21) N rtogs 22) D źes
23) N rnam 24) D źabs 25) N byedde ltar rten ciṅ ’brel bar ’byuṅ ba rgyas par bśad nas,
de’i don bsdus te bstan pa’i phyir de ltar sdug bsṅal gyi phuṅ po chen po ’ba’ źig po ’di
’byuṅ bar ’gyur ro źes bya ba gsuṅs so. de ltar źes bya ba ni goṅ du bśad pa ltar na’o. sdug
bsṅal gyi phuṅ po ni sdug bsṅal gsum daṅ brgyad la sogs pa sdug bsṅal maṅ po daṅ ldan
pas so. chen po ’khor ba thog ma med pa nas rgyun du sdug bsṅal bar gyur pa’i phyir ro. ’di
źes bya ba ni gzugs la sogs pa’i chos rnams la bya’o. ’ba’ źig ni bdag daṅ bdag gi daṅ bral
ba’i phyir ro. ’byuṅ bar ’gyur ro źes bya ba ni skye bar ’gyur ro źes bya ba’i don to.The
second paragraph according to the divisions from Abhidharmasamuccaya mentioned supra,
aṅgasamāsatas, "from the point of view of summarizing the members of the pratītyasamutpāda",
does not correspond to any part of the text in the mūla, only to ṭ. in fol. 137b7-138a4:
de la yan lag bsdu ba ni de ltar rten ciṅ ’brel bar ’byuṅ ba yan lag bcu gñis su phye ba
de yaṅ bsdus na yan lag gñis su blta ste, 1) riṅ ba’i rgyu daṅ, 2) ñe ba’i rgyu’o. 1) de
la riṅ ba’i rgyu ni dper na sa bon daṅ myu gu lta bu ste, ’bras bu daṅ thag riṅ ba’i phyir
ro. 2) ñe ba’i rgyu ni me tog la sogs pa lta bu ste, ’bras bu daṅ thag ñe ba’i phyir ro –
"... 1) The distant cause is like seed and sprout (bījāṅkura), they are far from the fruit
(phala). 2) The immediate cause is like the flower, etc. (puṣpādi), it is near by the fruit
(phala).The beginning of the paragraph is possibly based on Kośabhāṣya p. 15022-5111:
tad yathā bījād aṅkurakāṇḍapattrādīnāṃ prabhavo bhavaty evaṃ kleśāt kleśakarmavastūnām / ...
yathā cānapoddhṛtamūlā vanaspatayaś chināś chinnāḥ punar api prarohanty evam anapoddhṛtakleśamūlā
gatayaḥ / yathā ca vṛkṣāḥ kālena kālaṃ puṣpaphalānāṃ prasotāro bhavanty evaṃ kleśā
apy asakṛt kleśakarmavastūnāṃ hetur bhavanti / yathā ca tuṣāvanaddās taṇḍulāḥ prarohaṇasamarthā
bhavanti na kevalā evaṃ kleśaprāptatuṣāvanaddhaṃ karma janmāntaravirohaṇe samarthaṃ
na kevalam ity evaṃ tāvat kleśo bījādivad veditavyaḥ / ... yathā ca puṣpaṃ phalotpattāv
āsannaṃ kāraṇam, evaṃ karmāṇi vipākotpattau veditavyāni /de la riṅ ba’i rgyu yaṅ rnam pa
gsum du blta ste, a) jis ’debs, b) ji ’debs, c) ji ltar ’debs pa’o. a) jis ’debs śe na? ma
rig pa daṅ, ’du byed daṅ, rnam par śes pas ’debs pa’o. b) ji ’debs śe na? miṅ daṅ gzugs
daṅ, skye mched drug daṅ, reg pa daṅ, tshor ba rnams ’debs so. c) ji ltar ’debs śe na? ma
rig pa las byuṅ ba’i ’du byed kyis ci bsgrubs pa’i bag chags kun gźi la ’debs so.ñe ba’i rgyu
yaṅ rnam pa gsum du blta ste, a) jis mṅon du phyuṅ b) ji mṅon du phyuṅ, c) ji ltar mṅon
du phyuṅ ba’o. de la a) jis mṅon du phyuṅ ba ni sred pa daṅ, len pa daṅ, srid pas mṅon du
phyuṅ ṅo. b) ji mṅon du phyuṅ ba ni skye ba’o. c) ji ltar mṅon du phyuṅ ba ni sred pa daṅ
len pas kun gźi la btab pa’i sa bon srid pa me tog lta bur kha ’bye źiṅ ’bu bar ’byin te,
de dag gi ñes dmigs bstan pa ni rga śi’o.This piece is based on Abhidharmasamuccaya 2620-23:
katham aṅgasamāsato ’pi / ākṣepakāṅgam ākṣiptāṅgam abhinirvarttakāṅgam abhinirvṛttyaṅgaṃ
ca // ākṣepakāṅgaṃ katamat / avidyā samskārā vijñānaṃ ca // ākṣiptāṅgaṃ katamat / nāmarūpaṃ
ṣaḍāyatanaṃ sparśo vedanā ca // abhinirvarttakāṅgaṃ katamat / tṛṣṇā upādānaṃ bhavaś
ca // abhinirvṛttyaṅgaṃ katamat / jātir jarāmaraṇaṃ ca //. The Bhāṣya (p. 3110-12) also has
the relative pronouns yena and yat: etāvac ca pravṛttinirdeśe nirdeṣṭavyam yad uta hetukāle
yenākṣipyate yac cākṣipyate phalakāle yenābhinirvartyate yac cābhinirvartyate tad etat
sarvam ebhir aṅgair nirdiṣṭaṃ veditavyam / ... Point c) in ṭ, the yathā, is however omitted
by these texts in both cases: "How are they thrown? The habits (vāsanā) produced by the
factors (saṃskāra) arising from ignorance (avidyā) are thrown into the store-consciousness
(ālayavijñāna). .... How they are produced: The seeds (bīja) thrown (ākṣipta) into the store-consciousness
(ālayavijñāna) by thirst (tṛṣṇā) and grasping (upādāna) open up into existence
(bhava) like a flower which opens and bloooms. To teach the calamity (ādhīnava) of
these things one mentions ageing and death (jarāmaraṇa)".Then follows the third paragraph
according to the divisions from Abhidharmasamuccaya mentioned supra, aṅgasaṃkleśasaṃgrahatas,
"from the point of view of condensing the impurities in the pratītyasamutpāda," which
also does not correspond to any part of the text in the mūla, only to ṭ. fol. 138a4-6: yan
lag gi kun nas ñon moṅs pa bsdu ba ni rten ciṅ ’brel bar ’byuṅ ba yan lag bcu gñis po ’di
dag ñon moṅs pa rnam pa gsum du bsdu ste, a) ñon moṅs pa’i kun nas ñon moṅs par bsdu ba
daṅ, b) las kyi kun nas ñon moṅs pa daṅ, c) skye ba’i kun nas ñon moṅs par bsdu ba’o. a) de
la ma rig pa daṅ, sred pa daṅ, len pa gsum ni ñon moṅs pa’i kun nas ñon moṅs par bsdu’o.
b) ’du byed daṅ, rnam par śes pa daṅ, sred pa gsum ni las kyi kun nas ñon moṅs par bsdu ste,
rnam par śes pa yaṅ las kyi bag chags kyi rten yin pas der bsdu’o. c) lhag ma rnams ni
skye ba’i kun nas ñon moṅs par bsdu’o.Abhidharmasamuccaya p. 2714-16: katham aṅgasaṃkleśasaṃgrahataḥ
/ yā cāvidyā yā ca tṛṣṇā yac copādānam ity ayaṃ kleśasaṃkleśasaṃgraha / ye ca
saṃskārā yac ca vijñānaṃ yaś ca bhava ity ayaṃ karmasaṃkleśasaṃgrahaḥ / śeṣāṇi janmasaṃkleśasaṃgrahaḥ
//

The fourth paragraph according to the divisions mentioned supra, this title is not mentioned
in Abhidharmasamuccaya; ṭ. fol. 138a6-7: bdag med pa’i rkyen las byuṅ ba’i mtshan ñid bstan
pa’i phyir g-yo ba med pa byed pa med pa źes bya ba la sogs pa gsuṅs te,g-yo ba med pa
ni ma rig pa yaṅ ’di ltar bdag gis ’du byed bskyed do sñam du mi sems la, ’du byed kyaṅ ’di
ltar bdag ni ma rig pas bskyed do sñam du sems pa med pa’i phyir ro; byed pa med pa ni ma
rig pa la sogs pa skyed pa’i rkyen tsam byed pa yin yaṅ ’du byed skyed pa la byed pa po’i
mtshan ñid ma yin pa’i phyir ro; bdag po med pa źes bya ba ni de dag la dbaṅ phyug la sogs
pa dbaṅ byed par gyur pa’i mtshan ñid kyi bdag po gaṅ yaṅ med pa’i phyir ro; yoṅs su ’dzin
pa med pa źes bya ba ni bdag daṅ sems can daṅ gaṅ zag la sogs pa sñiṅ por gyur pa gaṅ
gis kyaṅ byin gyis ma brlabs pa’i phyir ro; chos ji ltar gnas pa bźin du ’byuṅ ste źes bya
ba ni rgyu gaṅ yin pa las ’bras bu gaṅ ’byuṅ ba ni chos ji ltar gnas pa bźin du ’byuṅ ba
źes bya ste, dbaṅ phyug la sogs pa las ’du byed mi ’byuṅ gi ma rig pa’i rgyu las ’du byed
’byuṅ ba’o.gaṅ ’di la śes pa ni źes bya ba la sogs pa, ’di la źes bya ba ni ’di ltar źes bya
ba’i sgra draṅs te, gaṅ tshul bźin ma yin pa kun ’byuṅ ba las ma rig pa kun ’byuṅ ba las
skye ba kun ’byuṅ ba las rga śi la sogs pa kun ’byuṅ bar zad kyi, de las gźan pa’i g-yo
ba po daṅ byed pa po la sogs pa med par śes pa ’di ni byaṅ chub sems dpa’i rten ciṅ ’brel
bar ’byuṅ ba la mkhas pa rnams źes bya’o.

rten ciṅ ’brel bar ’byuṅ ba la mkhas pa’i rnam graṅs gźan yaṅ bstan par bźed nas gźan yaṅ gaṅ
dge ba’i rgyu las byuṅ ba’am, mi dge ba’i rgyu las byuṅ ba’am źes bya ba la sogs pa gsuṅs
so.dge ba ni srog gcod pa las phyir ldog pa la sogs pa dge ba bcu’i las kyi lam rnams so.
rgyu de las byuṅ ba ni ’dod pa’i khams su lha daṅ mir skye ba’o.mi dge ba ni srog gcod pa
mi dge ba bcu’i las kyi lam rnams so. rgyu de las byuṅ ba ni ’dod pa’i khams su ṅan soṅ
gsum du skye ba’o.mi g-yo ba ni bsam gtan daṅ sñoms par ’jug pa rnams so. rgyu de las byuṅ
ba ni gzugs daṅ gzugs med pa’i khams su skye ba’o. khams gñis kyi las la ci’i phyir mi g-yo
ba’i las śes bya źe na? de dag gi las sems rtse gcig pa’i mtshan ñid la rnam par rtog pa’i
rluṅ gis bskyod par mi nus pas na mi g-yo ba źes bya’o. yaṅ na, ji ltar ’dod pa na spyod
pa’i las ’gro ba gźan du ’gro ba yin yaṅ, de ma yin pa rkyen gźan gyi dbaṅ gis bskyod de,
’gro ba de rnam par smin pa bźin du rnam par smin pa la g-yo ba med pas na mi g-yo ba źes
bya’o. de’i don ni ’di yin te, ’dod pa na spyod pa’i sems can gyi las byas pas sbyin pa
yoṅs su btaṅ nas mi’i naṅ du mi’i loṅs spyod myoṅ bar ’gyur ba las mi de ñid kyis tshul khrims
ñams pa la sogs pa’i las byas pa’i dbaṅ gis mir skye ba’i rnam par smin pa bskyod nas
rgyal po’am blon po’i ba laṅ ṅam rtar skye ba lta bur gzugs daṅ gzugs med pa’i khams kyi
las la rnam par smin pa g-yo med pas na mi g-yo ba źes bya’o.’khor bar skye ba’i rgyu ni
’khor ba’i rgyu ste, ’di ltar dge ba daṅ mi dge ba daṅ mi g-yo ba’i las zag pa daṅ bcas pa
rnams so. rgyu de las byuṅ ba ni ’khor ba ñid do.mya ṅan las ’das par gyur pa’i rgyu ni mya
ṅan las ’das pa’i rgyu ste, ’phags pa’i lam rnams so; de las byuṅ ba ni mya ṅan las ’das
pa’o. de la mya ṅan las ’das pa’aṅ rnam pa gñis te, 1. cha gcig spaṅs pa’i mya ṅan las ’das
pa daṅ, 2. cha gñis spaṅs pa’i mya ṅan las ’das pa’o. de la 1. cha gcig spaṅs pa’i mya
ṅan las ’das pa ni mthoṅ ba daṅ bsgom pas spaṅ bar bya ba’i ñon moṅs pa’i cha spaṅs te, phuṅ
po’i lhag ma daṅ bcas pa’i mya ṅan las ’das pa’o. 2. cha gñis spaṅs pa’i mya ṅan las ’das
pa ni ji ltar ñon moṅs pa’i cha spaṅs pa bźin du phuṅ po’i cha yaṅ spaṅs pa ste, phuṅ
po’i lhag ma yaṅ ma lus par spaṅs pa’i mya ṅan las ’das pa’o.de dag thams cad ces bya ba ni
goṅ du bśad pa’i dge ba’i rgyu daṅ, mi dge ba’i rgyu daṅ, mi g-yo ba’i rgyu daṅ, ’khor ba’i
rgyu daṅ, mya ṅan las ’das pa’i rgyu las byuṅ ba de dag thams cad ces bya ba’i don to.139a6-b3
says: sems can gaṅ dbaṅ po’i rgyu la jug pa tshad mar byed pa, de ni dbaṅ po’i rgyu
las byuṅ źiṅ, las kyi rgyu las byuṅ ba ste ’bras bu’i rgyu grub par byed do źes bya ba
la, dbaṅ po ñid dge ba daṅ, mi dge ba daṅ, ’khor ba daṅ, mya ṅan las ’das pa rnams byed pa
daṅ ’grub pa’i rgyu yin pas na dbaṅ po’i rgyu ste; de ltar dbaṅ po’i rgyu las chos de dag
’byuṅ gi, byed pa po la sogs pas byas pa ma yin par śes pa ni dbaṅ po’i rgyu las ’jug pa
tshad mar byed pa ste, de dag ni dge ba daṅ, mi dge ba daṅ, ’khor ba daṅ, mya ṅan las ’das
pa kun kyaṅ dbaṅ po daṅ las kyi rgyu las byuṅ źiṅ dge ba la sogs pa ’bras bu’i rgyu dbaṅ
po las grub par byed do źes zin pa’i chos rnams la yaṅ śes la ma zin pa’aṅ las kyi rgyu las
’byuṅ bar śes na rten ciṅ ’bral bar ’byuṅ ba la mkhas pa yin par sbyar ro. gaṅ de ltar rgyu
kun ’byuṅ ba las skye ba la mkhas pa źes bya ba ni gaṅ goṅ du bśad pa ltar rgyu smin par
gyur pa las ’bras bu skye bar śes pa ’di ni źes bya ba’i don to.

de ltar lugs daṅ mthun pa’i mtshan ñid bstan nas, lugs las bzlog pa’i mtshan ñid bstan pa’i
phyir gźan yaṅ rten ciṅ ’brel bar ’byuṅ ba’i mtshan ñid la mkhas pa ni źes bya ba la sogs
pa gsuṅs pa’o. Cf. supra.’di lta ste, śiṅ med na me daṅ du ba mi ’byuṅ ba daṅ, sa bon med
na myu gu mi skye ba bźin du ñon moṅs pa ’gags na, de las skyes pa’i ’bras bu mi ’byuṅ ba’i
phyir tshul bźin ma yin pa ’gags pas ma rig pa ’gag ces bya’o. ji ltar ma rig pa la sogs
pa ’gags pa yaṅ rten ciṅ ’brel bar ’byuṅ ba źes bya źe na? smras pa: ñes pa med de; ’di la
gtan med par dgag pa la ni ma rig pa la sogs pa ’gag go źes mi bya’i, dper na mar me’i rkyen
gyis mun pa ’gags na snaṅ ba ñid skye ba daṅ, sman bcud kyis len zos na nad med pa la
bde ba skye ba, de bźin du lam bsgoms pa’i mthus ma rig pa daṅ mi mthun pa gaṅ rig pa skye
bar ’gyur ba, de ni ma rig pa ’gags pa źes bya ste, de ltar goṅ nas goṅ du ’du byed la sogs
pa daṅ mi mthun pa’i gnas ’byuṅ ba la ’du byed la sogs pa ’gags par blta’o.

gźan yaṅ chos rnams mthun pa’i rgyu las byuṅ ba daṅ, mi mthun pa’i rgyu las mi ’byuṅ bar śes
pa ni rten ciṅ ’brel bar ’byuṅ ba la mkhas pa’o źes bstan par bźed nas gźan yaṅ chos thams
cad ni rgyu la rag lus pa’o źes bya ba la sogs pa gsuṅs te, chos thams cad ni naṅ gi chos
daṅ phyi’i chos rnams so. de la naṅ gi chos ni ma rig pa’i rkyen gyis ’du byed la sogs pa’o;
phyi’i chos ni sa bon daṅ myu gu la sogs pa’o.ṭ. fol. 140a1-b4 then explains the different
hetu, pratyaya and sāmagrī: rgyu la rag lus pa ni chos de dag rgyu drug la brten nas
skye’o źes bya ba’i don to. de la rgyu drug po gaṅ źe na? 1) byed pa’i rgyu daṅ, 2) lhan
cig ’byuṅ ba’i rgyu daṅ, 3) skal ba mñam pa’i rgyu daṅ, 4) mtshuṅs par ldan pa’i rgyu daṅ,
5) kun tu ’gro ba’i rgyu daṅ, 6) rnam par smin pa’i rgyu’o.1) de la byed pa’i rgyu ni chos
de dag skye ba na gzugs daṅ sems la sogs pa mtshan ñid de dag bdag ñid ma gtogs par chos
gźan thams cad ni byed pa’i rgyu ste, skye ba la bgegs mi byed pa’i ṅo bor gnas pa’i phyir
ro; Kośabhāṣya p. 8226: saṃskṛtasya hi dharmasya svabhāvavarjyāḥ sarvadharmāḥ kāraṇahetur
utpādaṃ prati / avighnabhāvāvasthānāt /2) chos gaṅ dag gcig la gcig gi ’bras bur gyur pa
de ni lhan cig byuṅ ba’i rgyu ste; ’di lta ste: ’byuṅ ba chen po bźi rnams lhan cig skye
ba na phan tshun skyed par byed pas gcig la gcig lhan cig ’byuṅ ba’i rgyu’o; Kośabhāṣya 8319:
ye dharmāḥ parasparaphalās te parasparaḥ sahabhūhetur yathā ... catvāri mahābhūtāny anyonyaṃ
sahabhūhetuḥ /3) de bźin du sems daṅ sems las byuṅ ba daṅ ’dod pa na spyod pa’i sdug
bsṅal mthoṅ bas spaṅ bar bya ba’i chos sṅar skyes pa rnams phyis skyes pa daṅ ma skyes pa
rnams kyi skal ba mñam pa’i rgyu’o. de bźin du dge ba daṅ mi dge ba daṅ luṅ du ma bstan
pa rnams daṅ yaṅ sbyar ro; Kośabhāṣya p. 8510: sadṛśā dharmāḥ sadṛśānāṃ dharmāṇāṃ sabhāgahetus
tad yathā kuśalāḥ pañca skandhāḥ kuśalānām anyonyaṃ, kliṣṭāḥ kliṣṭānām, avyākṛtā avyākṛtānāṃ
rūpam avyākṛtaṃ pañcānām /4) mtshuṅs par ldan pa’i rgyu ni sems daṅ sems las byuṅ
ba gaṅ dag skad cig ma gaṅ la brten nas gnas pa’i dbaṅ po rnams so; abridges Kośabhāṣya p.
8820-22: samāna āśrayo yeṣāṃ te cittacaittāḥ anyonyaṃ saṃprayuktahetuḥ / samāna ity abhinnas
tad yathā ya eva cakṣurindriyakṣaṇaś cakṣurvijñānasyāśrayaḥ, sa eva tatsaṃprayuktānāṃ
vedanādīnām eva yāvan mana-indriyakṣaṇo manovijñānatatsaṃprayuktānāṃ veditavyaḥ /5) sṅar skyes
pa’i ñon moṅs pa rnams phyis skyes pa daṅ ma skyes pa’i raṅ gi sa pa rnams kyis kun tu
’gro ba’i rgyu yin pa’i phyir kun tu ’gro ba’i rgyu’o; Kośabhāṣya p. 893: svabhūmikāḥ pūrvotpannāḥ
sarvatragā dharmāḥ paścimānāṃ kliṣṭānāṃ dharmāṇāṃ sarvatragahetuḥ /6) mi dge ba
daṅ dge ba zag pa daṅ bcas pa’i chos rnams ni rnam par smin pa’i rgyu’o; Kośabhāṣya p. 8919:
akuśalāḥ kuśalasāsravāś ca dharmā vipākahetuḥ /rkyen la rag lus źes bya ba ni rkyen bźi
la brten nas skye źes ba’i don to. rkyen bźi ni 1) rgyu’i rkyen daṅ, 2) dmigs pa’i rkyen
daṅ, 3) mtshuṅs pa de ma thag pa’i rkyen daṅ, 4) bdag po’i rkyen to.1) de la rgyu’i rkyen
ni gaṅ ’bras bu skyed pa la rgyu’i dṅos por gnas pa ste, sa bon la sogs pa daṅ kun gźi rnam
par śes pa bag chags daṅ bcas pa’o; gźan dag ni gźan du ’chad de: byed pa’i rgyu ma gtogs
par rgyu rnam pa lṅa rnams ni rgyu’i rkyen to źe’o; Abhidharmasamuccaya p. 289-10: hetupratyaya
katamaḥ / ālayavijñānaṃ kuśalavāsanā ca // "Others explain it otherwise:" kāraṇahetuvarjyāḥ
pañca hetavo hetupratyayaḥ / (Kośabhāṣya p. 988).2) dmigs pa gaṅ la sems daṅ sems
las byuṅ ba gaṅ dmigs nas skye bar ’gyur pa’i dmigs pa de dag ni de’i dmigs pa’i rkyen
te; de’aṅ ci rigs par chos thams cad rnam par śes pa drug gi dmigs pa’i rkyen to; abridging
Kośabhāṣya p. 1004-6: yathāyogaṃ cakṣurvijñānasya saṃprayogasya rūpam / śrotravijñānasya
śabdaḥ / ghrāṇavijñānasya gandhaḥ / jihvāvijñānasya rasaḥ / kāyavijñānasya spraṣṭavyam /
manovijñānasya sarvadharmāḥ / yo dharmo yasya dharmasyālambanaṃ na kadācit sa dharmas taddharmasya
nālambanam /3) mya ṅan las ’das par ’jug pa’i tha ma’i sems ma gtogs par sems daṅ
sems las ’byuṅ ba’i rgyu rnams ni mtshuṅs pa de ma thag pa’i rkyen to; Kośabhāṣya p. 9810:
arhataḥ paścimān apāsyotpannāś cittacaittāḥ samanantarapratyayaḥ /4) byed pa’i rgyu ñid
bdag po’i rkyen to; Kośabhāṣya p. 10013: ya eva kāraṇahetuḥ sa evādhipatipratyayaḥ /tshogs
pa la rag lus źes bya ba ni rgyu daṅ rkyen rnams ’dus nas ’bras bu bskyed nus pa’i mthu daṅ
ldan par gnas pa la brten nas ’bras bu skye źes bya ba’i don to. mthun pa’i rgyu las byuṅ
ba bstan nas mi mthun pa’i rgyu las mi ’byuṅ bar bstan pa’i phyir chos gaṅ rgyu daṅ rkyen
daṅ tshogs pa la rag lus pa de bdag la rag ma lus źes bya ba la sogs pa gsuṅs te, gźan
dag gis btags pa’i bdag la sogs pa la brten te mi skye źes bya ba’i don to.On hetu cf. also
Mvy. 2260-65; Kośa LVP p. ii. 245ff with other references; and Vyākhyā i. p. 18617ff; on
pratyaya cf. Mvy. 2267-70; Kośa p. 983ff, LVP ii. p. 299ff, Vyākhyā i. p. 2328ff; Bbh. p.
9826-998; Abhidharmasamuccaya p. 287ff.de ’di na źe’am, sṅa ma źe’am, gźan źes bgraṅ ba ci
yaṅ med de źes bya ba ni bdag la ji ltar rag ma lus pa daṅ sems can la sogs pa la rag ma
lus pas na da lta’i dus su yaṅ ’di na źes bgraṅ du med, ’das pa’i dus su yaṅ ’di ’dra ba
źig ces bgraṅ du med, ma ’oṅs pa’i dus su yaṅ ’di ltar ’gyur źes bgraṅ du med pa’i don to.
yaṅ na chos thams cad ni rgyu la rag lus źes bya ba ni phyi daṅ naṅ gi rten ciṅ ’brel bar
’byuṅ ba rnams rgyu daṅ ’brel ba la skye źes bya ba’i tha tshig ste, de la phyi rol gyi rten
ciṅ ’brel bar ’byuṅ ba’i rgyu daṅ ’brel ba gaṅ źe na? ’di lta ste, sa bon las myu gu,
myu gu las ’dab ma źes bya ba la sogs pa’o. de la naṅ gi rten ciṅ ’brel bar ’byuṅ ba rgyu
daṅ ’brel ba gaṅ źe na? ma rig pa’i rkyen gis ’du byed, ’du byed kyi rkyen gyis rnam par śes
pa źes bya ba la sogs pa’o. rkyen la rag lus pa źes bya ba ni phyi daṅ naṅ gi rten ciṅ
’brel bar ’byuṅ ba yaṅ rkyen daṅ ’brel ba la skye źes bya ba’i don to. phyi’i rten ciṅ ’brel
bar ’byuṅ ba’i rkyen gaṅ źe na? ’di lta ste, sa daṅ, chu daṅ, me daṅ, rluṅ daṅ, nam mkha’
daṅ, dus kyi khams rnams śes gaṅ gsuṅs pa’o. naṅ gi rten ciṅ ’brel bar ’byuṅ ba’i rkyen
gaṅ źe na? sa daṅ, chu daṅ, me daṅ, rluṅ daṅ, nam mkha’ daṅ, rnam par śes pa’i khams rnams
śes gaṅ gsuṅs pa’o. tshogs pa la rag lus pa źes bya ba ni rgyu daṅ rkyen ma tshaṅ bar ma
gyur pa la rten źes bya ba’i don to. (153a)Then, in ṭ. fol. 141a2-5, there follow several
abridged quotations from the Śālistambasūtra, summarizing this text, to elucidate the paragraph:
de bas na sā lu ljaṅ pa’i mdo las kyaṅ rgyu’i skabs su: sa bon med na myu gu mi ’byuṅ
ste, me tog med na ’bras bu’i bar du yaṅ mi ’byuṅ ṅo źes gsuṅs pa daṅ; rkyen gyi skabs
su: ’di rnams med par sa bon las myu gu skye bar mi ’gyur gyi, nam phyi rol gyi sa’i khams
ma tshaṅ ba med par gyur pa la źes bya ba la sogs pa gsuṅs so; naṅ gi rten ciṅ ’brel bar
’byuṅ ba la yaṅ rgyu’i skabs su: gal te ma rig pa ma byuṅ na ’du byed kyaṅ mi ’byuṅ ba źig
na, de bźin du skye ba ma byuṅ du zin na rga śi’i bar du yaṅ mi mṅon pa źig na, ’di ltar
ma rig pa yod pa las ’du byed rnams skye źiṅ ’byuṅ bar ’gyur ro źes bya ba la sogs pa gsuṅs
pa daṅ; rkyen gyi skabs su yaṅ: rkyen ’di dag med par lus skye bar mi ’gyur gyi, nam sa’i
khams tshaṅ źiṅ źes bya ba la sogs pa gsuṅs pa’o; ṭ. fol. 141a2 [hetvadhikāre]a, Śāl p.
413-14: asati bīje ’ṅkuro na bhavati, yāvad asati puṣpephalaṃ na bhavati; ṭ. fol. 141a2 [pratyayādhikāre],
Śāl p. 512-13: asatsv eṣu pratyayeṣu bījādaṅkurasyābhinirvṛttir na bhavati
/ yadā bāhyaś ca pṛthivīdhātur avikalo bhavati / ṭ. fol. 141a3-4 [ādhyātmikasyāpi pratītyasamutpādasya
hetvadhikāre], Śāl p. 79-11: avidyā cen nābhaviṣyat naiva saṃskārāḥ prajñāsyante
/ evaṃ yāvaj jātiś cen nābhaviṣyat jarāmaraṇaṃ na prajñāsyate / atha satyām avidyāyāṃ
saṃskārāṇām abhinirvṛttiṃ bhavati / ṭ. fol. 141a4-5 [pratyayādhikāre ’pi], Śāl p. 815-16:
asatām eṣāṃ pratyayānāṃ kāyasyotpattir na bhavati / yadā ādhyātmikaḥ pṛthivīdhātur avikalo
bhavati.ṭ. then again comments on Akṣ in fol. 141a5-b1: chos gaṅ rgyu daṅ rkyen daṅ tshogs
pa la rag lus pa de źes bya ba ni phyi daṅ naṅ gi chos gaṅ rgyu daṅ rkyen daṅ rgyu rkyen
’brel pa las skyes pa’i chos de dag ni bdag las mi skye, sems can las mi skye źes bya
ba’i don to. de bas na mdo sde de ñid las phyi’i rten ciṅ ’brel bar ’byuṅ ba’i skabs su: de
la sa’i khams kyaṅ ’di ltar bdag gi sa bon rten pa’i bya ba bya’o sñam du mi sems so źes
bya ba nas myu gu de yaṅ bdag gis ma byas, pha rol gyis ma byas, gñis kas ma byas, dbaṅ pos
ma sprul, dus kyis ma bsgyur, raṅ bźin las ma byuṅ, rgyu med pa las kyaṅ ma skyes te źes
gsuṅs pa daṅ; naṅ gi rten ciṅ ’brel bar ’byuṅ ba’i skabs su yaṅ: ma rig pa yaṅ ’di ltar
bdag gis ’du byed skyed do sñam du mi sems so źes bya ba nas bdag ma yin no, sems can ma yin,
srog ma yin źes bya ba la sogs pa gsuṅs pa’i phyir ro; ṭ. fol. 141a6-7 [bāhyasya pratītyasamutpādasyādhikāre],
Śāl p. 515-16, 63-5: tatra pṛthivīdhātor naivaṃ bhavati ahaṃ bījasya
saṃdhāraṇakṛtyaṃ karomīti / [yāvat] sa cāṅkuro na svayaṃkṛto na parakṛto nobhayakṛto neśvarakṛto
na kālapariṇamito na prakṛtisaṃbhūto nāpy ahetusamutpannaḥ / ṭ. fol. 141a7-b1 [ādhyātmikasyāpi
pratītyasamutpādasyādhikāre], Śāl p. 712, 99-10: tatrāvidyāyā naivaṃ bhavati
ahaṃ saṃskārān abhinirvartayāmīti / [yāvan] nātmā na sattvo na jīva [ity ādi]. ṭ. fol.
141b1-3: de na ’di na źe’am, sṅa ma na źe’am, gźan na źes bgraṅ ba ci yaṅ med de źes bya ba
ni chos gaṅ rgyu daṅ rkyen daṅ tshogs pa la rag lus pas bdag daṅ sems can la rag ma lus
pa’i chos de ni da ltar ci yin? źes brtag tu med pa daṅ, sṅon gyi dus na ci ’dra? źes brtag
tu med pa daṅ, ma ’oṅs pa’i dus na ci lta bur ’gyur źes brtag tu med ces bya ba’i don to.
de bas na sā lu ljaṅ pa’i mdo las kyaṅ: ji bdag ’das pa’i dus na byuṅ ba źig gam, ’on te
ma byuṅ ba źig? sñam du sṅon gyi mtha’ la mi rtog; ma ’oṅs pa’i dus na jir ’gyur, ji lta
bur ’gyur? źes ma ’oṅs pa’i dus la mi rtog go; ’di ji źig, ci źig yod, cir ’gyur? sems can
’di dag gaṅ nas ’oṅs, ’di nas śi ’phos nas goṅ du ’gro bar ’gyur? źes da ltar byuṅ ba la
mi rtog go źes gsuṅs so; Śāl p. 1812-192: na sa pūrvāntaṃ pratisarati kiṃ nv aham abhūvam
atīte ’dhvani, āhosvin nābhūvam atīte ’dhvani / ko nv aham abhūvam atīte ’dhvani, kathaṃ nv
aham abhūvam atīte ’dhvani / aparāntaṃ vā punar na pratisarati kiṃ nv ahaṃ bhaviṣyāmy anāgate
’dhvani / ahosvin na bhaviṣyāmy anāgate ’dhvani / ko nu bhaviṣyāmy anāgate ’dhvani,
kathaṃ nu bhaviṣyāmy anāgate ’dhvani / pratyutpannaṃ vā punar na pratisarati kiṃ nv idaṃ kathaṃ
nv idaṃ ke santaḥ ke bhaviṣyāmaḥ, ayaṃ sattvaḥ kuta āgataḥ, sa itaś cyutaḥ kutra gamiṣyatīti
/. The last quotation is somewhat abridged in ṭ.

gźan yaṅ rten ciṅ ’brel bar byuṅ ba mtha’ gñis daṅ bral ba śes pa ni rten ciṅ ’brel bar ’byuṅ
ba la mkhas pa yin no źes bstan par bźed nas, gźan yaṅ gaṅ byaṅ chub sems dpa’ byaṅ chub
kyi rkyen thams cad kyaṅ ñe bar gźog źes bya ba la sogs pa gsuṅs te, de la ye śes phun sum
tshogs pa daṅ, spaṅs pa phun sum tshogs pa ni byaṅ chub ces bya ste, byaṅ chub ni ye śes
daṅ spaṅs pa’i mtshan ñid yin pa’i phyir ro.de la ye śes phun sum tshogs pa rnam pa bźi ste:
1) thams cad śes pa daṅ, 2) rnam pa thams cad du śes pa daṅ, 3) ’bad pa med par śes pa
daṅ, 4) ma bstan par śes pa’o. 1) thams cad śes pa ni phuṅ po daṅ khams daṅ skye mched la
sogs pa śes bya’i dṅos po ma lus par śes pa’o; 2) rnam pa thams cad du śes pa ni de dag kyaṅ
mi rtag pa’am, bdag med pa’i rnam par śes pa’am, dus gsum thams cad du śes pa ste, nams
kyaṅa śes pa de la ñams pa med pa’o; 3) ’bad pa med par śes pa ni tiṅ ṅe ’dzin la sogs pa’i
rgyu la mi ltos śiṅ brtsal ba med par lhun gyis grub par śes pa’o; 4) ma bstan par śes
pa ni mkhan po daṅ slob dpon gyi man ṅag med par raṅ ’byuṅ gi ye śes kyis chos thams cad
raṅ ñid kyis mṅon par byaṅ chub pa’i phyir ro.spaṅs pa phun sum tshogs pa yaṅ rnam pa lṅa
ste: 1) ñon moṅs pa’i sgrib pa spaṅs pa daṅ, 2) śes bya’i sgrib pa spaṅs pa daṅ, 3) śin tu
spaṅs pa daṅ, 4) bag chags daṅ bcas pa spaṅs pa daṅ, 5) sñoms par ’jug pa’i sgrib pa thams
cad spaṅs pa’o. 1) de la ñon moṅs pa’i sgrib pa spaṅs pa ni ’dod chags la sogs pa mthoṅ
ba daṅ bsgom pa’i lam gyis spaṅ bar bya ba’i ñon moṅs pa rnams spaṅs pa’o; 2) śes bya’i sgrib
pa spaṅs pa ni phuṅ po daṅ khams daṅ skye mched la gzuṅ ba daṅ ’dzin pa’i mṅon par chags
pa’i bag chags ñon moṅs pa can ma yin pa mi śes pa spaṅs pa’o; 3) śin tu spaṅs pa ni sgrib
pa de gñis phyis sems kyi rgyud la ’byuṅ źiṅ skye ba med par spaṅs pa’o; 4) bag chags
daṅ bcas par spaṅs pa ni sgrib pa de gñis kyi bag la ñal rtsa nas bton pa’o; 5) sñoms par
’jug pa thams cad kyi sgrib pa spaṅs pa ni mthar gyis gnas pa’i sñoms par ’jug pa dgu daṅ
zad par gyi skye mched daṅ zil gyis gnon pa’i skye mched rnams thob par bya ba la bar du gcod
pa rnams spaṅs pa’o.rgyu daṅ rkyen gaṅ gis bla na med pa’i byaṅ chub thob par ’gyur ba’i
rgyu daṅ rkyen de rnams ñe bar sgrub pa la byaṅ chub kyi rkyen rnams kyaṅ ñe bar gźog la
źes bya ste, rgyu daṅ rkyen kyaṅ bsod nams daṅ ye śes kyi tshogs so. rkyen de dag kyaṅ zad
ciṅ ’gog par rtogs te źes bya ba ni byaṅ chub kyi rgyu daṅ rkyen rnams ṅo bo ñid med par
śes pa’am, ma rig pa’i rkyen gyis ’du byed ’byuṅ ba la sogs pa rkyen goṅ du smos pa rnams
ṅo bo ñid med par śes pa źes bya ba’i don to. sems can la lta ba’i phyir zad ciṅ ’gog pa’i
ye śes su mi ’jog ces bya ba ni de ltar de bźin mya ṅan las ’das pa stoṅ pa’i mtshan ñid
rtogs kyaṅ sems can gyi don du mya ṅan las ’das pa ’ba’ źig la gnas par mi byed ces bya
ba’i don to.The paragraph seems to be based upon Kośabhāṣya p. 41514ff., bhāṣya on Kośa vii.
34: ...sarvapuṇyajñānasaṃbhārasamudāgamataḥ dharmakāyapariniṣpattitaḥ arthacaryayā ca lokasya
/ .... caturvidhā ca phalasaṃpat / jñānasaṃpat prahāṇasaṃpat prabhāvasaṃpad rūpakāyasaṃpac
ca / ... jñānasaṃpat punaś caturvidhā / anupadiṣṭajñānaṃ sarvatrajñānaṃ sarvathājñānam
ayatnajñānaṃ ca / caturvidhā prahāṇasaṃpat / sarvakleśaprahāṇam atyantaprahāṇaṃ savāsanāprahāṇaṃ
sarvasamādhisamāpattyāvaraṇaprahāṇaṃ ca ... / The explanations of the concepts
are, however, found only in ṭ.

rten ciṅ ’brel bar ’byuṅ ba bśad pa’i don du dus gsum la mkhas pa bstan pas ji ltar bstan pa
bźin du bśad par bźed nas de la byaṅ chub sems dpa’i dus gsum la mkhas pa gaṅ źe na źes dris
so.dus gsum po de yaṅ dus ñid la rnam pa gsum yod pa ma yin gyi, sems daṅ sems las byuṅ
ba la dus gsum du bźag ste, sems daṅ sems las byuṅ ba’i dṅos po de dag ñid rgyu daṅ ’bras
bu bcas par ’das te źig pa ni ’das pa’i dus źes bya, rgyu daṅ ’bras bu da duṅ ma skyes pa
la ni ma ’oṅs pa’i dus źes bya, rgyu daṅ ’bras bu skyes nas ma źig gi bar du ni da ltar
byuṅ ba’i dus źes bya ste; dṅos po ’das pa daṅ ma ’oṅs pa daṅ da ltar byuṅ ba rnams ci ’dra
ba la mkhas pa ni dus gsum la mkhas pa źes bya’o. Translated in the introduction.

’das pa’i dus la mkhas pa bstan pa’i phyir gaṅ bdag daṅ sems can gźan gyi źes bya ba la sogs
pa smos te, dge ba daṅ, mi dge ba daṅ, ’brel pa’i sems daṅ sems las byuṅ ba gaṅ yin pa ni
sems daṅ sems las byuṅ ba dge ba daṅ mi dge ba rnams źes bya’o, gaṅ bdag daṅ sems can gźan
gyis ’das pa’i dus na dge ba ni ’di lta bu źig byas, mi dge ba ni ’di lta bu źig byas źes
bdag daṅ gźan gyis dge ba daṅ mi dge ba byas pa ma brjed pa ni rjes su dran pa’o; de tsam
gyi ’das pa’i dus la mkhas pa yin nam źe na? ma yin par bstan pa’i phyir mi dge ba’i sems
daṅ sems las byuṅ ba źes bya ba la sogs pa gsuṅs te, ’di yaṅ bdag daṅ gźan gyi mi dge ba
daṅ ’brel pa’i sems daṅ sems las byuṅ ba dran nas źes bya ba daṅ sbyar ro; byaṅ chub tu bsṅo
ba źes bya ba ni dge ba byas pa rnams bla na med pa’i byaṅ chub thob pa’i rgyur gyur ces
smon pa’o.

ma ’oṅs pa’i dus la mkhas pa bstan pa’i phyir gaṅ ma ’oṅs pa’i sems daṅ sems las byuṅ ba źes
bya ba la sogs pa gsuṅs te, ma ’oṅs pa na bdag gi bsod nams daṅ ye śes kyi tshogs bla na
med pa’i byaṅ chub thob pa’i rgyu bdag daṅ gźan la phan par byed pa’i rkyen du gyur pa’i dge
ba’i rtsa ba rnams gnod mi za bar bya’o źes sems pa ni dge ba’i rtsa ba’i tshogs la ṅes
par sems pa źes bya’o; don de ñid bstan pa’i phyir byaṅ chub mṅon du ’gyur ba’i las sems
te źes bya ba gsuṅs te, byaṅ chub thob par ’gyur ba’i dge ba’i las bya bar sems pa ni byaṅ
chub mṅon du ’gyur ba’i las sems pa źes bya’o; don de ñid ji lta bu yin pa gsal bar bstan
pa’i phyir bdag gi dge ba’i sems bskyed pa gaṅ dag ces bya ba la sogs pa gsuṅs te, dge ba
daṅ ’brel pa’i sems ni dge ba’i sems so, bskyed pa ni da ltar gyi dus na dge ba’i sems skyes
zin pa’o, skye bar ’gyur ba ni ma ’oṅs pa’i dus na dge ba daṅ ’brel pa’i sems gnod mi
za bar skye bar ’gyur ba’o; de dag ces bya ba ni dus gñis kyi dge ba’i sems ñid la sñegs te,
da ltar gyi dus na dge ba’i sems skyed pa daṅ ma ’oṅs pa’i dus na skye bar ’gyur ba de
dag ces bya ba’i don to, ni źes bya bas dge ba de dag theg pa gñis daṅ lha daṅ mi’i bde ’gror
mi sṅo źes bya bar ston to, byaṅ chub ces bya ba ni byaṅ chub thob par bya ba’i phyir
źes bya ba’i tha tshig go, skabs ni mi dbye źes bya ba ni ma ’oṅs pa’i mi dge ba’i sems daṅ
sems las byuṅ ba skye ba’i skabs mi dbye źes bya bar ston to; goṅ du bśad pa’i don rnams
bsdus te bstan pa’i phyir gaṅ de lta bur sems la bsgo ba, de ni źes bya ba la sogs pa gsuṅs
te, de lta bur sems la bsgo źes bya ba ni ji nas da ltar gyi dus nas dge ba’i sems bskyed
pa daṅ, ma ’oṅs pa’i dus na dge ba’i sems skye bar ’gyur ba de dag ṅes par byaṅ chub tu
bsṅo la, ma ’oṅs pa’i mi dge ba’i sems daṅ sems las byuṅ ba skye ba’i skabs mi dbye’o źes
de lta bur de nas sems la bsgo źiṅ sems la ’jog par byed pa de ni źes bya ba’i don to

da ltar byuṅ ba’i dus la mkhas pa bstan pa’i phyir da ltar byuṅ ba la mkhas pa gaṅ źe na źes
bya ba la sogs pa gsuṅs te, ’dod ma chags pa la sogs pa dge ba’i rtsa ba byed ciṅ, ’dod chags
la sogs pa mi dge ba’i rtsa ba rnams la mi ’jug pa ni tshul bźin sbyor ba źes bya ste,
don gźan ni sla bas ma bśad do.

śes rab daṅ thabs kyi ye śes kyis dus gsum na gnas pa’i dṅos po rnams ji lta ba bźin du phyin
ci ma log par khoṅ du chud pa ni dus gsum la mkhas pa yin no źes bstan par bźed nas gźan
yaṅ gaṅ ’das pa’i dus kyi chos rnams stoṅ par mos pa źes bya ba la sogs pa gsuṅs te, gaṅ
’das pa’i dus kyi chos phuṅ po daṅ skye mched la sogs pa gaṅ zag daṅ chos kyi dṅos por yod
pa ma yin pa yid ches pa ni ’das pa’i dus kyi chos rnams stoṅ par mos pa’o. lhag ma yaṅ de
bźin du sbyar te, tshig gźan ni sla bas ma bśad do.

gaṅ yaṅ dus gsum gyi chos rnams mi ’pho ba daṅ, mi skye ba daṅ, mi gnas par rtogs pa ni dus
gsum la mkhas pa’o źes bstan par bźed nas gźan yaṅ ’das pa’i dus na źes bya ba la sogs pa
gsuṅs so. ’das pa’i dus na zad pa’i chos rnams phyi ma’i mthar ’phos par mi lta źes bya ba
ni chos sṅa ma ’das pa rnams ṅo bo ñid kyis ’das te, phyi ma daṅ mtshams mi sbyor bar rtogs
kyaṅ źes bya ba’i don to; dge ba’i mṅon par ’du byed pa la brtson ’grus kyaṅ mi gtoṅ stea
źes bya ba ni de ltar don dam par mi ’pho yaṅ, las daṅ ’bras bu la yid ches te, sṅa ma’i
rgyus phyi ma’i ’bras bu sgrub par śes na dge ba spyod pa’i brtson ’grus kyaṅ mi gtoṅ źes
bya ba’i don to; mi dge ba mṅon par ’du mi byed ces bya ba ni de ltar dṅos po med de sṅa
ma daṅ phyi mar mi ’pho bas mi dge ba’i las kyi rnam par smin pa med par yaṅ mi bltab ste,
de’i phyir mi dge ba mṅon par ’du mi byed do.gaṅ ma ’oṅs pa’i dus kyi chos rnams mi skye
mi ’byuṅ bar rtog ciṅ, byaṅ chub tu bsṅo ba’i brtson ’grus kyaṅ mi ’dor źes bya ba ni don
dam par na ma ’oṅs pa’i dus na thob par bya ba’i byaṅ chub ñid mi skye mi ’byuṅ bar rtogs
kyaṅ, kun rdzob tu med par mi lta bas byaṅ chub tu bsṅo ba’i brtson ’grus kyaṅ mi gtoṅ ṅo.da
ltar byuṅ ba’i dus na chos rnams ’dug pa med ciṅ mi gnas par rtog ste, byaṅ chub sems
dpa’ lhag pa’i bsam pa rab tu brtan pa ni byaṅ chub kyi sems kyaṅ mi brjed de źes bya ba ni
don dam par da ltar byuṅ ba’i chos rnams mi gnas pas byaṅ chub kyi sems ñid kyaṅ mi gnas
te; byaṅ chub kyi sems la rmoṅs pa’am, brjed par ’gyur ba’i rigs na byaṅ chub sems dpa’ lhag
