pa’i bsam pa rab tu brtan pa ni spyod lam thams cad du byaṅ chub kyi sems kyaṅ mi brjed
do źes bya ba’i don to.

dus gsum la mkhas pa’i rnam graṅs gźan yaṅ bstan par bźed nas gźan yaṅ gaṅ ’das pa, de ni zad
pa’o źes bya ba la sogs pa gsuṅs te, ’das pa’i chos rnams ni rgyu daṅ ’bras bu bcas te,
’gags pas na zad pa źes bya’o, ma ’oṅs pa’i chos rnams ni rgyu daṅ ’bras bu bcas te ma phyin
pas na ma phyin pa’o, da ltar byuṅ ba’i chos rnams ni rgyus ’bras bu bskyed nas de ma thag
tu ’gags pas na gnas pa med pa’o. de ltar dus gsum gyi mtshan ñid bstan nas, de la mkhas
pa bstan pa’i phyir gaṅ de ltar sems daṅ sems las byuṅ ba źes bya ba la sogs pa gsuṅs so,
rtog ciṅ źes bya ba’i sgra re re daṅ sbyar te, sems daṅ sems las byuṅ ba skyes pa rnams
la rtog pa daṅ, sems daṅ sems las byuṅ ba źig pa rnams la rtog pa daṅ, sems daṅ sems las
byuṅ ba źu ba rnams la rtog ces bya bar sbyar ro; de la da ltar gyi sems daṅ sems las byuṅ
ba rnams rgyus ’bras bu bskyed de, bskyed ma thag tu rgyu daṅ ’bras bu bcas te, ’gags pas
dṅos po med do źes rtog pa ni sems daṅ sems las byuṅ ba skyes pa rnams la rtog pa źes bya’o;
’das pa’i sems daṅ sems las byuṅ ba rnams ni rgyu daṅ bcas te ’bras bu ’gags pas dṅos
po med do źes rtog pa ni sems daṅ sems las byuṅ ba’i źig pa rnams la rtog pa źes sbyar ro;
ma ’oṅs pa’i sems daṅ sems las byuṅ bas ni rgyu daṅ bcas te ’bras bu ma skyes pas na dṅos
po med do źes rtog pa ni źu ba rnams la rtog pa źes bya’o. de ltar dus gsum gyi dṅos po rnams
yaṅ dag par na dṅos po med pas dge ba’i tshogs rnams kyaṅ dṅos po med pa’i phyir tshogs
gñis kyaṅ mi ’grub pa ma sñam pa la byaṅ chub sgrub pa’i dge ba’i rtsa ba rnams kyaṅ yaṅ
dag par sgrub pa źes bya bar smos te, tshogs gaṅ gis byaṅ chub sgrub par byed pa’i tshogs
kyi mtshan ñid dge ba’i rtsa ba ni byaṅ chub sgrub pa’i dge ba’i rtsa ba źes bya ste, de
yaṅ bsod nams daṅ ye śes kyi tshogs kyi mtshan ñid do, de ni ’di skad du don dam pas dus
gsum gyi dṅos po rnams kyaṅ raṅ bźin med mod kyi, kun rdzob tu ji lta ji ltar las byas pa
de lta de ltar ’bras bu med pa ma yin te, de bas na bla na med pa’i byaṅ chub thob par byed
pa’i rgyu bsod nams daṅ ye śes kyi tshogs kyaṅ sgrub par byed ces bya bar ston to.Cf. Kpv.
97-98: yadi tāvad atītaṃ cittaṃ tat kṣīṇaṃ, yād anāgataṃ cittaṃ tad asaṃprāptaḥ, atha pratyutpannasya
cittasya sthitir nāsti. ... cittaṃ hi kāśyapa nadīsrotasadṛśaṃm anavasthitam
utpannaṃ bhagnavilīna. Cf. also supra, ṭ. fol. 79a2 and mūla p. 487.

gźan yaṅ mṅon par śes pa lṅa daṅ ldan pas dus gsum gyi dṅos po rnams khoṅ du chud ciṅ dran te,
bdag gi dge ba’i rtsa ba chud mi za bar byed pa ni dus gsum la mkhas pa’o źes bstan par
bźed nas gźan yaṅ gaṅ mṅon par śes pa la mkhas pa źes bya ba la sogs pa gsuṅs so. mṅon par
śes pa daṅ ldan pa ni mṅon par śes pa la mkhas pa’am, yaṅ na mṅon par śes pas dṅos po rnams
śes śiṅ dran te, dge ba’i rtsa ba byas pa rnams chud mi gson pa’i mṅon par śes pa ’das
pa’i dus rjes su dran te źes bya ba ni sṅon gyi gnas rjes su dran pa’i mṅon par śes pas ’das
pa’i dus na mi dge ba ci byas pa daṅ, dge ba ci byas pa ma brjed pa ni ’das pa’i dus dran
pa’o; de ltar dran pa yaṅ ma zad kyi sṅon dge ba’i rtsa ba bskyed pa rnams rjes su dran
nas byaṅ chub tu yoṅs su sṅo bar byed pa ni ’das pa’i dus la mkhas pa źes bya’o.gaṅ ma ’oṅs
pa’i dus na dge ba’i sems bskyed pa rnams rab tu śes pa daṅ źes bya ba ni ’dir yaṅ sṅon
gyi gnas rjes su dran pa’i mṅon par śes pa daṅ, ’chi ’pho daṅ skye ba śes pa’i mṅon par
śes pas ma ’oṅs pa’i dus na dge ba’i sems skye bar ’gyur ba rnams śes śiṅ mthoṅ źes bya bar
sbyar te, ma ’oṅs pa na byaṅ chub tu sems bskyed nas ’dod ma chags pa daṅ, źe mi sdaṅ ba
daṅ, gti mi mug pa’i dge ba’i rtsa ba’i rgyu las sbyin pa daṅ, tshul khrims la sogs pa dge
ba rnams gdon mi za bar skye bar śes pa ni ma ’oṅs pa’i dge ba’i sems skyed pa rnams rab
tu śes pa źes bya’o; de ltar śes nas kyaṅ da lta ñid kyi dus na dge ba de dag yoṅs su rdzogs
te, bla na med pa’i byaṅ chub kyi tshogs su gyur cig par sems la mṅon par ’du byed ciṅ
re ba ni de la smon pa yoṅs su rdzogs par byed pa’o.da ltar byuṅ ba’i dus la mkhas pa yaṅ
rnam pa gsum ste, a) phyin ci ma log par byed pa daṅ, b) mi ñams par byed pa daṅ, c) ’bras
bu gźan du mi ’gyur bar byed pa ste, de la a) gaṅ da ltar byuṅ ba’i dus la dge ba’i rtsa
ba skyes śiṅ byuṅ ba rnams yid la byed ciṅ źes bya bas phyin ci ma log par byed pa bstan
te, dge ba’i rtsa ba skyes śiṅ byuṅ ba la phyin ci ma log par yaṅ daṅ yaṅ yid la byed pa’i
phyir ro; b) gnas par byed ces bya ba ni mi ñams par byed pa bstan te, dge ba’i rtsa ba skyes
śiṅ byuṅ ba goṅ nas goṅ du khyad par du ’bogs par byed pa’i phyir ro; c) byaṅ chub tu
yoṅs su bsṅo ba źes bya bas ’bras bu gźan du mi ’gyur bar byed pa bstan te, da ltar byuṅ
ba’i dus su dge ba byas te gnas par gyur pa rnams lha daṅ klu la sogs pa’i ’bras bu thob par
mi bsṅo’i, bla na med pa’i byaṅ chub thob par bsṅo ba’i phyir ro.

dus gsum gyi bsod nams kyi tshogs ci byas pas, sems can yoṅs su smin par byed pa ni dus gsum
la mkhas pa yin no źes bstan par bźed nas gźan yaṅ gaṅ sems can thams cad yoṅs su smin par
bya ba’i phyir źes bya ba la sogs pa gsuṅs so; sems can thams cad ces bya bas ni rigs lṅa
daṅ ldan pa’i gaṅ zag rnams bsdus te, de dag so so’i theg pa daṅ, lha daṅ mi’i bde ’gror
’gog pa ni yoṅs su smin par bya ba ste, phyir źes bya ba ni de’i ched du’o; ’das pa’i bsod
nams kyi tshogs dran nas źes bya ba ni bdag gi sṅon dge ba ’di daṅ ’di byas so źes sbyin
pa daṅ tshul khrims la sogs pa bsod nams kyi tshogs ci byas pa ma brjed pa ni dran pa’o;
sems can gaṅ dag ji lta bur yoṅs su smin par bya ba de dag thams cad de bźin du yoṅs su smin
par byed ces bya bas sṅon byas pa’i bsod nams de dag dran pa tsam du ma zad kyi, bsod nams
de dag gi mthus sems can ji sñed cig ji ltar smin par bya ba de dag thams cad de bźin
du smin par byed ces bya ba’i tha tshig go.ma ’oṅs pa’i dus kyi sems can gaṅ dag saṅs rgyas
mñes par bya bas yoṅs su smin par bya ba, de dag thams cad de bźin du yoṅs su smin par byed
ces bya ba ni saṅs rgyas mñes par bya ba’i sgo nas ma ’oṅs pa’i sems can yoṅs su smin
par bya ba ni ma ’oṅs pa’i dus kyi sems can gaṅ dag saṅs rgyas mñes par bya bas yoṅs su smin
par bya ba źes bya ste, de ni ’di skad du de bźin gśegs pa de dag gi druṅ du soṅ nas dam
pa’i chos mñan pa daṅ, bsam pa daṅ, bsgom pa la sogs pa sgrub pa’i mchod pa daṅ mñes par
byas nas, de la brten te sems can ji sñed cig yod pa ji ltar yoṅs su smin par bya ba, de
sñed cig de bźin yoṅs su smin par byed ces bya ba ston to.da ltar byuṅ ba’i sems can rnams
la chos bstan pa’am, rdzu ’phrul gyi cho ’phrul gyis yoṅs su smin par bya ba de dag thams
cad kyaṅ de bźin du yoṅs su smin par byed de źes bya ba la, cho ’phrul gyi sgra gñi ga daṅ
sbyar te, a) chos bstan pa’i cho ’phrul daṅ b) rdzu ’phrul gyi cho ’phrul źes bya bar sbyar
ro.The two kinds of miracles are explained in ṭ. fol.145b4-146a4, dharmadeśanaprātihārya
divided into ādeśanāprātihārya and anuśāsanīprātihārya, and ṛddhiprātihārya divided into
five:a) de la chos bstan pa’i cho ’phrul yaṅ rnam pa gñis te, 1) kun brjod pa’i cho ’phrul
daṅ, 2) rjes su bstan pa’i cho ’phrul lo. de la 1) kun brjod pa’i cho ’phrul ni sems can
rnams kyi khams daṅ raṅ bźin daṅ bag la ñal rnams la btags nas de dag la de bźin du brjod
pa’o. 2) rjes su bstan pa’i cho ’phrul ni de ltar gdul bya de dag brda sprad nas bstan pa
la btsud de, ’di ni sdug bsṅal gyi bden pa, ’di ni kun ’byuṅ gi bden pa, ’di ni ’gog pa’i
bden pa, ’di ni lam gyi bden pa’o źes bden pa bźi la sogs pa ’chad pa’o.b) rdzu ’phrul gyi
cho ’phrul ni dbaṅ lṅa daṅ ldan pa ste, 1) gcig tu gyur nas maṅ por ’gyur ba daṅ, maṅ po
gyur nas gcig tu ’gyur ba daṅ, snaṅ ba daṅ mi snaṅ ba la dbaṅ bas sprul pa la dbaṅ ba daṅ,
2) rtsig pa la yaṅ thad kar ’gro, rab la yaṅ thad kar ’gro ba la sogs pa la dbaṅ bas ’gro
ba la dbaṅ ba daṅ, 3) nam mkha’ la mṅon du ’phags te spyod lam rnam bźi byed pa daṅ, chu
la yaṅ mi nub par ’gro ste, sa chen po la bya ba bźin byed pa la dbaṅ bas gnas pa la dbaṅ
ba daṅ, 4) mi’i ’gro ba ’di na gnas bźin du lha’i ’gro bar gtogs pa, zla ba daṅ ñi ma ’di
gñis ’di ltar rdzu ’phrul che ba, ’di ltar mthu che ba ’di ltar gzi brjid che ba la’aṅ lag
pas ’dzin ciṅ kun tu ñug par byed pas lus la dbaṅ ba daṅ, 5) tshaṅs pa’i ’jig rten gyi
bar du sems can rnams la lus kyi dbaṅ sgyur bas khams khyad par can la dbaṅ ba ste, de ltar
dbaṅ lṅa daṅ ldan pas gdul bya’i sems can ’dun par byed pa ni rdzu ’phrul gyi cho ’phrul
lo.da ltar gyi sems can kha cig chos bstan pa’i cho ’phrul gyis yoṅs su smin par bya ba yin,
sems can kha cig rdzu ’phrul gyi cho ’phrul gyis yoṅs su smin par bya ba yin te, de la
byaṅ chub sems dpa’i cho ’phrul gaṅ gis sems can gaṅ yoṅs su smin par bya ba cho ’phrul des
sems can de yoṅs su smin par byed do.de bas na sems can yoṅs su smin par bya ba de dag
thams cad kyaṅ de bźin du yoṅs su smin par byed do źes gsuṅs so.Cf. Kośa vii, 47-8, Msa v,
4-5; the divisions of ṛddhiprātihārya are similarly described in Dbh 3M p. 34-5; Śbh p. 6311-413;
other references in Edg. s. v. prātihārya.

146a4-147a2: dus gsum la mkhas pa goṅ du bśad pa rnams kyi don bsdus te, bstan par bźed nas
gaṅ dus gsum ’di dag la źes bya ba la sogs pa gsuṅs te, gaṅ źes bya ba ni byaṅ chub sems dpa’
daṅ sbyar te, byaṅ chub sems dpa’ gaṅ źes bya ba’i don to, dus gsum ’di dag ces bya ba
ni goṅ du bśad pa’i ’das pa daṅ, ma ’oṅs pa daṅ, da ltar gyi dus dag la’o, ma chags pas yoṅs
su rdzogs par byed ces bya ba’i tshig goṅ ma’i tshig gsum char daṅ yaṅ sbyar te, bdag
gi don la ma chags pas yoṅs su rdzogs par byed pa daṅ gźan gyi don la ma chags pas yoṅs su
rdzogs par byed pa daṅ, byaṅ chub kyi don la ma chags pas yoṅs su rdzogs par byed ces bya
bar sbyar ro.de la bdag yoṅs su smin par ’gyur ba’am, bdag la phan par ’gyur ba’i don ni
bdag gi don te, de yaṅ spaṅs pa daṅ sgrub pa’i mtshan ñid rnam pa gñis so.de la spaṅ ba yaṅ
rnam pa gsum ste, 1) ñon moṅs pa spaṅ ba daṅ, 2) sdug bsṅal spaṅ ba daṅ, 3. śin tu spaṅ
ba’o. de la 1) ñon moṅs pa spaṅ ba ni ’jig rten gyi lam sa goṅ ma la źi bar lta źiṅ, sa ’og
ma la skyon du lta bas cuṅ zad med pa’i skye mched man chad kyis ñon moṅs pa thaṅ cig rtse
bcil ba daṅ, ’jig rten las ’das pa mthoṅ ba daṅ bsgom pa’i lam gyis ’dod chags la sogs
pa ñon moṅs pa’i bag chags kyaṅ ma lus par bton pa’o. de la 2) sdug bsṅal spaṅ ba ni ṅan soṅ
gsum du skye ba’i sdug bsṅal daṅ khams gsum du skye ba’i sdug bsṅal ma lus par spaṅs pa’o.
3) śin tu spaṅ ba ni ñon moṅs pa daṅ sdug bsṅal spaṅs pa de dag lan cig spaṅs nas phyis
ci nas kyaṅ de’i sems kyi rgyud la mi skye bar byed pa’o.de la sgrub pa la yaṅ rnam pa gñis
te, 1) ’jig rten gyi bde ba sgrub pa daṅ, 2) ’jig rten las ’das pa’i bde ba sgrub pa’o.
1) ’jig rten gyi bde ba sgrub pa ni ji srid du ’jig rten las ’das pa’i bde ba ma thob kyi
bar du lha daṅ mi’i bde ’gror skye bar byed pa’o. 2) ’jig rten las ’das pa’i bde ba yaṅ
rnam pa gñis te, a) bla na yod pa daṅ, b) bla na med pa’o. de la a) bla na yod pa ni ñan thos
daṅ raṅ saṅs rgyas kyi theg pa la brten nas phuṅ po lhag ma daṅ bcas pa daṅ phuṅ po lhag
ma yaṅ ma lus pa spaṅs pa’i mya ṅan las ’das pa ’thob pa’o. b) bla na med pa ni theg pa
chen po la brten nas bdag daṅ gźan gyi don phun sum tshogs pa’i rten du gyur pa ni mi gnas
pa’i mya ṅan las ’das pa ’thob pa’o.sems can gźan yoṅs su smin par byas pa’am gźan la phan
par byas pa’i don ni gźan gyi don te, de yaṅ spaṅ ba daṅ sgrub pa la bkod pa goṅ ma bźin
du rnam pa gñis su rig par bya’o.byaṅ chub ñid don dam pas na byaṅ chub kyi don to. byaṅ
chub kyi sgras ’dir byaṅ chub rnam pa gsum la bya bar rig par bya ste, de dag ni ’phags pa’i
’bras bu yin pa’i phyir ro. yaṅ na, stobs daṅ mi ’jigs pa daṅ ma ’dres pa la sogs pa saṅs
rgyas kyi chos rnams yoṅs su smin par bya ba’i phyir ’phags pa’i lam sgom par byed pa
ni byaṅ chub kyi don ces bya’o.ma chags pas yoṅs su rdzogs par byed ces bya ba ni bdag daṅ
gźan daṅ byaṅ chub kyi don rnam pa gsum char la yaṅ dṅos por ’dzin pa med ciṅ, ’khor gsum
yoṅs su dag pa’i tshul gyis mthar phyin par byed pa de ni źes bya ba’i don to.

dus gsum la mkhas pa bśad pa’i ’og tu theg pa kun la mkhas pa bstan pas, ji ltar bstan pa bźin
du bśad par bźed nas de la byaṅ chub sems dpa’i theg pa thams cad la mkhas pa gaṅ źe na
źes dris te, theg pa thams cad la mkhas pa ni theg pa kun la mkhas pa ste, theg pa thams
cad kyi rgyu daṅ raṅ bźin daṅ ’bras bu phyin ci ma log par rtogs pa’o. de la theg pa thams
cad ni bsdus na rnam pa gñis te, a) ’jig rten las ’das pa’i theg pa daṅ, b) ’jig rten gyi
theg pa’o.a) ’jig rten las ’das pa’i theg pa bstan par bźed nas gsum po ’di dag ni theg pa
ste ṅes par ’byin pa’o źes bya ba la sogs pa gsuṅs te, ñan thos daṅ, raṅ saṅs rgyas daṅ,
byaṅ chub sems dpa’i theg pa ’di gsum ni ’jig rten las ’das pa’i theg pa źes bya ste, ci’i
phyir źe na? ’khor ba las ’byin par byed pa’i phyir ro.b) The ways of gods and men, being
laukika, as different from the three lokottara, mentioned before but leading to them, are
explained in detail in ṭ. fol. 147a5-b5: ’jig rten gyi theg pa bstan par bźed nas gźan yaṅ
theg pa gñis te, gñis gaṅ źe na? lha’i theg pa daṅ mi’i theg pa’o źes bya ba gsuṅs pa’o.
de la lha rnams kyi theg pa yin pas na lha’i theg pa daṅ, mi rnams kyi theg pa yin pas na
mi’i theg pa’am lhar ’gyur ba’i theg pa daṅ mi ’gyur ba’i theg pa ni lha’i theg pa daṅ daṅ
mi’i theg pa źes bya’o.de la lha’i sgras ni rgyal chen bźi la sogs pa ’dod pa’i khams lha
drug daṅ, gzugs kyi khams kyi lha daṅ, nam mkha’ mtha’ yas la sogs pa gzugs med pa’i khams
kyi lha rnams bsdu’o. theg pa’i sgras ni bsod nams su ñe bar ’gro ba’i ’du byed srog gcod
pa las phyir log pa la sogs pa dge ba bcu’i las kyi lam daṅ, rtog pa daṅ bcas dpyod pa
daṅ bcas pa źes bya ba la sogs pa zag pa daṅ bcas pa’i gzugs kyi khams kyi bsam gtan bźi
daṅ, nam mkha’ mtha’ yas so źes bya ba la sogs pa gzugs med pa’i khams kyi sñoms par ’jug
pa bźi mi g-yo ba ñe bar ’gro ba’i mtshan ñid rnams bsdus te ’du byed de gñis kyis lha’i gnas
de dag thob par byed ciṅ der ’gro bas na lha’i theg pa źes bya’o.mi’i sgras ni gliṅ bźi
na gnas pa’i skyes pa daṅ bud med ces bya ba la sogs pa bsdus te, theg pa’i sgras ni dge
ba bcu’i las kyi raṅ bźin bsod nams su ñe bar ’gro ba’i ’du byed la bya’o. kha cig na re:
bsod nams ma yin par ñe bar ’gro ba srog gcod pa la sogs pa mi dge ba’i las kyi lam bcu po
rnams kyis kyaṅ ṅan soṅ gsum du ’gro źiṅ skye bar byed pas ’dis ’gro ba daṅ ’dir ’gro ba
źes bya la sogs pa theg par bstan pa’i mtshan ñid yod na ’dir ’jig rten pa’i theg pa’i naṅ
du ṅan soṅ gsum rnams ci’i phyir theg pa ma bsdus śe na? theg pa źes bya ba’i don ni rgyus
bde ba skyed par byed pa daṅ, ’bras bu’i tshe ’phags pa’i bden pa rtogs pa’i snod du ruṅ
ba la bya ste, mi dge ba bcu’i las kyi lam rnams la ’dis ’gro ba daṅ ’dir ’gro ba źes bya
ba bstan du ruṅ yaṅ mi dge ba’i las kyi lam gyi rgyu ñid sdug bsṅal skyed par byed pa daṅ
’bras bu’i tshe na yaṅ ’phags pa’i bden pa rtogs pa’i snod du mi ruṅ bas na theg pa źes
mi bya’o.

ñan thos kyi theg pa la mkhas pa bstan par bźed nas de la byaṅ chub sems dpa’i ñan thos kyi
theg pa la mkhas pa gaṅ źe na źes dris pa la sogs pa’o, byaṅ chub sems dpa’ rnams kyis mkhas
par bya ba’i ñan thos kyi theg pa ni byaṅ chub sems dpa’i ñan thos kyi theg pa la mkhas
pa ste, ñan thos kyi theg pa gaṅ źe na źes bya ba’i tha tshig go.’dis ’gro bas na theg pa
ste, gaṅ gis ’gro źe na? tshul khrims kyi phuṅ po la sogs pas ’gro bas theg pa’i sgra ni
bslab pa gsum la bya’o. yaṅ na, ’dir ’gro bas na theg pa ste, des ni rnam par grol ba daṅ
rnam par grol ba’i ye śes mthoṅ ba’i phuṅ po la theg pa źes bya bar rig par bya’o – rec: anena
gamyata iti yānam, kena gamyate / śīlaskandhādibhir gamyata iti yānaśabdaḥ śikṣātraye
/ punar api idaṃ gamyata iti yānam, tena vimuktivimuktijñānadarśanaskandhe yānaṃ veditavyam
/theg pa de’i mtshan ñid daṅ rgyu la sogs pa phyin ci ma log par rtogs pa ni ñan thos kyi
theg pa la mkhas pa ste, de’aṅ ’og nas ’chad do. de la ñan thos kyi theg pa yaṅ rnam pa
drug tu rig par bya ste, 1) rten daṅ, 2) dmigs pa daṅ, 3) rgyu daṅ, 4) sgrub pa daṅ, 5) ’bras
bu daṅ, 6) de rab tu rig pa’o.

saṅs rgyas byuṅ ba med par ñan thos kyi theg pa yaṅ med do źes bya ba ni dga’ ldan gyi pho braṅ
nas byaṅ chub sems dpa’ ’chi ’pho ba bstan te, yum gyi lhums su bltams pa daṅ, btsas pa
daṅ, gźon nu la sogs pa’i rim pas sems can gyi don du thabs kyi spyod pa rnam pa sna tshogs
mdzad nas khab nas byuṅ ste, dka’ bar spyad pa la sogs pas bstan nas mṅon par saṅs rgyas
pa ni saṅs rgyas ’byuṅ ba źes bya ste, saṅs rgyas ’byuṅ ba la brten pa med par ñan thos
kyi theg pa ’byuṅ ba yaṅ med do źes bya ba’i don to. ’dis ni rten (1, cf. fol. 148a1) bstan
pa yin no.

de ci’i phyir źe na źes bya ba ni rgyu ’dri ba ste, saṅs rgyas ’byuṅ ba med par ñan thos kyi
theg pa yaṅ ci’i phyir med ce na źes bya ba’i tha tshig go, de’i lan du ñan thos rnams kyi
yaṅ dag par lta ba ni pha rol gyi sgra’i rjes su ’gro ba źes bya ba gsuṅs te, gaṅ chos thams
cad la gaṅ zag gi dṅos po med de, gaṅ zag la bdag med pa yaṅ dag pa’i ye śes kyis khoṅ
du chud pa ni ñan thos rnams kyi yaṅ dag par lta ba’o; yaṅ dag pa’i lta ba de yaṅ saṅs rgyas
sam, mkhan po’am, slob dpon gyis bśad pa’i sgra mñan nas gaṅ zag la bdag med par dmigs
par byed pas na pha rol gyi sgra’i rjes su ’gro ba źes bya ste. ’dis ni dmigs par smra ba
(2, cf. fol. 148a1) yin no.

pha rol gyis bstan pa’i sgra mñan nas źes bśad na ñan pa ni gaṅ źe na? de’i phyir de la ñan
pa ni gaṅ ’di’i tshul khrims sdom pa źes bya ba gsuṅs te, ñon moṅs pa’i gduṅ ba sel ciṅ sim
par byed pas tshul khrims te, des lus daṅ ṅag gi ñes pa daṅ kha na ma tho ba rnams mi ’byuṅ
bar sdom par byed pas na tshul khrims ñid sdom pa ste, de la ñan pa ni de yin no źes bya
ba’i don to. ji ltar bslab pa bcas pa’i rjes su ’jug pa ni źes bya ba la, de ltar tshul
khrims kyi sdom pa mñan nas ji ltar bcom ldan ’das kyis pham pa bźi daṅ, dge ’dun lhag ma
bcu gsum la sogs pa’i tshul khrims ñis brgya lṅa bcu bcas pa bźin du kha na ma tho ba phra
rab tsam yaṅ med par slob ciṅ byed pa ni ji ltar bslab pa bcas pa’i rjes su ’jug pa źes
bya ste, rgyu des tshul khrims kyi phuṅ po rdzogs par ’gyur bas na ’dis ni rgyu (3, cf. fol.
148a1) smras pa yin no.ṭ. fol. 148b2: de la sgrub pa (4, cf. fol. 148a1) yaṅ rnam pa gsum
ste, 1) tiṅ ṅe ’dzin gyi gnas rab tu sgrub pa daṅ, 2) ye śes kyi rten rab tu sgrub pa daṅ,
3) bya ba byas pa rab tu sgrub pa’o.tshul khrims kyi phuṅ po rab tu rdzogs par ’gyur te
źes bya ba la tshul khrims kyi sgras yan lag drug daṅ ldan pa’i tshul khrims la bya ste,
yan lag drug po gaṅ źe na? 1) tshul khrims daṅ ldan par gnas pa źes yan lag daṅ po daṅ, 2)
so sor thar pa’i sdom pas bsdams pa źes yan lag gñis pa daṅ, 3) cho ga phun sum tshogs pa
źes yan lag gsum pa daṅ, 4) spyod yul phun sum tshogs pa źes yan lag bźi pa daṅ, 5) kha
na ma tho ba phra rab tsam dag la yaṅ ’jigs par lta źes yan lag lṅa pa daṅ, 6) bslab pa’i
gźi rnams yaṅ dag par blaṅs nas slob ces yan lag drug pa’o.1) ji ltar tshul khrims daṅ ldan
pa yin źe na? yaṅ dag par blaṅs pa’i bslab pa’i gźi rnams la lus kyi las kyi mtha’ ma log
pa daṅ, ṅag gi las kyi mtha’ ma log par gyur ciṅ, ma ñams par byed pa daṅ, skyon med par
byed pa’o – kathaṃ śīlavān viharati / yathā samātteṣu śi(3)kṣāpadeṣu avipannakāyakarmāntaś
ca bhavaty avipannavākkarmāntaś ca / akhaṇḍacārī achidracārī ... quoted from Śbh fol. 2A12-3,
S p. 3710-13, D fol. 16a2-3.2) ji ltar so sor thar pa’i sdom pas bsdams pa yin źe na?
dge sloṅ pha daṅ, dge sloṅ ma daṅ, dge bsñen pha daṅ, dge bsñen ma daṅ, dge slob ma daṅ,
dge tshul pa daṅ, dge tshul ma’i tshul khrims rnams la so sor thar pa’i sdom pa źes bya ste,
de dag kyaṅ sde tha dad par dbye bas sdom pa maṅ du ’gyur med kyi, ’di’i skabs su dge
sloṅ gi sdom pa la dgoṅs nas so sor thar pa’i sdom pas bsdams pa źes gsuṅs so – Śbh fol. 2A13-4,
S p. 3714-381, D fol. 16a3-4: kathaṃ prātimokṣasamvarasaṃvṛto bhavati / saptanairyāṇikaṃ
śīlaṃ prātimokṣasamvara ity ucyate / ta ete nikāyabhedena bahavaḥ samvarā bhavanti /
asmiṃs tv arthe bhikṣusamvaram adhiṣṭhāyāha /(4) prātimokṣasamvarasaṃvṛtaḥ /3) ji ltar cho
ga phun sum tshogs pa yin źe na? de ltar spyod lam mam, ’phral gyi bya ba’am, dge ba’i phyogs
la rab tu sbyor ba yaṅ ruṅ ste, bya ba thams cad la ’jig rten gyi rjes su ’jug ciṅ ’jig
rten gyis dpyas par mi ’gyur ba daṅ, ’dul ba’i rjes su ’jug ciṅ ’dul ba daṅ ’gal bar mi
byed pa’o – Śbh fol. 2A14, S p. 382-5, D fol. 16a4-5: katham ācārasampanno bhavati / yathāpi
tadīryāpatham itikaraṇīyaṃ vā kuśalapakṣaprayogam vā adhiṣṭhāya lokānuvarttinā lokānutkrāntena
vinayānuvarttinā vinayānutkrāntena cācāreṇa samanvāgato bhavati /4) ji ltar spyod
yul phun sum tshogs pa yin źe na? dge sloṅ dag lṅa po ’di dag ni spyod yul ma yin pa ste,
gaṅ źe na? smad ’tshoṅ ma daṅ, chaṅ ’tshoṅ ma daṅ, śa ’tshoṅ gi gnas daṅ, rgyal po’i pho
braṅ daṅ, gdol ba’i khyim mo źes gsuṅs te, gaṅ de bźin gśegs pas ma gnaṅ ba’i spyod yul de
dag spaṅs nas, spyod yul gźan du ’jug par byed pa’o – Śbh fol. 2B14, S p. 405-9, D fol.
17a3-5: katañ ca gocarasampanno bhavati / pañca bhikṣor agocarāḥ / katame pañca / tad yathā
ghoṣo veṣaṃ pānāgāraḥ rājakulaṃ caṇḍālakaṭhinam eva pañcamam iti / ya etāṃs tathāgatapratikṣiptān
agocarān varjayitvā anyatra gocare caraty [anavadye ta(5)tra kālenaivaṃ gocarasampanno
bhavati /]5) ji ltar kha na ma tho ba phra rab tsam dag la yaṅ ’jigs par lta ba yin
źe na? kha na ma tho ba phra rab ces bya ba ni gaṅ bslab pa’i gźi phran tshegs su gyur pa
rnams te, de dag ñams par gyur na ’bad pa chuṅ ṅus spoṅ bar byed pa’o. de la ’jigs par lta
ba ni gal te bdag la de byuṅ bar gyur na ma thob pa thob par bya ba daṅ, ma rtogs pa rtogs
par bya ba daṅ, mṅon sum du ma byas pa mṅon sum du bya ba’i skal ba med ciṅ ṅan soṅ du
lhuṅ bar gyur ro sñam nas srog gi phyir yaṅ de dag las ñams par mi byed pa’o – Śbh fol. 2B15-6,
7-8, S p. 411-9, 15-16, D fol. 17a5-b3: katham aṇumātreṣv avadyeṣu bhayadarśī bhavati
/ aṇumātram avadyam ucyate / kṣudrāṇukṣudrāṇi śikṣāpadāni yeṣv adhyāpattir vyutthānaṃ ca
prajñāyate / teṣāṃ yādhyāpattir idam avadyam aṇumātraṃ / punas tathā hi tasyā adhyāpatter
alpakṛcchreṇa vyutthiṣṭhate (6) yena tad aṇumātram ity ucyate / tatra kathaṃ bhayadarśī bhavati
/ mā haivāham eṣām adhyāpattihetor abhavyo vā syām aprāptasya prāptaye anadhigatasyâdhigamāya
asākṣātkṛtasya sākṣātkriyāyai apāyago vā syām apāyagāmī .... jīvatahetor api na
[saṃdhi(8)bhyo] vyāpadyate /6) ji ltar bslab pa’i gźi rnams yaṅ dag par blaṅs nas slob pa
yin źe na? daṅ po so sor thar pa’i sdom pa len pa’i dus na gsol ba daṅ bźi’i las kyis bsñen
par rdzogs par byed pa’i tshe bslab pa’i gźi kha cig mkhan po daṅ slob dpon las thos nas,
gźan dag ni zla ba phyed phyed ciṅ so sor thar pa’i mdo ’don pa’i tshe na gaṅ yin pa śes
par gyis śig ces bstan nas, de ltar so sor thar pa’i sdom pa thob ste, de phyin chad ni
ji ltar blaṅs pa daṅ blaṅ bar dam bcas pa rnams kyaṅ blaṅs nas, lhag chad med par bslab par
byed pa’o – Śbh fol. 2B18-2A23, S p. 4119-4216, D 17b4-7, 18a1-2: kathaṃ samādāya śi(2A2)kṣate
śikṣāpadeṣu / āha / pūrvvam anena prātimokṣasamvarasamādānajñapticaturthena karmmaṇā
upasampadyamānena katipayānāṃ śikṣāpadānāṃ śarīraṃ śrutaṃ sātirekaṃ ca tad anyaṃ divasaṃ
śikṣāpadaśataṃ prātimokṣasūtroddiṣṭaṃ pratijñāyevopagataṃ sarvvatra labhiṣyāmīti / ācāryopādhyāyānām
antikāc chrutvā ..(2).. tataś ca tena .... prātimokṣasamvaraḥ pratilabdhas tata
uttarakālaṃ .... samādāya yathānuśiṣṭaḥ anyūnam adhikaṃ śikṣate /yan lag drug pa’i tshul
khrims kyi tshogs sam tshul khrims maṅ po bsdus pa ni tshul khrims kyi phuṅ po źes bya ste,
daṅ po tshul khrims yaṅ dag par blaṅs pa nas brtsams nas tha mar rnam par grol ba’i ye
śes la thug gi bar du rdul tsam yaṅ ñams pa daṅ god pa med pa’o. de ltar ñams pa daṅ god pa
med pas tshul khrims kyi mthar phyin te, zag pa med pa’i tshul khrims kyi mtshan ñid du
gyur pa ni tshul khrims kyi phuṅ po yoṅs su rdzogs pa źes bya’o.de ltar tshul khrims kyi phuṅ
po rgyas par bśad nas de yaṅ mdor bsdus na tshul khrims kyi phuṅ po’i mtshan ñid rnam
pa gsum du rig par bya ste: 1) chud mi za ba’i mtshan ñid daṅ, 2) raṅ bźin gyi mtshan ñid
daṅ, 3) raṅ bźin gyi yon tan gyi mtshan ñid do – Śbh fol. 2A24-5, S p. 4218-432, D fol. 18a2-4:
evaṃ samādāya śikṣate śikṣāpadeṣv ayaṃ tāvad vibhaṃgaḥ śīlasamvarasya vistarakṛtaḥ //
tatra kathamaḥ samāsārthaḥ / tathāyaṃ samāsārthas trilakṣaṇa eva śīlaskandhaḥ paridīpito
bhagavatā / tadyathā avipraṇāśalakṣaṇaḥ svabhāvalakṣaṇaḥ svabhāvagu(5)ṇalakṣaṇaś ca /1) de
la thaṅ cig tshul khrims daṅ ldan źes bya bas tshul khrims kyi sdom pa chud mi za ba’i mtshan
ñid bstan pa yin no – Śbh fol. 2A25, S p. 432-3, D fol. 18a4: yathā katham iti / yat
tāvad āha śīlavān viharatîty anena tāvad avipraṇāśalakṣaṇaṃ śīlasamvarasyākhyātaṃ /2) gaṅ
so sor thar pa’i sdom pas bsdams pa źes bya bas ni raṅ bźin gyi mtshan ñid smras so – Śbh
fol. 2A25, S p. 433-5, D fol. 18a4-5: yat punar āha prātimokṣasamvarasaṃvṛta iti / anena
svabhāvalakṣaṇam ākhyātaṃ /3) cho ga daṅ spyod yul phun sum tshogs pa źes bya bas ni pha rol
la brten nas de ltar yaṅ dag par blaṅs pa’i so sor thar pa’i sdom pa’i yon tan gyi mtshan
ñid bstan pa yin te, ’di ltar gźan dag gi cho ga daṅ spyod yul phun sum tshogs par mthoṅ
na ma dad pa rnams ni dad par ’gyur, dad pa rnams ni dad pa phyir źiṅ ’phel bar ’gyur ro.
gaṅ yaṅ kha na ma tho ba phra rab tsam la yaṅ ’jigs par lta ba daṅ, bslab pa’i gźi rnams
yaṅ dag par blaṅs nas slob pa gñis kyis raṅ gi dbaṅ du byas nas tshul khrims kyi yon tan
smras pa yin te, ci’i phyir źe na? yaṅ dag par blaṅs pa la rdul tsam yaṅ ñams pa med pa daṅ,
bslab pa’i gźi chen po dag blaṅs śiṅ slob pa’i rgyus ṅan soṅ du skye ba’i skal ba med ciṅ
ma thob pa la sogs pa yaṅ ’thob par ’gyur pas so – Śbh fol. 2A25-6, 2A27-2B21,, S p. 435-10,
p. 4314-20, D fol. 18a5-6, b1-3: [yat punar āha] ācāragocarasampanna iti / anena param
upanidhāya tathā samādattasya prātimokṣasamva(6)rasya guṇalakṣaṇam ākhyātaṃ / tathāpy apare
tām ācāragocarasampadam upalabhyāprasannāś ca prasīdanti prasannānāṃ ca bhavati bhūyobhāvaḥ
/ .... yat punar āha / aṇumātreṣv avadyeṣu bhayadarśī samādāya śikṣate śikṣāpadeṣu
/ anenādhyātmādhipateyaguṇānuśansalakṣaṇam ākhyātaṃ / tat kasya hetor yad asyedam ācāragocarasampannaḥ
parādhipateyaṃ guṇānuśansaṃ pratilabheta / api ca śīlam vi(2B2)pātayitvā taddhetus
tatpratyayam apāyeṣūpapadyate / abhavyatām vā aprāptasya prāptaye pūrvvavat /. ṭ abbreviates
the last portion.Notes to the Sanskrit text: 1) S ...kāya... for ...vāk... 2) ṭ enumerates
the seven 3) ṭ, but not D, reads an inserted na 4) S prati... for prāti... 5) MS
...ya for ...yaṃ 6) MS om. daṇḍa 7) MS ...ms 8) Cf. D bdag .... mi ruṅ ṅo sñam nas .... S
sā hai vāha (so ’ha)m ṭ yadi me sā bhaved abhavyo vā syām ... ? 9) S pratijñayev... 10) The
syllables la and bhi are partly hidden and somewhat uncertain, S has la(bdhā)ṣyāmîti (lapsyāmîti)
11) MS, S ins. daṇḍa 12) MS, S om. daṇḍa 13) MS aha 14) S // 15) MS, S ...pannaḥ
for ...panna iti 16) S tathāpi pare MS uncertain 17) S ...aṃ

’dis ni tiṅ ṅe ’dzin gyi gnas rab tu sgrub pa (1, cf. fol. 148b2) bstan te, ’di ltar tshul khrims
brten nas sems rtse gcig pa la rab tu reg par ’gyur ba’i phyir ro. de bas na gźuṅ ñid
las kyaṅ tshul khrims kyi phuṅ po yoṅs su rdzogs nas tiṅ ṅe ’dzin gyi phuṅ po yoṅs su rdzogs
par byed pa źes gsuṅs so.de la tiṅ ṅe ’dzin gaṅ źe na? ’di la I. dge sloṅ ’dod pa las
dben pa, sdig pa mi dge ba’i chos rnams la dben pa, rtog pa daṅ bcas pa, dpyod pa daṅ bcas
pa, dben pa las skyes pa’i dga’ ba daṅ bde ba can bsam gtan daṅ po ñe bar bsgrubs nas gnas
so. II. de rtog pa daṅ dpyod pa daṅ bral źiṅ naṅ yoṅs su daṅ ste, sems kyi rgyud gcig tu
gyur pas rtog pa med pa, dpyod pa med pa’i tiṅ ṅe ’dzin las skyes pa’i dga’ ba daṅ, bde
ba can bsam gtan gñis pa ñe bar bsgrubs nas gnas so. III. de dga’ ba’i ’dod chags daṅ bral
bas btaṅ sñoms la gnas śiṅ dran pa daṅ śes bźin can yin no, bde ba lus kyis myoṅ la ’phags
pa rnams kyis gaṅ de dran pa daṅ ldan pa, bde ba la gnas pa btaṅ sñoms pa’o źes brjod pa
ste, dga’ ba med pa’i bsam gtan gsum pa ñe bar bsgrubs nas gnas so. IV. de bde ba yaṅ spaṅs
te, sṅa nas sdug bsṅal yaṅ spaṅs śiṅ yid bde ba daṅ yid mi bde ba yaṅ nub pas bde ba yaṅ
ma yin sdug bsṅal ba yaṅ ma yin pas btaṅ sñoms daṅ dran pa yoṅs su dag pa bsam gtan bźi
pa ñe bar bsgrubs nas gnas so źes gsuṅs pa ni tiṅ ṅe ’dzin źes bya’o – quoted from Śbh fol.
1A26-8, S p. 141-159, D fol. 6b2-6: samādhisanniśrayaḥ katamaḥ / sa ... viviktaṃ kāmair
viviktam pāpakair akuśalair dharmaiḥ sa[vitarka]ṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ prītisukhaṃ prathamaṃ
dhyānam upasaṃpadya viharati / sa vitarkavicāraṇāṃ (7) vyupaśamād adhyātmasaṃprasādāc cetasa
ekotībhāvād avitarkam avicāraṃ samādhijaṃ prītisukhaṃ dvitīyaṃ dhyānam upasampadya viharati
/ sa prīter virāgād upekṣako viharati smṛtaḥ saṃprajānan sukhaṃ ca kāyena pratisamvedayate
yat tad āryā ācakṣate upekṣakaḥ smṛtimān sukhavihārī niṣprītikaṃa tṛtīyaṃ dhyānam
upasampadya viharati / (8) sa sukhasya ca prahāṇād duḥkhasya ca prahāṇāt pūrvam eva ca saumanasyadaurmanasyayor
astagamād aduḥkhāsukham upekṣāsmṛtipariśuddhaṃ caturthaṃ dhyānam upasampadya
viharati / ayam ucyate samādhisanniśrayaḥ / The enumeration of the four dhyānas is
based upon the classical description; for references v. Śbh p. 14, n. 1, 2; Edg. s. v. dhyāna,
Mvy no. 1478-81.Then a commentary on the above, based on excerpts from Śbh p. 44914ff:de
la bsam gtan rnams ni rnam pa bźis rnam par gźag ste, 1) mi mthun pa’i phyogs ñams par
byed pa daṅ, 2) gñen po bsgom pa daṅ, 3) bsgoms pa’i phan yon daṅ, 4) de gñi ga’i gnas
so.I. dhyāna: 1) de la bsam gtan daṅ po la "’dod pa dag las dben pa sdig pa mi dge ba’i chos
rnams las dben pa" źes bya bas mi mthun pa’i phyogs ñams pa bstan te:"’dod pa dag las dben
pa" źes bya ba ni ñon moṅs pa’i ’dod pa daṅ, dṅos po’i ’dod pa’o; ’dod pa dag las dben
pa ste, mthuṅs par ldan pa las dben pa daṅ, dmigs pa las dben pa’i phyir ro. "sdig pa mi
dge ba’i chos rnams las dben pa" źes bya ba ni gaṅ dag ñon moṅs pa’i ’dod pa’i rgyu las byuṅ
ba’i lus daṅ ṅag daṅ yid kyi ñes par spyod par gtogs pa chad pas gcod pa daṅ, mtshon ’debs
pa daṅ, ’thab pa daṅ, rtsod pa daṅ, ’gyed pa daṅ, g-yo ba’i tshig daṅ, gnod pa daṅ, brdzun
du smra ba la sogs pa de dag las dben pa’o – Śbh fol. 13A62-4, S p. 44914-45013, D fol.
169a3-b1: viviktaṃ kāmair iti / dvividhāḥ kāmāḥ kleśakāmā vastukāmāś ca / kāmaviveko ’pi
dvividhaḥ / saṃprayogaviveka ālambanavivekaś ca / viviktaṃ (3) pāpakair akuśalair dharmair
iti / upakleśāḥ kāmahetukā akuśalā dharmās tad yathā kāyaduścaritaṃ vāgduścaritaṃ manoduścaritaṃ
/ daṇḍādānaṃ śastrādānaṃ / kalahabhaṇḍanavigrahavivādaśāṭhyavañcananikṛtimṛṣāvādāḥ
sambhavanti / teṣāṃ prahāṇād viviktaṃ pāpakair akuśalair dharmair iti /2) rnam par rtog
pa daṅ rnam par dpyod pa dag skyon du ma mthoṅ bas ’dod pa’i gñen pa de dag gñis daṅ mtshuṅs
par ldan pa’i phyir "rtog pa daṅ bcas dpyod pa daṅ bcas pa" źes bya bas gñen po bsgom
pa bstan te, rtog pa daṅ dpyod pa gñis kyis ’dod pa daṅ, sdig pa mi dge ba’i chos ’joms par
byed pas so – vitarkavicāreṣv adoṣadarśanāt svabhūmi(4)kair vitarkavicāraiḥ kāmaprātipakṣikaiḥ
kuśalaiḥ savitarkaṃ savicāram iti / Not verbatim.3) "dben pa las skyes pa’i dga’ ba
daṅ bde ba can" źes bya bas bsgoms pa’i phan yon bstan te, ’dod pa las dben pa’am, sgrib
pa las dben pa las skyes pa’i dga’ ba daṅ bde ba ni "dben pa las skyes pa’i dga’ ba daṅ bde
ba" źes bya ste, ’dod pa’i don rñed nas gnas ṅan len thams cad daṅ bral bas lus daṅ sems
śin tu sbyaṅs te las su ruṅ ba’i phyir ro – prayoganiṣṭho manaskāraḥ kāmavivekaḥ / tasyānantaram
utpannaṃ taddhetukaṃ tatpratyayaṃ tenāha vivekajam / īpsitābhilaṣitārthasaṃprāpteḥ
prītau cādoṣadarśanāt / sarvadauṣṭulyāpagamāc ca vipulapraśrabdhicittakāyakarmaṇyatayā prītisukham
/ Not verbatim.4) "bsam gtan daṅ po ñe bar bsgrubs te gnas" źes bya bas de gñis
ka’i gnas bstan te, gñen po bsgom pa daṅ bsgoms pa’i phan yon gñis ni bsam gtan daṅ po’i sems
rtse gcig pa las grub pa’i phyir te, ’og ma dag la yaṅ de bźin du sbyar ro. ṭ only provides
short comments on the last portion of the first dhyāna, namely prathamaṃ dhyānam upasaṃpadya
viharati. The use of Śbh p. 45014-4514, D fol. 169b1-4 seems very limited.II. dhyāna:
1) "de rtog pa daṅ dpyod pa daṅ bral" źes bya bas bsam gtan gñis pa’i mi mthun pa’i phyogs
ñams pa bstan te, bsam gtan daṅ po’i rnam par rtog pa daṅ bcas, rnam par dpyod pa daṅ
bcas pa’i tiṅ ṅe ’dzin gyis mtshan ma dag la skyon du mthoṅ nas de las sems bzlog ste, rnam
par rtog pa med pa daṅ rnam par dpyod pa med pa’i tiṅ ṅe ’dzin gyis mtshan ma las sems
ñe bar ’dogs par byed pa’o – Śbh fol. 13A66-13B61, S p. 4514-13, D fol. 169b5-170a1: savitarkasavicārasamādhinimittebhyaś
cittam vyāvarttayitvā avitarkāvicārasamādhinimitteṣūpanibadhnāti
/2) "naṅ yoṅs su daṅ ste, sems kyi rgyud gcig tu gyur" ces bya bas gñen po bsgom pa
bstan te, de ltar rtog pa daṅ dpyod pa daṅ bcas pa’i dmigs pa daṅ bral bar byas nas rtse
gcig tu dpyod pa’i dmigs pa la ṅaṅ gcig pas źi ba daṅ, rab tu daṅ ba’i sems su ’jog pas na
yoṅs su daṅ ba yin la, de de ltar sems ñe bar ’jog pas rnam par rtog pa daṅ bcas rnam par
dpyod pa daṅ bcas pas glags daṅ bcas śiṅ, bar chad daṅ bcas pa’i gnas skabs las ’das nas
sgom pa goms pas glags med ciṅ bar chad med pa’i gnas skabs thob par ’gyur pas "sems kyi
rgyud gcig tu gyur pa" źes bya’o – vyagracāriṇa ālambanād vivecya avyagracāriṇy ālambane ekadharmatayā
śāntaṃ prasannaṃ cittaṃ pravarttate / vyavasthā(7)payati / tenāha vitarkavicārāṇāṃ
vyupaśamād adhyātmasaṃprasādanāt / sa bhāvanābhyāsāt tasyaivāvitarkāvicārasya samādheḥ
vitarkavicārasachidrasāntarām avasthām atikramya niśchidranirantarā(13B6)m avasthāṃ prāpnoti
/ tenāha / cetasa ekotībhāvāt /3) "tiṅ ṅe ’dzin las skyes pa’i dga’ ba daṅ bde ba can"
źes bya bas bsgoms pa’i phan yon bstan te, bsam gtan daṅ po’i dben pa las skyes pa’i dga’
ba daṅ bde ba las khyad par du ’phags pa bstan to, cf. Śbh p. 45116-22.4) "bsam gtan gñis
pa ñe bar bsgrubs nas gnas" źes bya bas de gñi ga’i gnas bstan to.III. dhyāna: 1) "de dga’
ba’i ’dod chags daṅ bral bas" źes bya bas bsam gtan gsum pa’i mi mthun pa’i phyogs ñams
pa bstan te, tiṅ ṅe ’dzin las skyes pa’i sems dga’ ba’i ’dod chags daṅ bral ba’i phyir ro,
cf. Śbh p. 45123ff.2) "btaṅ sñoms la gnas śiṅ dran pa daṅ śes bźin can yin" źes bya bas
gñen po bsgom pa bstan te, rnam par rtog pa daṅ bcas, rnam par dpyod pa daṅ bcas pa de dag
daṅ dga’ ba yaṅ spaṅs pas bar chad med par btaṅ sñoms daṅ ldan par gnas so. de yaṅ dga’
ba daṅ ldan pa’i ’du śes yid la byed pa rnams kyi go skabs mi dbye ba’i phyir dran pa ñe bar
gnas pa yin la, skyes pa rnams kyaṅ nam yaṅ ji ltar yaṅ daṅ yaṅ du mi blaṅ ba’i phyir śes
rab kyis naṅ du gnas pas na "dran pa daṅ ldan źiṅ śes bźin can" źes bya’o – Śbh fol. 13B63-13A71,
S p. 4526-45317, D fol. 170b1-171a3: tatra pratame dhyāne vitarkavicārā bhavanti
/ yena nirantaropekṣā na pravarttate / dvitīye dhyāne (4) prītir bhavati / yenātrāpi nirantaropekṣā
na pravarttate / tenāyaṃ dhyāyī prathamadvitīyeṣu dhyāneṣu nāsti tena tṛtīye dhyāne
upekṣako viharatīty ucyate / sa upekṣakas sans tathā tathopasthitasmṛtir viharati /
yathā yathā te prītisahagatāḥ saṃjñāmanasikārāḥ na samudācaranti / sa cet punar abhāvitatvāt
tṛtīyasya dhyāna(5)sya smṛtisaṃpramoṣāt kadācit karhacic citte prītisahagatāḥ saṃjñāmanasikārāḥ
samudācaranti / tāṃ laghu laghv eva prajñayā pratividhyati / samyag eva prajānāti
/ utpannotpannāṃś ca nādhivāsayati / prajahāti vinodayati / vyantīkaroti / cittam adhyupekṣate
/ tenāha smṛtaḥ saṃprajānann iti / ṭ abridges.3) "bde ba lus kyis myoṅ la, ’phags pa
rnams kyis gaṅ de dran pa daṅ ldan pa bde ba la gnas pa btaṅ sñoms pa’o źes brjod pa ste"
źes bya bas bsgoms pa’i phan yon bstan te, de ltar btaṅ sñoms la maṅ du gnas pa de sems g-yeṅ
ba med pa’i dga’ ba daṅ ldan pa’i tshor ba spaṅs nas, dga’ ba med pa’i źi ba rab tu źi
ba’i tshor ba ’byuṅ ste, de yaṅ de’i tshe gzugs kyi lus daṅ yid kyi lus kyis tshor ba’i
bde ba daṅ śin tu sbyaṅs pa’i bde ba myoṅ bar byed pas na "bde ba lus kyis myoṅ ba" źes bya’o.
bsam gtan ’og ma gñis la ni de lta bu’i bde ba daṅ btaṅ sñoms med la, goṅ ma la ni btaṅ
sñoms yod kyaṅ bde ba med kyi, bsam gtan gsum pa ’di ñid bde ba daṅ btaṅ sñoms kyi gnas
yin pas ’phags pa saṅs rgyas rnams daṅ saṅs rgyas kyi ñan thos rnams kyis bsam gtan gsum
pa ’di ñid la "dran pa daṅ ldan pa bde ba la gnas pa btaṅ sñoms pa’o" źes gtso bor bsṅags
pas na "’phags pa rnams kyis gaṅ de dran pa daṅ ldan pa, bde ba la gnas pa, btaṅ sñoms pa’o
źes brjod pa" źes gsuṅs so – tasya tasmin samaye e(6)vam upekṣakasya viharatā smṛtasya saṃprajanyasyāsevanānvayād
bhāvanānvayād bahulīkārānvayāt prītisahagataṃ prahīyate tac cittauddhatyakaraṃ
/ niḥprītikaṃ ca śāntaṃ praśāntaṃ cetasi veditam utpadyate prītiprātipakṣyena
/ tasmin samaye rūpakāyena manaḥkāyena veditam (13A7) sukhaṃ ca praśrabdhisukhaṃ pratisamvedayate
/ tenāha sukhaṃ ca kāyena pratisaṃvedayate / tṛtīyāc ca dhyānāt adhas tadrūpaṃ
sukhaṃ nāsti nāpi nirantarā upekṣā / tṛtīyād dhyānād ūrdhvaṃ yad apy upekṣopalabhyate / na
tu sukhaṃ / tatrādhaḥ sukhopekṣābhāvād ūrdhvañ ca sukhābhāvāt / idaṃ tad āyatanaṃ yad uta
tṛtīyaṃ dhyānaṃ yat tad āryā (2) ācakṣate / yat pratilambhavihāriṇaṃ pudgalam adhikṛtya upekṣakaḥ
smṛtimāṃ sukhavihārī tṛtīyaṃ dhyānam upasaṃpadya viharatīti / āryāḥ punaḥ buddhāś
ca buddhaśrāvakāś ca /IV. dhyāna: 1) "de bde ba yaṅ spaṅs te, sṅa nas sdug bsṅal yaṅ spaṅs
śiṅ yid bde ba daṅ yid mi bde ba yaṅ nub pas" źes bya bas bsam gtan bźi pa’i mi mthun pa’i
phyogs ñams pa bstan te, "bde ba yaṅ spaṅs" źes bya ba ni bsam gtan gsum pa daṅ ldan pa’i
bde ba bsam gtan bźi pa ’dis spaṅs par bstan pa’o. "sdug bsṅal yaṅ spaṅs" źes bya ba ni
bsam gtan gñis pa spaṅs pa yaṅ bsdus te bstan pa’o. "yid bde ba nub pas" śes bya ba ni bsam
gtan gsum pas dga’ ba spaṅs pa bstan pa’o. "yid mi bde ba nub pas" śes bya ba ni bsam gtan
gñis pas spaṅs pa bstan pa’o – Śbh fol. 13A74-6, S p. 4548-17, D fol. 171b1-4: tatra caturthadhyānasamāpattikāle
sukhasya ca prahāṇād dvitīyadhyānasa(5)māpattikāle duḥkhasya tṛtīyadhyānasamāpattikāle
saumanasyasyāstagamāt prathamadhyānasamāpattikāle daurmanasyasya /3)
"bde ba yaṅ ma yin sdug bsṅal ba yaṅ ma yin pa btaṅ sñoms daṅ dran pa yoṅs su dag pa" źes
bya bas bsgoms pa’i phan yon bstan te, tshor ba goṅ ma bźi po spaṅs pas sdug bsṅal yaṅ
ma yin bde ba yaṅ ma yin pa’i tshor ba daṅ ldan pa daṅ, bsam gtan gsum pa’i tshe btaṅ sñoms
daṅ dran pa yod kyaṅ yoṅs su ma dag pa, ’di’i tshe yoṅs su dag pa daṅ ldan par bstan pa’o
– asti tāvat sukhaduḥkhasya prahāṇād aduḥkhāsukhaivāsya vedanāvaśiṣṭā bhavati / tenāha /
aduḥkhāsukhā / tasmin samaye ...(6)... [teṣāṃ ca prahāṇād] yā tatropekṣā / smṛtiś ca sā pariśuddhā
bhavati /4) "bsam gtan bźi pa ñe bar bsgrubs te gnas" źes bya bas de gñi ga’i gnas
bstan to.Notes to the Sanskrit text: 1) Brackets: hole in MS 2) MS om. daṇḍa 3) S savitarkasavicārāṇāṃ

’di ni ye śes kyi rten du rab tu sgrub pa (2, cf. fol.148b2) bstan te, sems rtse gcig tu ’gyur
na yaṅ dag pa ji lta ba bźin du rab tu śes par ’gyur ba’i phyir ro. de bas na mdo las kyaṅ
tiṅ ṅe ’dzin gyi phuṅ po yoṅs su rdzogs nas śes rab kyi phuṅ po yoṅs su rdzogs par byed
pa daṅ źes gsuṅs te, de la śes rab kyi phuṅ po ’di ni sdug bsṅal ’phags pa’i bden pa’o źes
yaṅ dag pa ji lta ba bźin du śes pa daṅ, ’di ni sdug bsṅal kun ’byuṅ ba ’phags pa’i bden
pa’o źes yaṅ dag pa ji lta ba bźin du śes pa daṅ, ’di ni sdug bsṅal ’gog pa ’phags pa’i
bden pa’o źes yaṅ dag pa ji lta ba bźin du śes pa daṅ, ’di ni sdug bsṅal ’gog par ’gro bar
byed pa’i lam ’phags pa’i bden pa’o źes yaṅ dag pa ji lta ba bźin du śes pa ste ’phags pa’i
bden pa bźi phyin ci ma log par śes pa ni śes rab kyi phuṅ po yoṅs su rdzogs par byed pa
źes pa’o.

’di ni bya ba byas pa rab tu sgrub pa (3, cf. fol. 148b2) bstan te, ’di ltar ye śes śin tu rnam
par dag pas ni ñon moṅs pa spaṅs pa mṅon sum du byed pa’i phyir ro. de bas na mdo las
kyaṅ śes rab kyi phuṅ po yoṅs su rdzogs nas rnam par grol ba’i phuṅ po yoṅs su rdzogs par
byed pa źes gsuṅs te, de yaṅ tshul khrims rnam par dag pa ni ’gyod pa med par ’gyur ro, ’gyod
pa med na dga’ ba daṅ mchog tu dga’ ba daṅ śin tu rnam par sbyaṅs pa daṅ bde bar ’gyur
ro, bde bar gyur pa’i sems mñam par ’jog go, sems rnam par gźag na yaṅ dag pa ji lta ba bźin
du rab tu śes, yaṅ dag pa ji lta ba bźin du mthoṅ bar ’gyur ro, yaṅ dag pa ji lta ba bźin
du śes śiṅ mthoṅ bas skyo bar ’gyur ro, skyo bar ’gyur na ’dod pa’i zag pa las sems rnam
par grol ba daṅ, srid pa’i zag pa daṅ ma rig pa’i zag pa las sems rnam par grol te, rgyud
la dri ma med pa ’thob par ’gyur pas na rnam par grol ba’i phuṅ po yoṅs su rdzogs par byed
pa źes bya’o.’dis ni ’bras bu (5, cf. fol. 148a1) bstan te, rnam par grol ba’i phuṅ po
ni bslab pa gsum la źugs pa’i ’bras bu yin pa’i phyir ro.

de ltar khams gsum gyi ñon moṅs pa las sems rnam par grol nas de’i ’og tu rnam par grol ba ñid
śes śiṅ rig pa’i ye śes skyes te, de bas na mdo las kyaṅ rnam par grol ba’i phuṅ po yoṅs
su rdzogs nas rnam par grol ba’i ye śes mthoṅ ba’i phuṅ po yoṅs su rdzogs par byed ces gsuṅs
so.’dis ni de rab tu rig pa (6, cf. fol. 148a1) bstan te, rnam par grol ba’i ’og tu bdag
gi sdug bsṅal ni śes par byas, kun ’byuṅ ba ni spaṅs, ’gog pa ni mṅon sum du byas, lam
ni bsgoms pas de sdug bsṅal śes par bya mi dgos, kun ’byuṅ ba spaṅ mi dgos, ’gog pa mṅon
sum du bya mi dgos, lam bsgom mi dgos te, skye ba zad do, tshaṅs par spyad pa bsten to, bya
ba byas so, srid pa ’di las gźan mi śes so źes khoṅ du chud pa’i phyir ro.

gźan yaṅ ñan thos kyi theg pa la mkhas pa ni źes bya bas ñan thos kyi theg pa la mkhas pa rnam
graṅs gźan du ston te, mkhan po daṅ slob dpon gyis bśad pa’i sgra la brten nas gaṅ zag
la bdag med par dmigs pa ni ñan thos te, ñan thos de dag gi theg pa ni ñan thos kyi theg pa’o.
de yaṅ rnam pa gñis su rig par bya ste, 1) mi mthun pa’i phyogs sun ’byin pa daṅ, 2)
gñen po’i sa la yon tan du lta ba’o. de la 1) mi mthun pa’i phyogs sun ’byin pa ni gaṅ bsod
nams daṅ bsod nams ma yin pa źes bya ba nas brtsams te, skye ba’i gnas thams cad la mi smon
źes bya ba yan chad kyis bstan to; 2) gñen po’i sa la yon tan du lta ba ni mya ṅan las
’das pa la gnas daṅ skyabs su ’du śes pa źes bya bas bstan to. de bas na gaṅ gis ’gro ba
daṅ, gaṅ du ’gro ba’i phyir de gñis ni ñan thos kyi theg pa ste, gaṅ gis ’gro ba ni mi mthun
pa’i phyogs sun ’byin pa’i ’du śes kyis ’gro ba’o, gaṅ du ’gro ba ni mya ṅan las ’das pa’i
sar ’gro ba’o.mi mthun pa’i phyogs sun ’byin pa yaṅ rnam pa gñis te, 1) rgyu spoṅ ba daṅ,
2) ’bras bu spoṅ ba’o. rgyu spoṅ ba la yaṅ rnam pa gñis te, las spoṅ ba daṅ ñon moṅs pa
spoṅ ba’o. las spoṅ ba’i dbaṅ du byas nas gaṅ bsod nams daṅ źes bya ba la sogs pa smos te,
’du byed gsum ni khams gsum du skye ba’i rgyu byed par mthoṅ nas de rnams la rnam par smod
par byed de, rnam pa sna tshogs su smod pa ni rnam par smod pa ste, sun ’byin par byed
pa’o. de’aṅ rnam pa gñis te, sṅon byas pa spoṅ ba daṅ, phyis mi byed pa’o; de la sṅon byas
pa spoṅ ba ni ’du byed rnam pa gsum sṅon spyad pa’i bag chags yod pa la ’phags pa’i lam
gyis sbyoṅ ba’o; phyis mi byed pa ni phyin chad ’du byed rnam pa gsum gyi las la mi ’jug pa’o.
ñon moṅs pa spoṅ ba yaṅ rnam pa gñis te, a) de’i ’bras bu sdug bsṅal gyi bdag ñid du
mthoṅ bas de la mi dga’ ba daṅ, b) de’i rgyus sdug bsṅal bskyed par mthoṅ bas spoṅ bar ’dod
pa’o.khams gsum thams cad la yid byuṅ źiṅ źes bya bas de’i ’bras bu sdug bsṅal gyi bdag
ñid du mthoṅ bas de la mi dga’ ba bstan te, khams gsum ni ’dod pa’i khams daṅ, gzugs kyi khams
daṅ, gzugs med pa’i khams dag go. de la ’dod pa’i khams ni gliṅ bźi daṅ, ’dod pa’i khams
kyi lha drug daṅ, sems can dmyal ba daṅ, dud ’gro daṅ, yi dags rnams so. gzugs kyi khams
ni tshaṅs ris daṅ, tshaṅs pa mdun na ’don daṅ, tshaṅs chen źes bya ba la sogs pa gnas bcu
drug dag go. gzugs med pa’i khams ni nam mkha’ mtha’ yas skye mched ces bya ba la sogs
pa bźi’o. yid byuṅ ba ni khams gsum la skyo ba’o, ’dod chags daṅ bral ba źes bya bas de’i
rgyus sdug bsṅal bskyed par mthoṅ bas spoṅ bar ’dod pa bstan te, khams gsum ni ñon moṅs pa
spaṅs pa ni ’dod chags daṅ bral ba’o.’bras bu spoṅ ba’i dbaṅ du byas nas, ’du byed thams
cad la mi rtag ces bya ba la sogs pa smos so. thams cad kyi sgra daṅ rtog pa’i sgra gñi ga
daṅ sbyar te ’du byed thams cad la mi rtag par rtog pa daṅ, ’du byed thams cad la sdug bsṅal
bar rtog pa źes bya bar sbyar ro.rgyu daṅ rkyen gyis bskyed pa’i phuṅ po daṅ khams daṅ,
skye mched la sogs pa’i chos rnams ni ’du byed thams cad de, de dag mi rtag pa gñis kyis
’jig par byed pa ni ’du byed thams cad la mi rtag pa rtog pa źes bya’o.de la mi rtag pa rnam
pa gñis ni 1) ’jig pas mi rtag pa daṅ, 2) skad cig mas ’joms pas mi rtag pa’o:de la 1)
’jig pas mi rtag pa ni mthar ’chi bar ’gyur ba ste, mnar med pa nas brtsams nas srid pa’i
rtse mo’i bar du de na gnas pa’i sems can rnams raṅ gi gnas nas ’phos pas so. 2) skad cig
mas ’joms pas mi rtag pa ni skad cig ma re re la yaṅ ’jig ciṅ skye ba’i phyir ro.’du byed
thams cad sdug bsṅal rnam pa brgyad daṅ ldan par śes pa ni sdug bsṅal bar rtog pa źes bya
ste, sdug bsṅal rnam pa brgyad ni 1) skye ba’i sdug bsṅal daṅ, 2) rga ba’i sdug bsṅal daṅ,
3) na ba’i sdug bsṅal daṅ, 4) śi ba’i sdug bsṅal daṅ, 5) mi sdug pa daṅ phrad pa’i sdug
bsṅal daṅ, 6) sdug pa daṅ bral ba’i sdug bsṅal daṅ, 7) gaṅ ’dod pa de btsal te mi rñed pa’i
sdug bsṅal daṅ, 8) mdor na ñe bar len pa’i phuṅ po lṅa sdug bsṅal ba’o. The paragraph seems
based upon Abhidharmasamuccaya p. 3713ff: api khalu duḥkhalakṣaṇaprabhedā aṣṭau / jātir
duḥkhaṃ jarā duḥkhaṃ vyādhir duḥkhaṃ maraṇaṃ duḥkham apriyasaṃprayogo duḥkhaṃ yad apīccan
na labhate tad api duḥkhaṃ saṃkṣiptena pañcopādānaskandhā duḥkham // The text of ṭ in the
following is, however, different and more copious:de la 1) skye ba ni mi daṅ lha la sogs
pa’i ’gro ba de daṅ de dag tu phuṅ po daṅ khams daṅ skye mched mṅon par ’grub pa’o. ci’i
phyir skye ba sdug bsṅal ba źes bya źe na? rnam pa gñis kyi phyir te, a) raṅ bźin gyis sdug
bsṅal ba daṅ, b) sdug bsṅal gźan gyi rten du gyur pa’i phyir ro – Abhidharmasamuccaya: jātiḥ
kim upādāya duḥkham / saṃbādhaduḥkhtāṃ tadanyaduḥkhāśrayatāṃ copādāya / Rec ṭ: jātiḥ
kim upādāya duḥkham / svabhāvaduḥkhatām anyaduḥkhāśrayatāṃ copādāya /2) de la rgas pa ni phuṅ
po gźan du gyur pa ste, laṅ tsho bcom pa daṅ, na tshod ñams pa la sogs pa la’o. ci’i phyir
rga ba sdug bsṅal ba źes bya źe na? ñe du ’khor rnams kyis śin tu byams śiṅ yid du ’oṅ
bar bya ba daṅ, ’gro ba bzaṅ mo’i mig daṅ yid kyis rjes su mthun par byed pa’i kha dog daṅ
dbyibs śin tu mdzes pa de rga ba’i ser bas phog nas mi mdzes pa daṅ, ’khums pa daṅ źigs
par snaṅ bas ñe du’i phyogs rnams kyaṅ śin tu mi dga’ bar byed kyi, ’gro ba bzaṅ mos kyaṅ
spoṅ bar byed pas rga ba sdug bsṅal ba’o – Abhidharmasamuccaya: jarā kim upādāya duḥkham
/ kāle vipariṇatiduḥkhatā upādāya //3) de la khams mi mthun pa ’phel bar gyur pa ni na ba
ste, sa la sogs pa’i khams śas che chuṅ du gyur pa’o. ci’i phyir na sdug bsṅal ba źes bya
źe na? rab tu mi bzad pa’i nad kyi khyad par gyis thebs nas nags chen po mes tshig pa’i nad
du chud pa rab tu tsha ba’i me lces reg pa skad chen po ’byin pa bźin sdug bsṅal ba’i mes
reg pa na mi bzad pa’i skad cher ’byin pas na sdug bsṅal ba źes bya’o – Abhidharmasamuccaya:
vyādhi kim upādāya duḥkham / bhūteṣu vipariṇatiduḥkhatām upādāya //4) de la ’chi ba ni
dbaṅ po rnams ñams pa las de’i rgyus sems daṅ sems las byuṅ ba rnams mi rgyu ba’o, sems
daṅ sems las byuṅ ba rnams mi rgyu bar gyur pa na gaṅ zag de śi ba źes bya’o. ci’i phyir śi
ba sdug bsṅal ba źes bya źe na? ’di ltar śi bar gyur na yid du ’oṅ źiṅ sems la gcags pa’i
pha ma daṅ ñe du daṅ grogs la sogs pa daṅ bral źiṅ, nor daṅ ’bru daṅ, bran daṅ bu tsha la
sogs pa gtaṅ bar dka’ ba rnams daṅ bral te mi ’dod bźin du bsad sar bkri ba’i btson daṅ
’dra bar sdug bsṅal dpag tu med pa skyed par byed pas na ’di las sdug bsṅal gźan med pa’i
phyir ’chi ba sdug bsṅal ba’o – Abhidharmasamuccaya: maraṇaṃ kim upādāya duḥkham / jīvitavipraṇāśaduḥkhatām
upādāya //5) mi sdug pa daṅ phrad pa ni mi dge ba’i las byas pa’i rgyus
sems can dmyal ba pa la sogs pa ’bras bu yid du mi ’oṅ ba daṅ phrad pa’o. ci’i phyir mi sdug
pa daṅ phrad pa sdug bsṅal ba źes bya źe na? khyim mtshes mi bgruṅs pa daṅ ’dra bar gnod
pa byed pa’i bdag ñid yin pa daṅ, dug gi śiṅ bźin du sdug bsṅal skyed pa’i rgyu byed pa
daṅ, zug rṅus zug bźin du lus daṅ sems la gnod pa byed pa daṅ, skye bo mi bgruṅs pa daṅ dgra
daṅ phrad na źe sdaṅ skye bar byed pa bźin du źe sdaṅ skyed pa’i gnas su gyur pa’i phyir
sdug bsṅal ba źes bya’o – Abhidharmasamuccaya: apriyasaṃyogaḥ kim upādāya duḥkham / saṃyogajaduḥkhatām
upādāya //6) sdug pa daṅ bral ba ni sems can gyi graṅ su gtogs pa’am, sems
can gyi graṅs su ma gtogs pa yaṅ ruṅ, yid du ’oṅ ba’i dṅos po daṅ bral ba’o. ci’i phyir sdug
pa daṅ bral ba sdug bsṅal ba źes bya ba źe na? sdug pa daṅ bral bar dogs pa’am, mthoṅ ba’am,
rjes su dran pas kyaṅ mya ṅan daṅ, smre sṅags ’don pa daṅ, yid mi bde ba daṅ, ’khrugs1
pa’i sdug bsṅal ’gyur bar byed pas na, sdug pa daṅ bral ba sdug bsṅal ba’o – Abhidharmasamuccaya:
priyaviprayogaḥ kim upādāya duḥkham / viprayogajaduḥkhatām upādāya //7) ’dod pa
btsal te ma rñed pa ni sdug bsṅal ba daṅ bral ba la yaṅ mi phrad par ’dod pa daṅ, bde ba
daṅ phrad pa daṅ yaṅ mi ’bral bar ’dod pa de btsal na ma grub pa’o. yaṅ na sdug pa daṅ phrad
par ’dod pa daṅ, mi sdug pa daṅ bral bar ’dod pa las sdug pa daṅ ma phrad la mi sdug pa
daṅ phrad par gyur pa ni gaṅ ’dod pa btsal te ma rñed pa źes bya’o. ci’i phyir gaṅ ’dod pa
btsal te ma rñed pa sdug bsṅal ba źes bya źe na? sdug bsṅal skye ba’i rgyur gyur ba’i phyir
te, dus gsum du’aṅ bdag gis gaṅ btsal pa de ma rñed do źes sdug bsṅal skye ba’i phyir
ro – Abhidharmasamuccaya: yad apīcchan na labhate tat kim upādāya duḥkham / kāmyaphalābhāvajaduḥkhatām
upādāya //8) mdor na ñe bar len pa’i phuṅ po lṅa sdug bsṅal ba źes bya ba ni
ñe bar len pa’i phuṅ po lṅar sdug bsṅal thams cad ’dus te, sdug bsṅal gyi rten yin pa’i phyir
de skad ces bya’o – Abhidharmasamuccaya: saṃkṣiptena pañcopādānaskandhāḥ kim upādāya /
dauṣṭhulyaduḥkhatām upādāya, but cf. ibid, line 16: tad anyaduḥkhāśrayatāṃ copādaya referring
to jāti.chos thams cad la bdag med par rtog pa daṅ źes bya ba la chos thams cad ni ’dus
byas daṅ ’dus ma byas daṅ, zag pa daṅ bcas pa daṅ zag pa med pa’o. gaṅ na gaṅ med par śes
pa chos thams cad la bdag med par rtog pa ste, chos de dag la mu stegs can gyis brtag pa’i
bdag rtag pa med par khoṅ du chud pa’o.mya ṅan las ’das pa źi ba la mṅon par dga’ ba źes
bya ba la, mya ṅan las ’das pa ni sdug bsṅal spaṅs pa daṅ, ’dod chags la sogs pa spaṅs
pa’i phyir źi ba’o. yaṅ na mya ṅan las ’das pa rnam pa gñis te, phuṅ po’i lhag ma daṅ bcas
pa’i mya ṅan las ’das pa daṅ, phuṅ po’i lhag ma ma lus par spaṅs pa’i mya ṅan las ’das pa’o.
de la źi ba źes bya bas phuṅ po’i lhag ma daṅ bcas pa’i mya ṅan las ’das pa bstan te,
ñon moṅs pa thams cad spaṅs nas phuṅ po tsam yod pa’i phyir ro. mya ṅan las ’das pa źes bya
bas phuṅ po’i lhag ma ma lus pa spaṅs pa’i mya ṅan las ’das pa bstan te, ñon moṅs pa daṅ
phuṅ po gñi ga yaṅ spaṅs pa’i phyir ro. mṅon par dga’ ba ni de thob par mos pa daṅ, de ’thob
par ’dod pa’o.skad cig kyaṅ srid par skye bar mi ’dod pa źes bya ba la cuṅ zad kyaṅ khams
gsum du skye bar ma mos źes bya ba’i tha tshig ste, ci’i phyir źe na? khams gsum mtha’
dag rtag ru ’du byed kyi sdug bsṅal daṅ rjes su ’brel ciṅ des khyab par mthoṅ bas so.rtag
tu ’jigs par lta źes bya ba ’dir yaṅ srid pa la źes bya bar sbyar te, sdug bsṅal gyi sdug
bsṅal daṅ ldan pa’am, ñon moṅs pa ’byuṅ gnas yin par mthoṅ bas na rtag tu ’jigs par lta’o.rtag
tu yid mi rton ces bya ba ’dir yaṅ srid pa la źes bya bar sbyar te, thaṅ cig bde ba
rnams kyaṅ phyis sdug bsṅal ba’i rgyur gyur par ’gyur ba’i sdug bsṅal daṅ ldan pa’i phyir
rtag tu yid mi rton pa’o.phuṅ po rnams la gsod par ’du śes daṅ źes bya ba la dper na gśed
pos gsod ciṅ sdug bsṅal skyed par byed pa, de bźin du phuṅ po la bdag tu dmigs na yaṅ skye
rga na ’chi’i sdug bsṅal skye bar mthoṅ bas de dag phuṅ po rnams la gsod par ’du śes so.khams
rnams la sbrul gdug pa lta bur rtog pa’i ’du śes źes bya ba la, ji ltar sbrul gdug pas
sdug bsṅal daṅ ñon moṅs pa bskyed pa, de bźin du mig la sogs pa’i khams brten nas gzugs
la sogs pa’i khams la dmigs nas ’dod chags daṅ źe sdaṅ la sogs pa’i ñon moṅs pa ’byuṅ bar
khoṅ du chud pas na khams rnams la sbrul gdug pa lta bur rtog pa’i ’du śes pa źes bya’o.skye
mched rnams la groṅ stoṅ pa lta bur ’du śes pa daṅ źes bya ba la, ji ltar groṅ stoṅ pa
na skye bo dag rgyu ba mi gnas pas stoṅ pa, de bźin du skye mched bcu gñis kyaṅ miṅ daṅ gzugs
tsam du zad kyi, bdag daṅ bdag gir med par rtog pas na skye mched rnams la groṅ stoṅ lta
bur ’du śes pa źes bya’o.skye ba’i gnas thams cad la mi smon pa’i ’du śes źes bya ba la
skye ba’i gnas ni bźi ste: 1) mṅal nas skye ba daṅ, 2) rdzus te skye ba daṅ, 3) sgo ṅa las
skye ba daṅ, 4) drod gśer las skye ba’o. skyes na de’i rgyus skye ba daṅ, rga ba daṅ, na
ba daṅ, ’chi ba la sogs pa’i sdug bsṅal ’byuṅ bar mthoṅ bas skye gnas de dag tu skye bar
mi ’dod ciṅ skye ba mi tshol bas na mi smon pa’i ’du śes źes bya’o.gñen po’i sa la yon tan
du lta ba yaṅ rnam pa gñis te, rnam par grol ba’i bde ba’i rten du gyur pa daṅ, ’khor ba
las brgal źiṅ sdug bsṅal kun spaṅs par blta ba’o. ’di lta ste, mya ṅan las ’das pa ni ’khor
ba’i gñen po yin te, mya ṅan las ’das pa la rnam par grol ba’i bde ba thams cad kyi rten
du lta bas mya ṅan las ’das pa la gnas su ’du śes pa źes bya’o. de ñid la ’khor ba las brgal
źiṅ sdug bsṅal thams cad spaṅs par lta bas na skyabs su ’du śes pa’o. Cf. also supra,
ṭ. fol. 152b1-2.

ñan thos kyi theg pa la mkhas pa bstan nas raṅ saṅs rgyas kyi theg pa la mkhas pa bstan pa’i
phyir de la byaṅ chub sems dpa’i raṅ saṅs rgyas kyi theg pa la mkhas pa gaṅ źe na źes bya
ba la sogs pa gsuṅs te, byaṅ chub sems dpa’ rnams kyis śes par bya ba’i raṅ saṅs rgyas kyi
theg pa ni byaṅ chub sems dpa’i raṅ saṅs rgyas kyi theg pa źes bya ste,gaṅ dag bskal pa
gcig gis ye śes kyi tshogs yoṅs su bskaṅs te, gźan gyi man ṅag med par ’phags pa’i lam thob
nas, khams gsum pa’i ’dod chags daṅ bral bar źugs pa de dag ni sñiṅ rje chen po med pas
gźan la luṅ dbog pa’i bya ba med pa daṅ, bdag gcig pu saṅs rgyas par byed pas raṅ saṅs rgyas
so – "Having fulfilled the accumulation of knowledge (jñānasaṃbhāra) in one kalpa (a hundred
kalpas (kalpaśata)? cf. infra), attaining the holy way (āryamārga) without the instruction
of others, and entering the state of no passion for the threefold world, they do not
teach others since they have no great compassion (mahākaruṇā). Waking up alone they are
isolated buddhas (ekākino budhyante pratyekabuddhāḥ)".Cf. Pratyekabuddhabhūmi p. 346-10: yathāpīhaikatyaḥ
prathameṇa pratyekabuddhamārgeṇa paripūrṇakalpaśatasaṃbhāraḥ / kalpaśatasyātyayād
asati ca buddhānām utpāde anācāryakaṃ saptatriṃśadbodhipakṣyān dharmān bhāvayitvā
pratyekāṃ bodhim abhisaṃbudhyate ca sarvakleśaprahāṇam arhattvaṃ sākṣāt karoti //raṅ saṅs
rgyas de dag rnam par grol ba’i sar phyin par byed pa’i theg pa ni raṅ saṅs rgyas kyi theg
pa ste, gaṅ źe na źes bya ba ni raṅ saṅs rgyas kyi theg pa la mkhas pa dris pa’o. de yaṅ
rnam pa gsum du rig par bya ste, 1) rgyu daṅ, 2) rkyen daṅ, 3) ’bras bu’o.

de rnam pa gaṅ źes bya bas rgyu 1) bstan pa yin te, rgyu gaṅ dag gis bya ba’i tha tshig go;
rkyen gaṅ źes bya bas rkyen 2) bstan pa yin no; raṅ saṅs rgyas ’byuṅ źes ’bras bu 3) bstan
pa yin te, khams gsum las byuṅ nas ñon moṅs pa thams cad spaṅs te, mya ṅan las ’das par gyur
pa ni raṅ saṅs rgyas rnams ’byuṅ bar ’gyur źes bya’o; yaṅ dag pa ji lta ba bźin du rab
tu śes źes bya ba ni rgyu daṅ rkyen daṅ ’bras bu rnams phyin ci ma log par khoṅ du chud ces
bya ba’i don te, de ltar khoṅ du chud pa ni raṅ saṅs rgyas kyi theg pa la mkhas pa yin
no źes bya bar sbyar ro. de dag gaṅ źe na rgyu daṅ, rkyen daṅ, ’bras bu de dag gaṅ źe na źes
bya ba’i don te, de gsum bstan pa’i phyir ’di lta ste źes gsuṅs so. de la 1) ’dun pa daṅ
brtson ’grus źes bya ba nas brtsams te, rab tu dben par gnas mal ’cha’ ba źes bya ba yan
chad kyis rgyu bstan yin no, 2) bsñen par dka’ źes bya ba nas brtsams te, raṅ ’byuṅ gi ye
śes kyis rab tu rgal źes bya ba yan chad kyis rkyen bstan to, 3) dmigs pa la gnas pa thob
ces bya ba nas brtsams te, dmigs pa gaṅ yaṅ ruṅ ba la rkyen gyis ye śes rtogs pa źes bya
ba yan chad kyis ’bras bu bstan to.Cf. Pratyekabuddhabhūmi p. 3410-13: yathāpīhaikatyo dvitīyatṛtīyābhyāṃ
pratyekabuddhamārgābhyāṃ tena hetunā tena pratyayena asaty evaṃ buddhānām
utpāde anācāryakaṃ saptatriṃśadbodhipakṣyān dharmān bhāvayitvā dharmābhisamayaṃ karoti.

de la rgyu rnam pa gsum ste, 1) bsags pa’i rgyu daṅ, 2) saṅs rgyas mñes par byed pa’i rgyu daṅ,
3) rigs so.1) de la bsags pa yaṅ rnam pa gñis te, a) gaṅ gis bsags pa daṅ, b) gaṅ bsags
pa’o. de la a) gaṅ gis bsags pa ni ’dun pa daṅ, bag yod pa daṅ, brtson ’grus chen po gsum
gyis bsags so; b) gaṅ bsags pa ni sbyin pa daṅ, tshul khrims daṅ, thos pa gsum bsags so.a)
gaṅ gis bsags pa yaṅ rnam pa gsum ste, rgyu daṅ, rkyen daṅ, sgrub pa’o; de la chen po’i
sgra ni ’dun pa la sogs pa’i tshig gsum po so so daṅ yaṅ sbyar te, ’dun pa chen po daṅ, brtson
’grus chen po daṅ, bag yod pa chen po źes bya bar sbyar ro. de la ’dun pa ni dkon mchog
daṅ bden pa daṅ las la yid ches nas ’di kho na bden gyi, gźan du ma yin no źes ’dzin pa’o,
’dis ni rgyu smras pa yin te, yid ches par gyur na brtson ’grus rtsom pas so. brtson
’grus źes bya ba la, spaṅ bar bya ba ma lus par spoṅ ba daṅ, thob par bya ba thob par byed
pa la sems spro ba ni brtson ’grus te, ’dis ni rkyen bstan pa yin te, dge ba sgrub pa rnams
brtson ’grus la brten pa’i phyir ro. bag yod pa źes bya ba la gcig pu dgon pa na gnas śiṅ
’du ’dzi daṅ mi ’dre ba ni bag yod pa ste, ’dis ni sgrub par byed pa bstan pa yin no. ci’i
phyir źe na? spaṅ bar bya ba daṅ bsgrub par bya ba gñis ni bag yod par bsgrubs so.b) gaṅ
bsags pa yaṅ rnam pa gsum ste, loṅs spyod kyi rgyu bsags pa daṅ, bde ’gro’i rgyu bsags
pa daṅ, rnam par grol ba’i rgyu bsags pa’o; yaṅ na ser sna’i gñen po bsags pa daṅ, ’dod pa
la chags pa’i gñen po bsags pa daṅ, ñon moṅs pa’i gñen po bsags pa’o; de la chen po źes bya
ba ni raṅ saṅs rgyas kyi ’dun pa daṅ brtson ’grus la sogs pa ñan thos dag pas lhag pas
na chen po źes bya’o, ñan thos kyi lta bu ma yin pa’i źes bya ba ni ñan thos kyi bas śas che
źes bya ba’i don to, sbyin pa’i bsod nams kyi tshogs sogs pa źes bya bas ser sna’i gñen
po bsags pa bstan te, sbyin pas rnam par grol ba thob pa’i rgyur gyur pa rnams ni tshogs
bsags pa źes bya’o, tshul khrims kyia bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa źes bya bas ’dod pa la
chags pa’i gñen po bsags pa bstan to. gaṅ gis, gaṅ gaṅ gi phyir tshul bsruṅs pa ni tshul
khrims te, gaṅ gis bsruṅs pa ni mi dge ba bcu las ldog ciṅ rnam par grol ba ’dod pa’i sems
kyis so, gaṅ bsruṅs pa ni yan lag drug pa’i tshul khrims bsruṅ ba’o, gaṅ gi phyir bsruṅ ba
ni mya ṅan las ’das pa thob par bya ba’i phyir bsruṅ ba’o. thos pa ñuṅ ba la chos kyi nan
tan byed ces bya bas ñon moṅs pa’i gñen po bsags pa bstan te, thos pa la mi dga’ bas cuṅ
zad thos pa ni thos pa ñuṅ ba’o, chos kyi nan tan byed ces bya ba ni byaṅ chub kyi phyogs
kyi chos rnams bsgoms śiṅ sgrub par byed ces bya ba’i don to. de ni ’di skad du ñan thos
ltar thos pa mi maṅ bar thos thos pa cuṅ zad cig gis chos kyi nan tan byed do źes bstan pa’o.2)
saṅs rgyas mñes par byed pa yaṅ rnam pa gñis te, chos ñid kyis mñes par byed pa daṅ,
zaṅ ziṅ gis mñes par byed pa’o. saṅs rgyas bcom ldan ’das la yaṅ rim gro daṅ źes bya bas
chos ñid kyis mñes par byed pa bstan te, ma rig pa’i gñid las saṅ ciṅ śes bya thams cad thugs
su chud pas na saṅs rgyas so. bdud bźi bcom pas na bcom ldan ’das te, des ji skad du bstan
pa’i bka’ luṅ daṅ bslab pa’i tshig las ’da’ bar mi byed pa ni saṅs rgyas bcom ldan ’das
la rim gror byed pa daṅ bsñen bkur byed pa źes bya bas zaṅ ziṅ gis mñes par byed pa bstan
te, bskal pa brgya’i bar du phyag ’tshal ba daṅ bskor ba daṅ gos la sogs pas bsñen bkur
byed pa’i phyir ro. Cf. Pratyekabuddhabhūmi p. 3316: kalpaśataṃ buddhotpādam ārāgayati; and
ibid. p. 3320-21, p. 3328-29.źum pa med ces bya ba ni mñes pa rnam pa gñis byed pa la sems
spro źiṅ spa goṅ ba med ces bya ba’i don to. des ni mdor na gaṅ la, gaṅ, gaṅ gis mñes
par byed pa bstan te, gaṅ la mñes par byed pa ni saṅs rgyas bcom ldan ’das la’o; gaṅ ni rim
gro byed pa daṅ bkur stis so, gaṅ gis ni źum pa med pa’i sems kyis so.mdo gźan dag las raṅ
saṅs rgyas gźan la ma mñan par raṅ gi blos chos rtogs pa daṅ, saṅs rgyas ’jig rten du mi
’byuṅ ba’i tshe raṅ saṅs rgyas ’byuṅ ṅo źes bśad pa yaṅ raṅ saṅs rgyas zag pa med pa’i chos
mṅon par rtogs pa’i tshe gźan gyi luṅ la mi brten pa daṅ, raṅ saṅs rgyas kyi ’bras bu
thob nas, gdod saṅs rgyas mi bźugs pa na ’byuṅ ba la bya’i, ’dir ni daṅ po slob ciṅ tshogs
bsog pa la bya bas ñes pa med do – "According to other sūtras the isolated buddhas are born
at the time when no Buddhas are born in the world, not serving other Buddhas but understanding
the dharma with their own intelligence (mati). The isolated buddha is not dependent
on the instructions of others at the time he realizes the unsullied moments of existence
(anāsravadharmābhisamaya); having attained the fruit (phala) of an isolated buddha he becomes
that when no Buddha is there, but here [in this sūtra] one is concerned with the beginning
when he is learning and accumulating, so there is no mistake [in saying that he is serving
the Lords and Buddhas]".3) rigs kyaṅ rnam pa gsum ste, a) ṅa rgyal spyod pa’i rigs
daṅ, b) sñiṅ rje chuṅ ba’i rigs daṅ, c) ñon moṅs pa chuṅ ba’i rigs so.a) ṅa rgyal spyod pa’i
rigs kyaṅ rnam pa gñis te, dbaṅ po ’briṅ daṅ sbyor ba dam pa la gnas pa’o. dbaṅ po bar
ma źes bya bas dbaṅ po ’briṅ bstan te, dbaṅ po rnam pa gsum ste, rab daṅ, bar ma daṅ, tha
ma’o. raṅ saṅs rgyas rnams ni dbaṅ po bar ma ste, dbaṅ po ’briṅ gi rigs can no.The division
into the three-fold gotra is modelled after Pratyekabuddhabhūmi p. 337-14: pratyekabuddhagotraṃ
katamat / tatra trilakṣaṇaṃ veditavyaṃ / prakṛtyā pratyekabuddhāḥ prāg evābhisaṃbodhān
mandarajaskagotrā bhavanti / ye naiṣām saṃsarge cittam na krāmanty ekārāmatāyāṃ krāmanti
/ prakṛtyā pratyekabuddhāḥ prāg evābhisaṃbodhān mandakāruṇyā bhavanti / ye naiṣām dharmadeśanāyāṃ
sattvārthakriyāyāṃ cittam na krāmanty alpotsukavihāritāyāṃ krāmanti / prakṛtyā
pratyekabuddhāḥ prāg evābhisaṃbodhān madhyendriyaś (sic, read -yā) bhavanti mānacaritajātīyāś
ca / ye nācāryaṃ niḥpratidvandvam abhisaṃbodham abhilaṣanti //rtag tu rab tu ’byuṅ ba
la gźol źes bya bas sbyor ba dam pa la gnas pa bstan te, rtag tu ni dus thams cad do.ji skad
du bcom ldan ’das kyis bśad pa: skra daṅ kha spu bregs gos ṅur smrig bgos te, yaṅ dag
par dad pas khyim nas khyim med par rab tu byuṅ źes gsuṅs pas ni rab tu byuṅ ba la gźol ba’o.
Cf. kesamassuṃ oharetvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajati, phrase
quoted passim, for Pāli references v. Pāli Concordance and PTSD, s.v. agāra, agāriya,
kesamassu, kāsāya.’dis dge sloṅ gi phun sum tshogs pa rnam pa bźi bstan te, cha lugs phun
sum tshogs pa daṅ, las phun sum tshogs pa daṅ, bsam pa phun sum tshogs pa daṅ, gnas phun
sum tshogs pa’o. de la skra daṅ ka spu bregs te gos ṅur smrig bgos źes bya bas cha lugs phun
sum tshogs pa bstan te, cha lugs ’di ni ñon moṅs pa daṅ ñe ba’i ñon moṅs pa daṅ mi mthun
pa yin pas, khyim na gnas pa’i cha lugs phun sum tshogs pa’o. yaṅ dag par źes bya bas las
phun sum tshogs pa bstan te, gsol ba daṅ bźi’i las kyis rab tu byuṅ ba’i phyir ro. dad pas
źes bya bas bsam pa phun sum tshogs pa bstan te, rgyal po daṅ rkun po’i ’jigs pas rab tu
byuṅ ba ni ma yin gyi, dad pas rab tu byuṅ ba’i phyir ro. khyim nas khyim med par rab tu
byuṅ źes bya bas gnas phun sum tshogs pa bstan te, khyim na gnas pa rnams kyi gnas rab tu
mi bzad pa de btaṅ nas khyim med pa’i śiṅ druṅ la sogs pa la gnas pas so.b) sñiṅ rje chuṅ
ba’i rigs kyaṅ rnam pa gñis te, bdag ’ba’ źig gi don la ’jug pa daṅ, gźan gyi don mi byed
pa’o. de la don ñuṅ ba źes bya bas bdag ’ba’ źig gi don la ’jug pa bstan te, bdag źi bar
bya ba daṅ, grol bar bya ba daṅ, mya ṅan las ’das par bya ba tsam las bya ba gźan mi byed
pa’i phyir ro. byed pa ñuṅ źes bya bas gźan gyi don mi byed pa bstan te, gźan źi bar bya ba
daṅ, mya ṅan las ’das par bya ba la mi ’bad par bya bas so.c) ñon moṅs pa chuṅ ba’i rigs
kyaṅ rnam pa gsum ste, 1) lus dben pa la dga’ ba daṅ, 2) sems dben pa la dga’ ba daṅ, 3)
gnas dben pa la dga’ ba’o.1) ’du ’dzi la mi dga’ źiṅ źes bya bas lus dben pa la dga’ ba bstan
te, raṅ bźin gyis ’gro ba maṅ po daṅ ’dre bar ma mos śiṅ bse ru bźin du gcig pur gnas
par mos pa’i phyir ro. Cf. Pratyekabuddhabhūmi p. 3421-23: naikāṃśena ekārāmo bhavaty ekavihārī
/ api tu vargavihārī bhavati / śiṣṭo vihāras tasyāpi yathā khaḍgaviṣāṇakalpaś ca //2)
dben pa la dga’ ba źes bya bas sems dben pa la dga’ ba bstan te, de dag ’dod pa daṅ khoṅ
khro ba’i rnam par rtog pa riṅ du spoṅ bar mos pas so.3) rab tu dben par gnas mal ’cha’ ba
źes bya bas gnas dben pa la dga’ ba bstan te, śiṅ druṅ daṅ ri sul na gnas ’cha’ ba’i phyir
ro.

rkyen kyaṅ rnam pa bźi ste, 1) yon tan daṅ, 2) gnas pa daṅ, 3) rtogs pa daṅ, 4) ’byuṅ ba’o.1)
yon tan yaṅ rnam pa gsum ste, a) ñon moṅs pa chuṅ źiṅ dge ba che ba daṅ, b) rdzu ’phrul
che ba daṅ, c) ’bras bu’i sa la mṅon par dga’ ba’o.a) bsñen par dka’ źes bya bas ñon moṅs
pa chuṅ źiṅ dge ba che bar bstan te, mthu daṅ gzi brjid daṅ byin rnams la gźan gyis zil gyis
mi non źiṅ des gźan zil gyis gnon pa’i phyir ro.b) mthu che ba źes bya bas rdzu ’phrul
che ba bstan te, stod nas me ’bar ba daṅ, smad nas chu draṅ mo’i rgyun ’bab pa daṅ, gcig tu
gyur nas maṅ por ’gyur ba daṅ, maṅ por gyur nas gcig tu ’gyur ba la sogs pa’i mthu daṅ ldan
pa’i phyir ro.c) sbyin pa’i gnas kyi sa la mṅon par dga’ ba źes bya bas ’bras bu’i sa
la dga’ ba bstan te, sbyin pa’i gnas kyi sa ni ’gro ba thams cad kyi bsod nams kyi źiṅ du
gyur pa’i dus dgra bcom pa’i ’bras bu thob pa ste, mṅon par dga’ ba ni ’bras bu de thob par
bya bar sems mos pa’o.2) rgyun mi ’chad par rten ciṅ ’brel bar ’byuṅ ba la lta ba źes bya
bas gnas pa bstan te, rgyun mi ’chad pa źes bya bas ni rtag tu źes bya ba’i don to. rgyu
daṅ rkyen la brten nas dus mñam du ’bras bu ’byuṅ ba ni rten ciṅ ’brel bar ’byuṅ ba ste,
de yaṅ phyi daṅ naṅ gi rnam pa gñis so: de la phyi’i rten ciṅ ’brel ba ni sa bon gyi rkyen
gyis myu gu la sogs pa’o; naṅ gi rten ciṅ ’brel bar ’byuṅ ba ni ma rig pa’i rkyen gyis ’du
byed ces bya ba la sogs pa’o. lta ba ni phyi naṅ gi chos ’di rgyu rkyen las ’byuṅ ba tsam
du zad kyi, bdag daṅ byed pa po med par rtog pa’o.3) ṅes par ’byuṅ ba’i dbyiṅs gcig la rtog
pa źes bya bas rtog pa bstan te, ṅes par ’byuṅ ba’i dbyiṅs ni mya ṅan las ’das pa’i dbyiṅs
so, mya ṅan las ’das pa ’ba’ źig tu gnas pa daṅ ’gro bar sems pa ni ṅes par ’byuṅ ba’i
dbyiṅs gcig la rtog pa źes bya’o.4) raṅ ’byuṅ gi ye śes kyis rab tu rgal ba źes bya bas
’byuṅ ba bstan te, bdag ñid kyi śes rab daṅ ye śes kyis gaṅ zag la bdag med par rtogs nas
ñon moṅs pa spaṅs te, khams gsum las rgal bar gyur pa ni raṅ ’byuṅ gi ye śes kyis rab tu rgal
ba źes bya’o.

’bras bu thob pa yaṅ rnam pa gñis te, 1) tiṅ ṅe ’dzin thob pa daṅ, 2) mṅon par byaṅ chub pa
thob pa’o.1) tiṅ ṅe ’dzin thob pa yaṅ rnam pa gñis te, a) mi g-yo ba thob pa daṅ, b) rgyun
du yid la byed pa thob pa’o.a) dmigs pa la ’jug pa thob pa daṅ źes bya bas mi g-yo ba thob
pa bstan te, dmigs pa ni rten ciṅ ’brel bar ’byuṅ ba la sogs pa tiṅ ṅe ’dzin gyi yul rnams
so. ’jug pa thob pa ni yul la dmigs pa’i tshe sems rtse gcig pa la gnas pa thob ste, phyi
rol du mi g-yeṅ bar nus pa’o.b) bsam gtan daṅ, rnam par thar pa daṅ, tiṅ ṅe ’dzin daṅ,
sñoms par ’jug pa rgyun mi chad pa ces bya bas rgyun du yid la byed pa thob pa bstan te, rgyun
mi chad pa ni de dag la rgyun du yid la byed pa’o. Cf. Msa. p. 922: sātatyamanaskāraḥ.2)
mṅon par byaṅ chub pa yaṅ rnam pa gñis te, a) ston pa daṅ rjes su ston pa med par mṅon
par byaṅ chub pa daṅ, b) rten ciṅ ’brel bar ’byuṅ ba mṅon par byaṅ chub pa’o.a) gźan gyi
driṅ la mi ’jog pa’i ye śes bskyed pa daṅ źes bya bas ston pa daṅ rjes su ston pa med par
mṅon par byaṅ chub pa bstan te, mkhan po daṅ slob dpon gyi man ṅag mi rten par zad la mi skye
ba’i ye śes skyed par byed ces bya ba’i don to – (rec:) ācāryopādhyāyopadeśam anāśrito
nirodhe ’nutpādajñānam utpādayatīty arthaḥ.b) dmigs pa gaṅ yaṅ ruṅ ba la rkyen gyi ye śes
rtogs pa ste źes bya bas rten ciṅ ’brel bar ’byuṅ ba mṅon par byaṅ chub par bstan te, dmigs
pa’i yul gaṅ yaṅ ruṅ ste, chos thams cad rten ciṅ ’brel bar ’byuṅ ba’i ṅo bo ñid du śes
śiṅ khoṅ du chud ces bya ba’i don to.

de ltar źes bya ba ni goṅ du bśad pa’i tshul ltar ro, ’chad pa ni don to, ston pa ni tshig go,
rab tu ston pa ni don daṅ tshig go; yaṅ na rgyu ston pa ni ’chad pa’o, rkyen ’chad pa ni
ston pa’o, ’bras bu ’chad pa ni rab tu ston pa’o.

byaṅ chub sems dpa’i theg pa la mkhas pa bstan pa’i phyir de la byaṅ chub sems dpa’i theg pa
chen po la mkhas pa gaṅ źes na źes bya ba la sogs pa gsuṅs so. byaṅ chub sems dpa’ rnams
kyi khoṅ du chud par bya ba’i theg pa’am, byaṅ chub sems dpa’ rnam mi gnas pa’i mya ṅan las
’da’ bar phyin par byed pa’i theg pa ni byaṅ chub sems dpa’i theg pa ste, ’dis ’gro bas
theg pa’am, ’dir ’gro bas theg pa’o. de la ’dis ’gro ba ni pha rol tu phyin pa daṅ sa rnams
kyis ’gro bas na de dag la theg pa źes bya’o. ’dir ’gro ba ni saṅs rgyas kyi sar ’gro ba
ste, de la theg pa źes bya’o.theg pa yaṅ yin la chen po yaṅ yin pas theg pa chen po ste,
chen po rnam pa bdun pa daṅ ldan pa’i phyir ro. chen po rnam pa bdun ni 1) chos che ba daṅ,
2) sems bskyed pa che ba daṅ, 3) bsam pa che ba daṅ, 4) mos pa che ba daṅ, 5) tshogs che
ba daṅ, 6) dus che ba daṅ, 7) thob pa che ba’o:1) śes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stoṅ phrag
brgya la sogs pa mdo sde tshad med pa’i phyir chos che ba’o. 2) sems can thams cad kyi
don du bla na med pa yaṅ dag par rdzogs pa’i byaṅ chub tu sems bskyed pas sems bskyed pa
che ba’o. 3) bdag daṅ gźan mñam pa ñid kyi bsam pa thob pas na bsam pa che ba’o. 4) zab ciṅ
rgya che ba’i mdo sde la mos pa’i phyir mos pa che ba’o. 5) skad cig ma re re la yaṅ bsod
nams kyi tshogs dpag tu med pa sogs pas na tshogs che ba’o. 6) bskal pa chen po graṅs med
pa gsum gyi bar du rgyun du sbyar bas na dus che ba’o. 7) bla na med pa’i byaṅ chub kyi
’bras bu thob pas na thob pa che ba’o.theg pa de’i raṅ bźin daṅ, rgyu daṅ ’bras bu la sogs
pa rtogs pa ni theg pa chen po la mkhas pa’o. gaṅ źe na? źes bya ba ni dris pa’o. byaṅ chub
sems dpa’i theg pa chen po la mkhas pa ni dpag tu med de źes bya ba la, theg pa ni bla
na med pa’i byaṅ chub tu phyin par byed pa ste, theg pa de las ’das pa daṅ ma ’oṅs pa daṅ
da ltar gyi dus kyi sems can graṅs med tshad med pa rnams ’tshaṅ rgya ba’i phyir theg pa de
tshad med do, theg pa tshad med pas de la mkhas pa’i śes rab kyaṅ tshad med pa’i phyir theg
pa chen po la mkhas pa ni dpag tu med do źes gsuṅs so. de ltar theg pa chen po tshad med
pas na thams cad bstan par mi nus te, de bas na de las phyogs tsam źig bstan to źes gsuṅs
te, mdo tsam źig bstan to źes bya ba’i don to.tshad med pa de yaṅ yon tan bcu gcig tu rig
par bya ste, 1) sems bskyed pa’i yon tan daṅ, 2) śes bya’i sgrib pa spaṅs te śes pa khoṅ
du chud pa’i yon tan daṅ, 3) rgyu bsags pa’i yon tan daṅ, 4) spyod pa dag pa’i yon tan daṅ,
5) mṅon par byaṅ chub pa’i yon tan daṅ, 6) mñam par phan ’dogs pa’i yon tan daṅ, 7) ñan
thos daṅ so so’i skye bo’i lam las rgal ba’i yon tan daṅ, 8) bgegs bcom pa’i yon tan daṅ,
9) ñon moṅs pa daṅ ñe ba’i ñon moṅs pa spaṅs pa’i yon tan daṅ, 10) bdag daṅ gźan gyi don
phun sum tshogs pa’i yon tan daṅ, 11) ’bras bu phun sum tshogs pa’i yon tan no.Eleven qualities
of the immeasurable are enumerated both in ṭ and in the mūla, though the number given
above is ten.

1. theg pa de ni sems can thams cad kyi go skabs ’byed pas na, dpag tu med pa’o źes bya bas
sems bskyed pa’i yon tan bstan te, sems can tshad med pa rnams bla na med pa’i byaṅ chub tu
’god ciṅ mṅon par ’tshaṅ rgya ba’i skabs ’byed pas na go skabs ’byed pa źes bya ste, theg
pa de yaṅ de’i rgyur gyur pa’i phyir, sems can dpag tu med pas de yaṅ dpag tu med pa’o.
rnam pa gñis kyis dpag tu med pa ste, a) rgya che ba daṅ, b) tshad med pa’o; a) ci tsam du
bsgrub par bya ba’i dge ba’i rtsa ba ’jig rten daṅ ’jig rten las ’das pa thams cad sgrub
par byed pas rgya che bas so, b) dge ba’i rtsa ba de dag thams cad kyaṅ sems can gyi don du
sgrub par bya ba’i phyir tshad med pa’o. yaṅ na byaṅ chub tu sems bskyed pa’i tshe sems
can ’ga’ yaṅ ma bkol bar sems can tshad med pa thams cad bla na med pa yaṅ dag par rdzogs
pa’i byaṅ chub tu bsgral lo źes sems bskyed pas na sems can thams cad kyi go skabs ’byed pa
źes bya ste, sems can dpag tu med pa’i phyir theg pa de yaṅ dpag tu med pa’o.2. theg pa
de ni chags pa med pa’i ye śes la btaṅ ba ste, sgrib pa med pa’o źes bya bas śes bya’i sgrib
pa spaṅs te śes pa khoṅ du chud pa’i yon tan bstan te, śes bya’i sgrib pa thams cad spaṅs
nas śes par bya ba’i dṅos po rnams skyu ru ra lag mthil du bźag pa bźin du gsal bar mkhyen
pa’i ye śes ni chags pa med pa’i ye śes te, theg pa de’i ye śes rgyur gyur pa’o; theg
pa des ye śes thob par byed pas na theg pa de ni chags pa med pa’i ye śes la btaṅ ba źes bya’o;
de ltar sgrib pa med pa’i ye śes kyi rgyur gyur pas theg pa de yaṅ sgrib pa med pa źes
bya’o.3. theg pa de ni sems can thams cad ñe bar ’tsho ba ste, bsod nams kyi tshogs daṅ
dge ba’i rtsa ba thams cad bsags pa’o źes bya bas rgyu bsags pa’i yon tan bstan te, tshogs
ji lta ba bsags pas sems can thams cad kyi sems kyi gsos su ’gyur ba’i mthu daṅ ldan pas
sems can thams cad ñe bar ’tsho ba źes bya’o, bsod nams kyi tshogs ni sbyin pa daṅ tshul
khrims la sogs pa’o, dge ba’i rtsa ni ’dod ma chags pa daṅ, źe mi sdaṅ ba la sogs pa’o.4.
theg pa de ni sems can thams cad kyi sems kyi spyod pa la las su ruṅ ba’i phyir, pha rol tu
phyin pa thams cad yoṅs su sbyaṅ bar byas pa’o źes bya bas spyod pa dag pa’i yon tan bstan
te, sems can thams cad kyi sems kyi rgyud la gnas pa sbyin pa la sogs pa’i mi mthun pa’i
phyogs ser sna daṅ ’chal pa’i tshul khrims la sogs pa theg pa des spaṅs pas na sems can
gyi sems kyi spyod pa la las su ruṅ ba źes bya’o; de ltar ser sna la sogs pa spaṅs pa daṅ
sbyin pa la sogs pa pha rol tu phyin pa rnams sbyaṅ ba byas par gyur ro, yoṅs su rdzogs par
’gyur źes bya ba’i don to.5. theg pa de ni thogs pa med par byaṅ chub kyi sñiṅ por ’gro
bas na thams cad mkhyen pa’i ye śes kyi tshogs ñams su lon par byed pa’o źes bya ba mṅon par
byaṅ chub pa’i yon tan bstan te, bsod nams daṅ ye śes kyi tshogs rdzogs nas sgrib pa gñis
spaṅs te, gñis su med pa’i ye śes kyi ’bras bur gyur pa ni byaṅ chub kyi sñiṅ po ste; dri
ma med par grags pas bstan pa’i mdo las kyaṅ: byaṅ chub ni sbyin pa’i sñiṅ po, byaṅ chub
ni tshul khrims kyi sñiṅ po, źes bya ba la sogs pa gsuṅs pa’i phyir ro. theg pa de la źugs
pas bdud daṅ bgegs kyi bar chad med par byaṅ chub kyi sñiṅ po thob par ’gyur bas na theg
pa de ni thogs pa med par byaṅ chub kyi sñiṅ por ’gro ba’o. de bas na theg pa des thams
cad mkhyen pa’i ye śes thob par ’gyur ba’i rgyu bsod nams daṅ ye śes kyi thsogs yoṅs su rdzogs
śiṅ mthar ’byin par byed pas na tshogs gñis ñams su lon par byed pa źes bya’o.The quotation
from Vimalakīrtinirdeśa is not verbatim, but refers to Vkn p. 3611ff, Lamotte p. 200ff.6.
sems can thams cad sbyin pa’i gnas kyi phyir, sems can thams cad la thogs pa med pa’i
’od zer mñam par gtoṅ ba źes bya bas mñam par phan ’dogs pa’i yon tan bstan te, sems can
thams cad bla na med pa’i byaṅ chub tu mṅon par saṅs rgyas nas bsod nams kyi źiṅ sbyin pa’i
gnas su ’gyur bar bya ba’i phyir mthon dman daṅ ñe riṅ med par byams pa daṅ ye śes kyi
snaṅ ba’i ’od zer sñoms par gtoṅ ṅo źes bya ba’i don to.7. theg pa de ni saṅs rgyas kyi chos
thams cad mṅon du gyur pa’i phyir, lam ṅan pa’i ’jigs pa thams cad las ’das pa’o źes bya
bas ñan thos daṅ so so’i skye bo’i lam las rgal ba’i yon tan bstan te, saṅs rgyas kyi chos
thams cad ni a) spaṅ bar bya ba daṅ, b) śes par bya ba daṅ, c) bsgrub pa bya ba daṅ, d)
rdzogs par bya ba daṅ, e) thob par bya ba rnams te, de dag thams cad khoṅ du chud ciṅ rtogs
pas na mṅon du gyur pa’o; de la a) spaṅ bar bya ba ni ñon moṅs pa’i sgrib pa daṅ śes bya’i
sgrib pa’o, b) śes par bya ba ni gaṅ zag la bdag med pa daṅ chos la bdag med pa’o, c)
bsgrub pa bya ba ni bdag daṅ gźan gyi don to, d) rdzogs par bya ba ni sa daṅ pha rol tu phyin
pa’o, e) thob par bya ba ni mi gnas pa’i mya ṅan las ’das pa’o; chos de dag mṅon sum
du gyur pas ñan thos kyi mya ṅan las ’das par yaṅ mi ltuṅ, ’khor bar yaṅ mi ltuṅ bas na lam
ṅan pa’i ’jigs pa thams cad las ’das pa źes bya’o, yaṅ na theg pa de ni gaṅ zag la bdag
med par mṅon sum du byas pas ṅan soṅ gsum du skye ba’i ’jigs pa med pas na ’jigs pa thams
cad las ’das pa źes bya’o.8. theg pa de ni byaṅ chub kyi phyogs kyi chos thams cad daṅ źes
bya ba la sogs pas bgegs ’joms pa’i yon tan bstan te, byaṅ chub kyi phyogs kyi chos thams
cad ni dran pa ñe bar gźag pa bźi daṅ, yaṅ dag par spoṅ ba bźi daṅ, rdzu ’phrul gyi rkaṅ
pa bźi la sogs pa byaṅ chub kyi phyogs sum cu rtsa bdun rnams so; rten ciṅ (175b) ’brel bar
’byuṅ ba ni chos rnams byed pa pos ma byas śiṅ rtag pa daṅ chad pa las ’das pa rgyu daṅ
rkyen las skyes pas na raṅ bźin gyis ma skyes pa ste, nam mkha’ bźin no; chos de dag ñid thams
cad las ’phags par gnas śiṅ mu stegs daṅ bdud la sogs pa las rgyal bar byed pas rgyal
mtshan daṅ ba dan źes bya’o; chos de dag gi sgra gsaṅ mthon por bsgrags pa ni rgyal mtshan
daṅ ba dan bsgreṅ ba’o; de ltar mu stegs can thams cad las rgyal ba’i rgyal mtshan daṅ ba
dan bsgreṅ bas pha rol rgol ba maṅ po daṅ log pa’i tshogs maṅ po tshar gcod par byed pas
na bdud daṅ, phas kyi rgol ba daṅ, ṅan pa’i tshogs can gyi tshogs rab tu ’joms pa źes bya
ste, bdud ni bdud ñid do, phas kyi rgol ba ni mu stegs can rnams so, ṅan pa’i tshogs can
gyi tshogs ni bdud kyi ’khor stobs daṅ bcas pa’am, mu stegs can ’khor daṅ bcas la bya’o.9.
theg pa de ni saṅs rgyas kyi theg pa sgrib pa med par gyur pa ste źes bya ba la sogs pas
ñon moṅs pa daṅ ñe ba’i ñon moṅs pa spoṅ ba’i yon tan bstan te, saṅs rgyas su ’gro ba’i theg
pa ni saṅs rgyas kyi theg pa ste, saṅs rgyas su ’gro bar byed pa’i theg pa yaṅ yin la theg
pa des ñon moṅs pa daṅ ñe ba’i ñon moṅs pa’i sgrib pa yaṅ sel bar byed pas na theg pa
de ni saṅs rgyas kyi theg pa sgrib pa med par gyur pa źes bya’o, de ltar sgrib pa med par
’gyur bas mtha’ daṅ, mtha’ med par lta ba la sogs pa lta ba’i ñon moṅs pa rnams sel bar byed
do źes bya bar sbyar ro, lta ba źes bya ba’i sgra mthar lta ba daṅ, mtha’ med par lta ba
daṅ, rtag par lta ba daṅ, chad par lta ba daṅ, ’byuṅ bar lta ba daṅ, ’jig par lta ba źes
tshig re re daṅ sbyar ro. de la mtha’ daṅ mtha’ med par lta ba ni ’di ltar ’di ni dge sbyoṅ
ṅam bram ze kha cig ’jig rten pa’i bsam gtan la brten nas: ’jig rten gyi mtha’ yod par
’du śes pa daṅ, mtha’ med par ’du śes pa ste, de yaṅ ji ltar lta źe na? ’jig rten gyi mtha’
tha mar chad par ’gyur ram mi ’gyur, sñam du yaṅ dag par tshol bar byed de, gaṅ gi tshe
’jig pa’i bskal pa rjes su dran pa de’i tshe ni mtha’ yod par ’du śes ’byuṅ bas mtha’ yod
par lta ba’o; gaṅ gi tshe chags pa’i bskal pa dran pa de’i tshe mtha’ med pa’i ’du śes ’byuṅ
bas mtha’ med par lta’o. rtag par lta ba ni dge sbyoṅ daṅ bram ze kha cig: bdag daṅ ’jig
rten ni rtag pa ste, byas pa ma yin pa daṅ, byas pas byas ma yin pa daṅ, sprul pa ma yin
pa daṅ, sprul pas byas pa ma yin pa daṅ, gsad du med pa daṅ, ther zug tu gnas pa daṅ, srog
śiṅ ltar brtan par gnas pa’o, sñam du ’dzin pa’o. chad par lta ba ni dge sbyoṅ ṅam bram
ze kha cig ’di lta ste: bdag gzugs can rags pa ’byuṅ ba chen po bźi las byuṅ ba ji srid du
’dug ciṅ sdod la ’tsho ba, de srid du nad daṅ bcas pa, ’bras daṅ bcas pa, zug rṅu daṅ bcas
pa, rims daṅ bcas pa yoṅs su gduṅ ba daṅ bcas pa yin te, nam śi ba’i ’og tu bdag chad de
źig ciṅ med par gyur pa, de na bdag gtan chad par ’gyur ro, źes smra ba’o. ’byuṅ bar lta
ba ni dṅos po skye bar lta ba’o. ’jig par lta ba ni dṅos po ’gag par lta ba’o; lta bar gyur
pa thams cad ces smos pa ni miṅ gis smos pa las ma gtogs pa bdag tu lta ba la sogs pa kun
bsdu ba’o; kun nas ldaṅ ba ni ñon moṅs pa la mṅon sum du ’byuṅ ba’o; sgrib pa ni sgrib pa
lṅa rnams so; chod pa ni dge ba’i bar du gcod pa’i chos dag go; the tshom ni bden pa daṅ
dkon mchog la yid mi ches pa’o; ’gyod pa ni dge ba daṅ mi dge ba byas kyaṅ ruṅ ma byas kyaṅ
ruṅ phyis sems la gduṅ ba skye ba’o; sel ba ni de dag theg pa ’dis spoṅ bar byed pa’o.10.
theg pa de ni lhag pa’i bsam pa daṅ sñiṅ rje chen pos phye bas na źes bya ba la sogs pas
bdag daṅ gźan gyi don phun sum tshogs pa’i yon tan bstan te, lhag pa’i bsam pa daṅ sñiṅ
rje chen pos phye bas źes bya ba ni lhag pa’i bsam pa chen po daṅ sñiṅ rje chen po’i rgyu
las byuṅ ba źes bya ba’i tha tshig go. de la sems can rnams bde ba la gźag par sems pa ni
