pa’o, mi gnod pa ni sdug bsṅal gyis gnod pa med pa’o, mi ’gyur ba’i chos can ni mi ’dra
ba du mar gyur pa med pa’o; yaṅ na ni mi g-yo bas rtag pa’o, mi ’gyur bas na ther zug pa’o.lus
’di la bdag gir mi bya’i źes bya ba la lus ’di źes bya ba ni byaṅ chub sems dpa’ ñid
kyi lus la bsñegs so, bdag gir mi bya źes bya ba ni lus de la bdag gi don du mi bya’o, yaṅ
na lus de la chags par mi bya’o, yaṅ na lus de la bdag tu ’dzin par mi bya ste, ’di ni lus
thams cad daṅ bral bar gyur pa’o; bdag gis sñiṅ po med pa’i lus ’dis sñiṅ po mṅon par rdzogs
par ’tshaṅ rgya bar źes bya ba la bdag gi lus sñiṅ po med pa ni pha ma’i mi gtsaṅ ba
daṅ las daṅ ñon moṅs pa’i rgyu rkyen las byuṅ ba daṅ, bdag daṅ sems can daṅ chos kyi dṅos
po med pas sñiṅ po med pa ste, sñiṅ po med pa de la brten źes bya ba’i don to; sñiṅ po mṅon
par ’tshaṅ rgya źes bya ba ni sñiṅ po’i chos de mṅon sum du bya źiṅ thob par bya’o źes bya
ba’i tha tshig go.de la sñiṅ po’i chos ni sku gsum ste, chos kyi sku daṅ, loṅs spyod rdzogs
pa’i sku daṅ, sprul pa’i sku’o. gaṅ ’di de bźin gśegs pa’i sku źes bya bas sku gsum char
la bya bar ’dod do. bdag gis de bźin gśegs pa’i sku źes bya ba nas brtsams te bsgrub par
bya’o źes bya ba yan chad kyis chos kyis thob par bya ba bstan to. chos kyi sku de yaṅ
rnam pa lṅar rig par bya ste, 1) pha rol tu phyin pa’i ’bras bur gyur pa daṅ, 2) ñon moṅs
pa daṅ śes bya’i sgrib pa ’joms par byed pa daṅ, 3) de gñis kyis mi tshugs pa daṅ, 4) dus
thams cad du gnas pa daṅ, 5) thams cad las ’phags par gyur pa’o. 1) chos kyi sku źes bya bas
sa daṅ pha rol tu phyin pa’i ’bras bur gyur pa bstan te, de bźin gśegs pa rnams kyi chos
kyi sku de sa daṅ pha rol tu phyin pa’i chos rnams bsgrub pa’i rgyu las byuṅ ba’i sku yin
pas so. 2) rdo rje’i sku źes bya bas ñon moṅs pa daṅ śes bya’i sgrib pa ’joms par bstan
te, rdo rje bźin du bdag med pa’i mtshan ñid kyi sku des ñon moṅs pa daṅ śes bya’i sgrib pa
spoṅ bar byed pa’i phyir ro. 3) mi śigs pa’i sku źes bya bas de gñis kyis mi tshugs pa bstan
to, chos kyi sku de ñon moṅs pa daṅ śes bya’i sgrib pa glo bur gyis mi gos pa’i phyir
ro. 4) brtan pa’i sku źes bya bas dus thams cad du gnas pa bstan te, nams kyaṅ ñams pa med
ciṅ ’khor ba ji srid kyi bar du yaṅ gnas pa’i phyir ro. 5) khams gsum thams cad las khyad
par du ’phags źes bya bas thams cad las ’phags par gyur pa bstan to, khams gsum thams cad
las ’phags pa ñan thos kyi rnam par grol ba’i sku las kyaṅ khyad par ’phags pa’i phyir ro.bdag
gi lus ñes pa du ma źes bya ba la sogs pas loṅs spyod rdzogs pa’i sku thob par bya
ba bstan te, bdag gi lus ñes pa du ma’i skyon chags źes bya ba ni sṅon yaṅ las daṅ ñon moṅs
pa daṅ pha ma’i mi gtsaṅ ba las byuṅ źiṅ, byuṅ nas kyaṅ ’dod chags la sogs pa ñon moṅs pa
skye ba daṅ, sdug bsṅal sna tshogs ’byuṅ ba’i rten du gyur pas ñes pa du ma’i skyon daṅ
ldan mod kyi źes bya ba’i don to; ’on kyaṅ źes bya ba ni lus de la yon tan yaṅ ’byuṅ bar ston
pa ste, yon tan ’byuṅ bas skyon can de la brten nas źes bya bar draṅ ṅo; de bźin gśegs
pa’i sku ñes pa thams cad daṅ bral ba thob par bya’o źes bya ba ni de bźin gśegs pa’i loṅs
spyod rdzogs pa’i sku ñon moṅs daṅ śes bya’i sgrib pa thams cad daṅ bral ba thob par bya’o.

des phan yon mthoṅ bas na so sor rtog pa’i stobs kyis ’byuṅ ba chen po’i gnas kyi lus spoṅ ste
źes bya ba ni lus sñiṅ po med pa ’di spyad legs na ’og nas ’byuṅ ba’i phan yon nam, yon
tan ’byuṅ bar mthoṅ bar so sor rtog pa’i stobs kyis sa, chu, me, rluṅ la sogs pa sems can
gyi gsos su gyur pa ’og nas bśad pa bźin du bdag gi lus kyaṅ de ltar zad par spyad do źes
bya ba’i don to.bdag gis lus ’di yaṅ źes bya ba la sogs pa ni sems can thams cad kyi don
bya ba ji yod pa rnams byed pa la lus ’di zad par bya, mthar byed par bya’o źes bya ba’i tha
tshig go.sgo sna tshogs ni sems can rnam pa maṅ po rnam pa du ma’i sgos so; rnam pa sna
tshogs ni rmo ba daṅ dpuṅ pa la sogs pa’i rnam pas so; dmigs pa sna tshogs ni sems can de
dag gi la las jir dmigs, la las jir dmigs par byed pa’i phyir ro; rnam graṅs sna tshogs ni
rmo ba daṅ rko ba la sogs pa yaṅ la las ji ltar la las ji ltar te, mi mthun pa du mar byed
pa’i phyir ro; yo byad sna tshogs ni kha cig gi gnas, kha cig gis bgo ba la sogs par byed
pa’i phyir ro; loṅs spyod sna tshogs ni bza’ ba du ma daṅ, btuṅ ba du ma’i dṅos po byed
pas so; yoṅs su spyod par ’gyur ba ni gnas la sogs par gyur pas so, loṅs spyod du gyur pa
ni bza’ ba la sogs par ’gyur bar ro.des don gyi dbaṅ ’di mthoṅ nas źes bya ba la byaṅ chub
sems dpa’ des lus de la goṅ du bśad pa lta bu’i don gyi dbaṅ mthoṅ nas źes bya ba’i don
to; lus la sdug bsṅal bar yaṅ rtog ciṅ źes bya ba ni lus skye ba daṅ, rga ba daṅ, na ba daṅ,
’chi ba la sogs pa’i sdug bsṅal rnam pa du ma daṅ ldan par rtog pa’o, sems can la lta ba’i
phyir lus kyi sdug bsṅal gyis kyaṅ mi skyo źes bya ba ni de lta mod kyi sems can la sñiṅ
rje ba’i phyir sdug bsṅal daṅ ldan pa’i lus kyis kyaṅ skyo ba med de, lus ’dor bar mi byed
ces bya ba’i don to; yaṅ na sdug bsṅal bar rtog pa ni sdug bsṅal gsum daṅ brgyad la sogs
pa graṅs med pa daṅ ldan par rtog pa’o.lus la mi rtag par rtog pa ni lus ’di skye ba daṅ,
rga ba daṅ, ’chi ba daṅ ldan par rtog pa’o, śi ’phos pas kyaṅ yoṅs su mi skyo źes bya ba
ni de lta mod kyi sems can gyi don du ’khor bar skye źiṅ ’chi ’pho bstan pas kyaṅ mi skyo
ste, skye ba daṅ ’chi ’pho yaṅ mi gtoṅ ba’o.lus la bdag med par rtog ciṅ źes bya ba ni lus
’di la mu stegs kyis brtags pa’i bdag daṅ sems can med pa yaṅ khoṅ du chud ciṅ bya źes
bya ba’i don to, sems can thams cad yoṅs su smin par bya ba’i phyir yaṅ mi skyo źes bya ba
ni de ltar bdag daṅ sems can med par yaṅ rtog mod kyi sems can yoṅs su smin par bya ba’i
phyir yaṅ mi skyo ste, sems can gyi don kyaṅ mi gtoṅ ṅo.lus la źi bar rtog ciṅ źes bya ba
ni lus ’di chos kyi dṅos pos kyaṅ stoṅ par khoṅ du chud ciṅ źes bya ba’i don to, lus źi ba’i
phyir btaṅ sñoms su yaṅ mi ltuṅ źes bya ba ni lus kyi stoṅ pa ñid du yaṅ mi ltuṅ ba’am,
lus daṅ sems sbyaṅ bar bya ba’i phyir daṅ, dge ba’i rtsa ba bsags pa’i phyir btaṅ sñoms su
yaṅ mi ’jog pa’o.dben par yaṅ rtog ces bya ba ni mya ṅan las ’das pa’i raṅ bźin yin par
khoṅ du chud ces bya ba’i don to; mi ltuṅ źes bya ba ni de dag la mi gnas śiṅ de dag mṅon
sum du mi byed pa ste, sla ba daṅ goṅ du bśad pa rnams ni ma bśad do.tshor ba med pa ni dge
ba daṅ mi dge ba’i ’bras bu bde ba daṅ sdug bsṅal ba la sogs pa myoṅ bar byed pa’i tshor
ba po med pa’o. byed pa med pa ni dbaṅ phyug la sogs pa lus skyed par byed pa’i byed pa po
med pa’o. bdag po med pa ni naṅ na gnas pa’i skyes bu med pa’o. lus ’dzin pa med pa ni de
las gźan pa’i bdag lus la byin gyis brlab pa med pa ste, tshig de dag gis gaṅ zag gi dṅos
po med par bstan to. lus dbyer med pa źes bya ba ni lus kyi chos ñid la tha dad pa med pas
so. lus ro gcig pa ni lus kyi chos ñid thams cad stoṅ pa ñid du ro gcig pas so. lus nam
mkha’i ṅo bo ñid ces bya ba ni ji ltar nam mkha’ dṅos po med ciṅ thams cad du soṅ ba, de
bźin du lus kyaṅ dṅos po med ciṅ thams cad du soṅ ba’i phyir ro. lus raṅ bźin gyis yoṅs su
mya ṅan las ’das ces bya ba ni raṅ bźin gyis ñon moṅs pa daṅ śes bya’i sgrib pa’i dri ma
daṅ ma ’dres pa ste, tshig de dag gis ni chos kyi dṅos po med par bstan to. mi ltuṅ ba ni
stoṅ pa’i chos de mṅon sum du mi byed pa’o.

de źes bya ba ni lus dran pa ñe bar gśag pa la gnas pa’i byaṅ chub sems dpa’ de’o, lus rdzas
daṅ sñiṅ po yaṅ dag par rjes su mi mthoṅ źes bya ba la de ltar lta źiṅ gnas pa na lus ’di
la rdzas yod pa daṅ, sñiṅ po yod par mi mthoṅ ba’o, de la rdzas yod par mi mthoṅ ba ni dṅos
po yod par mi mthoṅ ba’o, sñiṅ po yod par mi mthoṅ ba ni mchog daṅ dam pa yin par mi mthoṅ
ba’o.de naṅ gi lus la lus kyi rjes su lta źiṅ gnas źes bya ba ni byaṅ chub sems dpa’ de
źes bya ba’i don to, naṅ gi lus ni bdag gi rgyud du gtogs pa’i lus so, lus la lus kyi rjes
su lta ba ni goṅ du bśad pa ltar bdag gi lus la śes rab kyis stoṅ pa daṅ bdag med par lta
ba’o, gnas pa ni de’i ’og tu tiṅ ṅe ’dzin gyis rtse gcig tu ’jog pa’o, gnas pas źes bya
ba ni gnas pa’i phyir źes bya ba’i don to, de bas na źes bya bar sbyar ro, naṅ na gnas pa’i
ñon moṅs pa rnams kyi skabs mi ’byed do źes bya ba ni lus la bdag tu lta ba la sogs pa’i
ñon moṅs pa rnams skye ba’i skabs med par byed pa’o.phyi rol gyi ni sems can gźan gyi rgyud
du gtogs pa’i lus so, lus kyi rjes su lta ba ni goṅ ma bźin du gźan gyi lus la dṅos po
med pa daṅ, stoṅ par lta ba’o, phyi rol gyi rjes su soṅ ba’i ñon moṅs pa daṅ lhan cig mi
gnas pa ni gźan gyi lus la dmigs pa las byuṅ ba’i ’dod chags daṅ źe sdaṅ la sogs pa’i ñon
moṅs pas ma gos pa’o.de lus ñon moṅs pa can ma yin pas, yoṅs su dag pa’i lus kyi las daṅ ldan
źes bya ba ni de ltar ñon moṅs pa’i dbaṅ du ma gyur pas sdig pa mi dge ba’i chos mi spyod
pa’i lus kyi las daṅ ldan pa’o, lha daṅ mi’i naṅ na mtshan gyis legs par brgyan pa’i lus
thob ces bya ba ni de dag gi naṅ na yaṅ mtshan thams cad tshaṅ bas brgyan pa’i lus sprul
pa’i sku ’thob pa’o, mṅon sum du ’dod par ’gyur źes bya ba ni de’i gan du ’gro źiṅ de’i
’khor du khas len par ’gyur ba’o.

de ltar źes bya ba ni goṅ du bśad pa ltar ro.

lus dran pa ñe bar gźag pa sgom pa mi zad pa bśad zin to.

## 35th akṣaya: Vedanāsmṛtyupasthāna

rab tu tshor ba gaṅ źe na? gaṅ tshor ba dran pa ñe bar gźag pa la gnas pa ste, sdug bsṅal gsum
las ’das pa yaṅ ’thob la, zag pa med pa’i tshor ba dag pa źi ba yaṅ tshor bar byed pa’o.
de’i dbaṅ du byas nas de la byaṅ chub sems dpa’i tshor ba’i rjes su lta ba dran pa ñe bar
gźag pa źes bya ba la sogs pa gsuṅs te, byaṅ chub sems dpa’ rnams kyis khoṅ du chud ciṅ
bsgom par bya ba’i tshor ba ni byaṅ chub sems dpa’i tshor ba’o. tshor ba rnams ni bde ba daṅ
sdug bsṅal la sogs pa ste, gźan gyi don du bśad pa bźin du sbyar ro – "What is [the bodhisattva]
feeling (pravedin)? He is the one continually engaged in the presence of recollection
concerned with the feelings, who attains transcendence from the threefold suffering
and feels the unsullied (anāsrava) feeling, pure (śuddha) and peaceful (śānta). With reference
to him it is said ...; the feeling of the bodhisattva is the feeling to be known (veditavya)
and cultivated by meditation (bhāvayitava). The feelings are pleasant (sukha) and
unpleasant (duḥkha), as stated elsewhere."

’di la źes bya ba ni tshor ba rnam pa gsum la’o; ’di sñam du sems te źes bya ba ni ’di ltar
rtog ste, źes bya ba’i tha tshig go; tshor ba gaṅ ci yaṅ ruṅ ste, de thams cad sdug bsṅal
źes bya ba ni tshor ba thams cad kyaṅ sdug bsṅal ba’i raṅ bźin te, bde ba’i tshor ba daṅ,
bde ba yaṅ ma yin sdug bsṅal ba yaṅ ma yin pa’i tshor ba rnams kyaṅ mthar sdug bsṅal du ’gyur
źiṅ ’du byed kyi sdug bsṅal gyis khyab pa’i phyir ro sñam nas źes bya ba ni de ltar rtog
nas źes bya ba’i tha tshig go; des źes bya ba ni tshor ba dran pa ñe bar gźag pa las gnas
pa’i byaṅ chub sems dpa’ des so; tshor ba śin tu rtogs pa daṅ źes bya ba ni tshor ba dṅos
po med pa’am, tshor ba thams cad sdug bsṅal ba yin par phyin ci ma log ciṅ legs par rtogs
pa’o; ye śes kyis rtogs pa ni de lta bur ’phags pa’i ye śes zag pa med pas khoṅ du chud
pa’o; śes rab kyis rtogs pa ni zag pa med pa’i śes rab kyis rtogs pa’o; ñe bar źi bas rtogs
pa ni ñon moṅs pa źi ba’i śes pas rtogs pa’o; bde ba’i tshor ba yaṅ tshor bar byed ces
bya ba ni zag pa med pa’i bde ba’i tshor ba tshor bar byed pa’am, bde ’gro’i tshor ba ñid
myoṅ bar byed pa’o; de ’dod chags kyi bag la ñal yaṅ bag la ñal bar mi ’gyur źes bya ba la
tshor ba thams cad stoṅ par khoṅ du chud pa’i byaṅ chub sems dpa’ des goṅ du bśad pa ltar
bde ba’i tshor ba yaṅ dṅos po med par khoṅ du chud pas bde ba’i tshor bas kyaṅ ’dod chags
mi skye źes bya ba’i don to.sdug bsṅal gyi tshor bas reg pa na yaṅ źes bya ba ni sdug bsṅal
gyi tshor ba myoṅ bar gyur pa na yaṅ śin tu bzod par dka’ ba’i ṅo bo yin par rig nas ṅan
soṅ la sogs pa sdug bsṅal gyi tshor ba daṅ ldan pa rnams la sñiṅ rje chen po bskyed ciṅ,
sdug bsṅal gyi tshor ba ñid kyaṅ raṅ bźin med par rtogs pas, de’i rgyu las khoṅ khro ba yaṅ
mi skye źes bya ba’i don to.bde ba yaṅ ma yin sdug bsṅal ba yaṅ ma yin źes bya ba la sogs
pa la btaṅ sñoms kyi tshor ba yaṅ myoṅ ba de dag raṅ bźin med par khoṅ du chud pas, de’i
rgyus gti mug kyaṅ skye bar mi byed ces bya ba’i don to.de tshor ba daṅ ldan pa’i dran pas
źes bya ba la byaṅ chub sems dpa’ des tshor ba gsum bsgom pa daṅ ldan pa’i śes rab kyis
źes bya ba’i don to; tshor ba de dag thams cad las byuṅ ba’i ye śes mthoṅ ba bsgom mo źes
bya ba ni goṅ du smos pa’i tshor ba de dag daṅ bral ba ye śes de rtogs par bsgom źes bya
ba’i tha tshig go.

de sems can thams cad kyi tshor ba źes bya ba ni tshor ba bdag gi tshor ba bźin du byaṅ chub
sems dpa’ sems can thams cad kyi tshor ba’i raṅ bźin khoṅ du chud par bya ba’i phyir brtson
’grus rtsom par byed pa’o.tshor ba las ṅes par ’byuṅ ba ni tshor ba las thar par byed pa’i
thabs tshol ba thams cad stoṅ pa yin par śes pa’o.bdag ni śes rab daṅ ye śes yoṅs su ldan
pa’i tshor bas źes bya ba la zag pa med pa’i śes rab daṅ ldan pa’i tshor ba daṅ zag pa
med pa’i ye śes daṅ ldan pa’i tshor bas tshor ba kun tu stoṅ pa ñid du rig pa źes bya ba’i
don to. tshor ba thams cad rgyun chad pa’i thabs mkhas pa źes bya ba ni tshor ba thams cad
stoṅ par khoṅ du chud pas bde ba’i tshor ba la sogs pa myoṅ yaṅ ’dod chags daṅ źe sdaṅ
mi skye ba’i thabs mkhas pas so. sñiṅ rje chen pos zin pas źes bya ba la sñiṅ rje chen po
daṅ ldan pa las byuṅ ba’i dge ba’i rtsa ba’o.

tshor ba dran pa ñe bar gźag pa rnam graṅs gźan yaṅ bstan pa’i phyir yaṅ ci’i phyir tshor ba
źes bya źe na źes bya ba la sogs pa gsuṅs so.ma rtogs pa’i tshor ba ni sdug bsṅal du ’gyur
źes bya ba ni tshor ba myoṅ ba dṅos po med par ma rtogs pa’i tshor ba ni sdug bsṅal skye
ba’i rgyur ’gyur ba’o. ye śes kyis rtogs pa’i tshor ba źes bya ba ni tshor ba myoṅ la ye
śes kyis stoṅ par rtogs pa’i tshor ba ni zag pa med pa’i bde ba skye ba’i rgyur ’gyur ba’o.gaṅ
gis kyaṅ tshor bar ’gyur ba med kyi źes bya ba ni tshor ba myoṅ bar byed pa’i bdag daṅ
sems can la sogs pa goṅ du smos pa rnams ni med kyi, phyin ci log tu rtog ciṅ mṅon par źen
pa ñid tshor ba’o, źes bya ba’i don to. de bas na mṅon par źen pa ni źes bya ba dṅos su
gsuṅs so, yaṅ na, mṅon par źen pa la sogs pa ni tshor ba skye ba’i rgyu yin pas de dag la
tshor ba źes gsuṅs so.mṅon par źen pa ni bdag yod par mṅon par chags pa’o; yoṅs su ’dzin
pa ni bdag gir ’dzin pa’o; ñe bar len pa ni sems daṅ sems las byuṅ ba yod par rtog pa’o; dmigs
pa ni phyi’i yul gzugs la sogs pa yod par dmigs pa’o; phyin ci log ni bdag med pa la
bdag tu rtog pa la sogs pa phyin ci log bźi’o; rnam par rtog pa ni bdag daṅ bdag gi yod par
rtog pa’o; lta ba ni bdag tu lta ba daṅ sems can la sogs pa ste, de dag gi bag la ñal lam,
ñon moṅs pa gźan gyi bag la ñal lo; mig tu ’du śes pa la sogs pa ni dbaṅ po rnams yod par
’du śes pa ste, de dag kyaṅ tshor ba skye ba’i rgyur ’gyur bas mig tu ’du śes pa’i tshor
ba’o. yaṅ na, yoṅs su ’dzin pa ni tshor ba’o źes bya ba ni dṅos po med pa la dṅos por ’dzin
pa ñid tshor ba źes bya ba’i don to; ñe bar len pa’i tshor ba źes bya ba la sdug bsṅal
gyi phuṅ po lṅa len pa ñid tshor ba źes bya ba’i tha tshig go; dmigs pa ni tshor ba’o źes
bya ba la gzugs la sogs pa la dmigs pa ñid tshor ba’o źes bya ba’i don to.

tshor ba’i rnam graṅs gźan yaṅ bstan pa’i phyir gźan yaṅ rnam graṅs su źes bya ba la sogs pa
gsuṅs ste, ’og nas smos pa’i rnam graṅs rnams kyaṅ miṅ du tha dad kyi, don du gcig go źes
bya bar dgoṅs pa’o; tshor ba gcig pu źes bya ba ni gcig tu zad de źes bya ba’i tha tshig
go; gaṅ ’di sems kyi rnam par rig pa źes bya ba la gaṅ gi mtshan ñid rnam par rig pa’i ṅo
bo ñid tshor ba yin pa’am, sems kyi rnam par rig pa las byuṅ ba’i tshor ba’o.naṅ gi ñe bar
len pa las byuṅ ba’i tshor ba ni naṅ gi tshor ba’o, phyi’i gzugs la sogs pa la dmigs pa’i
rgyu las byuṅ ba’i tshor ba ni phyi’i tshor ba’o.tshor ba gsum ste źes bya ba ni dus gsum
gyi dṅos po rnam par rig pa ñid tshor ba’am, dṅos po rnam par rig pa’i rgyu las byuṅ ba’i
tshor ba’o.khams bźi ni sa chu me rluṅ bźi ste, de dag rig pa ñid tshor ba’am, de dag rig
pa’i rgyu las byuṅ ba’i tshor ba ste, yul bźi yod pas de la dmigs par byed pa’i tshor ba
yaṅ rnam pa bźir gźag go.phuṅ po lṅa yid la byed ces bya ba ni phuṅ po lṅa yid la byed pa
ñid tshor ba’am, de yid la byed pa’i rgyu las byuṅ ba’i tshor ba’o.skye mched drug la yoṅs
su rtog pa’o źes bya ba ni skye mched drug la yoṅs su rtog pa ñid tshor ba’am, yoṅs su rtog
pa’i rgyu las byuṅ ba’i tshor ba’o.tshor ba ni bdun ste, gaṅ ’di rnam par śes pa gnas pa
bdun no źes bya ba la:rnam par śes pa gnas pa bdun ni 1) lus sna tshogs pa daṅ ’du śes sna
tshogs pa’i rnam par śes pa gnas pa daṅ, 2) lus sna tshogs la ’du śes gcig pa’i rnam par
śes pa gnas pa daṅ, 3) lus gcig la ’du śes sna tshogs pa’i rnam par śes pa gnas pa daṅ,
4) lus gcig pa la ’du śes kyaṅ gcig pa’i rnam par śes pa gnas pa daṅ, 5-7) gzugs med pa’i
sa gsum rnams bdun no.1) de la lus sna tshogs la ’du śes sna tshogs pa’i sems can rnams ni
mi rnams daṅ, ’dod pa na spyod pa’i lha’i ris drug daṅ, bsam gtan daṅ por skyes pa thog ma
byuṅ ba ma gtogs pa rnams te; sems can dag lus kyaṅ che phra bzaṅ ṅan rnam pa sna tshogs
yod la ’du śes kyaṅ rnam pa sna tshogs yod pa’i phyir ro;2) lus sna tshogs la ’du śes gcig
pa ni dper na tshaṅs ris kyi lha dag daṅ por byuṅ ba rnams te, de dag lus sna tshogs pa
ni sṅa ma bźin la ’du śes gcig pa ni, thams cad tshaṅs pas bskyed par ’du śes gcig pa’i phyir
ro;3) ’du śes sna tshogs la lus gcig pa ni ’od gsal gyi lha’i ris sṅa phyir skyes pa ste,
de dag thams cad kyi lus che phra bzaṅ ṅan ’dra źiṅ ’od snaṅ ba can du gcig la mi’i bskal
pa bsam gtan daṅ por byuṅ ba’i tshe kha cig ’jig, kha cig mi ’jig pa’i phyir ’du śes tha
dad do;4) lus gcig la ’du śes gcig pa ni bsam gtan gsum pa yan chad du skyes pa ste, bsam
gtan gsum pa’i sems can rnams de dag dge ba’i tshor ba la rtog pa’i ’du śes gcig go. lus
gcig pa ni bsam gtan gñis pa bźin no;5-7) gzugs med pa gsum ni nam mkha’ mtha’ yas skye
mched daṅ, rnam śes mtha’ yas skye mched daṅ, ci yaṅ med pa’i skye mched de;mi daṅ lha’i ris
miṅ gis smos pa de dag gi rnam par śes pa’i rgyu brtan par gnas pa’i phyir rnam par śes
pa gnas pa źes bya’o.ṅan soṅ rgyud gsum ni sdug bsṅal sna tshogs kyis g-yen spyo bas rnam
par śes pa brtan par mi gnas pas der mi bgraṅ ṅo. ’du śes med pa’i sems can rnams ni de na
gcig tu ṅes par rnam par śes pa kun tu ’byuṅ ba med pa’i phyir ma yin gyi, gzugs med pa’i
khams kyi ’du śes med min skye mched kyaṅ ’du śes daṅ rnam par śes pa yod pa yaṅ ma yin
med pa yaṅ ma yin pas brtan par mi gnas so.Kośa III,5-6:nānātvakāyasaṃjñāś ca nānākāyayaiksaṃjñinaḥ/viparyayāc
caikakāyasaṃjñāś cārūpiṇas trayaḥ //5//vijñānasthitayaḥ sapta śeṣaṃ tatparipbhedavat/bhavāgrāsaṃjñisattvāś
ca sattvāvāsā nava smṛtāḥ/with bhāṣya p. 11517-11719
treats the seven vijñānasthiti and nine sattvāvāsa in the item after the next in greater
detail; they are also enumerated in Mvy CXIX.tshor ba brgyad źes bya ba ni bdag tu lta ba
daṅ, sems can du lta ba daṅ, gaṅ zag tu lta ba daṅ, srog tu lta ba daṅ, ther zug tu lta ba
daṅ, nad par lta ba daṅ, srid par lta ba daṅ, srid pa med par lta ba’o; yaṅ na log pa brgyad
ni mi khom pa brgyad de, de dag gi tshor ba la bya’o.sems can gyi gnas dgu ni goṅ ma’i
rnam par śes pa gnas bdun gyi steṅ du ’du śes med pa daṅ srid pa’i rtse mo gñis bsnan pa’o
– "The above-mentioned seven places of consciousness with, in addition, the two, which consist
of the [the states] beyond concept (asaṃjñin) and the uttermost point of existence
(bhavāgra)."mi dge ba bcu źes bya ba ni rgyu bcu yod pas de’i rgyu las byuṅ ba’i sdug bsṅal
’bras bu tshor ba yaṅ bcur gźag go.

’di ni tshor ba kun gyi tshul te źes bya ba ni tshor ba’am tshor ba’i dṅos po ni med kyi, kun
rdzob tu tshor ba tha dad du gdags śiṅ rnam graṅs su bya ba goṅ du bśad pa’i rim pa ’di
lta bu dag go źes bya ba’i don to.dmigs pa ji sñed pa źes bya ba la sogs pas tshor ba mi zad
pa bstan te, gzugs la sogs pa dmigs pa’i yul ji sñed pa de la dmigs śiṅ yid la byed pa
de sñed do. yid la byed pa ji sñed pa sems yoṅs su rtog pa yaṅ de sñed do. yoṅs su rtog pa
ji sñed pa tshor ba yaṅ de sñed de, de bas na tshor ba tshad med ciṅ mi zad par śes par bya’o
źes bya ba’i don to; des źes bya ba ni tshor ba tshad med pa’o.

rjes su lta źiṅ gnas pas źes bya ba ni śes rab daṅ tiṅ ṅe ’dzin gyis so; śes pa bskyed ces bya
ba ni skye ba la skye bar śes pa daṅ, ’jig pa la ’jig par śes pa daṅ, gnas pa la gnas par
śes pa bskyed par bya’o.

tshor ba la tshor ba’i rjes su lta źiṅ dran par ñe bar gźag pa mdor bsdus te bstan pa’i phyir
gaṅ sems can thams cad kyi tshor ba źes bya ba la sogs pa gsuṅs te, śes pa’i tshig skye
ba la sogs pa kun daṅ sbyar ro; dge ba’i rgyu las byuṅ ba’i tshor ba gaṅ yin pa śes pa daṅ,
mi dge ba’i rgyu las byuṅ ba’i tshor ba gaṅ yin pa śes pa’o. tshor ba dran pa ñe bar gźag
pa bsgom pa mi zad pa bśad zin to.

## 36th akṣaya: Cittasmṛtyupasthāna

rab tu gnas pa’i byaṅ chub sems dpa’ gaṅ źe na źes gaṅ sems dran pa ñe bar gźag pa la rab tu
źugs pa ste, rnam par śes pa’i gnas thams cad las ’das yaṅ thob la, byaṅ chub sems dpa’i
tiṅ ṅe ’dzin tshad med pa yoṅs su rdzogs par byed pa’o. de’i dbaṅ du byas nas de la byaṅ chub
sems dpa’i sems la sems kyi rjes su lta ba dran pa ñe bar gźag pa gaṅ źe na? źes bya ba
la sogs pa gsuṅs te, byaṅ chub sems dpa’ rnams kyis bsgom par bya ba ni byaṅ chub kyi sems
so – "What is the established (pratiṣṭhita) bodhisattva? He is the one progressing in the
presence of recollecting thoughts (cittasmṛtyupasthānapratipanna), who attains transcendence
from all states of consciousness (vijñānasthiti) and accomplishes the immeasurable concentration
of the bodhisattvas (apramāṇāṃ bodhisattvasamādhiṃ paripūrayati). With reference
to him, it is said (tam adhipatiṃ kṛtvā) ... What is to be cultivated (bhāvayitavya) by
the bodhisattvas is the thought of awakening (bodhicitta)".byaṅ chub sems dpa’ de’i byaṅ
chub kyi sems ma brjed pa źes bya ba la sogs pa la ñan thos daṅ raṅ saṅs rgyas dag sems dran
par ñe bar gźag pa na bdag gi sems mi rtag pa la sogs pa dran pa ñe bar ’jog pa lta bu
ni ma yin gyi, byaṅ chub sems dpa’ rnams thog mar byaṅ chub tu sems ji ltar bskyed pa’i byaṅ
chub kyi sems de mi brjed pa’i gzuṅs kyis dran pas mi brjed pa daṅ, dran pa ñid ma ñams
par bsruṅ ba daṅ, bsruṅs pa ñid mi mthun pa’i phyogs la mi g-yeṅ bar byed pa ni sems dran
pa ñe bar ’jog pa źes bya’o – "... It is not like when the disciples and isolated buddhas
practice recollection concerned with the impermanence, etc., of one’s own thoughts, the
bodhisattvas do not forget the original thought of awakening (ādibodhicitta) because of recollection
(smṛti), because of unfailing memory (asaṃpramoṣadhāraṇī). ...

byaṅ chub kyi sems mi brjed pa de ji rtag pa’i phyir de lta bu źig nas mñam pa la de’i phyir
de sems la ’di ltar rtog go źes bya ba la sogs pa gsuṅs te, de źes bya ba ni sems dran pa
ñe bar gźag pa la gnas pa’i byaṅ chub sems dpa’ de’am, byaṅ chub kyi sems ma brjed pa’i byaṅ
chub sems dpa’ de’o; sems la źes bya ba ni byaṅ chub kyi sems la’o; ’di ltar rtog ces
bya ba ni byaṅ chub kyi sems de la ’og nas ’byuṅ ba ltar rtog pa’o.ji ltar rtog ce na? de’i
phyir sems ni skyes nas źig ciṅ źu ste źes bya ba la sogs pa gsuṅs te, sems ni sems ñid
dam byaṅ chub kyi sems so; skyes nas źes bya ba ni skyes ma thag tu’o, źig ciṅ źu ste źes
bya ba ni don gcig ste, de ma thag tu źig pa’o, mi gnas pa ni cuṅ zad kyaṅ ’dug pa’i mthu
med pa ste, de bas na źes bya bar sbyar ro; naṅ na yaṅ mi ’dug phyi rol tu yaṅ ma ’phos gñi
ga med par yaṅ mi dmigs źes bya ba ni sems de skad ciṅ ma’i raṅ bźin skyes ma thag tu ’jig
ciṅ deṅs pa’i ṅo bo ñid de, źig nas kyaṅ med par ’gyur ba’i, naṅ gi dṅos po rnams la yaṅ
mi gnas, phyi rol gyi yul rnams la yaṅ ma ’phos, de gñis ka ma yin pa gźan phyi naṅ gñis
kyi bar na yaṅ mi dmigs mi gnas śes bya ba’i don to.gaṅ bdag gi byaṅ chub kyi sems daṅ po
skyes pa de ni źes bya ba la sogs pa la goṅ du bśad par yaṅ ma zad kyi ’di ltar yaṅ khoṅ
du chud do źes bya bar sbyar ro, skyes pa ’das pa’i dus su skyes zin to, zad ciṅ ’gags pa
la sogs pa ni don gcig ste med par gyur par ston pa’o, zad pa ni rgyu med pa’o, ’gags pa ni
raṅ bźin gyis med pa’o, yal źiṅ med par gyur pas kyaṅ gaṅ du yaṅ gnas par ma gyur te, de
bas na med par gyur pa źes bya’o, yul daṅ phyogs na mi gnas te de ni gdags par mi nus so
źes bya ba la thog mar sems bskyed de, de skad cig ma re re la yaṅ zad ciṅ ’gags te, gźan
daṅ gźan du gyur la, yal źiṅ med par gyur pas dṅos po med pa’i phyir yul daṅ phyogs na mi
gnas miṅ daṅ mtshan mar gdags su med do źes bya ba’i don to.sems gaṅ dag gis byaṅ chub kyi
phyir dge ba’i rtsa ba rnams yaṅ dag par bsgrubs pa, de dag kyaṅ zad ciṅ ’gags te yal źiṅ
med par gyur pas źes bya ba la sems gaṅ dag gis ni dge ba’i rtsa ba’i rgyur ’gyur ba’i sems
bskyed pa gaṅ gis so, byaṅ chub kyi phyir ni ’bras bu de thob par bya ba’i phyir ro, dge
ba’i rtsa ba bsgrubs pa ni bsod nams daṅ ye śes kyi tshogs bsgrubs pa’o; byaṅ chub kyi sems
ñid goṅ du smos pa’i tshul gyis don dam par ṅo bo ñid med pas, de las byuṅ ba’i dge ba’i
rtsa ba rnams kyaṅ yal źiṅ med par gyur pas sems bźin du ṅo bo ñid med pa’i phyir yul daṅ
phyogs na mi gnas śiṅ miṅ daṅ mtshan mar gdags par mi nus so źes bya ba’i don to.sems gaṅ
dag gis dge ba’i rtsa ba de dag byaṅ chub tu bsṅos pa, de dag kyaṅ de’i raṅ bźin de’i mtshan
ñid de źes bya ba la sems gaṅ gis ni dge ba’i rtsa ba’i rgyur gyur pa’i byaṅ chub kyi
sems bskyed pas so, byaṅ chub tu bsṅos pas kyaṅ źes bya ba ni byaṅ chub tu bsṅos pa’i ’og
tu ’phel bar gyur pa’i dge ba’i rtsa ba de dag go, de ni ’di skad du byaṅ chub kyi sems
kyis bskyed pa’i dge ba’i rtsa ba bla na med pa’i byaṅ chub tu bṅos pa de dag kyaṅ sems daṅ
’dra bar zad ciṅ ’gags te yal źiṅ med par ’gyur ba’i mtshan ñid las yul daṅ phyogs na mi
gnas śiṅ gdags par nus so źes bya bar ston to.sems kyis sems mi śes so źes bya ba ni sems
de raṅ bźin med pas śes par byed pa daṅ śes par bya ba med pa’i phyir ro. de bźin du ’og
ma la yaṅ sbyar ro; sems kyis sems kyi mtshams mi sbyor ba ni ’das pa’i sems de ma ’oṅs par
mi ’pho źiṅ, ma ’oṅs pa’i sems daṅ mtshams mi sbyor ba’o.

de la gaṅ gis bdag bla na med pa yaṅ dag par rdzogs pa’i byaṅ chub mṅon par rdzogs par ’tshaṅ
rgya bar bya źes bya ba la sogs pa la mṅon par ’tshaṅ rgya bar ’gyur ba’i byaṅ chub kyi
sems daṅ dge ba’i rtsa ba’i sems la sogs pa goṅ du smos pa lta bu’i tshul gyis brtags na gaṅ
yaṅ raṅ bźin du grub pa ni med pas byaṅ chub kyi sems gaṅ yin pa de dge ba’i rtsa ba’i
sems daṅ lhan cig mi gnas źes bya ba la sogs pa gsuṅs so. (269a)

sems la rtog pa’i rnam pa gźan pa bstan pa’i phyir yaṅ de ’di sñam du sems te rgyu daṅ ’bras
bu chud mi za ba źes bya ba la sogs pa gsuṅs so; de ni byaṅ chub sems dpa’ de’o; de ltar
sems kyi raṅ bźin stoṅ pa yaṅ kun rdzob tu rgyu gaṅ spyad pa’i ’bras bu de bźin du thob par
’gyur te chud mi za bar rten ciṅ ’brel bar ’byuṅ ba gcig kho nar ṅes par mi mṅon pa de ni
blta dka’ bas śin tu zab bo źes bya ba’i don to; sems kyi chos ñid de lta bu yin du zin
kyaṅ źes bya ba la sogs pa ni don dam par sems de ṅo bo ñid kyis stoṅ du zin kyaṅ kun rdzob
tu rgyu daṅ rkyen rnams tshogs na med par mi ’gyur la, rgyu rkyen tshogs pa las ’byuṅ ba
de dag kyaṅ mu stegs can gyi byed pa po la sogs pa med pas de dag gis kyaṅ bskyod do źes
bya ba’i don to; de dag ji ltar ’dod pa bźin rnam par bsgrub pa źes bya ba ni ji ltar byed
pa po la sogs pa med par yaṅ rgyu rkyen tshogs pa las kun rdzob tu skye źiṅ ’byuṅ bas na
rgyu gaṅ daṅ gaṅ gis ’bras bu gaṅ daṅ gaṅ sgrub pa de dag ji ltar ’dod pa bźin du grub źes
bya ba’i don to. bdag gis kyaṅ rnam par bsgrub pa la brtson par bya źes bya ba ni ji ltar
’dod pa bźin ’bras bu ’grub pas bdag gis kyaṅ bdog pa thams cad yoṅs su gtaṅ ba la sogs pa’i
’bras bu saṅs rgyas kyi źiṅ yoṅs su dag par bya ba’i phyir bsṅo ba la sogs pa la brtson
par bya’o źes bya ba’i don to; sems kyi chos ñid ’di yaṅ mi spoṅ ṅo źes bya ba ni de dag
kun rdzob tu sgrub pa la brtson par byed kyaṅ, don dam par sems kyi chos ñid ma skyes pa
yaṅ mi spoṅ ba’am, de yaṅ ñams par mi byed pa’o; sems ni sgyu ma lta bu ste źes bya ba la
sogs pas pha rol tu phyin pa drug don dam par mi dmigs pa daṅ, kun rdzob tu rgyu daṅ ’bras
bu ṅes par yod par bstan pa’o.

sgyu ma lta bur źes bya ba ni sgyu ma bźin du raṅ bźin med pa ste, de bas na gaṅ zag ’di la
bdag gis dṅos po gtoṅ bar snaṅ ba ni raṅ bźin med pa’o; bdog pa thams cad yoṅs su btaṅ ste
źes bya ba ni phyi daṅ naṅ gi dṅos po thams cad yoṅs su gtoṅ ba’o, saṅs rgyas kyi źiṅ dag
pa ni bai dū rya’i kha dog la sogs pa’o.

sems rmi lam lta bu źes bya ba la, ji ltar rmi lam na dṅos po rnam pa sna tshogs snaṅ yaṅ raṅ
bźin stoṅ pa de bźin du sems la gzuṅ ba daṅ ’dzin pa la sogs pa rnam pa du mar snaṅ yaṅ
raṅ bźin gyis stoṅ pa’o; yaṅ dag par blaṅs pa daṅ yaṅ dag par slob pa ni tshul khrims so,
yaṅ dag par blaṅ bar bya ba daṅ bslab par bya ba ni bslab pa’o, thams cad mkhyen pa ñid kyi
phyir źes bya ba ni thams cad mkhyen pa thob par bya ba’i phyir ro.

gzod ma nas yoṅs su ma grub ces bya ba ni ji ltar mig yor phyis brtags te, raṅ bźin med pa ltar
daṅ po snaṅ ba’i dus na yaṅ raṅ bźin med pa yin no, de daṅ ’dra bar sems ’di yaṅ thog
ma nas raṅ bźin med ciṅ ma skyes pa’o, bzod pa ni gźan gyis gnod pa byas pa ñams su len pa’o,
des pa ni slar gnod pa mi byed pa ste, de dag bsgrubs pa źes bya bar sbyar ro; mi skye
ba’i chos la bzod pa rdzogs par bya ba’i phyir źes bya ba ni skye ba daṅ ’gag pa med pa’i
chos la skrag pa med pa thob par bya ba’i phyir bsṅo ba’o.

śin tu dben pa źes bya ba ni smig rgyu chus stoṅ ste, dben pa bźin du sems la yaṅ gzuṅ ba daṅ
’dzin pas stoṅ ste dben pa’o; dge ba’i rtsa ba thams cad la źes bya ba ni dge ba’i rtsa
ba thams cad sgrub pa la źe’am, sgrub pa’i phyir źes bya ba’i don to, saṅs rgyas kyi chos
ni sa daṅ pha rol tu phyin pa la sogs pa’o.

gzugs can ma yin pa źes bya ba ni thogs pa daṅ bcas pa’i gzugs kyi ṅo bo ma yin pa’i phyir ro,
bstan du med pa źes bya ba ni sṅon po la sogs pa bźin du gźan la bstan par mi nus pa’o,
thogs pa med pa ni nam mkha’ bźin du kun tu soṅ ba’i phyir ro, rnam par rig pa med pa ni
rig par bya ba daṅ rig par byed pa daṅ bral ba’i phyir ro; saṅs rgyas kyi tiṅ ṅe ’dzin ni
rnam par mi rtog pa’i tiṅ ṅe ’dzin no.

gzuṅ ba med pa ni sems daṅ sems las byuṅ ba’i gzuṅ bar snaṅ ba dṅos por ma grub pa’i phyir ro,
mtshan ma med pa ni gzugs la sogs pa’i ṅo bo ma yin pa’i phyir ro, bstan du med pa ni sṅa
ma bźin no, gnas med pa ni gzugs daṅ dbaṅ po la mi gnas pa’i phyir ro; dris pa’i tshig
ni phuṅ po daṅ khams la sogs pa gźan gyis dris pa’o, dbye ba bstan pa śes pa źes bya ba ni
ji ltar thos pa’i chos rnams so sor phye ste bśad pa’i gnas śes rab bo, saṅs rgyas kyi ye
śes ni me loṅ lta bu la sogs pa’o.

sems ni dmigs pa med par mi skye źes bya ba la sogs pas kun rdzob kyi sems kyis dmigs pa’i rgyu
daṅ rkyen la sogs pa yod par bstan pa las sgrub pa yaṅ yod par bstan pa ste, dmigs par
bya ba’i yul med par sems mi skye’o, yul la dmigs nas skye ba ni sems kyi chos ñid do; gaṅ
dge ba’i rtsa ba thams cad la dmigs pa źes bya ba ni sems yul la dmigs nas skye ba yin pas,
dmigs nas yaṅ dge ba’i rtsa ba skye bar ’gyur ba’i dmigs pa thams cad la sems dmigs pa’o.

rgyu med par mi skye ba ni kun gźi rnam par śes pa’i bag chags med par sems mi skye ba’o – "Thought
does not originate without the habits (vāsanā) of the store-consciousness (ālayavijñāna)".
byaṅ chub kyi phyogs kyi chos źes bya ba ni sems skye ba’i rgyu bskyed ciṅ ’jog na
yaṅ byaṅ chub kyi phyogs kyi chos skye ba’i rgyu bskyed pa’o.

yul drug la źes bya ba ni yul drug la ma brten par sems mi skye ba’o; saṅs rgyas kyi chos thams
cad ni sa daṅ pha rol tu phyin pa daṅ stobs daṅ mi ’jigs pa la sogs pa’o, de dag gi yul
ni stoṅ pa ñid do, rgyu ni yul te, mṅon du byed pa’i chos thabs daṅ śes rab bo; sgrub pa
ni thabs daṅ śes rab sgrub pa’o.

mṅon par śes pa ni drug rnams so, sems ñe bar ’dogs pa ni rtse gcig tu ’jog pa’o.sems kyi spyod
pa rab tu śes pa’o sems can rnams kyi sems ji lta bu yin pa daṅ, ’dod chags la sogs pa’i
ñon moṅs pa gaṅ la spyod pa śes pa’o.de lta bu’i raṅ bźin gyis chos ston pa ni ñon moṅs
pa gaṅ la spyod pa daṅ de daṅ mthun pa’i chos mi gtsaṅ ba la sogs pa ston pa’o.mi skyo ba
ni sñiṅ rje daṅ ldan pas so.sems zad par bya ba’i phyir sems mi skyed ces bya ba la sogs
pa ni ñan thos daṅ raṅ saṅs rgyas ltar źi ba’i phyogs gcig pa’i mya ṅan las ’das pa la gnas
pa ni ma yin gyi, thabs kyis yoṅs su zin pas ’khor ba’i rgyun gyi dge ba’i rtsa ba mi gcod
do źes bya ba’i don to. zad pa ni ñon moṅs pa zad pa’i phyir ro; ’gog pa ni phuṅ po spaṅ
ba’i phyir ro.sems kyi dran pa śes pa des źes bya ba la sogs pas goṅ du smos pa lta bu’i
sems dran pa ñe bar ’jog pa de khoṅ du chud de, des ma byuṅ ba daṅ mi skye ba la sogs pa’i
mtshan ñid la gnas kyaṅ chos ñid de’i dbaṅ du ma gyur pas ñan thos daṅ raṅ saṅs rgyas dag
ltar ’khor ba yoṅs su spoṅ bar yaṅ mi ’gyur ro źes bya ba’i don to.nam saṅs rgyas kyi chos
źes bya ba la sogs pa ni bdag daṅ sems can thams cad bla na med pa’i byaṅ chub tu ma grub
kyi bar du thabs daṅ śes rab zuṅ du ’brel ba’i sems kyi rgyun mi gtoṅ ba’o.sems kyi skad
cig gcig daṅ ldan pa’i śes rab ces bya ba ni mthar mṅon par byaṅ chub pa la ’jug pa’i sems
kyi skad cig ma gcig daṅ ldan pa, bdag med pa gñis khoṅ du chud pa’i śes rab kyis de bźin
ñid mṅon sum du byed pa’o. Cf. Rgv p. 4113-14, Takasaki’s tr. p. 189 with note 24.

sems dran pa ñe bar gźag pa bsgom pa mi zad pa bśad zin to.

## 37th akṣaya: Kāyasmṛtyupasthāna

rab tu rnam par byaṅ ba’i byaṅ chub sems dpa’ gaṅ źe na? gaṅ chos dran pa ñe bar gźag pa la
rab tu źugs pa ste, sgrib pa daṅ, kun nas sbyor ba daṅ, ’chiṅ ba daṅ, bag la ñal ba daṅ, ñon
moṅs pa’i kun nas dkris pa thams cad las ’das pa yaṅ thob la, chos thams cad la dbaṅ thob
pa yoṅs su rdzogs par byed pa’o. de’i dbaṅ du byas nas de la byaṅ chub sems dpa’i chos
rnams la źes bya ba la sogs pa gsuṅs te – "What is the bodhisattva purifying (pravyavadānaka)?
He is the one progressing in the presence of recollection concerned with moments of existence
(dharmasmṛtyupasthānapratipanna), he is one to fulfil the attainment of mastery over
all moments of existence (sarvadharmavaśitāprāpti) in attaining transcendence from obsession
(paryavasthāna) of hindrances (āvaraṇa), fetters (saṃyojana), ties (bandhana), latent
potentialities (anuśaya) and vices (kleśa). With reference to him (tam adhipatiṃ kṛtvā),
it is said ...chos ni ’dus byas daṅ ’dus ma byas daṅ, zag pa daṅ bcas pa daṅ zag pa med
pa’o. chos kyi rjes su lta ba ni śes rab kyis chos de dag la stoṅ par rtog pa’o; dran pa ñe
bar gźag pa ni tiṅ ṅe ’dzin gyis de la rtse gcig tu ’jog pa’o. gaṅ źe na źes bya ba ni de
dag dṅos po gaṅ yin pa ’dri ba’o.

de dag bstan pa’i phyir ’phags pa’i śes rab kyi mig gis mthoṅ ba’i chos de dag ces bya ba la
sogs pa gsuṅs te, ’phags pa źes smos pa ni zag pa med par ston to; śes rab kyi mig ces smos
pa ni rnam par mi rtog pa’i mtshan ñid yin par ston to; mthoṅ ba ni ’dus byas daṅ ’dus
ma byas kyi chos thams cad ’og nas ’byuṅ ba’i tshul du stoṅ pa ñid kyi raṅ bźin mthoṅ ba ste
de ltar mthoṅ ba’i chos de dag ni ’bras bu la gnas kyi bar du ñams par mi ’gyur źes bya
ba’i don to.

stoṅ pa las rnam par grol ba źes bya ba la sogs pa ni chuṅ rab tsam yaṅ mi mthoṅ źes bya bar
sbyar te, stoṅ pa ñid la sogs pa’i naṅ du ma ’dus pa’i chos gaṅ yaṅ med do, der ma ’dus pa’i
chos gaṅ yaṅ mi mthoṅ ṅo źes bya ba’i don to. chos gaṅ rten ciṅ ’brel bar ’byuṅ ba las
rnam par grol ba chuṅ rab tsam yaṅ mi mthoṅ ṅo źes bya ba ni don dam par chos rnams stoṅ
pa ñid kyi raṅ bźin yin yaṅ, kun rdzob tu yaṅ rten ciṅ ’brel bar ’byuṅ ba ma yin pa’i chos
gcig kyaṅ mi mthoṅ ste, der ma gtogs pa’i chos gcig kyaṅ med do źes bya ba’i don to.Alternatively:
... sees the moment of existence, not the non-moment of existence.

chos kho na mthoṅ gi, chos ma yin pa mi mthoṅ ṅo źes bya ba la bdag med pa la sogs pa phyin
ci ma log pa yaṅ dag pa yin pas na chos kho na źes bya ste, de mthoṅ ba’o. bdag tu lta ba
la sogs pa smos pa ni yaṅ dag pa ma yin pa phyin ci log pas chos ma yin pa ste, de mi mthoṅ
ba’o.

chos thams cad ni chos so źes bya ba la chos kyi sgra ni stoṅ pa ñid la sogs pa la bya ste,
de chos thams cad la yod pas na chos thams cad ni chos so. chos thams cad ni chos ma yin źes
bya ba ni chos de dag ñid la bdag daṅ bdag gir ’dzin pa yaṅ skye bas na chos thams cad
chos ma yin pas te, bdag tu ’dzin pa la sogs pa la chos ma yin pa źes bya’o.so sor rtog pas
źes bya ba ni stoṅ pa śes pas sam, stoṅ pas khyab pas so. mṅon par źen pa źes bya ba ni
chos de dag ñid bdag daṅ bdag gir chags pa’i rgyu yin pas so.

saṅs rgyas kyi chos med pa daṅ źes bya ba la sogs pas ni chos rnams stoṅ par khoṅ du chud pa
las thar pa daṅ mya ṅan las ’das par ’gyur te, de bas na chos gaṅ la brten te saṅs rgyas
kyi chos su mi ’gyur ba’i chos de dag yaṅ med do źes bya ba’i don to. saṅs rgyas kyi chos
ni lus daṅ khoṅ du chud par bya ba’i chos te, de’i raṅ bźin du ma gyur pa’i chos gaṅ yaṅ med
do źes bya bar dgoṅs so. gaṅ las byaṅ chub med pa źes bya ba la, byaṅ chub ni spaṅs pa
daṅ ye śes kyi mtshan ñid de, chos gaṅ la brten te de’i rgyur mi ’gyur ba’i chos gaṅ yaṅ med
do źes bya ba’i tha tshig go. lam med ces bya ba la lam ni sa bcu ste, de’i raṅ bźin du
ma gyur pa’i chos gaṅ yaṅ med do źes bya ba’i don to. thar pa med pa źes bya ba ni thar pa
med pa’i rgyur ma gyur pa’i chos gaṅ yaṅ med do źes bya ba’i don to. ṅes par ’byuṅ ba med
pa źes bya ba ni khams gsum las ’byuṅ bar ma gyur pa’i chos gaṅ yaṅ med do źes bya ba’i
don to.des chos thams cad ṅes par ’byuṅ bar śes źes bya ba la chos dran pa ñe bar gźag pa
la gnas pa’i byaṅ chub sems dpa’ des chos thams cad khams gsum las ’byuṅ ba daṅ ’byuṅ ba’i
rgyur ’gyur ba daṅ, thar pa’i rgyur gyur pa śes pa’o, yaṅ na des chos thams cad ṅes par ’byuṅ
bar śes pas sems can rnams la sgrib pa med pa źes bya ba’i sñiṅ rje chen po’i tiṅ ṅe
’dzin gyi sgo thob par ’gyur ro źes bya ba la chos thams cad las byuṅ ba’i dṅos po daṅ mtshan
ma thams cad las thar pa’am bral ba ste, stoṅ pa ñid śes pa la bya’o. des chos thams cad
de ltar stoṅ par śes pas mtshan mar lta ba’i sems can rnams la sñiṅ rje chen po ’byuṅ ba’i
tiṅ ṅe ’dzin gyi sgo thob par ’gyur te, tiṅ ṅe ’dzin gaṅ la źugs na sñiṅ rje chen po ’byuṅ
ba’i tiṅ ṅe ’dzin la sñiṅ rje chen po’i tiṅ ṅe ’dzin ces bya’o, de’i sgo ni tiṅ ṅe ’dzin
de thob par ’gyur ba’am, de la ’jug pa’i thabs la bya’o, sgrib pa med pa ni tiṅ ṅe ’dzin
de mi mthun pa’i phyogs spaṅs pa’o, des źes bya ba ni sñiṅ rje chen po’i tiṅ ṅe ’dzin gyi
sgo thob pa’i byaṅ chub sems dpa’ de’am, chos dran pa ñe bar gźag pa la gnas pa’i byaṅ
chub sems dpa’ des so.chos thams cad ni phuṅ po daṅ khams la sogs pa’o, ñon moṅs pa ni ’dod
chags la sogs pa’o, bcos ma’i ’du śes thob ces bya ba ni sgyu ma daṅ ’dra bar raṅ bźin med
par śes pa thob pa’o.ji ltar ’du śes thob pa bstan pa’i phyir chos ’di dag ni ñon moṅs
pa med pa źes bya ba la sogs pa gsuṅs te, phuṅ pa la sogs pa’i chos ’di dag ni ñon moṅs pa
skye ba’i rgyu ma yin pa’am, ñon moṅs pa daṅ ’dres pa ma yin pa ste, de bas na chos ’di dag
ni ñon moṅs pa daṅ bcas pa ma yin pa’o. de ci’i phyir źe na źes bya ba ni byaṅ chub sems
dpa’ de ci’i phyir de lta bu’i ’du śes thob ces bya ba’am, chos de dag ci’i phyir ñon moṅs
pa ma yin źe na źes bya ba’i tha tshig go.241b2-4: ’di ltar de dag ṅes pa’i don gyi don
la rton te źes bya ba la ’di ltar ni ’og nas bśad pa ltar ro, de dag ni byaṅ chub sems dpa’
de dag gam, chos de dag go, ṅes pa’i don gyi don la rton pa ni chos gaṅ ñon moṅs pa goṅ
du smos pa thams cad stoṅ pa ñid kyi don la rton pa’am, byaṅ chub sems dpa’ ñid stoṅ pa ñid
kyi don la rton pa ste, ṅes pa’i don ni stoṅ pa ñid kyi don to, ñon moṅs pa’i tshogs kyaṅ
med ces bya ba la sogs pa ni de ltar stoṅ pa yin pas na ñon moṅs pa ñid kyaṅ med la phuṅ
por gyur pa’aṅ med pa’o.ñon moṅs pa ’di dag rtogs pa’i phyir byaṅ chub ste źes bya ba ni
ñon moṅs pa goṅ du smos pa’i tshul ṅo bo ñid med par rtogs pa ñid byaṅ chub bo źes bya ba’i
don to, ñon moṅs pa’i ṅo bo ñid gaṅ yin pa, byaṅ chub kyi ṅo bo ñid kyaṅ de yin no źes
bya ba ni ñon moṅs pa’i ṅo bo ñid stoṅ pa’i ṅo bo, byaṅ chub kyi ṅo bo yaṅ stoṅ pa’i ṅo bo
ste, de gñis don dam pa ñid du ro gcig pas de skad ces bya’o, yaṅ na ñon moṅs pa’i ṅo bo
stoṅ pa gaṅ yin pa de ñid byaṅ chub ste, byaṅ chub kyaṅ de las gźan ma yin pas na de skad
ces bya’o.’di ltar dran pa ñe bar ’jog kyaṅ ci la yaṅ ñe bar mi ’jog ces bya ba la sogs pa
mi dmigs pa’i tshul gyis ñe bar ’jog gi mtshan ma’i sgo nas dran pa ñe bar mi ’jog go źes
bya ba’i don to, yaṅ na kun rdzob kyi mtshan ñid tsam du de ltar ñe bar ’jog kyaṅ don dam
par gaṅ yaṅ ñe bar ’jog pa med do źes bya ba’i don to, ñe bar mi ’jog pa ni ñan pa’i dus
na ñe bar mi ’jog pa’o, rab tu mi ’jog pa ni sems pa’i dus na ñe bar mi ’jog pa’o, rnam par
mi ’jog pa ni bsgom pa’i dus na sems la mi ’jog pa’o.

chos ñid de gnas pa rab tu śes źes bya ba ni stoṅ pa’i chos ñid de ye nas de bźin du mi ’gyur
ba yin par śes pa ste, de bas na chos kyi dbyiṅs gnas pa źes bya’o.

saṅs rgyas kyi chos la rton pa yin te, de chos thams cad kyaṅ saṅs rgyas kyi chos su mos so
źes bya ba ni byaṅ chub sems dpa’ de saṅs rgyas kyi chos la rton ciṅ gnas pa yin te, ji ltar
źe na? ’dus byas daṅ ’dus ma byas kyi chos thams cad saṅs rgyas bcom ldan ’das kyis ji
ltar mkhyen pa la rton te, de bźin du tha dad do źes bya ba’i don to.de zad pa śes pa yaṅ
skyed de ’dus byas kyaṅ zad par mi byed do źes bya ba la, dran pa ñe bar gźag pa la gnas pa’i
byaṅ chub sems dpa’ de śes bya daṅ ñon moṅs pa’i sgrib pa daṅ chos thams cad mtshan mar
dmigs pa don dam par śes kyaṅ, kun rdzob tu ’dus byas kyi chos la zad par mi byed pa med
par mi lta ba’o; yaṅ na bdag med par khoṅ du chud par byas nas ñon moṅs pa thams cad spaṅs
pa’i ye śes kyaṅ bskyed la, khams gsum du skye bar byed pa’i rgyu dge ba mṅon par ’du byed
pa yaṅ gtoṅ bar mi byed ces bya ba’i don to.mi skye ba śes pa yaṅ mṅon par sgrub ste, de
sems can la lta ba yaṅ skyed ciṅ mi skye ba’i mtha’ yaṅ mi spoṅ ṅo źes bya ba ni thog ma
nas ma skyes par śes pa’i ye śes thob kyaṅ, kun rdzob tu sems can gyi don la lta ba’aṅ skyed
de, de skyed kyaṅ skye ba ’ba’ źig la mi phyogs kyi, mi skye ba’i chos ñid kyaṅ mi gtoṅ
ṅo źes bya ba’i don to.

chos dran pa ñe bar gźag pa’i don bsdu źiṅ, ji ltar chos dran pa ñe bar gźag pa yin par mdor
bstan pa’i phyir chos dran pa ñe bar gźag pa źes bya ba la sogs pa gsuṅs te, ñan thos daṅ
raṅ saṅs rgyas kyi chos ’og nas miṅ gis smos pa thams cad stoṅ pa ñid du rtogs pa’i dran
pa de la gnas pas na chos dran pa ñe bar gźag pa źes bya’o.

dran pa’i don bstan pa’i phyir phyi ma’i mtha’i bar du yaṅ dran pa des mi brjed ces bya ba la
sogs pa gsuṅs te, sems can gyi mtha’ daṅ ’khor ba’i mtha’ ji srid yod kyi bar du rtogs pa’i
dran pa de ñams par mi ’gyur źes bya ba’i don to. de bas na chos thams cad ma lus par
źes tshig phyi ma daṅ sbyar ro.dran pa ñe bar gźag pa źes bya ba de ni tshad med pa śin tu
bstan pa’i tshig ste źes bya ba la, chos dran pa ñe bar gźag ces bya ba’i tshig de ni tshad
med pa śin tu bstan pa’i tshig ste, ji ltar tshad med pa śin tu bstan pa’i tshig yin pa
ni chos thams cad la dmigs so źes sṅar yaṅ bśad la, kun tu spyod yul źes bya ba la sogs pa
’og nas ’byuṅ ba’i tshig gis kyaṅ bstan to. de ltar mod kyi mdor na dran par bya ba’i chos
rnams tshad med de, mi zad pa’i phyir ram, phyi ma’i mtha’i bar du yaṅ dran pa de mi brjed
ciṅ ñams par mi ’gyur ba’i phyir tshad med pa’i don to.kun tu spyod yul źes bya ba ni
śes bya thams cad kyaṅ dran pa de’i spyod yul du gyur pa ste, thams cad du khyab par dmigs
źes bya ba’i don to; thams cad yaṅ dag par ’du ba ni dran pa der stobs daṅ mi ’jigs pa la
sogs pa’i saṅs rgyas kyi chos thams cad yaṅ dag par ’du ba’i phyir ro; tshim par byed pa
ni sems can la phan ’dogs śiṅ sems can daṅ bskyed par byed pa’o; pham par byed pa ni bdud
thams cad ’joms par byed pa’o; rtogs par byed pa ni rnam par mi rtog pa’i ye śes raṅ gis rig
par byed pa’o. de ltar kun byed pa’i tshig de ni chos la chos kyi rjes su lta ba’i dran
par ñe bar gźag pa źes bya’o.

’di ni chos dran pa ñe bar gźag pa mi zad pa bsgom pa ste, dran pa ñe bar gźag pa bźi bsgom
pa mi zad pa bśad zin to.

## 38th-41st akṣaya: Catuḥsamyakprahāṇa

brtson ’grus śin tu gñen por gyur pa daṅ, brtson ’grus śin tu sbyaṅ pa daṅ, brtson ’grus thob
pa daṅ, brtson ’grus śin tu brtan pa bstan pa’i phyir btsun pa śa ra dva ti’i bu gźan yaṅ
byaṅ chub sems dpa’ rnams kyi yaṅ dag pa’i spoṅ ba bźi yaṅ mi zad pa ste źes bya ba la sogs
pa gsuṅs so. ’dir yaṅ bstan pa daṅ bśad pa’i tshul du rig par bya ste, bźi gaṅ źe na?
źes bya ba nas brtsams te, sems rab tu ’dzin ciṅ yaṅ dag par rab tu ’jog pa źes bya ba yan
chad ni bstan pa’i tshul lo, de man chad lhag ma rnams ni bśad pa’i tshul lo.bźi po de dag
mi zad pa yaṅ spaṅ bar bya ba daṅ bsgrub par bya ba’i chos rnams mi zad pa’i phyir ro –
"Those four are imperishable (akṣaya) since the moments of existence to be eliminated (prahātavya)
and to be attained (pratipādya) are imperishable (akṣaya)".

rgal ba sdig pa mi dge ba’i chos ma skyes pa mi skyed pa daṅ, skyes pa spoṅ ba la ni yaṅ dag
pa’i spoṅ ba źes bya bar ’os na, dge ba’i chos ma skyes pa bskyed pa daṅ skyes pa gnas par
bya ba la yaṅ dag pa’i spoṅ ba źes ji ltar gdags śe na? de gñis la gdags par mi rigs pa
’dra mod kyi, dge ba bskyed pa daṅ gnas par bya ba’i mi mthun pa’i phyogs spaṅs pa daṅ, bskyed
ciṅ gnas par ’gyur ba’i phyir mi mthun pa’i phyogs spoṅ ba la yaṅ dag par spoṅ ba źes
bya bas ñes pa med do – "It is appropriate to use the term ‘correct elimination (samyakprahāṇa)’
for [action] ’so that sinful and bad moments of existence which have not yet arisen
should not arise (anutpannānāṃ pāpakānām akuśalānāṃ dharmāṇām anutpādāya)’ and ’so those
which have arisen should be eliminated (utpannānāṃ prahāṇam)’, but how can [action] ’so that
good moments of existence which have not yet arisen may arise (anutpannānāṃ kuśalānāṃ
dharmāṇām utpādāya)’ and ’so that those which have arisen should remain (utpannānāṃ sthitiḥ)’
be designated ’correct elimination (samyakprahāṇa)’? Designating the two thus seems contrary
to logic (ayukta), but there is no inconsistency, since the contrary to the production
and preservation of the good is eliminated, and the term ’correct elimination (samyakprahāṇa)’
refers to the elimination of the contrary (vipakṣaprahāṇa) for the sake of producing
and preserving [the good]."There is also a word-play on prahāṇa from prahā- "to give up",
etc., deriving it from pradhā- "to exert oneself", etc., giving prahāṇa also the meaning
of "exertion", on the basis of pradadhāti appearing in the text. On this cf. Edg. s. v.

brtson ’grus śin tu gñen por gyur pa’i byaṅ chub sems dpa’ gaṅ źe na? gaṅ yaṅ dag pa’i spoṅ
ba daṅ po la źugs pa ste, mi dge ba’i chos ma skyes pa rnams kyi gñen po bsgom par bya ba
la sgom par byed pa’o. de’i dbaṅ du byas nas gaṅ sdig pa mi dge ba’i chos gaṅ ma skyes pa
rnams mi skyed pa’i phyir ’dun pa skyed ces bya ba ni tshul bźin yid la byed pa’i tshig bla
dags so źes bya ba la sogs pa gsuṅs so – "What is the bodhisattva really producing the antidote
which is vigour (vīryasupratipakṣabhūta)? It is the one progressing in the first kind
of correct elimination (prathamasamyakprahāṇapratipanna), who cultivates by meditation
the antidote to bad moments of existence which have not yet arisen (anutpannānām akuśalānāṃ
dharmāṇāṃ pratipakṣabhāvanāṃ bhāvayati). With reference to him (tam adhipatiṃ kṛtvā) it
is said ..."243a5-b1: sdig pa mi dge ba’i chos ma skyes pa rnams mi skyed pa’i phyir ’dun
pa skyed ces kyaṅ bya, tshul bźin yid la byed ces kyaṅ bya ste, ’dun pa skyed ces bya ba
ni tshul bźin yid la byed pa’i tshig bla dags so.ṭ then comments on the basis of Śbh fol.
10B35-6, S p. 30711-3083, D fol. 113a2-4, not in W:de la sdig pa mi dge ba’i chos ni gaṅ ’dod
pa na spyod pa’i lus daṅ ṅag daṅ yid kyi las ñes par spyod pas yoṅs su bsdus pa daṅ, de
skyed par byed pa’i ñon moṅs pa rnams so; ma skyes pa ni chos de mṅon du ma gyur ciṅ ñe
bar ma gyur pa’o; mi skyed pa ni mṅon du mi ’byuṅ ba daṅ ñe bar mi ’gyur bar bya’o; ’dun pa
bskyed pa ni de’i gñen por gyur pa źi gnas la sogs pa’i mtshan ma yid la byed pa la mi brten
par mi gtsaṅ ba la sogs pa’i gñen po ñi tshe sgom par byed pa ste, de bas na ’dun pa
skyed pa ni tshul bźin yid la byed pa’i tshig bla dags so – tatra katame pāpakā akuśalā dharmā
yat kāmāvacaraṃ kliṣṭaṃ kāyakarma vākkarma manaskarma kāyavāṅmanoduścaritasaṃgṛhītaṃ/
ye tatsamutthāpakāḥ kleśās/ te punar ye asamavahitā asaṃmukhībhūtās te anutpannā (6) [ye
samavahitāḥ saṃmukhībhūtās te utpannāḥ/ tatra kuśalā dharmā ye] tatprātipakṣikā [dharmā duścaritaprātipakṣikā
nivaraṇaprātipakṣikāḥ] ...Notes to the Sanskrit text: 1) MS, S yena for
ye cf. D 2) MS, S om. daṇḍa 3) As D ma skyes pa and ṭ, MS, S utpannā 4) MS om daṇḍa 5) Parts
in brackets not in ṭ’bad brtson ’grus rtsom źes bya ba de ni tshul bźin yid la byed pa
mi ’dor ba’i tshig bla dags so źes bya ba la, ’dir yaṅ sdig pa mi dge ba’i chos ma skyes
pa źes bya ba sbyar te, ’bad brtson ’grus rtsom źes kyaṅ bya, tshul bźin yid la byed pa mi
’dor mi gtoṅ źes kyaṅ bya ste, de bas na ’bad brtson ’grus rtsom źes bya ba ni tshul bźin
yid la byed pa mi ’dor ba’i tshig bla dags so.Śbh fol. 10A42-3, S p. 30814-3092, D fol.
113a7-b3, not in W:de la sdig pa mi dge ba’i chos de dag kyaṅ ’das pa’i dṅos po la dmigs pa
daṅ, ma ’oṅs pa’i dṅos po la dmigs pa daṅ, da ltar gyi yul la dmigs nas skye’o. de ltar
na de dag ni lkog tu gyur pa’i yul la dmigs pa daṅ, mṅon sum du gyur pa’i yul la dmigs pa
ste, gaṅ ’das pa daṅ ma ’oṅs pa’i dṅos po la dmigs pa ni lkog tu gyur pa’i yul la dmigs pa’o;
da ltar gyi yul la dmigs pa ni mṅon sum gyi yul la dmigs pa’o. de la lkog tu gyur pa’i
yul la dmigs pa’i sdig pa mi dge ba’i chos ma skyes pa rnams mi skyed pa ni ’bad do, mṅon
sum du gyur pa’i yul la dmigs pa’i sdig pa mi dge ba’i chos ma skyes pa rnams mi skyed pa’i
phyir ni brtson ’grus rtsom mo – te punaḥ pāpakā akuśalā dharmā atītavastvālambanā vā anāgatavastvālambanā
vā varttamānaviṣayālambanā vā utpadyante/ bhavanti parokṣaviṣayālambanāḥ
pratyakṣaviṣayālambanāś ca/ ye atītānāgatavastvālambanās te parokṣaviṣayālambanā ye varttamānaviṣayālambanās
te pratyakṣaviṣayālambanāḥ/ tatra parokṣaviṣayālambanānāṃ pāpa(3)kānām
akuśalānāṃ dharmāṇām anutpannānām anutpādāya/ [utpannānāṃ ca prahāṇāya/] vyāyacchate/ pratyakṣaviṣayālambanānāṃ
punaḥ anutpannānām anutpādāya [-otpannānāṃ ca prahāṇāya] vīryam ārabhate.Notes
to the Sanskrit text: 1) S varta... 2) MS, S om. daṇḍa 3) MS, S ins. daṇḍa 4)
S yenokta... for parokṣa... 5) S atītānāgatāvasthālambanās 6) S ye cokta... for parokṣa...
7) MS ...ā for ...āḥ, om. daṇḍa 8) From D and ṭ, MS, S parokṣālambanānāṃ for parokṣaviṣayālambanānāṃ
9) MS ...ān for āṃ 10) As D, cf. ṭ, MS, S om. anutpannānām 11) Bracketed parts

tshul bźin du rtog pa’i tshig bla dag so źes bya ba la, ’dir yaṅ sdig pa mi dge ba’i chos
ma skyes pa rnams źes bya bar sbyar te, sems rab tu ’dzin ciṅ yaṅ dag par rab tu ’jog ces
kyaṅ bya, tshul bźin du rtog pa źes kyaṅ bya ste, sems rab tu ’dzin ciṅ yaṅ dag par rab tu

S p. 3124-9, D fol. 114b7-115a1, not in W:de la sems rab tu ’dzin pa źes bya ba ni gaṅ gi
tshe źum pa’i ñon moṅs pa skyes par gyur pa, de’i tshe de bsal bar bya ba’i phyir rab tu
daṅ bar ’gyur ba la sogs pa’i yid la byed pa sems gzuṅ ba ste, gzuṅ źes bya ba ni de’i gñen
po ’phags pa’i lam daṅ de bźin gśegs pa’i yon tan rnams bsams nas sems gzeṅs bstod par bya
źes bya ba’i don to. yaṅ dag par ’jog rab tu ’jog ces bya ba ni rgod pa’i ñe ba’i ñon moṅs
pa skyes pa na sems naṅ du bsdu ba’i tshul gyis rtse gcig tu gźag pa ste, dmigs pa de
ñid la yaṅ daṅ yaṅ du gźag ciṅ ’khor ba’i ñes pa la sogs pa yid la byed pas skyo ba bskyed
pa’o – līnatvābhiśaṃki caivaṃ paśyati/ tadā cānyatamānyatamena pragrāhakena nimittena prasadanīyena
pratigṛhṇāti/ saṃharṣayaty e(7)vaṃ cittaṃ pragṛhṇāti/ kathaṃ pradadhāti/ punar
uddhatam auddhatyābhiśaṃki vā pragrahakāle paśyati/ tadā punar apy adhyātmam abhisaṃkṣipati/
...Notes to the Sanskrit text: 1) S anya... for cānya...

de ci’i phyir źe na źes bya ba ni ’dri ba ste, ’dun pa skyed pa daṅ ’bad de brtson ’grus rtsom
pa daṅ sems rab tu ’dzin ciṅ yaṅ dag par rab tu ’jog pa de dag la ci’i phyir tshul bźin
źes bya ṅe na źes bya ba’i don to. lan du tshul bźin rab tu sbyor ba ni źes bya ba la sogs
pa gsuṅs te, sdig pa mi dge ba’i chos rnams kyi gñen po daṅ źum pa daṅ rgod pa’i gñen po
bsgom pa rnams ni de daṅ mi mthun pa sdig pa mi dge ba’i chos rnams la mi ’jug ste, de bas
na de dag ni tshul bźin gyi tshig bla dags so.

de la sdig pa mi dge ba’i chos gaṅ źe na? gaṅ bslab pa gsum mthar dbyuṅ bar bya ba daṅ mi mthun
pa’i chos rnams so. de dag dṅos po gaṅ yin pa bstan pa’i phyir tshul khrims kyi mi (276a)
mthun pa’i phyogs źes bya ba la sogs pa gsuṅs so.

tshul khrims ñams pa daṅ źes bya ba ni gaṅ yan lag drug pa’i tshul khrims ñams pa ñid sdig pa
mi dge ba’i chos so. gaṅ dag gźan gyi tshul khrims kyaṅ ñams par byed pa źes bya ba la,
gźan dag tshul khrims ñams par byed pa’i rgyu’i chos rnams kyaṅ sdig pa mi dge ba’i chos źes
bya’o.The following is an abridged quotation with some variations from Śbh fol. 2B25ff,
S p. 452ff, D fol. 19a3ff:Fol. 2B25-6, S p. 452-7, W p. 69, D fol. 19a3-5: de yaṅ gaṅ źe
na? rgyu bcu ste: 1) daṅ po nas legs par ma blaṅs pa daṅ, 2) lhod par byed pa daṅ, 3) log
par ’dzin pa daṅ, 4) bag med pa daṅ le los yoṅs su zin pa daṅ, 5) log par smon pa daṅ, 6)
spyod lam ñams par gyur pa daṅ, 7) ’tsho ba ñams par gyur pa daṅ, 8) mtha’ gñis su ltuṅ ba
daṅ, 9) ’byuṅ bar mi byed pa daṅ, 10) yi dam blaṅs pa ñams pa’o – katamair daśabhiḥ kāraṇair
vipanno bhavati/ ādita eva durgṛhīto bhavaty atilīno bhavaty atisṛto bhavati pramādakausīdyaparigṛhīto
bhavati/ mithyā praṇihito bhavati/ ācāravipattyā pa(6)rigṛhīto bhavaty ājīvavipattyā
parigṛhīto bhavaty antadvayapatito bhavati/ anairyāṇiko bhavati/ samādānaparibhraṣṭaś
ca bhavati/Fol. 2B26-7, 1B86-7, 1A91-1A103, S p. 458-5111, D fol. 19a5-21b2, not in
W:1) de la ji ltar daṅ po nas legs par ma blaṅs śe na? ’di ltar rgyal po’i ’jigs pas sam,
rkun po’i ’jigs pas sam, ’tsho ba med pa’am, de la sogs pa’i rkyen gźan gyi phyir blaṅs
pa’o – tatra katham ādito durgṛhītaṃ śīlaṃ bhavati/ yathāpīhaikatyo rājābhinirbhīto vā pravrajitaś
caurābhinirbhīto vā ṛṇārtto vā bhayārtto vā ājīvikābhayabhīto vā na śrāmaṇyāya (7)
na brāhmaṇyāya nātmaśamāya nātmadamāya nātmaparinirvvāṇāyaivam ādito (1B86) durgṛhītaṃ bhavati/2)
ji ltar na lhod par byed pa źe na? ’di la kha cig tshul khrims blaṅs nas kyaṅ ṅo
tsha med pa daṅ, ’gyod pa chuṅ ba daṅ, bslab pa’i gnas rnams la lhod par byed pa’o – katham
atilīnaṃ bhavati/ yathāpīhaikatyaḥ alajjībhavati mandakaukṛtyaḥ/ [śaithilikaḥ śithilakārī]
śikṣāpadeṣv evam atilīnaṃ bha(7)vati.3) ji ltar na log par ’dzin pa gaṅ źe na? kha cig
log par ’dzin pa daṅ ldan pa yin te, gnas ma yin pa la ’gyod par gyur ciṅ ’gyod pa des dge
ba’i bar du gcod par byed pa’o – katham atisṛtaṃ bhavati/ yathāpīhaikatyo durgṛhītagrāhī
bhavaty asthānakaukṛtyaḥ/ saukṛtyakaraṇīyeṣu sthāneṣu kaukṛtyāyamānaḥ asthāne pareṣām antike
paribhavacittaṃ vā āghātaṃ votpādayati/ pravedayaty evam atisṛtaṃ (1A9) bhavati/4) ji
ltar na bag med pa daṅ le los yoṅs su zin pa yin źe na? la la dag daṅ po nas ñes pa mi ’byuṅ
bar dam bca’ ba med ciṅ ñes pa byuṅ nas yaṅ slar chos bźin gso bar mi byed la, ñal ba daṅ
’phres pa daṅ, gñid kyi bde ba rnams lhur len par byed pa’o – kathaṃ pramādakausīdyaparigṛhītaṃ
bhavati/ yathāpīhaikatyo [yām a]tītam adhvānam upādāyāpattim āpannaḥ/ sā cānena smṛtisaṃpramoṣād
ekatyā na yathādharmaṃ pratikṛtā bhavati/ ..(2)... na ca pūrvvam evāpatter
āyatyām anadhyāpattaye tīvram autsukyam āpadyate/ yan nv ahaṃ tathā tathā careyaṃ yathā yathā
caran viharaṃś cāpattiṃ nādhyāpadyeya/ tathā ca tathā carati viharati yathāpattim adhyāpadyate/
...(3)... nidrāsukhaṃ śayanasukhaṃ pārśvasukhaṃ ca svīkaroti/ ...5) ji ltar na
log par smon pa yin źe na? tshul khrims sam, brtul źugs sam, dka’ thub ’dis lha’am, lha gaṅ
yaṅ ruṅ ba’am, rñed pa daṅ bkur sti daṅ ldan par gyur cig ces smos pa’o – kathaṃ mithyāpraṇihitaṃ
bhavati/ yathāpīhaikatyaḥ praṇidhāya brahmacaryaṃ carati/ anenāhaṃ śīlena vā vratena
vā tapasā vā brahmacaryavāsena vā devo vā syāṃ devānyatamo vā/ lābhasatkārakāmo bhavati/
parataḥ lābhasatkāraṃ prārthayate/ lābhasatkārasya spṛhayati/ evaṃ mithyāpraṇihitaṃ bhavati/6)
ji ltar na spyod lam ñams par gyur pa yin źe na? de la kha cig spyod lam daṅ, ’phral
gyi bya ba daṅ, dge ba la sbyor ba rnams ’jig rten daṅ mi mthun źiṅ ’jig rten daṅ ’gal
ba daṅ, ’dul ba daṅ mi mthun źiṅ ’dul ba daṅ ’gal bar byed pa’o – katham ācāravipattyā parigṛhītaṃ
bhavati/ yathāpīhaikatya īryāpathaṃ vādhiṣṭhāya itikaraṇīyam vā kuśalapa(5)kṣaprayogaṃ
vā lokotkrāntaś ca bhavati/ vinayotkrāntaś ca pūrvavad evam ācāravipattyā parigṛhītaṃ
bhavati//7) ji ltar ’tsho ba ñams par ’gyur ba yin źe na? ’di la kha cig chog mi śes pa
’dod pa maṅ ba daṅ, gso dka’ ba dgaṅ dka’ ba ste, chos ma yin pa lhuṅ bzed daṅ chos gos la
sogs pa tshol bar byed pa’o – katham ājīvavipattyā parigṛhītaṃ bhavati/ yathāpīhaikatyo
maheccho bhavaty asaṃtuṣṭaḥ durmmoṣo durdharajātīyaḥ sa cādharmeṇa cīvaraṃ paryeṣate/ na dharmeṇādharmeṇa
piṇḍapātaṃ ...(6)... paryeṣate/ ...(1B9)...8) ji ltar na mtha’ gñis su lhuṅ
ba źe na? ’di la kha cig ’dod pa’i bsod ñams la lhag par źen nas, ’dod pa’i chos rnams la
bag med par spyod pa daṅ; la la dag tsher ma la gnas ’cha’ ba daṅ, thal ba’i naṅ na gnas
pa la sogs pa dka’ thub mi bzad par ’dzin par byed pa’o – katham antadvayapatitaṃ bhavati/
yathāpīhaikatyaḥ kāmasukhallikānuyukto bhavati/ adhyavasitaḥ [parapratilabdhān dharmeṇa
vā adharmeṇa vā cīvarapiṇḍapātaśaya(6)nāsanaglānapratyayabhaiṣajyapariṣkārān] paribhuṅkte/
... punar aparam ihaikatya [ātmaklamathānuyukto bhavaty]...(7)... tad yathā kaṇṭakāpāśrayo
vā bhavati/ bhasmāpāśrayo [musalāpāśrayaḥ/ ...(1A10)...9) ji ltar na ’byuṅ bar mi byed pa
źe na? la la dag tshul khrims daṅ brtul źugs sam lta ba mchog tu ’dzin pa ste, tshul khrims
’di ñid dam, brtul źugs ’di ñid kyis thar pa daṅ grol bar ’gyur źes lta ba’o – katham
anairyāṇikaṃ bhavati/ yathāpīhai(2)katyaḥ śīlaṃ vā vratam vā dṛṣṭyā parāmṛśati/ anenaiva śīlena
vā vratena vā śuddhir bhaviṣyati/ muktir niryāṇaṃ bhaviṣyatīti/ ...10) ji ltar na yi
dam blaṅs pa ñams pa źe na? la la dag thams cad nas thams cad du ṅo tsha med ciṅ sdig pa
mi dge ba’i chos byed pa la mi ’dzem pa, tshul khrims ñams pa tshig pa’i chos can khoṅ du
rul ba, luṅ boṅ ltar kun tu spyod pa, dge sbyoṅ ma yin par dge sbyoṅ du khas ’che ba dag go
– kathaṃ samādānaparibhraṣṭaṃ bhavati/ yathāpīhaikatyaḥ sarvveṇa sarvam alajjībha(3)vati/
nirapekṣaḥ śrāmaṇye sa ca bhavati/ duḥśīlaḥ pāpadharmā antaḥpūtir avasrutaḥ kaśambakajātaḥ/
śaṃkhasvarasamācāraḥ/ aśramaṇaḥ śramaṇapratijñaḥ abrahmacārī brahmacāripratijña evaṃ samādānaparibhraṣṭaṃ
bhavati/Notes to the Sanskrit text: 1) Cf. infra ati.. W, S ani... MS
? 2) S // for / 3) As confirmed by ṭ, D gtses S, probably also MS ...nirṇṇīto 4) Change to
another folio. Last syllable before change ta, first after change dur, but to before mark

[a]yam for śikṣāpadeṣv evam 8) MS ...to 9) D confirms with kun nas mnar sems kyi sems,

de yaṅ 11) MS, S om. daṇḍa 12) MS, S ins. daṇḍa 13) S ...rvv... 14) MS ...yampa... 15) MS,

D gźan dag las thob pa’i .... lhag par chags pa (yoṅs su spyod par byed ciṅ ) 17) Bracketed
part abbreviated in ṭ 18) S bhasmādāyī 19) MS, S kaśambodakajātaḥ 20) MS ...a for ...aḥ

cho ga ñams źes bya ba ni tiṅ ṅe ’dzin ñams pa’o. gaṅ dag gźan gyi sems kyaṅ rnam par g-yeṅ
bar byed pa’i chos ci yaṅ ruṅ ste źes bya ba ni gźan dag tiṅ ṅe ’dzin las ñams par byed ciṅ,
sems g-yeṅ bar ’gyur ba’i chos gaṅ yaṅ ruṅ rnams kyaṅ sdig pa mi dge ba’i chos źes bya’o.
de yaṅ chos gos daṅ lhuṅ bzed la sogs pa’i yo byad la chags pa maṅ ba daṅ, lus la nad maṅ
ba daṅ, kha zas la maṅ du brkam pa daṅ, ’du ’dzi maṅ po’i naṅ na gnas par dga’ ba daṅ ’jig
rten gyi khams kyi bya ba maṅ po la dga’ ba daṅ, smra ba maṅ po la mos pa daṅ, ñal ba
daṅ ’phres pa la sogs pa la dga’ ba’o. For the expressions cf. Śbh p. 485-6

gaṅ ’di ñams pa źes bya ba ni rtag pa’am chad par lta bar gyur pa’o. gaṅ dag gźan gyi lta ba
yaṅ ñams par byed pa źes bya ba la sogs pa ni gźan dag log pa’i lta ba la źen par ’gyur ba’i
rgyu ñon moṅs pa mṅon du ’byuṅ ba daṅ sgrib pa daṅ tshor bar ’gyur ba’i chos goṅ du bśad
pa rnams kyaṅ sdig pa mi dge ba’i chos źes bya’o.

brtson ’grus rab tu sbyaṅs pa’i byaṅ chub sems dpa’ gaṅ źe na? gaṅ yaṅ dag pa’i spoṅ ba gñis
pa la rab tu źugs pa ste, mi dge ba’i chos skyes pa rnams śin tu sbyaṅs pa sgom par byed
pa’o. de’i dbaṅ du byas nas gaṅ yaṅ sdig pa mi dge ba’i chos skyes pa rnams źes bya ba la
sogs pa gsuṅs te, sdig pa mi dge ba’i chos ni goṅ du bśad pa rnams so, skyes pa ni mṅon sum
du gyur pa’o, goṅ du bśad pa daṅ mthun pa rnams ni ’dir ma bśad do, sṅar bśad pa bźin du
blta bar bya’o – "What is the bodhisattva tranquilizing with vigour (vīryapraśrabdha)? He
is the one progressing in the second kind of correct elimination (dvitīyasamyakprahāṇapratipanna),
who cultivates the allaying of bad moments of existence which have arisen (utpannānām
akuśalānāṃ dharmāṇāṃ praśrabdhiṃ bhāvayati). With reference to him (tam adhipatiṃ kṛtvā)
it is said ..."

de ci’i phyir źe na źes bya ba ni sdig pa mi dge ba’i chos skyes pa rnams spaṅ ba’i phyir ’dun
pa bskyed pa la sogs pa la ci’i phyir tshul bźin yid la byed pa źes bya źe na źes bya ba’i
don to. mi dge ba’i chos de dag sems la phuṅ por gyur pa med ces bya ba ni sdig pa mi
dge ba’i chos skyes pa de dag skyes ma thag tu ’gags te med par gyur pas sems la bcer ciṅ
phuṅ por gyur pa med de, de bas na phyi naṅ gi yul daṅ phyogs na mi gnas śiṅ miṅ daṅ mtshan
mar gdags par mi nus źes bya’o.

gal te sdig pa mi dge ba’i chos skyes pa de dag med pa yin na, de dag med pas spaṅ ba’i rtsol
ba mi dgos la, spaṅ ba źes ’byuṅ ba yaṅ ji lta bu sñam pa la sdig pa mi dge ba’i chos de
dag sems la kun tu ’byuṅ ba źes bya ba la sogs pa gsuṅs te, sems la kun tu ’byuṅ ba ni chos
de dag sems las skyes pa’o.ji ltar spaṅ bar śes pa ni spaṅ bar śes pa’o, ji ltar spaṅ bar
śes pa bstan pa’i phyir rgyu daṅ dmigs pa gaṅ gis źes bya ba la sogs pa gsuṅs te; rgyu
ni tshul bźin ma yin pa yid la byed pa’am, ñon moṅs pa’i bag chags so; dmigs pa ni ñon moṅs
pa skye bar ’gyur ba’i yul rnams so. gaṅ gis sdug pa’i rnam par ’dod chags źes bya ba ni
ñon moṅs pa’i rgyu daṅ dmigs pa gaṅ gis rgyu daṅ dmigs pa byas nas sdug par ’dzin pa’i rnam
pa’i ’dod chags skyes pa’am źes bya ba la sogs par sbyar ro. de dag la źes bya ni ñon moṅs
pa skye bar ’gyur ba’i yul daṅ dmigs pa la’o, ’di dag ces bya ba ni ’dod chags la sogs
pa’i ñon moṅs pa dag yin no.

tha sñad btags pa’i gzuṅ gis źes bya ba ni mi sdug pas ’dod chags źi bar byed ces bya ba la
sogs pa ni tha sñad du btags pa tsam du zad kyi, don dam par na de la spaṅ bar bya ba daṅ
spoṅ bar byed pa gñi ga med do, chos thams cad stoṅ pa ñid du mñam par gnas śiṅ, ’phags pa’i
ye śes kyis mṅon sum du gyur pas na spaṅ bar bya ba med do. de’i phyir źes bya ba ni tha
sñad la sñegs te, gñen pos mi mthun pa’i phyogs spoṅ ba’i phyir źes bya ba’i don to. The
"etymology" is based on the similarity of the words samyak and samatāpratyakṣa.

brtson ’grus thob pa’i byaṅ chub sems dpa’ ni yaṅ dag par spoṅ ba gsum pa la rab tu źugs pa
ste, dge ba’i chos ma skyes pa rnams thob pa’i bsgom par bya ba la sgom par byed pa’o. de’i
dbaṅ du byas nas gaṅ dge ba’i chos ma skyes pa rnams bskyed pa’i phyir źes bya ba la sogs
pa gsuṅs te, dge ba’i chos ni tshul khrims la sogs pa bslab pa gsum po, ma skyes pa ni mṅon
du ma gyur pa’o, bskyed pa’i phyir bya ba ni mṅon du bya ba’i phyir ro – "What is the
bodhisattva who has attained vigour (vīryaprāpta)? He is the one progressing in the third
correct elimination (tṛtīyasamyakprahāṇapratipanna), who cultivates by meditation the attainment
of good moments of existence which have not yet arisen (anutpannānām kuśalānāṃ dharmāṇāṃ
prāptibhāvanāṃ bhāvayati). With reference to him (tam adhipatiṃ kṛtvā) it is said ..."

de ci’i phyir źe na źes bya ba ni dge ba’i chos ma skyes pa rnams bskyed pa’i phyir ’dun pa
bskyed pa la sogs pa la ci’i phyir, tshad med pa’i tshig śin tu bstan pa źes bya źe na źes
bya ba’i don to.dge ba’i chos ni sbyin pa la sogs pa pha rol tu phyin pa rnams so, ’dun pa
ni dge ba’i chos thams cad kyi rtsa ba’o źes bya ba la byaṅ chub sems dpa’ rnams kyi sgrub
pa’i dge ba’i chos ni tshad med de, de sgrub par ’dun pa yaṅ tshad med pas de bas na de
ni tshad med pa’i tshig śin tu bstan pa’o; dge ba’i chos bsgrub par ’dun pa las bsgrub pa
’byuṅ źiṅ dge ba’i chos skye bar ’gyur bas na ’dun pa ni dge ba’i chos thams cad kyi rtsa
ba źes bya’o. ñams su len par byed ces bya ba ni mthar phyin par byed ces bya ba’i don to.
dge ba’i chos de dag la dpyod ciṅ rnam par ’byed ces bya ba ni smon lam gyi dge ba’i chos
skyes pa de daṅ de dag la so so’i mtshan ñid la rtog ciṅ phyis kyaṅ bskyed par bya bar sems
pa’o.

brtson ’grus rab tu brtan pa’i byaṅ chub sems dpa’ ni gaṅ yaṅ dag par spoṅ ba bźi pa la rab
tu źugs pa ste, dge ba’i chos skyes pa rnams brtan pa’i bsgom par bya ba la sgom par byed
pa’o. de’i dbaṅ du byas nas gaṅ yaṅ dge ba’i chos skyes pa rnams źes bya ba la sogs pa gsuṅs
te – "What is the bodhisattva established in vigour (vīryasupratiṣṭhita)? He is the one
progressing in the fourth correct elimination (caturthasamyakprahāṇapratipanna), who cultivates
by meditation the consolidation of good moments of existence which have arisen (utpannānām
kuśalānāṃ dharmāṇāṃ sthitibhāvanāṃ bhāvayati). With reference to him (tam adhipatiṃ
kṛtvā) it is said ..."246a4-6: gnas pa ni sṅar skyes pa rnams las de las chuṅ bar mi bya’o,
bsgom pa ni sṅar skyes pa las śas chuṅ zad skyed pa’i phyir de dag la yaṅ nas yaṅ du sgom
par byed pa’o, phyir źiṅ ’byuṅ ba ni de bas kyaṅ śas ’briṅ du bskyed par bya ba’i phyir
chuṅ du skyes pa la yaṅ nas yaṅ du sgom par byed pa’o, chud za ba daṅ ñams par mi ’gyur
ba don gcig ste, skyes pa rnams ñams par mi byed pa’o, yaṅ na, chud za bar mi ’gyur ba ni
ñams par mi byed pa’o, ñams par mi ’gyur ba ni brjed par mi bya ba’o, śin tu rgyas par bya
ba ni dge ba’i rtsa ba thams cad mthar thug ciṅ rdzogs par bya ba’o, v. Śbh p. 31017-3123

de ci’i phyir źe na źes bya ba ni dge ba’i rtsa ba’i chos skyes pa rnams ’dug pa la sogs par
byed pa la byaṅ chub tu yoṅs su bsṅos pa’i dge ba’i rtsa ba źes ci’i phyir bya źe na źes
bya ba’i don to. mthar thug gi bar du źes bya ba ni bya ni byaṅ chub kyi sñiṅ po ma thob kyi
bar du źes bya ba’i don to. chud mi za źes bya ba ni med par mi ’gyur, ñams par mi ’gyur
źes bya ba’i tha tshig ste, ’phel bar ’gyur źiṅ rgya cher ’gyur ro źes bya bar sbyar ro.de
ci’i phyir źe na źes bya ba ni byaṅ chub tu bsṅos pa’i dge ba’i rtsa ba de byaṅ chub kyi
sñiṅ po’i bar du mthar ma thug gi bar du bar ma dor ci’i phyir chud za źes bya ba’i don
to. khams gsum pa thams cad la mi gnas pa źes bya ba ni khams gsum du skyes pa’i rgyu mi byed
ces bya ba’i tha tshig go.yoṅs su zad par ’gyur źes bya ba ni khams gsum du ’gyur ba’i
chos de dag ni ’bras bu rnam par smin pa myoṅ nas zad par ’gyur ba’o.

yaṅ dag pa’i spoṅ ba bźi mi zad pa bśad zin to.

## 3rd akṣaya: Prayoga

khur mi ’dor ba’i byaṅ chub sems dpa’ ni sbyor ba la rtag tu byed pa daṅ gus par byed pa gaṅ
yin pa ste, de bstan pa’i phyir gźan yaṅ, btsun pa śa ra dva ti’i bu, byaṅ chub sems dpa’
rnams kyi bsam pa mi zad pas na, sbyor ba mi zad pa yin te źes bya ba la sogs pa gsuṅs so
– "The bodhisattva not putting down the burden (anikṣiptabhāra) always performs his practice
and pays respect..." Cf. 1st Imperishable n. 1, 2nd Imperishable, n. 1, and the introduction.47b5-6:
goṅ du bśad pa’i bsam pa mi zad pa de lta bu las ’og nas ’byuṅ ba’i sbyor ba
mi zad pa rnams ’byuṅ ba’i don to; rnam pa gñis su na goṅ du bśad pa ltar bsam pa mi zad
pas ni gźan yaṅ bsam pa mi zad pa de las ’byuṅ ba’i sbyor ba ’og nas smos pa rnams mi zad
pa’o źes bśad pa’o – "..... The practice (prayoga) described below is imperishable since
it arises from the imperishable intention (āśaya)." The āśayākṣayatvāt in the text may at
some point have been taken from the commentary, as it is left out in T1 p. 188a22.47b6-7:
de ci’i phyir źe na źes bya ba la sogs pas ni bsam pa mi zad pas sbyor ba mi zad par ji ltar
gyur pa’i gtan tshigs ’dri ba’o.The paragraph is divided into five parts, ṭ. fol. 47b7:
sbyor ba mi zad pa yaṅ rnam pa lṅas bstan te, gaṅ źe na? gaṅ la sbyor ba mi zad pa daṅ, gaṅ
gis sbyor ba mi zad pa daṅ, gaṅ la gnas nas sbyor ba mi zad pa daṅ, ji ltar sbyor ba mi
zad pa daṅ, gaṅ gi phyir sbyor ba mi zad pas bstan to.47b7-48a2: de la gaṅ la sbyor ba mi
zad pa yaṅ rnam pa drug ste, phan ’dogs pa’i sbyor ba daṅ, las rnam pa gsum sbyoṅ ba’i sbyor
ba daṅ, gnod pa mi byed pa’i sbyor ba daṅ, mthar ’byin pa’i sbyor ba daṅ, ñon moṅs pa
’jil ba’i sbyor ba daṅ, śes bya rnams la phyin ci ma log par ’jug pa’i sbyor ba’o.

de la sbyin pa’i bsam pa ni byaṅ chub sems dpa’i sbyor ba mi zad pa ste źes bya bas phan ’dogs
pa’i sbyor ba bstan te, sbyin pa gtoṅ bar sems pa’i bsam pa la byaṅ chub sems dpa’i sbyor
ba mi zad pa źes bya ste, ci’i phyir bsam pa de la sbyor ba mi zad pa źes bya źe na? bsam
pa de las gaṅ phyi daṅ naṅ gi dṅos po thams cad yoṅs su gtoṅ bar snaṅ ba de ni byaṅ chub
sems dpa’i sbyor ba mi zad par lta’o – "... It is said that practice with the intention
of thought (cittāśaya) to give gifts is imperishable. Why? The appearance that one gives away
both outer and inner things stemming from that intention is the imperishability of the
bodhisattva’s practice." The other pāramitās are treated similarly in the following.

tshul khrims kyi bsam pa ni byaṅ chub sems dpa’i sbyor ba mi zad pa ste źes bya ba las rnam
gsum sbyoṅ ba’i sbyor ba bstan te, tshul khrims la gnas par sems pa’i bsam pa la byaṅ chub
sems dpa’i sbyor ba mi zad pa źes bya ste, bsam pa de la ci’i phyir sbyor ba mi zad pa źes
bya źe na? bsam pa de’i rgyus gaṅ tshul khrims la sogs pa yaṅ dag par ’dzin par snaṅ ba’i
phyir ro.

bzod pa’i bsam pa ni byaṅ chub sems dpa’i sbyor ba mi zad pa ste źes bya bas gnod pa mi byed
pa’i sbyor ba bstan te, bzod pa la gnas par sems pa’i bsam pa ni byaṅ chub sems dpa’i sbyor
ba mi zad pa ste, de ci’i phyir źe na? bsam pa de’i rgyu las sems can gnod par byed pa
thams cad la źe ’gras pa med pa’i sems su snaṅ ba’i sbyor ’byuṅ ba’i phyir ro.

brtson ’grus kyi bsam pa ni byaṅ chub sems dpa’i sbyor ba mi zad pa ste źes bya bas mthar ’byin
pa’i sbyor ba bstan te, brtson ’grus la gnas par sems pa’i bsam pa ni byaṅ chub sems dpa’i
sbyor ba mi zad pa ste, ci’i phyir źe na? bsam pa de’i rgyu las dge ba’i rtsa ba thams
cad mthar dbyuṅ ba’i sṅon du brtson ’grus ’gro bar snaṅ ba’i phyir ro

bsam gtan gyi bsam pa ni byaṅ chub sems dpa’i sbyor ba mi zad pa ste źes bya bas ñon moṅs pa
’jil ba’i sbyor ba bstan te, bsam gtan la gnas par sems pa’i bsam pa ni byaṅ chub sems dpa’i
sbyor ba mi zad pa źes bya ste, ci’i phyir źe na? gaṅ bsam pa de’i rgyus bsam gtan gyi
mi mthun pa’i phyogs ñon moṅs pa thams cad ’jil źiṅ sbyor bar snaṅ ba’i phyir ro.

śes rab kyi bsam pa ni byaṅ chub sems dpa’i sbyor ba mi zad pa ste źes bya bas śes bya rnams
la phyin ci ma log par ’jug pa’i sbyor ba bstan te, śes rab sgrub par sems pa’i bsam pa la
byaṅ chub sems dpa’i sbyor ba mi zad pa ces bya ste, de ci’i phyir źe na? bsam pa de’i rgyus
thos pa thams cad phyin ci ma log par ’dzin pa’i sbyor bar snaṅ ba’i phyir ro.

gaṅ gis sbyor ba mi zad pa ni tshad med pa bźi’i bsam pas bstan te, byams pa daṅ, sñiṅ rje daṅ,
dga’ ba daṅ, btaṅ sñoms kyi bsam pa ni byaṅ chub sems dpa’i sbyor ba mi zad pa ste źes
gsuṅs pa’o; ci’i phyir tshad med pa bźi’i bsam pa la sbyor ba mi zad pa źes bya źe na? byams
pa’i bsam pas sems can rnams la phan par byed pa daṅ, sñiṅ brtse ba’i bsam pas sems can
rnams la bde bar byed pa daṅ, dga’ ba’i bsam pas sems can rnams chos kyi dga’ ba la mos
par byed pa daṅ, btaṅ sñoms kyi bsam pas sems can rnams la chags sems daṅ khoṅ khro ba spoṅ
bar sbyor ba’i phyir ro, de la mya ṅan las ’das pa daṅ bde ’gror ’jog par byed pa ni phan
par byed pa’o, khams gsum gyi sdug bsṅal las sgrol bar byed pa ni bde bar byed pa’o, ’dod
pa’i ’dod chags la bde ba’i mos pa med pa ni chos kyi dga’ ba la mos pa’o, byams pa daṅ
gnod par sems pa la ’dod chags daṅ źe sdaṅ gi sems med pa de ni chags pa daṅ khoṅ khro ba
spoṅ ba źes bya’o.

gaṅ la gnas nas sbyor ba mi zad pa ni lus daṅ ṅag daṅ yid kyi sdom pa’i sbyor bas bstan te,
lus kyi bsam pa ni byaṅ chub sems dpa’i sbyor ba mi zad pa źes bya ba la sogs pa gsuṅs so;
lus kyi las yoṅs su dag par bya bar sems pa’i bsam pa ni byaṅ chub sems dpa’i sbyor ba mi
zad pa źes bya ste, bsam pa de’i rgyu las lus kyi las rnam gsum gyi sdom pa yoṅs su dag pa’i
sbyor ba ’byuṅ ba’i phyir te, ṅag daṅ yid kyi sdom pa yaṅ de daṅ ’dra bar sbyar ro. lus
kyi las rnam gsum gyi sdom pa ni srog gcod pa daṅ, ma byin par len pa daṅ, ’dod pas log
par g-yem pa spaṅs pa’o. ṅag gi ñes pa rnam pa bźi ni brdzun du smra ba daṅ, phra ma daṅ,
ṅag rtsub mo daṅ, tshig kyal pa ste, de dag spaṅs pa’o – "... The threefold vow of bodily
deeds is to give up taking life (prāṇātighāta), taking what is not given (adattādāna) and
behaving falsely because of cupidity (kāmamithyācāra). The fourfold imperfection of speech
is speaking untruth (mṛṣāvāda), harsh speech (pāruṣya), slanderous speech (paiśunya) and
confused speech (saṃbhinnapralāpa). They are to be given up." Cf. Mvy. 1685-98, where the
three wrong ways of thought are also mentioned.

ji ltar sbyor ba mi zad pa ni chos la slob dpon gyi dpe mkhyud med pa’i phyir, thos pa’i bsam
pa ni byaṅ chub sems dpa’i sbyor ba mi zad pa’o źes bya bas bstan te, byaṅ chub sems dpas
mdo la sogs pa bsam pa rnam par dag ciṅ zaṅ ziṅ med ciṅ thos pa tshol ba’i bsam pa ni sbyor
ba mi zad pa źes bya ste, thos pa’i bsam pa yoṅs su dag pa de las sems can gźan la dpe
mkhyud med pa’i sbyor ba ston pa’i sbyor ba ’byuṅ ba’i phyir ro.

gaṅ gi phyir sbyor ba mi zad pa ni slob dpon gyi dpe mkhyud med pa’i bsam pa ni byaṅ chub sems
dpa’i sbyor ba mi zad pa’o źes bya bas bstan te, slob dpon gyi dpe mkhyud med par ston
pa’i bsam pa ni byaṅ chub sems dpa’i sbyor ba mi zad pa źes bya ste, ci’i phyir źe na? slob
dpon gyi dpe mkhyud med par ston pa de yaṅ thams cad mkhyen pa ñid kyi ye śes thob pa’i
phyir sbyor bas na byaṅ chub sems dpa’i sbyor ba mi zad pa źes bya’o. de la ji ltar yod pa
daṅ ji sñed yod pa kun ma lus par mkhyen pas na thams cad mkhyen pa źes bya’o. gaṅ gi phyir
sbyor ba de ñid kyaṅ rnam pa bco lṅas rgyas par bstan te, gaṅ źe na? gaṅ gi don du sbyor
ba daṅ, mchog gi gnas la sbyor ba daṅ, bla ma’i sa la rjes su ’jug pa’i sbyor ba daṅ, chos
thams cad la dbaṅ sgyur ba’i phyir sbyor ba daṅ, saṅs rgyas kyi tshul rtogs pa’i phyir
sbyor ba daṅ, mi dge ba las dbyuṅ ba’i phyir sbyor ba daṅ, kha na ma tho ba bśags pa’i phyir
sbyor ba daṅ, dge ba la ’jug pa’i phyir sbyor ba daṅ, byaṅ chub kyi tshogs kyi phyir sbyor
ba daṅ, chos kyi ’khor lo bskor ba’i phyir sbyor ba daṅ, bstan pa bzuṅ ba’i phyir sbyor
ba daṅ, dam pa dag pa daṅ mthun pa’i phyir sbyor ba daṅ, kha ’og tu lus ’khrus pa’i phyir
sbyor ba daṅ, go cha’i bsam pa brtan źiṅ mi g-yo ba’i phyir sbyor ba daṅ, gźan gyi don daṅ
phan pa la sbyor ba’o.de la thams cad mkhyen pa’i sems kyi bsam pa ni byaṅ chub sems dpa’i
sbyor ba mi zad pa’o źes bya ba gaṅ gi don du sbyor ba bstan te, thams cad mkhyen pa ñid
kyi ye śes thob par sems pa’i bsam pa ni byaṅ chub sems dpa’i sbyor ba mi zad pa źes bya
ste, ci’i phyir źe na? thams cad mkhyen pa’i ye śes thob nas sems can gźan la yaṅ bla na
med pa’i byaṅ chub kyi sems la ’jog ciṅ, byaṅ chub tu sems skyed pa’i sbyor ba byed pa’i
phyir byaṅ chub sems dpa’i sbyor ba mi zad pa źes bya ste. lhag ma rnams kyaṅ tshul ’dis ci
rigs par bśad par bya’o – "... The bodhisattva’s imperishability of practice (prayogākṣayatā)
is the intention which consists in the aspiration to attain the knowledge of omniscience
(sarvajñatājñānaprāpticittāśaya). Why? Having attained knowledge of omniscience he also
establishes other beings in the thought of incomparable awakening, thus the bodhisatva’s
practice is imperishable since it is performing the practice of producing the thought of
awakening. This also applies to the following."sems can gźan byaṅ chub kyi sems yaṅ dag par
’dzin du ’jug pa’i bsam pa ni byaṅ chub sems dpa’i sbyor ba mi zad pa’o źes bya bas mchog
gi gnas la sbyor ba bstan te, sems can gźan byaṅ chub kyi sems la ’god par sems pa’i bsam
pa las ni sems can rnams ’dod ma chags pa daṅ, źe mi sdaṅ ba daṅ, gti mi mug pa’i dge ba’i
rtsa ba la rab tu ’dzud pa’i sbyor ba ’byuṅ ba’i phyir ro.dge ba’i rtsa ba la sbyor ba’i
bsam pa ni byaṅ chub sems dpa’i sbyor ba mi zad pa’o źes bya bas bla ma’i sa la rjes su
’jug par sbyor ba bstan te, sems can gźan dge ba’i rtsa ba gsum la dgod par sems pa’i bsam
pa las ni dge ba’i rtsa ba thams cad bla na med pa’i byaṅ chub thob pa’i phyir bsṅo ba la
sbyor ba ’byuṅ ba’i phyir ro.byaṅ chub tu yoṅs su bsṅos pa’i bsam pa ni byaṅ chub sems dpa’i
sbyor ba mi zad pa’o źes bya bas chos thams cad la dbaṅ sgyur ba’i phyir sbyor ba bstan
te, dge ba’i rtsa ba thams cad bla na med pa’i byaṅ chub tu bsṅo bar sems pa’i bsam pa
las stobs daṅ mi ’jigs pa la sogs pas saṅs rgyas kyi chos thams cad yaṅ dag par sdud pa’i
sbyor ba ’byuṅ ba’i phyir ro.saṅs rgyas kyi chos thams cad yaṅ dag par sdud pa’i bsam pa ni
byaṅ chub sems dpa’i sbyor ba mi zad pa’o źes bya bas źes bya bas saṅs rgyas kyi tshul rtogs
pa’i phyir sbyor ba bstan te, saṅs rgyas kyi chos thams cad yaṅ dag par sdud par sems
pa’i bsam pa de las dam pa’i chos kun ’dzin pa’i sbyor ba ’byuṅ ba’i phyir ro.dam pa’i chos
kun ’dzin pa’i bsam pa ni byaṅ chub sems dpa’i sbyor ba mi zad pa’o źes bya bas mi dge
ba las ’byuṅ ba’i phyir sbyor ba bstan te, dam pa’i chos kun rtogs par bya ba’i bsam pa las
lus daṅ ṅag daṅ yid gsum gyi sgo nas mi dge ba byas pa kun ’chags śiṅ med par bya ba’i phyir
sbyor ba’i phyi ro.ñes pa bśags pa’i bsam pa ni byaṅ chub sems dpa’i sbyor ba mi zad
pa’o źes bya bas kha na ma tho ba bśags pa’i phyir sbyor bstan te, sdig pa mi dge ba’i chos
bśags par sems pa’ bsam pa las sdig pa thams cad mthol źiṅ med pa’i sbyor ba ’byuṅ ṅo.sdig
pa mthol ba’i bsam pa ni byaṅ chub sems dpa’i sbyor ba mi zad pa’o źes bya bas dge ba la
’jug pa’i sbyor ba bstan te, kha na ma tho ba bśags par sems pa’i bsam pa las so so’i skye
bo daṅ, ñan thos daṅ, raṅ saṅs rgyas daṅ, byaṅ chub sems dpa’ daṅ, de bźin gśegs pa’i bsod
nams thams cad kyi rjes su yi raṅ ba’i sbyor ba ’byuṅ ba’i phyir ro.bsod nams thams cad
kyi rjes su yi raṅ ba’i bsam pa ni byaṅ chub sems dpa’i sbyor ba mi zad pa’o źes bya bas
byaṅ chub kyi tshogs kyi phyir sbyor ba bstan te, bsod nams thams cad kyi rjes su yi raṅ
bar sems pa’i bsam pa las bsod nams kyi tshogs chen po bsags pa’i sbyor ba ’byuṅ ba’i phyir
ro.bsod nams kyi tshogs tshad med par bsags pa’i bsam pa ni byaṅ chub sems dpa’i sbyor ba
mi zad pa’o źes bya bas chos kyi ’khor lo bskor ba’i phyir sbyor ba bstan te, bsod nams
kyi tshogs tshad med pa bsags par sems pa’i bsam pa las de bźin gśegs pa thams cad la chos
kyi ’khor lo bskor bar gsol ba ’debs pa’i sbyor ba ’byuṅ ba’i phyir ro.saṅs rgyas thams cad
la gsol ba ’debs pa’i bsam pa ni byaṅ chub sems dpa’i sbyor ba mi zad pa’o źes bya bas
bstan pa gzuṅ ba’i phyir sbyor ba bstan te, saṅs rgyas thams cad la chos kyi ’khor lo bskor
bar gsol ba ’debs pa’i bsam pa las de bźin gśegs pa rnams kyis gsuṅs pa’i dam pa’i chos
yoṅs su ’dzin pa’i sbyor ba ’byuṅ ba’i phyir te, ’di ni de bźin gśegs pa’i bstan pa yun riṅ
du gnas par bya ba’i phyir sbyor ba yin la, dam pa’i chos kun sṅar ’dzin pa źes sṅar bstan
pa ni raṅ ñid kyis rtogs pa ’dzin pa la bya bas bye brag yod do.dam pa’i chos yoṅs su ’dzin
pa’i bsam pa ni byaṅ chub sems dpa’i sbyor ba mi zad pa’o źes bya bas dam pa dag pa daṅ
mthun pa’i sbyor ba bstan te, dam pa’i chos yoṅs su ’dzin pa’i bsam pa las skyes bu dam
pa’i chos kyi sbyor ba ’byuṅ ba’i phyir ro; de la skyes bu dam pa ni saṅs rgyas daṅ byaṅ
chub sems dpa’ rnams so. de dag gi phrin las ni dam pa’i chos thams cad ’dzin par mdzad pa
ste; de lta bu’i las la sbyor bas na byaṅ chub sems dpa’i sbyor ba mi zad pa źes bya’o.skyes
bu dam pa’i las kyi bsam pa ni byaṅ chub sems dpa’i sbyor ba mi zad pa’o źes bya bas kha
’og tu lus ’khrus pa’i phyir sbyor ba bstan te, skyes bu dam pa rnams kyi las bya bar sems
pa’i bsam pa las bdag daṅ gźan gyi don sgrub bo źes khas blaṅs pa’i khur sgrol ba’i sbyor
ba ’byuṅ ba’i phyir ro.khur blaṅs pa sgrol ba’i bsam pa ni byaṅ chub sems dpa’i sbyor
ba mi zad pa’o źes bya bas go cha bsam pa brtan źiṅ mi g-yo ba’i phyir sbyor ba bstan te,
khur blaṅs pa sgrol ba’i bsam pa las go cha sra źiṅ mi ’dor ba’i sbyor ba ’byuṅ ba’i phyir
